title: KAO: Kernel-Adaptive Optimization in Diffusion for Satellite Image
summary:
Satellite image inpainting is a crucial task in remote sensing, where
accurately restoring missing or occluded regions is essential for robust image
analysis. In this paper, we propose KAO, a novel framework that utilizes
Kernel-Adaptive Optimization within diffusion models for satellite image
inpainting. KAO is specifically designed to address the challenges posed by
very high-resolution (VHR) satellite datasets, such as DeepGlobe and the
Massachusetts Roads Dataset. Unlike existing methods that rely on
preconditioned models requiring extensive retraining or postconditioned models
with significant computational overhead, KAO introduces a Latent Space
Conditioning approach, optimizing a compact latent space to achieve efficient
and accurate inpainting. Furthermore, we incorporate Explicit Propagation into
the diffusion process, facilitating forward-backward fusion, which improves the
stability and precision of the method. Experimental results demonstrate that
KAO sets a new benchmark for VHR satellite image restoration, providing a
scalable, high-performance solution that balances the efficiency of
preconditioned models with the flexibility of postconditioned models.

AI.title_translation: 卫星图像中的核自适应优化：KAO
AI.tldr: KAO框架通过在扩散模型中引入核自适应优化和潜空间条件化，高效且精确地修复了VHR卫星图像，在保持效率的同时提高了灵活性，并在实验中树立了新的修复性能基准。
AI.motivation: 卫星图像修复是遥感中的关键任务，需要准确恢复缺失或遮挡区域以实现稳健的图像分析。现有方法（预处理或后处理）存在需要大量重新训练或计算开销大的问题，尤其是在处理DeepGlobe和Massachusetts Roads Dataset等超高分辨率（VHR）数据集时。
AI.method: 提出KAO框架，利用核自适应优化（Kernel-Adaptive Optimization）于扩散模型中。具体方法包括采用潜空间条件化（Latent Space Conditioning）来优化紧凑的潜空间，并引入显式传播（Explicit Propagation）到扩散过程中以实现前向-后向融合。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，KAO为VHR卫星图像修复设定了新的基准，提供了一个可扩展、高性能的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: KAO为VHR卫星图像修复树立了新的基准，提供了一个在效率和灵活性之间取得平衡的可扩展、高性能解决方案。
AI.translation: 卫星图像修复是遥感中的一项关键任务，准确恢复缺失或遮挡区域对于稳健的图像分析至关重要。在本文中，我们提出了KAO，一个利用扩散模型中核自适应优化（Kernel-Adaptive Optimization）的新框架，用于卫星图像修复。KAO专门设计用于解决超高分辨率（VHR）卫星数据集（如DeepGlobe和Massachusetts Roads Dataset）所带来的挑战。与依赖需要大量重新训练的预处理模型或具有显著计算开销的后处理模型不同，KAO引入了一种潜空间条件化方法，优化一个紧凑的潜空间以实现高效准确的修复。此外，我们将显式传播纳入扩散过程，促进前向-后向融合，从而提高了方法的稳定性和精度。实验结果表明，KAO为VHR卫星图像恢复设定了新的基准，提供了一个在预处理模型的效率和后处理模型的灵活性之间取得平衡的可扩展、高性能解决方案。
AI.summary: KAO是一个用于卫星图像修复的新框架，它将核自适应优化集成到扩散模型中，专门用于解决VHR卫星数据集的挑战。KAO通过优化紧凑的潜空间（潜空间条件化）来高效准确地修复图像，并利用显式传播改进了扩散过程的稳定性和精度，其性能超越了现有方法。
AI.keywords: 卫星图像修复, 扩散模型, 核自适应优化, 潜空间条件化, 高分辨率图像
AI.comments: KAO的创新点在于它将核自适应优化（Kernel-Adaptive Optimization）引入扩散模型，并采用潜空间条件化（Latent Space Conditioning）来高效处理VHR卫星图像，避免了传统预处理模型需要大量重新训练或后处理模型计算开销过大的问题。其重要性在于为高分辨率卫星图像修复提供了一个高效且精确的新基准。局限性可能在于其对特定VHR数据集的优化效果，通用性有待进一步验证。

title: Auditable-choice reframing unlocks RL-based verification for open-ended tasks
summary:
Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated great
potential in enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models
(LLMs), achieving remarkable progress in domains such as mathematics and
programming where standard answers are available. However, for open-ended tasks
lacking ground-truth solutions (e.g., creative writing and instruction
following), existing studies typically regard them as non-reasoning scenarios,
thereby overlooking the latent value of reasoning capabilities. This raises a
key question: Can strengthening reasoning improve performance in open-ended
tasks? To address this, we explore the transfer of the RLVR paradigm to the
open domain. Yet, since RLVR fundamentally relies on verifiers that presuppose
the existence of standard answers, it cannot be directly applied to open-ended
tasks. To overcome this challenge, we introduce Verifiable Multiple-Choice
Reformulation (VMR), a novel training strategy that restructures open-ended
data into verifiable multiple-choice formats, enabling effective training even
in the absence of explicit ground truth. Experimental results on multiple
benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our method in improving LLM
performance on open-ended tasks. Notably, across eight open-ended benchmarks,
our VMR-based training delivers an average gain of 5.99 points over the
baseline. Code will be released upon acceptance to facilitate reproducibility.

AI.title_translation: 可审计选择重构解锁了基于强化学习的开放式任务验证
AI.tldr: 为了解决RLVR无法应用于开放式任务（无标准答案）的问题，本文提出了VMR策略，将开放任务重构为可验证的多项选择题格式，成功地将强化学习中的推理增强技术迁移到开放域，并在实验中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的RLVR在有标准答案的领域（如数学、编程）表现出色，但对于缺乏地面真值（如创意写作、指令遵循）的开放式任务，通常被视为非推理场景，忽略了推理能力的潜在价值。因此，研究如何通过加强推理来提高开放式任务的性能。
AI.method: 引入了可验证多项选择重构（VMR），这是一种新颖的训练策略，它将开放式数据重构为可验证的多项选择格式，从而在没有明确地面真值的情况下实现有效的训练。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上验证了方法的有效性，VMR训练在八个开放式基准测试上平均比基线提高了5.99分。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了VMR方法的有效性，它能提高LLM在开放式任务上的性能。
AI.translation: 强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）在增强大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力方面展现出巨大潜力，在数学和编程等存在标准答案的领域取得了显著进展。然而，对于缺乏地面真值（如创意写作和指令遵循）的开放式任务，现有研究通常将其视为非推理场景，从而忽略了推理能力的潜在价值。这提出了一个关键问题：加强推理能否提高开放式任务的性能？为了解决这个问题，我们将RLVR范式探索性地应用于开放域。然而，由于RLVR本质上依赖于预设标准答案的验证器，它不能直接应用于开放式任务。为克服这一挑战，我们引入了可验证多项选择重构（VMR），一种新颖的训练策略，它将开放式数据重构为可验证的多项选择格式，即使在没有明确地面真值的情况下也能实现有效训练。多个基准测试的实验结果验证了我们方法在提高LLM在开放式任务上的性能方面的有效性。值得注意的是，在八个开放式基准测试中，我们的VMR训练平均比基线提高了5.99分。代码将在接受后发布，以方便重现。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在将强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）范式扩展到缺乏标准答案的开放式任务。为此，研究人员提出了可验证多项选择重构（VMR）策略，该策略将开放式数据重构为可验证的多项选择格式，从而使RLVR能够在没有明确地面真值的情况下进行有效训练，并在多个开放式基准测试中显著提升了大型语言模型的性能。
AI.keywords: RLVR,开放式任务,可验证多项选择重构,大型语言模型,推理能力
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种将RLVR范式迁移到开放域的方法——VMR，通过将开放式任务重构为可验证的多项选择格式，解决了现有RLVR方法依赖标准答案的局限性。其重要性在于拓宽了RLVR的应用范围，并证明了在开放式任务中加强推理能力是有效的。方法的局限性在于它依赖于将任务重构为多项选择格式，这可能引入新的结构性偏差。

title: HAGI++: Head-Assisted Gaze Imputation and Generation
comments:
Extended version of our UIST'25 paper "HAGI: Head-Assisted Gaze
  Imputation for Mobile Eye Trackers"
summary:
Mobile eye tracking plays a vital role in capturing human visual attention
across both real-world and extended reality (XR) environments, making it an
essential tool for applications ranging from behavioural research to
human-computer interaction. However, missing values due to blinks, pupil
detection errors, or illumination changes pose significant challenges for
further gaze data analysis. To address this challenge, we introduce HAGI++ - a
multi-modal diffusion-based approach for gaze data imputation that, for the
first time, uses the integrated head orientation sensors to exploit the
inherent correlation between head and eye movements. HAGI++ employs a
transformer-based diffusion model to learn cross-modal dependencies between eye
and head representations and can be readily extended to incorporate additional
body movements. Extensive evaluations on the large-scale Nymeria, Ego-Exo4D,
and HOT3D datasets demonstrate that HAGI++ consistently outperforms
conventional interpolation methods and deep learning-based time-series
imputation baselines in gaze imputation. Furthermore, statistical analyses
confirm that HAGI++ produces gaze velocity distributions that closely match
actual human gaze behaviour, ensuring more realistic gaze imputations.
Moreover, by incorporating wrist motion captured from commercial wearable
devices, HAGI++ surpasses prior methods that rely on full-body motion capture
in the extreme case of 100% missing gaze data (pure gaze generation). Our
method paves the way for more complete and accurate eye gaze recordings in
real-world settings and has significant potential for enhancing gaze-based
analysis and interaction across various application domains.
comment:
Extended version of our UIST'25 paper "HAGI: Head-Assisted Gaze
  Imputation for Mobile Eye Trackers"

title: MVAFormer: RGB-based Multi-View Spatio-Temporal Action Recognition with Transformer
comments: Selected as Best Industry Paper Award at ICIP2024
summary:
Multi-view action recognition aims to recognize human actions using multiple
camera views and deals with occlusion caused by obstacles or crowds. In this
task, cooperation among views, which generates a joint representation by
combining multiple views, is vital. Previous studies have explored promising
cooperation methods for improving performance. However, since their methods
focus only on the task setting of recognizing a single action from an entire
video, they are not applicable to the recently popular spatio-temporal action
recognition~(STAR) setting, in which each person's action is recognized
sequentially. To address this problem, this paper proposes a multi-view action
recognition method for the STAR setting, called MVAFormer. In MVAFormer, we
introduce a novel transformer-based cooperation module among views. In contrast
to previous studies, which utilize embedding vectors with lost spatial
information, our module utilizes the feature map for effective cooperation in
the STAR setting, which preserves the spatial information. Furthermore, in our
module, we divide the self-attention for the same and different views to model
the relationship between multiple views effectively. The results of experiments
using a newly collected dataset demonstrate that MVAFormer outperforms the
comparison baselines by approximately $4.4$ points on the F-measure.
comment: Selected as Best Industry Paper Award at ICIP2024

title: Lost in Code Generation: Reimagining the Role of Software Models in AI-driven Software Engineering
summary:
Generative AI enables rapid ``vibe coding," where natural language prompts
yield working software systems. While this lowers barriers to software
creation, it also collapses the boundary between prototypes and engineered
software, leading to fragile systems that lack robustness, security, and
maintainability. We argue that this shift motivates a reimagining of software
models. Rather than serving only as upfront blueprints, models can be recovered
post-hoc from AI-generated code to restore comprehension, expose risks, and
guide refinement. In this role, models serve as mediators between human intent,
AI generation, and long-term system evolution, providing a path toward
sustainable AI-driven software engineering.

AI.title_translation: 代码生成中的迷失：重塑软件模型在人工智能驱动的软件工程中的作用
AI.tldr: AI生成的“随性代码”很脆弱，我们需要从这些代码中“事后提取”软件模型，让模型成为连接人类想法、AI产出和未来维护的桥梁，以实现可持续的AI软件工程。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI导致的“vibe coding”虽然降低了软件创建门槛，但也模糊了原型与工程软件的界限，导致系统缺乏鲁棒性、安全性和可维护性。这促使人们需要重新思考软件模型的作用。
AI.method: 通过论证当前AI生成代码（vibe coding）的局限性，提出应事后（post-hoc）从AI生成的代码中恢复软件模型，以恢复理解、暴露风险并指导系统优化。
AI.result: 提出了一种新的软件模型角色：作为人类意图、AI生成和长期系统演化的中介，通过事后恢复模型来指导系统的精炼和可持续发展。
AI.conclusion: 软件模型应从单纯的前期蓝图转变为从AI生成代码中事后恢复的实体，作为人类意图、AI生成和长期系统演化的中介，从而实现可持续的AI驱动软件工程。
AI.translation: 生成式人工智能使得快速的“氛围编码”成为可能，即自然语言提示可以产生可工作的软件系统。虽然这降低了软件创建的门槛，但它也模糊了原型和工程软件之间的界限，导致系统缺乏鲁棒性、安全性和可维护性。我们认为，这种转变激励了对软件模型的重新构想。模型不再仅仅充当前期蓝图，而是可以从人工智能生成的代码中事后恢复，以恢复理解、暴露风险并指导精炼。在这种作用下，模型充当人类意图、人工智能生成和长期系统演化之间的中介，为可持续的人工智能驱动的软件工程提供了一条途径。
AI.summary: 随着生成式AI的“vibe coding”导致软件质量下降，本文认为需要重新定义软件模型的作用。模型不应仅作为初始蓝图，而应在代码生成之后被恢复出来，用以理解代码、揭示风险并指导后续的工程优化，从而确保AI驱动的软件工程的可持续性。
AI.keywords: 代码生成, 软件模型, AI驱动软件工程, 模型恢复, 软件维护
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了“事后恢复”软件模型，用以解决AI生成代码（“vibe coding”）带来的鲁棒性、安全性和可维护性挑战。其重要性在于为可持续的AI驱动软件工程提供了一种新的中介机制。局限性在于其有效性依赖于模型恢复的质量。

title: Wireless Video Semantic Communication with Decoupled Diffusion Multi-frame Compensation
summary:
Existing wireless video transmission schemes directly conduct video coding in
pixel level, while neglecting the inner semantics contained in videos. In this
paper, we propose a wireless video semantic communication framework with
decoupled diffusion multi-frame compensation (DDMFC), abbreviated as WVSC-D,
which integrates the idea of semantic communication into wireless video
transmission scenarios. WVSC-D first encodes original video frames as semantic
frames and then conducts video coding based on such compact representations,
enabling the video coding in semantic level rather than pixel level. Moreover,
to further reduce the communication overhead, a reference semantic frame is
introduced to substitute motion vectors of each frame in common video coding
methods. At the receiver, DDMFC is proposed to generate compensated current
semantic frame by a two-stage conditional diffusion process. With both the
reference frame transmission and DDMFC frame compensation, the bandwidth
efficiency improves with satisfying video transmission performance.
Experimental results verify the performance gain of WVSC-D over other DL-based
methods e.g. DVSC about 1.8 dB in terms of PSNR.

AI.title_translation: 带解耦扩散多帧补偿的无线视频语义通信
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的无线视频语义通信方法WVSC-D，它用语义编码取代像素编码，并使用解耦扩散模型（DDMFC）进行帧补偿，从而在保持性能的同时大幅提高带宽效率。
AI.motivation: 现有无线视频传输方案在像素级别进行视频编码，忽略了视频内部的语义信息。
AI.method: 首先将原始视频帧编码为语义帧，然后基于这些紧凑的表示进行视频编码（语义级编码）。引入参考语义帧替代传统运动矢量。在接收端，提出解耦扩散多帧补偿（DDMFC）通过两阶段条件扩散过程生成补偿后的当前语义帧。
AI.result: WVSC-D相较于其他基于深度学习的方法（如DVSC），在PSNR方面实现了约1.8 dB的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过参考帧传输和DDMFC帧补偿，提高了带宽效率并保证了满意的视频传输性能。
AI.translation: 现有的无线视频传输方案直接在像素级别进行视频编码，而忽略了视频内部所包含的语义信息。在本文中，我们提出了一种具有解耦扩散多帧补偿（DDMFC）的无线视频语义通信框架，简称WVSC-D，它将语义通信的思想融入无线视频传输场景。WVSC-D首先将原始视频帧编码为语义帧，然后基于这些紧凑的表示进行视频编码，从而实现了基于语义级别的视频编码而非像素级别。此外，为了进一步减少通信开销，引入了一个参考语义帧来替代通用视频编码方法中每一帧的运动矢量。在接收端，提出了DDMFC，通过一个两阶段的条件扩散过程来生成补偿后的当前语义帧。通过参考帧传输和DDMFC帧补偿，带宽效率得到了提高，同时保证了令人满意的视频传输性能。实验结果验证了WVSC-D相较于其他基于深度学习的方法（例如DVSC）在PSNR方面约1.8 dB的性能增益。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个名为WVSC-D的无线视频语义通信框架，它通过将视频编码从像素级别提升到语义级别来实现。该框架引入了参考语义帧来减少开销，并提出了解耦扩散多帧补偿（DDMFC）技术，用于接收端根据参考帧生成当前帧。实验证明，该方法显著提高了带宽效率并提升了视频传输性能。
AI.keywords: 无线视频语义通信, 扩散模型, 多帧补偿, 语义编码, 带宽效率
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将语义通信的概念引入无线视频传输，并提出了新颖的解耦扩散多帧补偿（DDMFC）机制来替代传统的运动矢量，以提高带宽效率。其局限性可能在于对扩散模型的计算复杂性要求较高，以及在不同网络条件下的鲁棒性有待进一步验证。

title: NOWS: Neural Operator Warm Starts for Accelerating Iterative Solvers
summary:
Partial differential equations (PDEs) underpin quantitative descriptions
across the physical sciences and engineering, yet high-fidelity simulation
remains a major computational bottleneck for many-query, real-time, and design
tasks. Data-driven surrogates can be strikingly fast but are often unreliable
when applied outside their training distribution. Here we introduce Neural
Operator Warm Starts (NOWS), a hybrid strategy that harnesses learned solution
operators to accelerate classical iterative solvers by producing high-quality
initial guesses for Krylov methods such as conjugate gradient and GMRES. NOWS
leaves existing discretizations and solver infrastructures intact, integrating
seamlessly with finite-difference, finite-element, isogeometric analysis,
finite volume method, etc. Across our benchmarks, the learned initialization
consistently reduces iteration counts and end-to-end runtime, resulting in a
reduction of the computational time of up to 90 %, while preserving the
stability and convergence guarantees of the underlying numerical algorithms. By
combining the rapid inference of neural operators with the rigor of traditional
solvers, NOWS provides a practical and trustworthy approach to accelerate
high-fidelity PDE simulations.

title: Generalized Swing Control Framework for Inverter-based Resources
summary:
This paper proposes a novel control framework designed for Inverter-Based
Resources (IBRs), denoted as Generalized Swing Control (GSC). The proposed GSC
framework generalizes the definition of Grid-Forming (GFM) control schemes and
exploits the coupling between active and reactive power dynamics. To validate
the proposed scheme, we conduct extensive time-domain simulations and
small-signal analysis using a modified version of the WSCC 9-bus system and a
1479-bus dynamic model of the all-island Irish transmission system. The case
studies focus on evaluating the dynamic performance of the proposed framework
under different configurations, including Virtual Synchronous Machine (VSM),
coupled-VSM and dual-VSM schemes. To address the nonlinear nature of power
system dynamics, sensitivity analysis based on Monte Carlo methods are employed
to improve parameter tuning and assess the stability of GSC configurations in
the studied systems.

title: OLATverse: A Large-scale Real-world Object Dataset with Precise Lighting Control
summary:
We introduce OLATverse, a large-scale dataset comprising around 9M images of
765 real-world objects, captured from multiple viewpoints under a diverse set
of precisely controlled lighting conditions. While recent advances in
object-centric inverse rendering, novel view synthesis and relighting have
shown promising results, most techniques still heavily rely on the synthetic
datasets for training and small-scale real-world datasets for benchmarking,
which limits their realism and generalization. To address this gap, OLATverse
offers two key advantages over existing datasets: large-scale coverage of real
objects and high-fidelity appearance under precisely controlled illuminations.
Specifically, OLATverse contains 765 common and uncommon real-world objects,
spanning a wide range of material categories. Each object is captured using 35
DSLR cameras and 331 individually controlled light sources, enabling the
simulation of diverse illumination conditions. In addition, for each object, we
provide well-calibrated camera parameters, accurate object masks, photometric
surface normals, and diffuse albedo as auxiliary resources. We also construct
an extensive evaluation set, establishing the first comprehensive real-world
object-centric benchmark for inverse rendering and normal estimation. We
believe that OLATverse represents a pivotal step toward integrating the next
generation of inverse rendering and relighting methods with real-world data.
The full dataset, along with all post-processing workflows, will be publicly
released at https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/OLATverse/.

title: Using ensemble learning with hybrid graph neural networks and transformers to predict traffic in cities
summary:
Intelligent transportation systems (ITS) still have a hard time accurately
predicting traffic in cities, especially in big, multimodal settings with
complicated spatiotemporal dynamics. This paper presents HybridST, a hybrid
architecture that integrates Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), multi-head temporal
Transformers, and supervised ensemble learning methods (XGBoost or Random
Forest) to collectively capture spatial dependencies, long-range temporal
patterns, and exogenous signals, including weather, calendar, or control
states. We test our model on the METR-LA, PEMS-BAY, and Seattle Loop tree
public benchmark datasets. These datasets include situations ranging from
freeway sensor networks to vehicle-infrastructure cooperative perception.
Experimental results show that HybridST consistently beats classical baselines
(LSTM, GCN, DCRNN, PDFormer) on important metrics like MAE and RMSE, while
still being very scalable and easy to understand. The proposed framework
presents a promising avenue for real-time urban mobility planning, energy
optimization, and congestion alleviation strategies, especially within the
framework of smart cities and significant events such as the 2030 FIFA World
Cup.

AI.title_translation: 使用集成学习与混合图神经网络和Transformer来预测城市交通
AI.tldr: HybridST模型结合了GNN、Transformer和集成学习，在复杂城市交通预测任务中，一致性地超越了LSTM、GCN等现有基线模型，在关键指标上表现更优。
AI.motivation: 智能交通系统在准确预测大城市、多模式环境中具有复杂时空动态的交通方面仍面临困难。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为HybridST的混合架构，它集成了图神经网络（GNN）以捕获空间依赖性，多头时间Transformer以捕获长期时间模式，以及监督集成学习方法（XGBoost或随机森林）以整合外生信号（如天气、日历或控制状态）。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，HybridST在MAE和RMSE等关键指标上持续优于经典的基线模型（LSTM、GCN、DCRNN、PDFormer），同时保持了很高的可扩展性和易理解性。
AI.conclusion: HybridST框架为实时城市交通规划、能源优化和拥堵缓解策略提供了一条有前景的途径，特别是在智慧城市和重大活动（如2030年FIFA世界杯）的背景下。
AI.translation: 智能交通系统在准确预测城市交通方面仍然面临困难，尤其是在具有复杂时空动态的大型、多模式环境中。本文提出了HybridST，一种混合架构，它集成了图神经网络（GNN）、多头时间Transformer和监督集成学习方法（XGBoost或随机森林），以共同捕获空间依赖性、长期时间模式和外生信号，包括天气、日历或控制状态。我们在METR-LA、PEMS-BAY和西雅图Loop树的公共基准数据集上测试了我们的模型。这些数据集涵盖了从高速公路传感器网络到车路协同感知的各种情况。实验结果表明，HybridST在MAE和RMSE等重要指标上持续优于经典基线模型（LSTM、GCN、DCRNN、PDFormer），同时仍然具有很高的可扩展性和易于理解性。所提出的框架为实时城市交通规划、能源优化和拥堵缓解策略提供了一条有前景的途径，特别是在智慧城市和重大活动（如2030年FIFA世界杯）的框架内。
AI.summary: 本文提出了HybridST，一个结合了GNN、Transformer和集成学习的混合架构，用于解决复杂城市交通预测中的时空动态问题。该模型通过集成捕获空间依赖、长期时间模式和外生信号的能力，在多个基准数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能，为智能交通规划提供了有前景的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 城市交通预测, 混合模型, 图神经网络, Transformer, 集成学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将GNN（捕获空间依赖）、Transformer（捕获长期时间模式）和集成学习（XGBoost/Random Forest，处理外生信号）进行混合，形成一个统一的框架HybridST，以应对复杂城市交通预测的挑战。其重要性在于提供了一个在多个基准数据集上优于现有方法的通用且可扩展的解决方案。局限性未在摘要中明确提及，但模型的复杂性可能带来一定的计算开销。

title: Coherency among Power System Devices
summary:
The paper proposes a novel general definition of coherency among power system
devices of any type. The proposed approach is thus not limited to synchronous
machines. With this aim, the paper shows that coherency can be formally based
on the difference in the complex frequency of the current injections of any two
devices electrically connected to the same grid. The proposed definition is
model-agnostic, making it general and suitable for modern power systems
composed of a heterogeneous mix of technologies. The paper also provides a
systematic analytical procedure to study the properties that specific device
models must satisfy to be coherent. Time-domain simulations are conducted in
three case studies whose results illustrate the ability of our definition to
evaluate coherency among any type of device.

title: Learning CNF formulas from uniform random solutions in the local lemma regime
summary:
We study the problem of learning a $n$-variables $k$-CNF formula $\Phi$ from
its i.i.d. uniform random solutions, which is equivalent to learning a Boolean
Markov random field (MRF) with $k$-wise hard constraints. Revisiting Valiant's
algorithm (Commun. ACM'84), we show that it can exactly learn (1) $k$-CNFs with
bounded clause intersection size under Lov\'asz local lemma type conditions,
from $O(\log n)$ samples; and (2) random $k$-CNFs near the satisfiability
threshold, from $\widetilde{O}(n^{\exp(-\sqrt{k})})$ samples. These results
significantly improve the previous $O(n^k)$ sample complexity. We further
establish new information-theoretic lower bounds on sample complexity for both
exact and approximate learning from i.i.d. uniform random solutions.

title: Object Detection as an Optional Basis: A Graph Matching Network for Cross-View UAV Localization
summary:
With the rapid growth of the low-altitude economy, UAVs have become crucial
for measurement and tracking in patrol systems. However, in GNSS-denied areas,
satellite-based localization methods are prone to failure. This paper presents
a cross-view UAV localization framework that performs map matching via object
detection, aimed at effectively addressing cross-temporal, cross-view,
heterogeneous aerial image matching. In typical pipelines, UAV visual
localization is formulated as an image-retrieval problem: features are
extracted to build a localization map, and the pose of a query image is
estimated by matching it to a reference database with known poses. Because
publicly available UAV localization datasets are limited, many approaches
recast localization as a classification task and rely on scene labels in these
datasets to ensure accuracy. Other methods seek to reduce cross-domain
differences using polar-coordinate reprojection, perspective transformations,
or generative adversarial networks; however, they can suffer from misalignment,
content loss, and limited realism. In contrast, we leverage modern object
detection to accurately extract salient instances from UAV and satellite
images, and integrate a graph neural network to reason about inter-image and
intra-image node relationships. Using a fine-grained, graph-based
node-similarity metric, our method achieves strong retrieval and localization
performance. Extensive experiments on public and real-world datasets show that
our approach handles heterogeneous appearance differences effectively and
generalizes well, making it applicable to scenarios with larger modality gaps,
such as infrared-visible image matching. Our dataset will be publicly available
at the following URL: https://github.com/liutao23/ODGNNLoc.git.

title: BRAINS: A Retrieval-Augmented System for Alzheimer's Detection and Monitoring
summary:
As the global burden of Alzheimer's disease (AD) continues to grow, early and
accurate detection has become increasingly critical, especially in regions with
limited access to advanced diagnostic tools. We propose BRAINS (Biomedical
Retrieval-Augmented Intelligence for Neurodegeneration Screening) to address
this challenge. This novel system harnesses the powerful reasoning capabilities
of Large Language Models (LLMs) for Alzheimer's detection and monitoring.
BRAINS features a dual-module architecture: a cognitive diagnostic module and a
case-retrieval module. The Diagnostic Module utilizes LLMs fine-tuned on
cognitive and neuroimaging datasets -- including MMSE, CDR scores, and brain
volume metrics -- to perform structured assessments of Alzheimer's risk.
Meanwhile, the Case Retrieval Module encodes patient profiles into latent
representations and retrieves similar cases from a curated knowledge base.
These auxiliary cases are fused with the input profile via a Case Fusion Layer
to enhance contextual understanding. The combined representation is then
processed with clinical prompts for inference. Evaluations on real-world
datasets demonstrate BRAINS effectiveness in classifying disease severity and
identifying early signs of cognitive decline. This system not only shows strong
potential as an assistive tool for scalable, explainable, and early-stage
Alzheimer's disease detection, but also offers hope for future applications in
the field.

title: Oriented Metrics for Bottom-Up Enumerative Synthesis
summary:
In syntax-guided synthesis, one of the challenges is to reduce the enormous
size of the search space. We observe that most search spaces are not just flat
sets of programs, but can be endowed with a structure that we call an oriented
metric. Oriented metrics measure the distance between programs, like ordinary
metrics do, but are designed for settings in which operations have an
orientation. Our focus is on the string and the bitvector domains, where
operations like concatenation and bitwise conjunction transform an input into
an output in a way that is not symmetric. We develop several new oriented
metrics for these domains. Oriented metrics are designed for search space
reduction, and we present four techniques: (i) pruning the search space to a
ball around the ground truth, (ii) factorizing the search space by an
equivalence that is induced by the oriented metric, (iii) abstracting the
oriented metric (and hence the equivalence) and refining it, and (iv) improving
the enumeration order by learning from abstract information. We acknowledge
that these techniques are inspired by developments in the literature. By
understanding their roots in oriented metrics, we can substantially increase
their applicability and efficiency. We have integrated these techniques into a
new synthesis algorithm and implemented the algorithm in a new solver. Notably,
our solver is generic in the oriented metric over which it computes. We
conducted experiments in the string and the bitvector domains, and consistently
improve the performance over the state-of-the-art by more than an order of
magnitude.

AI.title_translation: 面向自底向上的枚举综合中的定向度量
AI.tldr: 引入“定向度量”来结构化字符串和位向量合成的搜索空间，并通过四种技术（修剪、分解、抽象/细化、学习排序）显著减小搜索空间，使得新求解器性能比SOTA提升十倍以上。
AI.motivation: 在语法引导合成中，搜索空间规模过于庞大是一个挑战。作者观察到搜索空间通常具有结构，并希望利用这种结构（即“定向度量”）来减少搜索空间。
AI.method: 提出并定义了“定向度量”的概念，用于衡量具有方向性操作的程序间的距离。基于此，开发了四种搜索空间约减技术：（i）修剪搜索空间至以真实解为中心的球体；（ii）通过定向度量诱导的等价关系分解搜索空间；（iii）抽象和细化定向度量（及等价关系）；（iv）通过从抽象信息中学习来改进枚举顺序。将这些技术集成到一个新的、对定向度量通用的合成算法和求解器中。
AI.result: 在字符串和位向量域的实验中，新的求解器在性能上持续优于最先进的技术，提升幅度超过一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 作者集成这些基于定向度量的技术到一个新的合成算法和求解器中，并在字符串和位向量领域取得了比现有技术提高一个数量级的性能提升。
AI.translation: 在语法引导综合中，挑战之一是减少搜索空间的巨大尺寸。我们观察到大多数搜索空间不仅仅是程序的扁平集合，而是可以被赋予我们称为定向度量（oriented metric）的结构。定向度量像普通度量一样衡量程序间的距离，但专为操作具有方向性的设置而设计。我们的重点是字符串和位向量域，其中连接和按位合取等操作以非对称的方式将输入转换为输出。我们为这些域开发了几种新的定向度量。定向度量旨在减少搜索空间，我们提出了四种技术：（i）将搜索空间修剪到围绕真实解的一个球体；（ii）通过由定向度量诱导的等价关系分解搜索空间；（iii）抽象定向度量（及其等价关系）并对其进行细化；（iv）通过从抽象信息中学习来改进枚举顺序。我们承认这些技术受到文献中发展的启发。通过理解它们在定向度量中的根源，我们可以实质性地提高它们的适用性和效率。我们将这些技术集成到一个新的合成算法中，并在一个新的求解器中实现了该算法。值得注意的是，我们的求解器是通用的，因为它在定向度量上进行计算。我们在字符串和位向量域中进行了实验，并持续将性能比现有技术提高了十倍以上。
AI.summary: 本文针对语法引导合成中搜索空间过大的问题，提出了“定向度量”（Oriented Metrics）的概念，该度量适用于具有非对称操作的领域（如字符串和位向量）。基于此，作者提出了四种利用定向度量进行搜索空间约减的技术，并将它们集成到一个新的、通用的合成求解器中，实验结果显示性能比现有技术提高了十倍以上。
AI.keywords: 定向度量, 语法引导合成, 搜索空间约减, 字符串, 位向量
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了“定向度量”（Oriented Metrics）的概念来结构化搜索空间，这对于字符串和位向量等具有非对称操作的领域尤为重要。其重要性在于它提供了一种新的、更有效的搜索空间约减框架，并在实验中显著优于现有技术。局限性是该方法主要集中在字符串和位向量领域，其在更复杂的领域中的适用性有待验证。

title: Digit-Recurrence Posit Division
summary:
Posit arithmetic has emerged as a promising alternative to IEEE 754
floating-point representation, offering enhanced accuracy and dynamic range.
However, division operations in posit systems remain challenging due to their
inherent hardware complexity. In this work, we present posit division units
based on the digit-recurrence algorithm, marking the first implementation of
radix-4 digit-recurrence techniques within this context. Our approach
incorporates hardware-centric optimizations including redundant arithmetic,
on-the-fly quotient conversion, and operand scaling to streamline the division
process while mitigating latency, area, and power overheads. Comprehensive
synthesis evaluations across multiple posit configurations demonstrate
significant performance improvements, including more than 80% energy reduction
with small area overhead compared to existing methods, and a substantial
decrease in the number of iterations. These results underscore the potential of
our adapted algorithm to enhance the efficiency of posit-based arithmetic
units.

AI.title_translation: 数字递推正数除法
AI.tldr: 研究人员首次将四倍数数字递推算法应用于正数除法，通过硬件优化，实现了比现有方法能效高80%以上、迭代次数更少的正数除法器。
AI.motivation: 正数运算（Posit arithmetic）作为IEEE 754浮点数的替代方案，具有更高的精度和动态范围，但其除法运算因固有的硬件复杂性而仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 基于数字递推算法（digit-recurrence algorithm）实现正数除法单元，并结合了冗余算术、实时商转换和操作数缩放等硬件优化技术。
AI.result: 与现有方法相比，性能有了显著提升，包括能耗降低了80%以上（仅有较小的面积开销），并且迭代次数大幅减少。
AI.conclusion: 我们改编的算法具有潜力，可以提高基于正数的算术单元的效率。
AI.translation: 正数算术已成为IEEE 754浮点表示的有前景的替代方案，它提供了增强的精度和动态范围。然而，正数系统中的除法运算由于其固有的硬件复杂性仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了基于数字递推算法的正数除法单元，标志着首次在这一背景下实现四倍数（radix-4）数字递推技术。我们的方法采用了以硬件为中心的优化，包括冗余算术、实时商转换和操作数缩放，以简化除法过程，同时减轻延迟、面积和功耗开销。跨多种正数配置的综合综合评估证明了显著的性能提升，包括与现有方法相比，能耗降低了80%以上，且面积开销较小，迭代次数也大幅减少。这些结果强调了我们改编的算法在提高基于正数的算术单元效率方面的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了基于四倍数数字递推算法的正数除法单元，并采用冗余算术、实时商转换和操作数缩放等硬件优化措施来简化除法过程，降低延迟、面积和功耗。综合评估显示，该方法在能耗和迭代次数上实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: Posit arithmetic, Division, Digit-recurrence, Radix-4, Hardware optimization
AI.comments: 该工作创新性地将四倍数（radix-4）的数字递推算法首次应用于正数（posit）除法，并通过冗余算术、实时商转换和操作数缩放等硬件优化，显著降低了能耗和迭代次数，解决了正数除法硬件复杂性的挑战。

title: DetectiumFire: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Dataset Bridging Vision and Language for Fire Understanding
comments:
Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 2025 (NeurIPS
  2025), Poster, https://neurips.cc/virtual/2025/loc/san-diego/poster/121400
summary:
Recent advances in multi-modal models have demonstrated strong performance in
tasks such as image generation and reasoning. However, applying these models to
the fire domain remains challenging due to the lack of publicly available
datasets with high-quality fire domain annotations. To address this gap, we
introduce DetectiumFire, a large-scale, multi-modal dataset comprising of 22.5k
high-resolution fire-related images and 2.5k real-world fire-related videos
covering a wide range of fire types, environments, and risk levels. The data
are annotated with both traditional computer vision labels (e.g., bounding
boxes) and detailed textual prompts describing the scene, enabling applications
such as synthetic data generation and fire risk reasoning. DetectiumFire offers
clear advantages over existing benchmarks in scale, diversity, and data
quality, significantly reducing redundancy and enhancing coverage of real-world
scenarios. We validate the utility of DetectiumFire across multiple tasks,
including object detection, diffusion-based image generation, and
vision-language reasoning. Our results highlight the potential of this dataset
to advance fire-related research and support the development of intelligent
safety systems. We release DetectiumFire to promote broader exploration of fire
understanding in the AI community. The dataset is available at
https://kaggle.com/datasets/38b79c344bdfc55d1eed3d22fbaa9c31fad45e27edbbe9e3c529d6e5c4f93890

AI.title_translation: DetectiumFire：一个弥合视觉与语言以实现火灾理解的综合性多模态数据集
AI.tldr: 研究人员创建了一个名为 DetectiumFire 的大型火灾多模态数据集（图像+视频+文本描述），以解决火灾AI研究中缺乏高质量标注数据的难题，并在多种任务上展示了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态模型在火灾领域应用面临挑战，主要原因是缺乏具有高质量火灾领域注释的公开数据集。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含 22.5k 高清火灾图像和 2.5k 真实火灾视频的大规模多模态数据集 (DetectiumFire)，并使用传统计算机视觉标签（如边界框）和详细的文本描述进行标注。随后，在目标检测、扩散模型图像生成和视觉-语言推理等任务上验证了该数据集的效用。
AI.result: 在目标检测、扩散模型图像生成和视觉-语言推理等多个任务上验证了 DetectiumFire 的效用，结果突显了该数据集在推动火灾相关研究和支持智能安全系统开发方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: DetectiumFire 的发布旨在促进人工智能社区对火灾理解的广泛探索。
AI.translation: 多模态模型在图像生成和推理等任务中展现了强大的性能。然而，由于缺乏公开的高质量火灾领域标注数据集，将这些模型应用于火灾领域仍然具有挑战性。为解决这一差距，我们推出了 DetectiumFire，一个大规模的多模态数据集，包含 22.5k 高分辨率火灾相关图像和 2.5k 真实火灾相关视频，涵盖了广泛的火灾类型、环境和风险水平。这些数据使用传统计算机视觉标签（例如边界框）和描述场景的详细文本提示进行标注，从而支持诸如合成数据生成和火灾风险推理等应用。DetectiumFire 在规模、多样性和数据质量方面明显优于现有基准，显著减少了冗余并增强了对真实世界场景的覆盖。我们验证了 DetectiumFire 在多个任务中的效用，包括目标检测、基于扩散的图像生成和视觉-语言推理。我们的结果凸显了该数据集在推动火灾相关研究和支持智能安全系统开发方面的潜力。我们向 AI 社区发布 DetectiumFire，以促进对火灾理解的更广泛探索。数据集可在 https://kaggle.com/datasets/38b79c344bdfc55d1eed3d22fbaa9c31fad45e27edbbe9e3c529d6e5c4f93890 上获取。
AI.summary: 为解决火灾领域高质量多模态数据集的缺失问题，本文推出了 DetectiumFire，一个包含 22.5k 图像和 2.5k 视频的大规模多模态数据集，并配有视觉和文本标注。该数据集在规模、多样性和质量上优于现有基准，并通过在多个下游任务上的验证证明了其对火灾研究的推动作用。
AI.keywords: 多模态数据集, 火灾理解, 计算机视觉, 视觉-语言推理, 智能安全系统
AI.comments: 该论文的主要创新在于构建了一个大规模、多模态的火灾数据集 (DetectiumFire)，弥补了火灾领域高质量标注数据的缺失。其重要性在于为火灾识别、风险推理和智能安全系统开发提供了基础资源。局限性是仅基于现有数据集的分析，未展示模型性能的绝对提升，仅验证了数据集的可用性。

title: Variational Geometric Information Bottleneck: Learning the Shape of Understanding
summary:
We propose a unified information-geometric framework that formalizes
understanding in learning as a trade-off between informativeness and geometric
simplicity. An encoder phi is evaluated by U(phi) = I(phi(X); Y) - beta *
C(phi), where C(phi) penalizes curvature and intrinsic dimensionality,
enforcing smooth, low-complexity manifolds. Under mild manifold and regularity
assumptions, we derive non-asymptotic bounds showing that generalization error
scales with intrinsic dimension while curvature controls approximation
stability, directly linking geometry to sample efficiency. To operationalize
this theory, we introduce the Variational Geometric Information Bottleneck
(V-GIB), a variational estimator that unifies mutual-information compression
and curvature regularization through tractable geometric proxies such as the
Hutchinson trace, Jacobian norms, and local PCA. Experiments across synthetic
manifolds, few-shot settings, and real-world datasets (Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10)
reveal a robust information-geometry Pareto frontier, stable estimators, and
substantial gains in interpretive efficiency. Fractional-data experiments on
CIFAR-10 confirm that curvature-aware encoders maintain predictive power under
data scarcity, validating the predicted efficiency-curvature law. Overall,
V-GIB provides a principled and measurable route to representations that are
geometrically coherent, data-efficient, and aligned with human-understandable
structure.

AI.title_translation: 变分几何信息瓶颈：学习理解的形状
AI.tldr: 研究人员提出了 V-GIB，这是一个新的框架，它使用信息论和几何学来衡量深度学习模型的“理解”程度，通过限制模型的内在维度和曲率来提高泛化能力和数据效率。
AI.motivation: 将学习中的“理解”形式化为信息量与几何简单性之间的权衡，并直接将几何属性（内在维度和曲率）与样本效率和泛化误差联系起来。
AI.method: 提出一个统一的信息-几何框架，使用目标函数 $U(\phi) = I(\phi(X); Y) - \beta * C(\phi)$ 来评估编码器 $\phi$，其中 $C(\phi)$ 惩罚曲率和内在维度。通过变分估计器 V-GIB 来操作化该理论，利用可处理的几何代理（如 Hutchinson 迹、雅可比行列式范数和局部 PCA）来统一互信息压缩和曲率正则化。
AI.result: 推导了非渐近界限，表明泛化误差与内在维度成正比，而曲率控制着近似稳定性。实验结果显示了稳健的信息-几何帕累托前沿、稳定的估计器以及解释效率的显著提高。分数数据实验证实了感知能力强的编码器在数据稀缺时能保持预测能力。
AI.conclusion: V-GIB提供了一条原则性且可衡量的途径，以获得在几何上一致、数据高效且与人类可理解结构对齐的表示。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个统一的信息-几何框架，将学习中的理解形式化为信息量和几何简单性之间的权衡。编码器 $\phi$ 通过 $U(\phi) = I(\phi(X); Y) - \beta * C(\phi)$ 进行评估，$C(\phi)$ 惩罚曲率和内在维度，强制实现平滑、低复杂度的流形。在温和的流形和正则性假设下，我们推导出非渐近界限，表明泛化误差与内在维度成比例，而曲率控制着近似稳定性，直接将几何与样本效率联系起来。为了操作化该理论，我们引入了变分几何信息瓶颈（V-GIB），一个变分估计器，它通过可处理的几何代理（如 Hutchinson 迹、雅可比行列式范数和局部 PCA）统一了互信息压缩和曲率正则化。跨越合成流形、少样本设置和真实世界数据集（Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10）的实验揭示了一个稳健的信息-几何帕累托前沿、稳定的估计器以及解释效率的实质性提高。在 CIFAR-10 上的分数数据实验证实了感知能力强的编码器在数据稀缺下能保持预测能力，验证了预测的效率-曲率定律。总而言之，V-GIB 提供了一条原则性且可衡量的途径，以获得在几何上一致、数据高效且与人类可理解结构对齐的表征。
AI.summary: 本文提出了变分几何信息瓶颈（V-GIB），一个基于信息几何的统一框架，用于学习具有几何简单性的表征。它通过最小化互信息和惩罚曲率与内在维度来量化“理解”。理论上，它将几何属性与泛化和样本效率联系起来。实验证明了 V-GIB 在数据效率和可解释性方面的优势。
AI.keywords: 信息几何, 变分几何信息瓶颈, 曲率, 内在维度, 泛化误差
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一个统一的信息-几何框架，将“理解”量化为信息量与几何复杂性之间的权衡。其重要性在于首次将几何属性（曲率和内在维度）与泛化误差和样本效率直接联系起来。局限性可能在于其理论推导依赖于“温和的流形和正则性假设”。

title: Decentralized Approach to Detect and Eliminate Flapping Phenomena due to Flexible Resources
summary:
This paper presents a decentralized methodology for detecting and mitigating
flapping phenomena in power systems, primarily caused by the operation of
discrete devices. The proposed approach applies moving-window autocorrelation
to local measurements, enabling each device to autonomously identify sustained
oscillations. Upon detection, a probabilistic, device-specific mitigation
strategy is executed. Flexible demand resources (DFRs), under-load tap changers
(ULTCs), and automatic voltage regulators (AVRs) are utilised to illustrate the
performance of the proposed approach to both discrete and continuous-operation
devices. Results show that the proposed method is robust and properly
distinguishes damped oscillations from persistent flapping, allowing devices to
independently recognize problematic operating scenarios and implement
corrective actions accordingly.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于检测和消除由柔性资源引起的拍振现象的去中心化方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种去中心化的新方法，使用局部测量和自相关来让电力系统中的设备（如DFRs、ULTCs、AVRs）自主检测并独立解决由它们自己引起的拍振问题，效果稳健。
AI.motivation: 解决主要由离散设备操作引起的电力系统中的拍振现象（flapping phenomena）。
AI.method: 该方法应用移动窗口自相关（moving-window autocorrelation）到局部测量数据上，使每个设备能够自主识别持续振荡，并在检测到后执行概率性的、特定于设备的缓解策略。
AI.result: 结果表明，所提出的方法稳健，并且能够正确地区分阻尼振荡与持续的拍振现象，允许设备独立识别问题操作场景并采取纠正措施。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法稳健，能够正确区分阻尼振荡和持续的拍振现象，使设备能够独立识别问题操作场景并相应地实施纠正措施。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种用于检测和减轻电力系统中主要由离散设备运行引起的拍振现象的去中心化方法。所提出的方法将移动窗口自相关应用于局部测量，使每个设备能够自主识别持续振荡。检测到后，执行一种概率性的、特定于设备的缓解策略。利用柔性需求资源（DFRs）、有载调压器（ULTCs）和自动电压调节器（AVRs）来说明所提出方法对离散和连续运行设备的性能。结果表明，所提出的方法是稳健的，并能正确地区分阻尼振荡和持续的拍振现象，使设备能够独立识别问题操作场景并相应地实施纠正措施。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于检测和减轻电力系统中由离散设备操作引起的拍振现象的去中心化方法。该方法利用局部测量数据的移动窗口自相关来识别持续振荡，并触发概率性的设备特定缓解策略。该方法在柔性需求资源、有载调压器和自动电压调节器上进行了测试，证明了其鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 去中心化方法, 拍振现象检测, 柔性资源, 局部测量, 概率性缓解
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一个完全去中心化的方法来处理电网中的拍振现象，避免了全局协调的复杂性。其重要性在于能够使设备自主识别并解决振荡问题。限制是仅基于局部测量，可能无法捕捉到全局耦合的复杂模式。

title: Evolutionary Algorithm for Chance Constrained Quadratic Multiple Knapsack Problem
summary:
Quadratic multiple knapsack problem (QMKP) is a combinatorial optimisation
problem characterised by multiple weight capacity constraints and a profit
function that combines linear and quadratic profits. We study a stochastic
variant of this problem where profits are considered as random variables. This
problem reflects complex resource allocation problems in real-world scenarios
where randomness is inherent. We model this problem using chance constraints to
capture the stochastic profits. We propose a hybrid approach for this problem,
which combines an evolutionary algorithm (EA) with a local optimisation
strategy inspired by multi-factorial optimisation (MFO). EAs are used for
global search due to their effectiveness in handling large, complex solution
spaces. In the hybrid approach, EA periodically passes interim solutions to the
local optimiser for refinement. The local optimiser applies MFO principles,
which are typically used in multi-tasking problems. The local optimiser models
the local problem as a multi-tasking problem by constructing disjoint search
spaces for each knapsack based on an input solution. For each item, its
assignment across all knapsacks is considered to determine the preferred
knapsack. Items are then divided into disjoint groups corresponding to each
knapsack, allowing each knapsack to be treated as a separate optimisation task.
This structure enables effective application of MFO-based local refinements. We
consider two EAs for the problem, (1+1) EA and ($\mu+\lambda$) EA. We conduct
experiments to explore the effectiveness of these EAs on their own and also
with the proposed local optimiser. Experimental results suggest that hybrid
approaches, particularly those incorporating MFO, perform well on instances
where chance constraints and capacity constraints are tight.

title: Lightweight Latency Prediction Scheme for Edge Applications: A Rational Modelling Approach
comments:
Presented at the ICCS 2025 - 5th International Conference on Computer
  Systems, Xian, China
summary:
Accurately predicting end-to-end network latency is essential for enabling
reliable task offloading in real-time edge computing applications. This paper
introduces a lightweight latency prediction scheme based on rational modelling
that uses features such as frame size, arrival rate, and link utilization,
eliminating the need for intrusive active probing. The model achieves
state-of-the-art prediction accuracy through extensive experiments and 5-fold
cross-validation (MAE = 0.0115, R$^2$ = 0.9847) with competitive inference
time, offering a substantial trade-off between precision and efficiency
compared to traditional regressors and neural networks.

title: Generalized informational functionals and new monotone measures of statistical complexity
summary:
In this paper we introduce a biparametric family of transformations which can
be seen as an extension of the so-called up and down transformations. This new
class of transformations allows to us to introduce new informational
functionals, which we have called \textit{down-moments} and \textit{cumulative
upper-moments}. A remarkable fact is that the down-moments provide, in some
cases, an interpolation between the $p$-th moments and the power R\'enyi
entropies of a probability density. We establish new and sharp inequalities
relating these new functionals to the classical informational measures such as
moments, R\'enyi and Shannon entropies and Fisher information measures. We also
give the optimal bounds as well as the minimizing densities, which are in some
cases expressed in terms of the generalized trigonometric functions. We
furthermore define new classes of measures of statistical complexity obtained
as quotients of the new functionals, and establish monotonicity properties for
them through an algebraic conjugation of up and down transformations. All of
these properties highlight an intricate structure of functional inequalities.

AI.title_translation: 广义信息泛函与新的统计复杂性单调度量
AI.tldr: 引入了新的双参数变换和信息泛函（下矩、累积上矩），它们能插值矩和Rényi熵，并建立了与经典信息度量（熵、Fisher信息）之间的尖锐不等式，同时定义了新的单调统计复杂性度量。
AI.motivation: 扩展现有的“上”和“下”变换，以引入新的信息泛函，并探索这些新泛函与经典信息度量之间的关系以及它们在统计复杂性度量中的应用。
AI.method: 引入双参数变换族（作为“上”和“下”变换的扩展），基于此定义了“下矩”和“累积上矩”等新的信息泛函，并建立了这些新泛函与经典信息度量之间的不等式，最后定义了基于新泛函的统计复杂性度量。
AI.result: 引入了“下矩”和“累积上矩”等新的信息泛函，这些泛函在某些情况下是$p$阶矩和Rényi熵的插值。建立了这些新泛函与矩、Rényi熵、Shannon熵和Fisher信息等经典度量之间的新的、尖锐的不等式，并给出了最优界限和最小化密度。定义了新的统计复杂性度量类，并证明了它们具有单调性。
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们引入了一个可视为所谓“上”和“下”变换的扩展的双参数变换族。这类新的变换使我们能够引入新的信息泛函，我们称之为“下矩”和“累积上矩”。一个显著的事实是，下矩在某些情况下在 $p$ 阶矩和概率密度的Rényi熵之间提供了一种插值。我们建立了这些新泛函与经典信息度量（如矩、Rényi熵和Shannon熵以及Fisher信息度量）之间的新且尖锐的不等式。我们还给出了最优界限以及在某些情况下以广义三角函数表示的最小化密度。此外，我们定义了由新泛函的商得到的新的统计复杂性度量类别，并通过上、下变换的代数共轭确立了它们的单调性。所有这些性质都突显了泛函不等式中一种错综复杂的结构。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的双参数变换族，并基于此引入了“下矩”和“累积上矩”等新信息泛函。研究发现这些新泛函可以插值经典矩和Rényi熵，并建立了它们与经典信息度量（如Shannon熵和Fisher信息）之间的尖锐不等式。此外，定义了基于新泛函的统计复杂性度量，并证明了其单调性。
AI.keywords: 信息泛函, 下矩, 累积上矩, 统计复杂性度量, 变换
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于引入了一类新的双参数变换，并基于此提出了“下矩”和“累积上矩”等新的信息泛函。其重要性在于这些泛函在某些情况下能作为$p$阶矩和Rényi熵的插值，并建立了它们与经典信息度量之间的尖锐不等式。局限性可能在于新泛函和复杂性度量的实际应用范围尚未在摘要中明确说明。

title: Adapting General-Purpose Foundation Models for X-ray Ptychography in Low-Data Regimes
summary:
The automation of workflows in advanced microscopy is a key goal where
foundation models like Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs)
show great potential. However, adapting these general-purpose models for
specialized scientific tasks is critical, and the optimal domain adaptation
strategy is often unclear. To address this, we introduce PtychoBench, a new
multi-modal, multi-task benchmark for ptychographic analysis. Using this
benchmark, we systematically compare two specialization strategies: Supervised
Fine-Tuning (SFT) and In-Context Learning (ICL). We evaluate these strategies
on a visual artifact detection task with VLMs and a textual parameter
recommendation task with LLMs in a data-scarce regime. Our findings reveal that
the optimal specialization pathway is task-dependent. For the visual task, SFT
and ICL are highly complementary, with a fine-tuned model guided by
context-aware examples achieving the highest mean performance (Micro-F1 of
0.728). Conversely, for the textual task, ICL on a large base model is the
superior strategy, reaching a peak Micro-F1 of 0.847 and outperforming a
powerful "super-expert" SFT model (0-shot Micro-F1 of 0.839). We also confirm
the superiority of context-aware prompting and identify a consistent contextual
interference phenomenon in fine-tuned models. These results, benchmarked
against strong baselines including GPT-4o and a DINOv3-based classifier, offer
key observations for AI in science: the optimal specialization path in our
benchmark is dependent on the task modality, offering a clear framework for
developing more effective science-based agentic systems.

title: Dexterous Robotic Piano Playing at Scale
summary:
Endowing robot hands with human-level dexterity has been a long-standing goal
in robotics. Bimanual robotic piano playing represents a particularly
challenging task: it is high-dimensional, contact-rich, and requires fast,
precise control. We present OmniPianist, the first agent capable of performing
nearly one thousand music pieces via scalable, human-demonstration-free
learning. Our approach is built on three core components. First, we introduce
an automatic fingering strategy based on Optimal Transport (OT), allowing the
agent to autonomously discover efficient piano-playing strategies from scratch
without demonstrations. Second, we conduct large-scale Reinforcement Learning
(RL) by training more than 2,000 agents, each specialized in distinct music
pieces, and aggregate their experience into a dataset named RP1M++, consisting
of over one million trajectories for robotic piano playing. Finally, we employ
a Flow Matching Transformer to leverage RP1M++ through large-scale imitation
learning, resulting in the OmniPianist agent capable of performing a wide range
of musical pieces. Extensive experiments and ablation studies highlight the
effectiveness and scalability of our approach, advancing dexterous robotic
piano playing at scale.

title: ESA: Energy-Based Shot Assembly Optimization for Automatic Video Editing
summary:
Shot assembly is a crucial step in film production and video editing,
involving the sequencing and arrangement of shots to construct a narrative,
convey information, or evoke emotions. Traditionally, this process has been
manually executed by experienced editors. While current intelligent video
editing technologies can handle some automated video editing tasks, they often
fail to capture the creator's unique artistic expression in shot assembly.To
address this challenge, we propose an energy-based optimization method for
video shot assembly. Specifically, we first perform visual-semantic matching
between the script generated by a large language model and a video library to
obtain subsets of candidate shots aligned with the script semantics. Next, we
segment and label the shots from reference videos, extracting attributes such
as shot size, camera motion, and semantics. We then employ energy-based models
to learn from these attributes, scoring candidate shot sequences based on their
alignment with reference styles. Finally, we achieve shot assembly optimization
by combining multiple syntax rules, producing videos that align with the
assembly style of the reference videos. Our method not only automates the
arrangement and combination of independent shots according to specific logic,
narrative requirements, or artistic styles but also learns the assembly style
of reference videos, creating a coherent visual sequence or holistic visual
expression. With our system, even users with no prior video editing experience
can create visually compelling videos. Project page:
https://sobeymil.github.io/esa.com

AI.title_translation: ESA：用于自动视频编辑的基于能量的镜头组装优化
AI.tldr: ESA方法使用能量模型来优化视频剪辑中的镜头排序，通过学习参考视频的艺术风格和属性（如镜头大小、运动），实现了比现有技术更具艺术性的自动化视频组装，即使是新手也能创作出视觉吸引人的视频。
AI.motivation: 传统视频剪辑中的镜头组装过程依赖人工，现有智能视频编辑技术往往无法捕捉创作者在镜头组装方面的独特艺术表达。
AI.method: 首先，通过大型语言模型生成的脚本与视频库进行视觉语义匹配，获取候选镜头子集。然后，对参考视频进行分割和标注，提取镜头大小、摄像机运动和语义等属性。接着，采用能量模型学习这些属性，并根据与参考风格的对齐情况对候选镜头序列进行评分。最后，结合多种句法规则实现镜头组装优化。
AI.result: 实现了与参考视频组装风格对齐的视频，能够自动根据特定逻辑、叙事要求或艺术风格排列和组合独立镜头，并学习参考视频的组装风格，从而创建连贯的视觉序列或整体视觉表达。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过学习参考视频的组装风格，不仅能根据逻辑、叙事或艺术风格自动排列和组合独立镜头，还能生成连贯的视觉序列或整体视觉表达，使用户无需经验也能创作出引人注目的视频。
AI.translation: 镜头组装是电影制作和视频编辑中的一个关键步骤，涉及镜头的排序和安排，以构建叙事、传达信息或唤起情感。传统上，这个过程由经验丰富的编辑手动完成。虽然目前的智能视频编辑技术可以处理一些自动视频编辑任务，但它们往往无法捕捉创作者在镜头组装方面的独特艺术表达。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种用于视频镜头组装的基于能量的优化方法。具体来说，我们首先对大型语言模型生成的脚本与视频库进行视觉语义匹配，以获得与脚本语义对齐的候选镜头子集。接着，我们对参考视频中的镜头进行分割和标注，提取诸如镜头大小、摄像机运动和语义等属性。然后，我们采用能量模型从这些属性中学习，根据候选镜头序列与参考风格的对齐程度进行评分。最后，我们通过结合多种句法规则来实现镜头组装优化，生成与参考视频组装风格对齐的视频。我们的方法不仅能根据特定的逻辑、叙事要求或艺术风格自动排列和组合独立镜头，还能学习参考视频的组装风格，从而创建连贯的视觉序列或整体视觉表达。有了我们的系统，即使是没有视频编辑经验的用户也可以创作出视觉上引人注目的视频。项目页面：https://sobeymil.github.io/esa.com
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为ESA（能量基础镜头组装优化）的能量模型优化方法，用于解决传统和现有自动视频编辑技术在捕捉镜头组装艺术表达方面的不足。该方法首先进行脚本与视频的语义匹配以获取候选镜头，然后提取参考视频的属性，并利用能量模型学习这些属性以评估镜头序列。最终目标是生成符合参考风格的、具有连贯视觉表达的视频。
AI.keywords: 镜头组装优化, 能量模型, 视频编辑, 风格学习, 脚本匹配
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地将能量模型（Energy-Based Models, EBMs）应用于视频剪辑中的镜头组装优化，以捕捉和学习参考视频的组装风格，这超越了传统或现有自动编辑方法仅关注局部逻辑或叙事对齐的局限性。其重要性在于提供了一种更具艺术性和风格化控制的自动化编辑方案。局限性在于依赖于脚本生成和高质量的参考视频属性提取。

title: Keeping it Local, Tiny and Real: Automated Report Generation on Edge Computing Devices for Mechatronic-Based Cognitive Systems
comments:
6 pages, 4 figures, 1 table; accepted for MECATRONICS-REM 2025
  International Conference, PARIS, FRANCE December 3-5 2025
summary:
Recent advancements in Deep Learning enable hardware-based cognitive systems,
that is, mechatronic systems in general and robotics in particular with
integrated Artificial Intelligence, to interact with dynamic and unstructured
environments. While the results are impressive, the application of such systems
to critical tasks like autonomous driving as well as service and care robotics
necessitate the evaluation of large amount of heterogeneous data. Automated
report generation for Mobile Robotics can play a crucial role in facilitating
the evaluation and acceptance of such systems in various domains. In this
paper, we propose a pipeline for generating automated reports in natural
language utilizing various multi-modal sensors that solely relies on local
models capable of being deployed on edge computing devices, thus preserving the
privacy of all actors involved and eliminating the need for external services.
In particular, we evaluate our implementation on a diverse dataset spanning
multiple domains including indoor, outdoor and urban environments, providing
quantitative as well as qualitative evaluation results. Various generated
example reports and other supplementary materials are available via a public
repository.

AI.title_translation: 本地化、微型化和真实化：面向机电认知系统的边缘计算设备上的自动化报告生成
AI.tldr: 为了让依赖AI的机器人和机电系统（如自动驾驶和护理机器人）更容易被接受和评估，我们设计了一个报告生成系统，它完全在本地的边缘设备上运行，不使用云服务，从而保护了数据隐私，并在多种环境中进行了测试。
AI.motivation: 深度学习的应用使得机电系统（尤其是机器人）能够与动态、非结构化环境交互，但将这些系统应用于自动驾驶、服务和护理机器人等关键任务时，需要评估大量异构数据。自动化报告生成对促进这些系统的评估和接受至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了一种自动化报告生成管道，该管道利用各种多模态传感器，并仅依赖于可部署在边缘计算设备上的本地模型。
AI.result: 在涵盖室内、室外和城市环境的异构数据集上评估了实现方案，并提供了定量和定性的评估结果。
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 最近深度学习的进步使得硬件认知系统，即一般指机电系统，特别是机器人技术，能够与动态和非结构化的环境进行交互。尽管成果令人印象深刻，但将此类系统应用于自动驾驶、服务和护理机器人等关键任务，需要评估大量的异构数据。移动机器人的自动化报告生成可以在促进这些系统在各个领域的评估和接受方面发挥关键作用。在本文中，我们提出了一种利用各种多模态传感器生成自然语言自动化报告的管道，该管道完全依赖于能够部署在边缘计算设备上的本地模型，从而保护了所有参与者的隐私，并消除了对外部服务的需求。特别是，我们在涵盖室内、室外和城市环境的多元数据集上评估了我们的实现方案，并提供了定量和定性的评估结果。各种生成的示例文档和其他补充材料可通过公共存储库获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在边缘计算设备上运行的自动化报告生成管道，该管道利用多模态传感器数据，完全依赖本地模型，从而在不依赖外部服务的情况下生成自然语言报告，以支持集成AI的机电认知系统的评估，同时保护所有参与者的隐私。
AI.keywords: 自动化报告生成, 边缘计算, 认知系统, 机器人技术, 隐私保护
AI.comments: 这项工作的主要创新点在于提出了一种完全依赖本地模型、可在边缘计算设备上部署的自动化报告生成管道，这对于需要处理敏感数据的领域（如服务机器人和自动驾驶）至关重要，因为它能确保数据隐私并消除对外部服务的依赖。其局限性可能在于边缘设备计算能力的限制可能影响复杂模型或大规模数据的处理效率。

title: LiteVoxel: Low-memory Intelligent Thresholding for Efficient Voxel Rasterization
summary:
Sparse-voxel rasterization is a fast, differentiable alternative for
optimization-based scene reconstruction, but it tends to underfit low-frequency
content, depends on brittle pruning heuristics, and can overgrow in ways that
inflate VRAM. We introduce LiteVoxel, a self-tuning training pipeline that
makes SV rasterization both steadier and lighter. Our loss is made
low-frequency aware via an inverse-Sobel reweighting with a mid-training
gamma-ramp, shifting gradient budget to flat regions only after geometry
stabilize. Adaptation replaces fixed thresholds with a depth-quantile pruning
logic on maximum blending weight, stabilized by EMA-hysteresis guards and
refines structure through ray-footprint-based, priority-driven subdivision
under an explicit growth budget. Ablations and full-system results across
Mip-NeRF 360 (6scenes) and Tanks & Temples (3scenes) datasets show mitigation
of errors in low-frequency regions and boundary instability while keeping
PSNR/SSIM, training time, and FPS comparable to a strong SVRaster pipeline.
Crucially, LiteVoxel reduces peak VRAM by ~40%-60% and preserves low-frequency
detail that prior setups miss, enabling more predictable, memory-efficient
training without sacrificing perceptual quality.

title: Emotional Contagion in Code: How GitHub Emoji Reactions Shape Developer Collaboration
comments:
12 pages, 3 figures. Analysis of 106,743 emoji reactions across 2,098
  GitHub items
summary:
Developer communities increasingly rely on emoji reactions to communicate,
but we know little about how these emotional signals spread and influence
technical discussions. We analyzed 2,098 GitHub issues and pull requests across
50 popular repositories, examining patterns in 106,743 emoji reactions to
understand emotional contagion in software development. Our findings reveal a
surprisingly positive emotional landscape: 57.4% of discussions carry positive
sentiment, with positive emotional cascades outnumbering negative ones 23:1. We
identified five distinct patterns, with "instant enthusiasm" affecting 45.6% of
items--nearly half receive immediate positive reinforcement. Statistical
analysis confirms strong emotional contagion (r=0.679, p<0.001) with a massive
effect size (d=2.393), suggesting that initial reactions powerfully shape
discussion trajectories. These findings challenge assumptions about technical
discourse being purely rational, demonstrating that even minimal emotional
signals create measurable ripple effects. Our work provides empirical evidence
that emoji reactions are not mere decoration but active forces shaping
collaborative outcomes in software development.

AI.conclusion: 表情符号反应不仅仅是装饰，而是积极影响软件开发中协作结果的力量。

title: Improved AntiGriesmer Bounds for Linear Anticodes and Applications
summary:
This paper improves the antiGriesmer bound for linear anticodes previously
established by Chen and Xie (Journal of Algebra, 673 (2025) 304-320). While the
original bound required the code length to satisfy $n < q^{k-1}$ and the dual
code to have minimum distance at least 3, our main result removes the length
restriction and relaxes the dual distance condition to at least 2.
Specifically, we prove that for any $[n,k]_q$ linear anticode $\mathcal{C}$
over $\mathbb{F}_q$ with diameter $\delta$ and $d(\mathcal{C}^\perp) \geq 2$,
the inequality \[ n \leq \sum_{i=0}^{k-1} \left\lfloor \frac{\delta}{q^i}
\right\rfloor \] holds. This generalization significantly broadens the
applicability of the antiGriesmer bound. We derive several corollaries,
including lower bounds on the diameter $\delta$ in terms of $n$ and $k$, upper
bounds on the code length $n$, and constraints on the dimension $k$.
Applications to the construction and classification of linear codes with few
weights are also discussed, along with examples demonstrating that our new
bound can be sharper than previous ones. Our work unifies and extends earlier
findings, providing a more comprehensive framework for studying linear
anticodes and their properties.

title: Large Lemma Miners: Can LLMs do Induction Proofs for Hardware?
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown potential for solving mathematical
tasks. We show that LLMs can be utilized to generate proofs by induction for
hardware verification and thereby replace some of the manual work done by
Formal Verification engineers and deliver industrial value. We present a
neurosymbolic approach that includes two prompting frameworks to generate
candidate invariants, which are checked using a formal, symbolic tool. Our
results indicate that with sufficient reprompting, LLMs are able to generate
inductive arguments for mid-size open-source RTL designs. For $87\%$ of our
problem set, at least one of the prompt setups succeeded in producing a
provably correct inductive argument.

AI.title_translation: 大型引理挖掘机：LLM能为硬件做归纳证明吗？
AI.tldr: 研究人员展示了如何使用大型语言模型（LLMs）和神经符号方法来自动生成硬件验证所需的归纳证明，通过反复提示，LLMs在超过87%的测试案例中成功生成了正确的证明论证。
AI.motivation: 利用大型语言模型在数学任务上的潜力，旨在为硬件验证生成归纳证明，以替代形式验证工程师的部分手动工作并提供工业价值。
AI.method: 提出了一种包含两种提示框架的神经符号方法，用于生成候选不变式，然后使用形式化的符号工具来验证这些不变式。
AI.result: 对于87%的问题集，至少有一种提示设置成功地生成了可证明正确的归纳论证。
AI.conclusion: LLMs有能力生成中等规模开源RTL设计的归纳论证，并且在87%的问题集上至少有一种提示设置成功生成了可证明正确的归纳论证。

AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 硬件验证, 归纳证明, 神经符号方法, 形式验证
AI.comments: 这项工作创新性地将大型语言模型（LLMs）应用于硬件验证中的归纳证明生成，采用了一种新颖的神经符号方法，并展示了其在实际设计中的有效性，尽管需要充分的提示工程（reprompting）。局限性在于对“足够多的重新提示”的依赖。

title: An End-to-End Learning Approach for Solving Capacitated Location-Routing Problems
summary:
The capacitated location-routing problems (CLRPs) are classical problems in
combinatorial optimization, which require simultaneously making location and
routing decisions. In CLRPs, the complex constraints and the intricate
relationships between various decisions make the problem challenging to solve.
With the emergence of deep reinforcement learning (DRL), it has been
extensively applied to address the vehicle routing problem and its variants,
while the research related to CLRPs still needs to be explored. In this paper,
we propose the DRL with heterogeneous query (DRLHQ) to solve CLRP and open CLRP
(OCLRP), respectively. We are the first to propose an end-to-end learning
approach for CLRPs, following the encoder-decoder structure. In particular, we
reformulate the CLRPs as a markov decision process tailored to various
decisions, a general modeling framework that can be adapted to other DRL-based
methods. To better handle the interdependency across location and routing
decisions, we also introduce a novel heterogeneous querying attention mechanism
designed to adapt dynamically to various decision-making stages. Experimental
results on both synthetic and benchmark datasets demonstrate superior solution
quality and better generalization performance of our proposed approach over
representative traditional and DRL-based baselines in solving both CLRP and
OCLRP.

title: Many-vs-Many Missile Guidance via Virtual Targets
comments:
will be submitted to Journal of Guidance, Control, and Dynamics as
  Technical Note
summary:
This paper presents a novel approach to many-vs-many missile guidance using
virtual targets (VTs) generated by a Normalizing Flows-based trajectory
predictor. Rather than assigning n interceptors directly to m physical targets
through conventional weapon target assignment algorithms, we propose a
centralized strategy that constructs n VT trajectories representing
probabilistic predictions of maneuvering target behavior. Each interceptor is
guided toward its assigned VT using Zero-Effort-Miss guidance during midcourse
flight, transitioning to Proportional Navigation guidance for terminal
interception. This approach treats many-vs-many engagements as
many-vs-distribution scenarios, exploiting numerical superiority (n > m) by
distributing interceptors across diverse trajectory hypotheses rather than
pursuing identical deterministic predictions. Monte Carlo simulations across
various target-interceptor configurations (1-6 targets, 1-8 interceptors)
demonstrate that the VT method matches or exceeds baseline straight-line
prediction performance by 0-4.1% when n = m, with improvements increasing to
5.8-14.4% when n > m. The results confirm that probabilistic VTs enable
effective exploitation of numerical superiority, significantly increasing
interception probability in many-vs-many scenarios.

title: Implementation and Evaluation of Stable Diffusion on a General-Purpose CGLA Accelerator
comments:
This paper is accepted at 2025 IEEE 18th International Symposium on
  Embedded Multicore/Many-core Systems-on-Chip (MCSoC)
summary:
This paper presents the first implementation and in-depth evaluation of the
primary computational kernels from the stable-diffusion.cpp image generation
framework on IMAX3, a general-purpose Coarse-Grained Reconfigurable Array
(CGRA) accelerator. We designed IMAX3 as a versatile computational platform,
and this work assesses its capabilities by executing a demanding image
generation workload. We evaluate its performance on a current
Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) prototype to establish a baseline and
project its potential for a future Application-Specific Integrated Circuit
(ASIC) implementation. Our results demonstrate that, despite its
general-purpose architecture, IMAX3 achieves promising performance and power
efficiency, particularly in its projected ASIC form. This work provides
concrete guidelines for future IMAX architectural designs and establishes a
foundation for developing next-generation, AI-specialized Coarse-Grained Linear
Array (CGLA) accelerators by refining this versatile platform. Ultimately, this
achievement contributes to the realization of energy-efficient, on-device,
multi-modal AI platforms.

title: Causal Graph Neural Networks for Healthcare
summary:
Healthcare artificial intelligence systems routinely fail when deployed
across institutions, with documented performance drops and perpetuation of
discriminatory patterns embedded in historical data. This brittleness stems, in
part, from learning statistical associations rather than causal mechanisms.
Causal graph neural networks address this triple crisis of distribution shift,
discrimination, and inscrutability by combining graph-based representations of
biomedical data with causal inference principles to learn invariant mechanisms
rather than spurious correlations. This Review examines methodological
foundations spanning structural causal models, disentangled causal
representation learning, and techniques for interventional prediction and
counterfactual reasoning on graphs. We analyse applications demonstrating
clinical value across psychiatric diagnosis through brain network analysis,
cancer subtyping via multi-omics causal integration, continuous physiological
monitoring with mechanistic interpretation, and drug recommendation correcting
prescription bias. These advances establish foundations for patient-specific
Causal Digital Twins, enabling in silico clinical experimentation, with
integration of large language models for hypothesis generation and causal graph
neural networks for mechanistic validation. Substantial barriers remain,
including computational requirements precluding real-time deployment,
validation challenges demanding multi-modal evidence triangulation beyond
cross-validation, and risks of causal-washing where methods employ causal
terminology without rigorous evidentiary support. We propose tiered frameworks
distinguishing causally-inspired architectures from causally-validated
discoveries and identify critical research priorities making causal rather than
purely associational claims.

AI.title_translation: 用于医疗保健的因果图神经网络
AI.tldr: 医疗AI因学习统计关联而非因果机制而失败。因果图神经网络结合图表示和因果推理来学习不变机制，以解决分布漂移和歧视问题。综述涵盖了相关方法和临床应用，但指出计算和验证是主要障碍。最终目标是实现患者特定的因果数字孪生。
AI.motivation: 医疗AI系统在跨机构部署时经常失败，表现下降并固化了历史数据中嵌入的歧视性模式。这种脆弱性部分源于学习统计关联而非因果机制。因果图神经网络旨在通过结合图表示和因果推理原理来解决分布漂移、歧视和不可解释性这三重危机。
AI.method: 本综述审查了跨越结构因果模型、解耦因果表示学习以及图上的干预预测和反事实推理技术的​​方法基础。
AI.result: 分析了跨越精神病学诊断（通过脑网络分析）、癌症亚型（通过多组学因果整合）、连续生理监测（具有机制解释）和纠正处方偏差的药物推荐等应用的临床价值。
AI.conclusion: 这些进展为患者特定的因果数字孪生奠定了基础，能够进行计算机模拟的临床实验，并整合了大型语言模型用于假设生成和因果图神经网络用于机制验证。仍然存在重大障碍，包括阻碍实时部署的计算要求、需要超越交叉验证的多模式证据三角验证的挑战，以及因果清洗的风险。需要分层框架来区分受因果启发的架构和经过因果验证的发现，并确定优先研究领域。
AI.translation: 医疗保健人工智能系统在部署到各个机构时经常失败，表现出记录的性能下降和历史数据中嵌入的歧视模式的延续。这种脆弱性部分源于学习统计关联而非因果机制。因果图神经网络通过将生物医学数据的基于图的表示与因果推理原则相结合，学习不变机制而不是虚假相关性，从而解决了分布漂移、歧视和不可解释性的三重危机。本综述审查了跨越结构因果模型、解耦因果表示学习以及图上的干预预测和反事实推理技术的​​方法基础。我们分析了在精神病学诊断（通过脑网络分析）、癌症亚型（通过多组学因果整合）、连续生理监测（具有机制解释）和纠正处方偏差的药物推荐等应用中展示临床价值的案例。这些进展为患者特定的因果数字孪生奠定了基础，能够进行计算机模拟的临床实验，并整合了大型语言模型用于假设生成和因果图神经网络用于机制验证。仍然存在重大障碍，包括阻碍实时部署的计算要求、需要超越交叉验证的多模式证据三角验证的挑战，以及因果清洗的风险，即方法使用因果术语而没有严格的证据支持。我们提出了分层框架，区分受因果启发的架构与经过因果验证的发现，并确定了提出因果性而非纯粹关联性主张的关键研究优先事项。
AI.summary: 本文综述了因果图神经网络（CGNNs）在医疗保健中的应用，CGNNs通过结合图表示和因果推理原则，旨在解决当前AI系统面临的分布漂移、歧视和不可解释性问题。综述涵盖了相关方法论基础和已展示临床价值的应用案例，并指出了计算挑战和验证难题等未来研究方向。
AI.keywords: 因果图神经网络, 医疗保健AI, 分布漂移, 因果推理, 数字孪生
AI.comments: 该综述全面概述了因果图神经网络（CGNNs）在解决医疗AI中常见的分布漂移、歧视和不可解释性问题方面的潜力。其创新性在于将图表示与因果推理相结合，以学习不变机制。然而，对计算需求的担忧和“因果清洗”的风险是需要注意的局限性。

title: Agentic AI for Mobile Network RAN Management and Optimization
summary:
Agentic AI represents a new paradigm for automating complex systems by using
Large AI Models (LAMs) to provide human-level cognitive abilities with
multimodal perception, planning, memory, and reasoning capabilities. This will
lead to a new generation of AI systems that autonomously decompose goals,
retain context over time, learn continuously, operate across tools and
environments, and adapt dynamically. The complexity of 5G and upcoming 6G
networks renders manual optimization ineffective, pointing to Agentic AI as a
method for automating decisions in dynamic RAN environments. However, despite
its rapid advances, there is no established framework outlining the
foundational components and operational principles of Agentic AI systems nor a
universally accepted definition.
  This paper contributes to ongoing research on Agentic AI in 5G and 6G
networks by outlining its core concepts and then proposing a practical use case
that applies Agentic principles to RAN optimization. We first introduce Agentic
AI, tracing its evolution from classical agents and discussing the progress
from workflows and simple AI agents to Agentic AI. Core design
patterns-reflection, planning, tool use, and multi-agent collaboration-are then
described to illustrate how intelligent behaviors are orchestrated. These
theorical concepts are grounded in the context of mobile networks, with a focus
on RAN management and optimization. A practical 5G RAN case study shows how
time-series analytics and LAM-driven agents collaborate for KPI-based
autonomous decision-making.

AI.title_translation: 面向移动网络RAN管理和优化的代理式人工智能
AI.tldr: Agentic AI（利用具有认知能力的LAMs）是管理复杂5G/6G网络的未来方向。本文概述了Agentic AI的设计原理（如规划和工具使用），并展示了一个实际的5G RAN优化案例，其中AI代理通过协作实现基于关键性能指标（KPI）的自主决策，以克服手动优化的不足。
AI.motivation: 5G和未来6G网络的复杂性使得手动优化变得无效，这表明需要Agentic AI来自动化动态RAN环境中的决策。然而，目前还没有关于Agentic AI系统基础组件和操作原则的既定框架或普遍接受的定义。
AI.method: 首先介绍和追溯了Agentic AI的演变，讨论了从经典代理到Agentic AI的进展。然后描述了核心设计模式（如反射、规划、工具使用和多代理协作）。最后，在一个5G RAN优化案例研究中，展示了时间序列分析和LAM驱动代理如何协作进行自主决策。
AI.result: 提出了Agentic AI在RAN优化中的应用框架，并通过一个5G RAN案例研究展示了LAM驱动的代理如何利用时间序列分析来实现KPI驱动的自主决策。
AI.conclusion: 论文概述了Agentic AI的核心概念，并提出了一个将这些原则应用于RAN优化的实用案例，展示了时间序列分析和LAM驱动的代理如何协作以实现基于KPI的自主决策。
AI.translation: 代理式人工智能（Agentic AI）代表了一种通过利用大型人工智能模型（LAMs）来提供人类水平的认知能力，包括多模态感知、规划、记忆和推理能力，从而实现复杂系统自动化的新范式。这将催生新一代的AI系统，它们能够自主分解目标、长期保持上下文、持续学习、跨工具和环境操作以及动态适应。5G和即将到来的6G网络的复杂性使得手动优化变得无效，这表明Agentic AI是自动化动态RAN环境中决策的一种方法。然而，尽管其快速发展，目前还没有一个概述Agentic AI系统基础组件和操作原则的既定框架，也没有一个公认的定义。本文通过概述其核心概念并提出一个将Agentic原则应用于RAN优化的实用案例，为5G和6G网络中关于Agentic AI的持续研究做出了贡献。我们首先介绍了Agentic AI，追溯了其从经典代理的演变，并讨论了从工作流和简单AI代理到Agentic AI的进展。然后描述了核心设计模式——反射、规划、工具使用和多代理协作——以说明智能行为是如何被编排的。这些理论概念在移动网络的背景下得到印证，重点关注RAN管理和优化。一个实用的5G RAN案例研究表明，时间序列分析和LAM驱动的代理如何协作以实现基于KPI的自主决策。
AI.summary: 本文旨在通过概述Agentic AI的核心概念并提出一个将其应用于RAN优化的实用案例，来推进Agentic AI在5G/6G网络中的研究。论文追溯了Agentic AI的演变，描述了其关键设计模式（反射、规划等），并将这些理论概念应用于移动网络管理，通过一个5G RAN案例验证了LAM驱动的代理在KPI驱动的自主决策中的潜力。
AI.keywords: Agentic AI, RAN优化, 移动网络, 大型AI模型, 5G/6G
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一个将前沿的Agentic AI概念应用于移动网络（特别是RAN管理和优化）的实用框架和案例研究。其重要性在于为解决5G/6G网络日益增加的复杂性提供了一种自动化的、认知驱动的解决方案。局限性在于，它侧重于概念的概述和单一的用例，其通用性和在真实、大规模部署中的鲁棒性尚未充分证明。

title: Rawlsian many-to-one matching with non-linear utility
summary:
We study a many-to-one matching problem, such as the college admission
problem, where each college can admit multiple students. Unlike classical
models, colleges evaluate sets of students through non-linear utility functions
that capture diversity between them. In this setting, we show that classical
stable matchings may fail to exist. To address this, we propose alternative
solution concepts based on Rawlsian fairness, aiming to maximize the minimum
utility across colleges. We design both deterministic and stochastic algorithms
that iteratively improve the outcome of the worst-off college, offering a
practical approach to fair allocation when stability cannot be guaranteed.

AI.title_translation: 具有非线性效用的罗尔斯式许多对一匹配
AI.tldr: 当学院对学生集合的偏好是非线性（考虑多样性）时，传统稳定匹配可能失效。我们转向罗尔斯公平性，设计算法来最大化最差学院的效用，实现公平匹配。
AI.motivation: 在许多对一匹配问题（如学院招生）中，学院评估学生集合是通过考虑学生之间多样性的非线性效用函数，而经典稳定匹配在这种设置下可能不存在。
AI.method: 提出了基于罗尔斯公平性的解概念（旨在最大化学院之间的最小效用），并设计了确定性和随机算法来迭代改进最差学院的成果。
AI.result: 证明了在存在非线性效用函数的情况下，经典的稳定匹配可能无法存在。
AI.conclusion: 由于经典稳定匹配可能不存在，研究提出了基于罗尔斯公平性的替代解，并通过迭代改进最差学院效用的确定性和随机算法来提供一个实际的公平分配方法。
AI.translation: 我们研究了一个许多对一的匹配问题，例如学院招生问题，其中每个学院可以录取多个学生。与经典模型不同，学院通过捕获学生之间多样性的非线性效用函数来评估学生群体。在这种情况下，我们证明了经典的稳定匹配可能不存在。为解决这个问题，我们提出了基于罗尔斯公平性的替代解概念，旨在最大化学院之间的最小效用。我们设计了确定性和随机算法，以迭代地改善最差学院的结果，为在无法保证稳定性时提供一种公平分配的实用方法。
AI.summary: 本文研究了学院招生等许多对一匹配问题，其中学院使用考虑多样性的非线性效用函数评估学生集合。由于经典稳定匹配可能不存在，研究提出了基于罗尔斯公平性的新概念，旨在最大化最差学院的效用，并为此设计了确定性和随机算法。
AI.keywords: 许多对一匹配, 非线性效用, 罗尔斯公平性, 稳定匹配, 学院招生
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将非线性效用函数引入到经典的许多对一匹配问题中，这更真实地反映了现实世界中对多样性的偏好。重要性在于它解决了经典稳定匹配可能不存在的问题，并提出了基于罗尔斯公平性的替代解。局限性在于摘要没有详细说明算法的效率或在更复杂模型中的适用性。

title: Knowledge Graph-enhanced Large Language Model for Incremental Game PlayTesting
summary:
The rapid iteration and frequent updates of modern video games pose
significant challenges to the efficiency and specificity of testing. Although
automated playtesting methods based on Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown
promise, they often lack structured knowledge accumulation mechanisms, making
it difficult to conduct precise and efficient testing tailored for incremental
game updates. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a KLPEG framework.
The framework constructs and maintains a Knowledge Graph (KG) to systematically
model game elements, task dependencies, and causal relationships, enabling
knowledge accumulation and reuse across versions. Building on this foundation,
the framework utilizes LLMs to parse natural language update logs, identify the
scope of impact through multi-hop reasoning on the KG, enabling the generation
of update-tailored test cases. Experiments in two representative game
environments, Overcooked and Minecraft, demonstrate that KLPEG can more
accurately locate functionalities affected by updates and complete tests in
fewer steps, significantly improving both playtesting effectiveness and
efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 知识图谱增强的大型语言模型在增量游戏可玩性测试中的应用
AI.tldr: KLPEG框架通过知识图谱增强大型语言模型，专门用于增量游戏更新的测试。它用KG结构化地存储游戏知识，LLM根据更新日志和KG推理来生成更有针对性的测试用例，实验证明它比现有方法更准确、更快速地完成测试。
AI.motivation: 现代视频游戏的快速迭代和频繁更新给测试的效率和特异性带来了重大挑战。现有的基于LLM的自动化测试方法通常缺乏结构化的知识积累机制，难以针对增量游戏更新进行精确和高效的测试。
AI.method: 该框架构建并维护了一个知识图谱（KG），用于系统地建模游戏元素、任务依赖和因果关系。然后，利用LLM解析自然语言更新日志，并通过在KG上进行多跳推理来识别影响范围，从而生成针对特定更新的测试用例。
AI.result: 在Overcooked和Minecraft两个代表性游戏环境中进行的实验表明，KLPEG能更准确地定位受更新影响的功能，并在更少的步骤内完成测试，显著提高了可玩性测试的有效性和效率。
AI.conclusion: KLPEG框架通过构建和维护知识图谱，利用LLM解析更新日志并基于KG进行多跳推理，能更准确地定位受更新影响的功能，并在更少的步骤内完成测试，显著提高了游戏可玩性测试的有效性和效率。
AI.translation: 现代视频游戏的快速迭代和频繁更新对测试的效率和特异性构成了重大挑战。虽然基于大型语言模型（LLM）的自动化可玩性测试方法显示出潜力，但它们通常缺乏结构化的知识积累机制，使得针对增量游戏更新进行精确和高效的测试变得困难。为应对这一挑战，本文提出了KLPEG框架。该框架构建并维护了一个知识图谱（KG），用于系统地建模游戏元素、任务依赖和因果关系，从而实现跨版本的知识积累和重用。在此基础上，该框架利用LLM解析自然语言更新日志，通过在KG上进行多跳推理来识别影响范围，从而生成针对更新定制的测试用例。在Overcooked和Minecraft两个代表性游戏环境中的实验表明，KLPEG能更准确地定位受更新影响的功能，并在更少的步骤内完成测试，显著提高了可玩性测试的有效性和效率。
AI.summary: 为解决现代游戏频繁更新带来的增量测试效率和特异性挑战，本文提出了KLPEG框架。该框架通过知识图谱（KG）系统地积累和重用游戏知识，并利用大型语言模型（LLM）解析更新日志，结合KG上的多跳推理来确定更新影响范围，从而生成定制化的测试用例，实验证明其在测试准确性和效率上均有显著提升。
AI.keywords: 知识图谱, 大型语言模型, 增量游戏测试, 知识积累, 多跳推理
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将知识图谱（KG）与大型语言模型（LLM）结合，专门用于处理增量游戏更新的测试问题，通过KG实现知识的系统化积累和多跳推理，解决了现有LLM方法缺乏结构化知识积累的缺点。其重要性在于提高了增量游戏版本测试的精度和效率。局限性方面，摘要未提及具体的局限性。

title: Theoretical Guarantees for Causal Discovery on Large Random Graphs
summary:
We investigate theoretical guarantees for the false-negative rate (FNR) --
the fraction of true causal edges whose orientation is not recovered, under
single-variable random interventions and an $\epsilon$-interventional
faithfulness assumption that accommodates latent confounding. For sparse
Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi directed acyclic graphs, where the edge probability scales
as $p_e = \Theta(1/d)$, we show that the FNR concentrates around its mean at
rate $O(\frac{\log d}{\sqrt d})$, implying that large deviations above the
expected error become exponentially unlikely as dimensionality increases. This
concentration ensures that derived upper bounds hold with high probability in
large-scale settings. Extending the analysis to generalized Barab\'asi--Albert
graphs reveals an even stronger phenomenon: when the degree exponent satisfies
$\gamma > 3$, the deviation width scales as $O(d^{\beta - \frac{1}{2}})$ with
$\beta = 1/(\gamma - 1) < \frac{1}{2}$, and hence vanishes in the limit. This
demonstrates that realistic scale-free topologies intrinsically regularize
causal discovery, reducing variability in orientation error. These
finite-dimension results provide the first dimension-adaptive,
faithfulness-robust guarantees for causal structure recovery, and challenge the
intuition that high dimensionality and network heterogeneity necessarily hinder
accurate discovery. Our simulation results corroborate these theoretical
predictions, showing that the FNR indeed concentrates and often vanishes in
practice as dimensionality grows.

title: Smart-Hiring: An Explainable end-to-end Pipeline for CV Information Extraction and Job Matching
summary:
Hiring processes often involve the manual screening of hundreds of resumes
for each job, a task that is time and effort consuming, error-prone, and
subject to human bias. This paper presents Smart-Hiring, an end-to-end Natural
Language Processing (NLP) pipeline de- signed to automatically extract
structured information from unstructured resumes and to semantically match
candidates with job descriptions. The proposed system combines document
parsing, named-entity recognition, and contextual text embedding techniques to
capture skills, experience, and qualifications. Using advanced NLP technics,
Smart-Hiring encodes both resumes and job descriptions in a shared vector space
to compute similarity scores between candidates and job postings. The pipeline
is modular and explainable, allowing users to inspect extracted entities and
matching rationales. Experiments were conducted on a real-world dataset of
resumes and job descriptions spanning multiple professional domains,
demonstrating the robustness and feasibility of the proposed approach. The
system achieves competitive matching accuracy while preserving a high degree of
interpretability and transparency in its decision process. This work introduces
a scalable and practical NLP frame- work for recruitment analytics and outlines
promising directions for bias mitigation, fairness-aware modeling, and
large-scale deployment of data-driven hiring solutions.

AI.title_translation: Smart-Hiring：用于简历信息抽取和职位匹配的可解释端到端管道
AI.tldr: Smart-Hiring是一个端到端的、可解释的NLP系统，用于从简历中提取信息并自动将候选人与工作要求进行匹配，旨在提高招聘效率和减少人为偏见，实验结果表明其准确且透明。
AI.motivation: 招聘过程通常涉及对数百份简历进行手动筛选，这是一项耗时、费力、容易出错且容易受到人为偏见影响的任务。
AI.method: 系统结合了文档解析、命名实体识别和上下文文本嵌入技术来捕获技能、经验和资历。然后，使用先进的NLP技术将简历和职位描述编码到共享向量空间中，以计算候选人与职位发布之间的相似度得分。该管道是模块化且可解释的。
AI.result: 实验证明了所提方法的鲁棒性和可行性，实现了具有竞争力的匹配准确性，同时保持了决策过程高度的可解释性和透明度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作引入了一个可扩展且实用的招聘分析NLP框架，并为偏见缓解、公平感知建模以及数据驱动招聘解决方案的大规模部署勾勒了有前景的方向。
AI.translation: 招聘过程通常涉及对每份工作的数百份简历进行手动筛选，这是一项耗时、费力、容易出错且容易受到人为偏见影响的任务。本文提出了Smart-Hiring，这是一个端到端的自然语言处理（NLP）管道，旨在自动从非结构化简历中提取结构化信息，并将候选人与职位描述进行语义匹配。所提出的系统结合了文档解析、命名实体识别和上下文文本嵌入技术，以捕获技能、经验和资历。使用先进的NLP技术，Smart-Hiring将简历和职位描述编码到共享向量空间中，以计算候选人与职位发布之间的相似度得分。该管道是模块化且可解释的，允许用户检查提取的实体和匹配的合理性。实验在跨越多个专业领域的真实简历和职位描述数据集上进行，证明了所提方法的鲁棒性和可行性。该系统在保持决策过程高度可解释性和透明度的同时，实现了具有竞争力的匹配准确性。这项工作引入了一个可扩展且实用的招聘分析NLP框架，并为偏见缓解、公平感知建模以及数据驱动招聘解决方案的大规模部署勾勒了有前景的方向。
AI.summary: Smart-Hiring是一个端到端的自然语言处理管道，旨在自动化简历的结构化信息提取和候选人与职位描述的语义匹配，以解决传统招聘流程中耗时、易错和存在偏见的问题。它利用文档解析、命名实体识别和上下文嵌入技术，并通过共享向量空间计算相似度。该系统具有模块化和可解释性，实验证明其匹配准确性具有竞争力且透明度高。
AI.keywords: 简历信息抽取, 作业匹配, 可解释性, 自然语言处理, 招聘分析
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提供了一个端到端的、可解释的招聘流程自动化解决方案，结合了信息抽取和语义匹配。其重要性在于解决了传统招聘中耗时、易错和存在偏见的问题。局限性未在摘要中明确提及，但端到端系统的复杂性可能是一个挑战。

title: Unsupervised Learning for Industrial Defect Detection: A Case Study on Shearographic Data
comments:
15 pages, 6 figures, 1 table; accepted for AI-2025 Forty-fifth SGAI
  International Conference on Artificial Intelligence CAMBRIDGE, ENGLAND 16-18
  DECEMBER 2025
summary:
Shearography is a non-destructive testing method for detecting subsurface
defects, offering high sensitivity and full-field inspection capabilities.
However, its industrial adoption remains limited due to the need for expert
interpretation. To reduce reliance on labeled data and manual evaluation, this
study explores unsupervised learning methods for automated anomaly detection in
shearographic images. Three architectures are evaluated: a fully connected
autoencoder, a convolutional autoencoder, and a student-teacher feature
matching model. All models are trained solely on defect-free data. A controlled
dataset was developed using a custom specimen with reproducible defect
patterns, enabling systematic acquisition of shearographic measurements under
both ideal and realistic deformation conditions. Two training subsets were
defined: one containing only undistorted, defect-free samples, and one
additionally including globally deformed, yet defect-free, data. The latter
simulates practical inspection conditions by incorporating deformation-induced
fringe patterns that may obscure localized anomalies. The models are evaluated
in terms of binary classification and, for the student-teacher model, spatial
defect localization. Results show that the student-teacher approach achieves
superior classification robustness and enables precise localization. Compared
to the autoencoder-based models, it demonstrates improved separability of
feature representations, as visualized through t-SNE embeddings. Additionally,
a YOLOv8 model trained on labeled defect data serves as a reference to
benchmark localization quality. This study underscores the potential of
unsupervised deep learning for scalable, label-efficient shearographic
inspection in industrial environments.
