title: Expertise and confidence explain how social influence evolves along intellective tasks
summary:
Discovering the antecedents of individuals' influence in collaborative
environments is an important, practical, and challenging problem. In this
paper, we study interpersonal influence in small groups of individuals who
collectively execute a sequence of intellective tasks. We observe that along an
issue sequence with feedback, individuals with higher expertise and social
confidence are accorded higher interpersonal influence. We also observe that
low-performing individuals tend to underestimate their high-performing
teammate's expertise. Based on these observations, we introduce three
hypotheses and present empirical and theoretical support for their validity. We
report empirical evidence on longstanding theories of transactive memory
systems, social comparison, and confidence heuristics on the origins of social
influence. We propose a cognitive dynamical model inspired by these theories to
describe the process by which individuals adjust interpersonal influences over
time. We demonstrate the model's accuracy in predicting individuals' influence
and provide analytical results on its asymptotic behavior for the case with
identically performing individuals. Lastly, we propose a novel approach using
deep neural networks on a pre-trained text embedding model for predicting the
influence of individuals. Using message contents, message times, and individual
correctness collected during tasks, we are able to accurately predict
individuals' self-reported influence over time. Extensive experiments verify
the accuracy of the proposed models compared to baselines such as structural
balance and reflected appraisal model. While the neural networks model is the
most accurate, the dynamical model is the most interpretable for influence
prediction.

title: A Behavioural Analysis of Credulous Twitter Users
comments: This is the Author's Accepted Manuscript, AAM
summary:
Thanks to platforms such as Twitter and Facebook, people can know facts and
events that otherwise would have been silenced. However, social media
significantly contribute also to fast spreading biased and false news while
targeting specific segments of the population. We have seen how false
information can be spread using automated accounts, known as bots. Using
Twitter as a benchmark, we investigate behavioural attitudes of so called
`credulous' users, i.e., genuine accounts following many bots. Leveraging our
previous work, where supervised learning is successfully applied to single out
credulous users, we improve the classification task with a detailed features'
analysis and provide evidence that simple and lightweight features are crucial
to detect such users. Furthermore, we study the differences in the way
credulous and not credulous users interact with bots and discover that
credulous users tend to amplify more the content posted by bots and argue that
their detection can be instrumental to get useful information on possible
dissemination of spam content, propaganda, and, in general, little or no
reliable information.

title: SoK: Design, Vulnerabilities, and Security Measures of Cryptocurrency Wallets
summary:
With the advent of decentralised digital currencies powered by blockchain
technology, a new era of peer-to-peer transactions has commenced. The rapid
growth of the cryptocurrency economy has led to increased use of
transaction-enabling wallets, making them a focal point for security risks. As
the frequency of wallet-related incidents rises, there is a critical need for a
systematic approach to measure and evaluate these attacks, drawing lessons from
past incidents to enhance wallet security. In response, we introduce a
multi-dimensional design taxonomy for existing and novel wallets with various
design decisions. We classify existing industry wallets based on this taxonomy,
identify previously occurring vulnerabilities and discuss the security
implications of design decisions. We also systematise threats to the wallet
mechanism and analyse the adversary's goals, capabilities and required
knowledge. We present a multi-layered attack framework and investigate 84
incidents between 2012 and 2024, accounting for $5.4B. Following this, we
classify defence implementations for these attacks on the precautionary and
remedial axes. We map the mechanism and design decisions to vulnerabilities,
attacks, and possible defence methods to discuss various insights.

title: Explainable Graph Neural Architecture Search via Monte-Carlo Tree Search (Full version)
summary:
The number of graph neural network (GNN) architectures has increased rapidly
due to the growing adoption of graph analysis. Although we use GNNs in wide
application scenarios, it is a laborious task to design/select optimal GNN
architectures in diverse graphs. To reduce human efforts, graph neural
architecture search (Graph NAS) has been used to search for a sub-optimal GNN
architecture that combines existing components. However, existing Graph NAS
methods lack explainability to understand the reasons why the model
architecture is selected because they use complex search space and neural
models to select architecture. Therefore, we propose an explainable Graph NAS
method, called ExGNAS, which consists of (i) a simple search space that can
adapt to various graphs and (ii) a search algorithm with Monte-Carlo tree that
makes the decision process explainable. The combination of our search space and
algorithm achieves finding accurate GNN models and the important functions
within the search space. We comprehensively evaluate ExGNAS compared with four
state-of-the-art Graph NAS methods in twelve graphs. Our experimental results
show that ExGNAS achieves high average accuracy and efficiency; improving
accuracy up to 26.1% and reducing run time up to 88%. Furthermore, we show the
effectiveness of explainability by questionnaire-based user study and
architecture analysis.

AI.title_translation: 通过蒙特卡洛树搜索实现可解释的图神经架构搜索（完整版）
AI.tldr: ExGNAS使用MCTS和简化的搜索空间来执行可解释的Graph NAS，在准确率和效率上显著优于现有方法，并证明了其决策过程的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 由于图分析应用的日益广泛，图神经网络（GNN）架构数量快速增加，但在多样化的图中设计/选择最优GNN架构是一项艰巨的任务。现有的Graph NAS方法由于使用了复杂的搜索空间和模型，缺乏对所选架构原因的解释性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为ExGNAS的可解释图NAS方法，它包含（i）一个可适应各种图的简单搜索空间，以及（ii）一个采用蒙特卡洛树的搜索算法，使决策过程可解释。
AI.result: ExGNAS在准确率上相对于现有方法平均提高了26.1%，运行时间减少了88%。同时，通过用户研究和架构分析验证了其可解释性的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ExGNAS在十二个图上与四种最先进的Graph NAS方法进行了全面比较，实验结果表明ExGNAS实现了高平均准确率和效率，并将准确率提高了26.1%，运行时间减少了88%。此外，通过基于问卷的用户研究和架构分析，证明了其可解释性的有效性。
AI.translation: 图神经网络（GNN）架构的数量由于图分析的日益普及而迅速增加。尽管我们在广泛的应用场景中使用GNN，但在多样化的图中设计/选择最佳GNN架构是一项费力的任务。为了减少人为努力，图神经架构搜索（Graph NAS）已被用于搜索结合现有组件的次优GNN架构。然而，现有的Graph NAS方法缺乏对模型架构被选择的原因的解释性，因为它们使用复杂的搜索空间和神经模型来选择架构。因此，我们提出了一种名为ExGNAS的可解释图NAS方法，它包括（i）一个可以适应各种图的简单搜索空间，以及（ii）一个采用蒙特卡洛树的搜索算法，使决策过程可解释。我们的搜索空间和算法的结合实现了找到准确的GNN模型和搜索空间中的重要功能。我们将ExGNAS与四种最先进的Graph NAS方法在十二个图上进行了全面评估。我们的实验结果表明，ExGNAS实现了高平均准确率和效率；准确率提高了26.1%，运行时间减少了88%。此外，我们通过基于问卷的用户研究和架构分析展示了可解释性的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ExGNAS，一种新的可解释图神经架构搜索（Graph NAS）方法。它通过结合一个简单的、适应性强的搜索空间和一个基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的搜索算法，解决了现有Graph NAS方法缺乏可解释性的问题。实验证明ExGNAS在准确性和效率上优于现有SOTA方法，并验证了其可解释性的价值。
AI.keywords: 图神经网络, 神经架构搜索, 可解释性, 蒙特卡洛树搜索, 图分析
AI.comments: 该方法的主要创新在于将蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）引入图神经架构搜索（Graph NAS）中，以解决现有方法的黑箱问题。通过设计一个简单的、可适应各种图的搜索空间，并使用MCTS来指导搜索，实现了搜索过程的可解释性。其性能超越了最先进的基线方法。

title: Machine Learning-assisted Dynamics-Constrained Day-Ahead Energy Scheduling
summary:
TThe rapid expansion of inverter-based resources, such as wind and solar
power plants, will significantly diminish the presence of conventional
synchronous generators in fu-ture power grids with rich renewable energy
sources. This transition introduces in-creased complexity and reduces dynamic
stability in system operation and control, with low inertia being a widely
recognized challenge. However, the literature has not thoroughly explored grid
dynamic performance associated with energy scheduling so-lutions that
traditionally only consider grid steady-state constraints. This paper will
bridge the gap by enforcing grid dynamic constraints when conducting optimal
energy scheduling; particularly, this paper explores locational
post-contingency rate of change of frequency (RoCoF) requirements to
accommodate substantial inertia reductions. This paper introduces a machine
learning-assisted RoCoF-constrained unit commit-ment (ML-RCUC) model designed
to ensure RoCoF stability after the most severe generator outage while
maintaining operational efficiency. A graph-informed NN (GINN)-based RoCoF
predictor is first trained on a high-fidelity simulation dataset to track the
highest locational RoCoF, which is then reformulated as mixed-integer linear
programming constraints that are integrated into the unit commitment model.
Case studies, by solving the optimization problem ML-RCUC and validating its
solutions with time-domain simulations, demonstrate that the proposed method
can ensure loca-tional RoCoF stability with minimum conservativeness.

AI.title_translation: 机器学习辅助的动态约束日前能源调度
AI.tldr: 针对未来高可再生能源并网导致的低惯量和动态稳定性问题，本研究开发了一种新的机器学习辅助单元承诺模型（ML-RCUC），该模型使用图神经网络预测并约束了系统在严重机组跳闸后的局部频率变化率（RoCoF），从而在保证动态安全的前提下优化了日前能源调度。
AI.motivation: 随着逆变器驱动资源（如风能和太阳能）的快速扩张，传统同步发电机减少，导致电网运行和控制的复杂性增加和动态稳定性降低，低惯量是一个公认的挑战。现有文献尚未充分研究仅考虑电网稳态约束的能量调度解决方案所带来的电网动态性能问题。因此，需要将电网动态约束（特别是Locational Post-Contingency RoCoF要求）纳入最优能量调度中。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于机器学习辅助的、受RoCoF约束的单元承诺（ML-RCUC）模型。首先，使用基于图的神经网络（GINN）在一个高保真仿真数据集上进行训练，以预测最高的局部RoCoF。然后，将预测结果重新构建为混合整数线性规划约束，并将其集成到单元承诺模型中，以在最严重的机组跳闸后确保RoCoF稳定性。最后，通过求解优化问题和时间域仿真验证了该方法。
AI.result: 通过解决ML-RCUC优化问题并使用时间域仿真验证其解决方案，证明了所提出的方法能够在确保局部RoCoF稳定性的同时，实现最小的保守性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的ML-RCUC模型能够确保发电机跳闸后局部RoCoF的稳定性，同时保持操作效率，并且通过时间域仿真验证，该方法具有最小的保守性。
AI.translation: 逆变器驱动资源（如风能和太阳能发电厂）的快速扩张，将显著减少未来富含可再生能源的电网中传统同步发电机的存在。这种转变带来了操作和控制复杂性的增加，并降低了系统的动态稳定性，低惯量是公认的挑战。然而，文献尚未充分探讨与传统上仅考虑电网稳态约束的能量调度解决方案相关的电网动态性能。本文将通过在进行最优能量调度时强制执行电网动态约束来弥补这一差距；特别是，本文探讨了局部事后频率变化率（RoCoF）要求，以适应大幅度的惯量减少。本文提出了一种机器学习辅助的受RoCoF约束的单元承诺（ML-RCUC）模型，旨在确保在最严重的机组跳闸后RoCoF的稳定性，同时保持运行效率。首先，在高质量仿真数据集上训练一个基于图的神经网络（GINN）RoCoF预测器，以跟踪最高的局部RoCoF，然后将其重新构建为混合整数线性规划约束，并集成到单元承诺模型中。通过求解ML-RCUC优化问题并通过时间域仿真验证其解决方案的案例研究表明，所提出的方法可以以最小的保守性确保局部RoCoF的稳定性。
AI.summary: 为应对未来高可再生能源并网中低惯量导致的动态稳定性挑战，本文提出了一种机器学习辅助的、受RoCoF约束的日前能量调度（ML-RCUC）模型。该模型利用图神经网络（GINN）预测最坏情况下的局部频率变化率（RoCoF），并将其转化为混合整数线性规划约束，以确保发电机跳闸后的动态稳定，同时保持运行效率。
AI.keywords: 能量调度, 惯量降低, 频率变化率, 机器学习, 单元承诺
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将机器学习预测的动态约束（特别是RoCoF）集成到传统的日前能量调度（UC）模型中，解决了现有方法仅关注稳态约束的局限性。其重要性在于为高比例可再生能源并网下的电网动态稳定性提供了可行的调度框架。限制是模型依赖于高保真仿真数据集来训练预测器。

title: Robust Identity Perceptual Watermark Against Deepfake Face Swapping
summary:
Notwithstanding offering convenience and entertainment to society, Deepfake
face swapping has caused critical privacy issues with the rapid development of
deep generative models. Due to imperceptible artifacts in high-quality
synthetic images, passive detection models against face swapping in recent
years usually suffer performance damping regarding the generalizability issue
in cross-domain scenarios. Therefore, several studies have been attempted to
proactively protect the original images against malicious manipulations by
inserting invisible signals in advance. However, existing proactive defense
approaches demonstrate unsatisfactory results with respect to visual quality,
detection accuracy, and source tracing ability. In this study, to fulfill the
research gap, we propose a robust identity perceptual watermarking framework
that concurrently performs detection and source tracing against Deepfake face
swapping proactively. We innovatively assign identity semantics regarding the
image contents to the watermarks and devise an unpredictable and nonreversible
chaotic encryption system to ensure watermark confidentiality. The watermarks
are robustly encoded and recovered by jointly training an encoder-decoder
framework along with adversarial image manipulations. For a suspect image,
falsification is accomplished by justifying the consistency between the
content-matched identity perceptual watermark and the recovered robust
watermark, without requiring the ground-truth. Moreover, source tracing can be
accomplished based on the identity semantics that the recovered watermark
carries. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art detection and
source tracing performance against Deepfake face swapping with promising
watermark robustness for both cross-dataset and cross-manipulation settings.

title: Testing with Non-identically Distributed Samples
summary:
We examine the extent to which sublinear-sample property testing and
estimation apply to settings where samples are independently but not
identically distributed. Specifically, we consider the following distributional
property testing framework: Suppose there is a set of distributions over a
discrete support of size $k$, $p_1, p_2,\ldots,p_T$, and we obtain $c$
independent draws from each distribution. Suppose the goal is to learn or test
a property of the average distribution, $p_{avg}$. This setup models a number
of important practical settings where the individual distributions correspond
to heterogeneous entities -- either individuals, chronologically distinct time
periods, spatially separated data sources, etc. From a learning standpoint,
even with $c=1$ samples from each distribution, $\Theta(k/\varepsilon^2)$
samples are necessary and sufficient to learn $p_{avg}$ to within error
$\varepsilon$ in $\ell_1$ distance. To test uniformity or identity --
distinguishing the case that $p_{avg}$ is equal to some reference distribution,
versus has $\ell_1$ distance at least $\varepsilon$ from the reference
distribution, we show that a linear number of samples in $k$ is necessary given
$c=1$ samples from each distribution. In contrast, for $c \ge 2$, we recover
the usual sublinear sample testing guarantees of the i.i.d.\ setting: we show
that $O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon^2 + 1/\varepsilon^4)$ total samples are
sufficient, matching the optimal sample complexity in the i.i.d.\ case in the
regime where $\varepsilon \ge k^{-1/4}$. Additionally, we show that in the
$c=2$ case, there is a constant $\rho > 0$ such that even in the linear regime
with $\rho k$ samples, no tester that considers the multiset of samples
(ignoring which samples were drawn from the same $p_i$) can perform uniformity
testing. We also extend our techniques to the problem of testing "closeness" of
two distributions.

title: Training Convolutional Neural Networks with the Forward-Forward algorithm
comments:
PEER-REVIEWED VERSION PUBLISHED ON "SCIENTIFIC REPORTS" (2025) DOI:
  10.1038/s41598-025-26235-2
summary:
Recent successes in image analysis with deep neural networks are achieved
almost exclusively with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), typically trained
using the backpropagation (BP) algorithm. In a 2022 preprint, Geoffrey Hinton
proposed the Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm as a biologically inspired
alternative, where positive and negative examples are jointly presented to the
network and training is guided by a locally defined goodness function. Here, we
extend the FF paradigm to CNNs. We introduce two spatially extended labeling
strategies, based on Fourier patterns and morphological transformations, that
enable convolutional layers to access label information across all spatial
positions. On CIFAR10, we show that deeper FF-trained CNNs can be optimized
successfully and that morphology-based labels prevent shortcut solutions on
dataset with more complex and fine features. On CIFAR100, carefully designed
label sets scale effectively to 100 classes. Class Activation Maps reveal that
FF-trained CNNs learn meaningful and complementary features across layers.
Together, these results demonstrate that FF training is feasible beyond fully
connected networks, provide new insights into its learning dynamics and
stability, and highlight its potential for neuromorphic computing and
biologically inspired learning.

title: How Teachers Can Use Large Language Models and Bloom's Taxonomy to Create Educational Quizzes
comments:
8 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to the main track of the EAAI-24: The
  14th Symposium on Educational Advances in Artificial Intelligence
summary:
Question generation (QG) is a natural language processing task with an
abundance of potential benefits and use cases in the educational domain. In
order for this potential to be realized, QG systems must be designed and
validated with pedagogical needs in mind. However, little research has assessed
or designed QG approaches with the input from real teachers or students. This
paper applies a large language model-based QG approach where questions are
generated with learning goals derived from Bloom's taxonomy. The automatically
generated questions are used in multiple experiments designed to assess how
teachers use them in practice. The results demonstrate that teachers prefer to
write quizzes with automatically generated questions, and that such quizzes
have no loss in quality compared to handwritten versions. Further, several
metrics indicate that automatically generated questions can even improve the
quality of the quizzes created, showing the promise for large scale use of QG
in the classroom setting.

AI.title_translation: 教师如何利用大型语言模型和布鲁姆分类法创建教育测验
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用大型语言模型和布鲁姆分类法来自动生成教育测验问题，实验证明教师喜欢使用这些问题，并且由AI生成的测验质量与教师手写的一样好甚至更好，预示着AI在课堂测验创建中的广阔前景。
AI.motivation: 为了实现问答生成（QG）在教育领域应用的全部潜力，QG系统必须根据教学需求进行设计和验证，但目前很少有研究采纳真实教师或学生的意见来设计QG方法。
AI.method: 应用一种基于大型语言模型的问答生成方法，其中问题是根据源自布鲁姆分类法的学习目标生成的，并通过多项实验评估教师在实践中如何使用这些自动生成的问题。
AI.result: 结果表明，教师更喜欢使用自动生成的问题来编写测验，并且此类测验的质量与手写版本相比没有损失；此外，多项指标显示自动生成的问题甚至可以提高测验的质量。
AI.conclusion: 自动生成的问题可以提高测验质量，表明大型语言模型在课堂环境中进行大规模问答生成具有潜力。
AI.translation: 问答生成（QG）是一项在教育领域具有大量潜在益处和用例的自然语言处理任务。为了实现这一潜力，QG系统必须根据教学需求进行设计和验证。然而，很少有研究评估或设计了考虑真实教师或学生输入的QG方法。本文应用了一种基于大型语言模型的QG方法，其中问题是根据源自布鲁姆分类法的学习目标生成的。自动生成的问题被用于多项实验中，旨在评估教师如何在实践中使用它们。结果表明，教师更喜欢使用自动生成的问题来编写测验，并且此类测验的质量与手写版本相比没有损失。此外，多项指标表明自动生成的问题甚至可以提高测验的质量，显示了QG技术在课堂环境中进行大规模应用的潜力。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在解决现有问答生成（QG）系统缺乏教学实践考量的问题，提出了一种基于大型语言模型（LLM）并结合布鲁姆分类法学习目标的问答生成方法。通过实验评估，发现教师倾向于使用这些自动生成的问题，且测验质量不低于手写版本，甚至有所提高，证明了QG技术在课堂中大规模应用的潜力。
AI.keywords: 问题生成, 大型语言模型, 布鲁姆分类法, 教师实践, 教育技术
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于将大型语言模型（LLM）与布鲁姆分类法（Bloom's Taxonomy）相结合，以满足教学需求来生成教育测验问题。重要性在于它首次从真实教师的实践角度评估了自动生成的问题。局限性可能在于研究仅关注了教师对生成问题的偏好和质量，而未深入探讨对学生学习效果的具体影响。

title: Continuous-time Riemannian SGD and SVRG Flows on Wasserstein Probabilistic Space
summary:
Recently, optimization on the Riemannian manifold have provided valuable
insights to the optimization community. In this regard, extending these methods
to to the Wasserstein space is of particular interest, since optimization on
Wasserstein space is closely connected to practical sampling processes.
Generally, the standard (continuous) optimization method on Wasserstein space
is Riemannian gradient flow (i.e., Langevin dynamics when minimizing KL
divergence). In this paper, we aim to enrich the family of continuous
optimization methods in the Wasserstein space, by extending the gradient flow
on it into the stochastic gradient descent (SGD) flow and stochastic variance
reduction gradient (SVRG) flow.
  By leveraging the property of Wasserstein space, we construct stochastic
differential equations (SDEs) to approximate the corresponding discrete
Euclidean dynamics of the desired Riemannian stochastic methods. Then, we
obtain the flows in Wasserstein space by Fokker-Planck equation. Finally, we
establish convergence rates of the proposed stochastic flows, which align with
those known in the Euclidean setting.

title: A supervised learning scheme for computing Hamilton-Jacobi equation via density coupling
comments:
This is a revised version of the original manuscript, with updated
  numerical examples. Any comments or suggestions are very welcome
summary:
We propose a supervised learning scheme for the first order Hamilton--Jacobi
PDEs in high dimensions. The scheme is designed by using the geometric
structure of Wasserstein Hamiltonian flows via a density coupling strategy. It
is equivalently posed as a regression problem using the Bregman divergence,
which provides the loss function in learning while the data is generated
through the particle formulation of Wasserstein Hamiltonian flow. We prove a
posterior estimate on $L^1$ residual of the proposed scheme based on the
coupling density. Furthermore, the proposed scheme can be used to describe the
behaviors of Hamilton--Jacobi PDEs beyond the singularity formations on the
support of coupling density. Several numerical examples with different
Hamiltonians are provided to support our findings.

AI.title_translation: 一种通过密度耦合计算哈密顿-雅可比方程的监督学习方案
AI.tldr: 提出一种基于密度耦合和Wasserstein流几何结构的新监督学习方法，用于求解高维HJ方程，并通过Bregman散度进行回归训练，同时获得了理论误差估计，并能处理奇点后的行为。
AI.motivation: 针对高维一阶哈密顿-雅可比偏微分方程（HJ PDEs）的求解问题。
AI.method: 通过密度耦合策略，利用Wasserstein哈密顿流的几何结构，将高维一阶哈密顿-雅可比偏微分方程的求解转化为一个使用Bregman散度作为损失函数的回归问题，数据通过Wasserstein哈密顿流的粒子形式生成。
AI.result: 基于耦合密度，对所提方案的$L^1$残差提供了一个后验估计。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方案可以用于描述耦合密度支撑上超越奇点形成的哈密顿-雅可比偏微分方程的行为。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于高维一阶哈密顿-雅可比偏微分方程的监督学习方案。该方案通过使用密度耦合策略，利用Wasserstein哈密顿流的几何结构来设计。它等价于一个使用Bregman散度作为学习中损失函数的回归问题，而数据是通过Wasserstein哈密顿流的粒子形式生成的。我们基于耦合密度证明了所提方案的$L^1$残差的后验估计。此外，所提出的方案可用于描述耦合密度支撑上超越奇点形成的哈密顿-雅可比偏微分方程的行为。提供了几个具有不同哈密顿量的数值例子来支持我们的发现。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于求解高维一阶哈密顿-雅可比偏微分方程的监督学习方案。该方案利用Wasserstein哈密顿流的几何结构，通过密度耦合策略设计，等价于一个使用Bregman散度作为损失函数的回归问题，数据由Wasserstein哈密顿流的粒子公式生成。研究证明了基于耦合密度的$L^1$残差的后验估计，并展示了该方案可用于描述奇点形成后的方程行为。
AI.keywords: 哈密顿-雅可比方程, 监督学习, 密度耦合, Wasserstein流, Bregman散度
AI.comments: 该方法创新地将高维HJ方程的求解转化为基于Wasserstein流的密度耦合策略下的回归问题，利用Bregman散度作为损失函数，并在耦合密度上提供了$L^1$残差的后验估计。其优势在于能够描述奇点形成之外的行为。

title: Ruitenburg's Theorem Mechanized and Contextualized
comments:
In Proceedings FICS 2024, arXiv:2511.00626. The results were obtained
  while the author was employed at FAU Erlangen-Nuremberg. In the final stages
  of preparing the print version, the author has been employed at University of
  Naples Federico II, supported by the PNRR MUR projects FAIR (No.
  PE0000013-FAIR)
summary:
In 1984, Wim Ruitenburg published a surprising result about periodic
sequences in intuitionistic propositional calculus (IPC). The property
established by Ruitenburg naturally generalizes local finiteness; recall that
intuitionistic logic is not locally finite, even in a single variable. One of
the two main goals of this note is to illustrate that most "natural"
non-classical logics failing local finiteness also do not enjoy the periodic
sequence property. IPC is quite unique in separating these properties. The
other goal of this note is to present a Coq formalization of Ruitenburg's
heavily syntactic proof. Apart from ensuring its correctness, the formalization
allows extraction of a program providing a certified implementation of
Ruitenburg's algorithm.

AI.title_translation: Ruitenburg定理的机械化与语境化
AI.tldr: 利用Coq形式化了Ruitenburg关于IPC周期序列的复杂证明，并发现大多数不局部有限的非经典逻辑都没有周期序列性质，IPC是特例。
AI.motivation: 两个主要动机：一是说明大多数不满足局部有限性的“自然”非经典逻辑也不具有周期序列性质，从而凸显直觉主义命题演算（IPC）的独特性；二是呈现Ruitenburg高度句法化证明的Coq形式化，以确保正确性并提取认证的算法实现。
AI.method: Coq形式化Ruitenburg的句法证明，并用于阐述大多数不满足局部有限性的非经典逻辑也不满足周期序列性质。
AI.result: 成功对Ruitenburg的证明进行了Coq形式化，确保了其正确性，并允许提取一个提供认证实现的程序。同时，证实了大多数不满足局部有限性的非经典逻辑也不具有周期序列性质。
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation:
Ruitenburg定理的机械化与语境化

1984年，Wim Ruitenburg发表了一个关于直觉主义命题演算（IPC）中周期序列的惊人结果。Ruitenburg确立的性质自然地推广了局部有限性；回想一下，直觉主义逻辑即使在单个变量下也不是局部有限的。本文的两个主要目标之一是说明大多数不满足局部有限性的“自然”非经典逻辑也不具有周期序列性质。IPC在区分这些性质上是非常独特的。本文的另一个目标是呈现对Ruitenburg高度句法化证明的Coq形式化。除了确保其正确性之外，这种形式化还允许提取一个提供Ruitenburg算法认证实现的程序。
AI.summary: 本文旨在通过Coq形式化来验证和实现Ruitenburg关于直觉主义命题演算（IPC）周期序列的证明。此外，它还阐明了大多数不具有局部有限性的非经典逻辑也缺乏周期序列性质，表明IPC在这些性质上的独特性。
AI.keywords: Ruitenburg's Theorem, Intuitionistic Propositional Calculus, Periodic Sequences, Local Finiteness, Coq Formalization
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将一个复杂的、高度句法化的数学证明（Ruitenburg's Theorem）进行了Coq形式化，这不仅验证了其正确性，还提供了可验证的算法实现。重要性在于揭示了周期序列性质与局部有限性之间的关系在非经典逻辑中的普遍性，突显了IPC的独特性。局限性是分析主要集中在周期序列性质和局部有限性，可能没有探讨其他非经典逻辑的特性。

title: Reset & Distill: A Recipe for Overcoming Negative Transfer in Continual Reinforcement Learning
summary:
We argue that the negative transfer problem occurring when the new task to
learn arrives is an important problem that needs not be overlooked when
developing effective Continual Reinforcement Learning (CRL) algorithms. Through
comprehensive experimental validation, we demonstrate that such issue
frequently exists in CRL and cannot be effectively addressed by several recent
work on either mitigating plasticity loss of RL agents or enhancing the
positive transfer in CRL scenario. To that end, we develop Reset & Distill
(R&D), a simple yet highly effective baseline method, to overcome the negative
transfer problem in CRL. R&D combines a strategy of resetting the agent's
online actor and critic networks to learn a new task and an offline learning
step for distilling the knowledge from the online actor and previous expert's
action probabilities. We carried out extensive experiments on long sequence of
Meta World tasks and show that our simple baseline method consistently
outperforms recent approaches, achieving significantly higher success rates
across a range of tasks. Our findings highlight the importance of considering
negative transfer in CRL and emphasize the need for robust strategies like R&D
to mitigate its detrimental effects.

AI.title_translation: 重置与蒸馏：克服持续强化学习中负迁移的秘诀
AI.tldr: 持续强化学习中存在负迁移问题，现有方法效果不佳。我们提出了一个简单有效的新方法R&D，它通过重置网络和知识蒸馏来克服负迁移，并在实验中显著提高了成功率。
AI.motivation: 负迁移问题是开发有效持续强化学习（CRL）算法时不应忽视的一个重要问题。
AI.method: R&D结合了重置智能体在线Actor和Critic网络以学习新任务的策略，以及一个用于从在线Actor和先前专家动作概率中蒸馏知识的离线学习步骤。
AI.result: 我们的简单基线方法R&D在Meta World任务的长期序列上进行了广泛实验，一致优于近期方法，在各种任务中实现了显著更高的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 我们的发现突出了考虑CRL中负迁移的重要性，并强调了像R&D这样稳健策略来减轻其不利影响的必要性。
AI.translation: 我们认为，当新任务到来时发生的负迁移问题是在开发有效的持续强化学习（CRL）算法时不应忽视的一个重要问题。通过全面的实验验证，我们证明了这种问题在CRL中频繁存在，并且现有的几种缓解RL智能体可塑性损失或增强CRL场景中正向迁移的工作都无法有效解决。为此，我们开发了重置与蒸馏（R&D），一个简单但非常有效的基线方法，以克服CRL中的负迁移问题。R&D结合了重置智能体在线Actor和Critic网络以学习新任务的策略，以及一个用于从在线Actor和先前专家动作概率中蒸馏知识的离线学习步骤。我们在长期序列的Meta World任务上进行了广泛的实验，结果表明我们的简单基线方法一致优于近期方法，在各种任务中实现了显著更高的成功率。我们的发现突出了考虑CRL中负迁移的重要性，并强调了像R&D这样稳健策略来减轻其不利影响的必要性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“重置与蒸馏”（R&D）的简单而有效的方法，旨在解决持续强化学习（CRL）中普遍存在的负迁移问题。R&D通过重置智能体网络并结合知识蒸馏步骤，在Meta World任务上取得了比现有方法更高的成功率。
AI.keywords: 持续强化学习, 负迁移, 重置, 蒸馏, 知识迁移
AI.comments: 该方法创新点在于结合了“重置”和“蒸馏”两个简单而有效的步骤来解决持续强化学习中的负迁移问题，实验结果表明其优于现有方法。局限性在于仅基于Meta World任务进行验证。

title: Using Fiber Optic Bundles to Miniaturize Vision-Based Tactile Sensors
comments:
This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication.
  The CAD design files of DIGIT Pinki are available at
  https://github.com/facebookresearch/digit-design
summary:
Vision-based tactile sensors have recently become popular due to their
combination of low cost, very high spatial resolution, and ease of integration
using widely available miniature cameras. The associated field of view and
focal length, however, are difficult to package in a human-sized finger. In
this paper we employ optical fiber bundles to achieve a form factor that, at 15
mm diameter, is smaller than an average human fingertip. The electronics and
camera are also located remotely, further reducing package size. The sensor
achieves a spatial resolution of 0.22 mm and a minimum force resolution 5 mN
for normal and shear contact forces. With these attributes, the DIGIT Pinki
sensor is suitable for applications such as robotic and teleoperated digital
palpation. We demonstrate its utility for palpation of the prostate gland and
show that it can achieve clinically relevant discrimination of prostate
stiffness for phantom and ex vivo tissue.

AI.title_translation: 使用光纤束使基于视觉的触觉传感器小型化
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用光纤束将基于视觉的触觉传感器缩小到小于指尖的尺寸（15毫米直径），同时保持了高分辨率（0.22毫米空间，5 mN力），并成功将其应用于前列腺组织硬度的临床相关区分。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于视觉的触觉传感器虽然成本低、空间分辨率高、易于集成，但其视场和焦距难以封装在人大小的手指中。
AI.method: 采用光纤束来实现传感器的小型化封装，将电子设备和相机远程放置，以减小封装尺寸。
AI.result: 所提出的DIGIT Pinki传感器实现了0.22毫米的空间分辨率和5毫牛（mN）的法向和剪切接触力的最小力分辨率。
AI.conclusion: DIGIT Pinki传感器具有临床上相关的区分前列腺硬度的能力，适用于机器人和遥操作数字触诊等应用。
AI.translation: 基于视觉的触觉传感器由于其低成本、极高的空间分辨率以及易于使用现有的微型相机进行集成等优点，最近变得流行起来。然而，相关的视场和焦距在人大小的手指中难以封装。在本文中，我们采用光纤束来实现一种外形尺寸，其直径为15毫米，小于平均人类指尖。电子设备和相机也位于远程，进一步减小了封装尺寸。该传感器实现了0.22毫米的空间分辨率和5毫牛（mN）的法向和剪切接触力的最小力分辨率。凭借这些属性，DIGIT Pinki传感器适用于机器人和遥操作数字触诊等应用。我们证明了其在触诊前列腺方面的效用，并显示出它可以实现对模型和离体组织前列腺硬度的临床相关区分。
AI.summary: 本研究利用光纤束成功地将基于视觉的触觉传感器小型化至15毫米直径，小于平均人类指尖，并将电子设备和相机远程放置。这种新型传感器（DIGIT Pinki）具有0.22毫米的空间分辨率和5毫牛的力分辨率，非常适合机器人和遥操作数字触诊，并已成功用于区分前列腺组织硬度。
AI.keywords: 光纤束, 触觉传感器, 小型化, 视觉传感器, 数字触诊
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于使用光纤束成功地将基于视觉的触觉传感器小型化，使其尺寸小于人类指尖，解决了传统视觉传感器的视场和焦距难以集成到人手大小手指中的问题。其重要性在于为机器人和遥操作数字触诊等应用提供了一个高分辨率、低成本的解决方案。限制在于摘要中未明确提及。

title: Guided Bayesian Optimization: Data-Efficient Controller Tuning with Digital Twin
comments:
This work has been published in IEEE Transactions on Automation
  Science and Engineering
summary:
This article presents the guided Bayesian optimization algorithm as an
efficient data-driven method for iteratively tuning closed-loop controller
parameters using an event-triggered digital twin of the system based on
available closed-loop data. We define a controller tuning framework independent
of the controller or the plant structure. Our proposed methodology is
model-free, making it suitable for nonlinear and unmodelled plants with
measurement noise. The objective function consists of performance metrics
modeled by Gaussian processes. We utilize the available information in the
closed-loop system to identify and progressively maintain a digital twin that
guides the optimizer, improving the data efficiency of our method. Switching
the digital twin on and off is triggered by data-driven criteria related to the
digital twin's uncertainty estimations in the BO tuning framework. Effectively,
it replaces much of the exploration of the real system with exploration
performed on the digital twin. We analyze the properties of our method in
simulation and demonstrate its performance on two real closed-loop systems with
different plant and controller structures. The experimental results show that
our method requires fewer experiments on the physical plant than Bayesian
optimization to find the optimal controller parameters.

title: Interactive Identification of Granular Materials using Force Measurements
comments:
Accepted to 2025 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and
  Cybernetics (SMC)
summary:
Despite the potential the ability to identify granular materials creates for
applications such as robotic cooking or earthmoving, granular material
identification remains a challenging area, existing methods mostly relying on
shaking the materials in closed containers. This work presents an interactive
material identification framework that enables robots to identify a wide range
of granular materials using only force-torque measurements. Unlike prior works,
the proposed approach uses direct interaction with the materials. The approach
is evaluated through experiments with a real-world dataset comprising 11
granular materials, which we also make publicly available. Results show that
our method can identify a wide range of granular materials with near-perfect
accuracy while relying solely on force measurements obtained from direct
interaction. Further, our comprehensive data analysis and experiments show that
a high-performancefeature space must combine features related to the force
signal's time-domain dynamics and frequency spectrum. We account for this by
proposing a combination of the raw signal and its high-frequency magnitude
histogram as the suggested feature space representation. We show that the
proposed feature space outperforms baselines by a significant margin. The code
and data set are available at: https://irobotics.aalto.fi/identify_granular/.

AI.title_translation: 使用力测量进行颗粒材料的交互式识别
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的机器人识别颗粒材料的方法，它通过直接接触材料并仅测量力/力矩来实现近乎完美的识别精度，并提供了一个结合时域和频域特征的有效特征空间。
AI.motivation: 颗粒材料识别对机器人烹饪或土方作业等应用具有巨大潜力，但现有方法大多依赖于在密闭容器中摇晃材料，因此需要开发新的、更具交互性的识别方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种交互式材料识别框架，机器人仅使用力-力矩测量数据与材料直接交互进行识别。该方法通过实验评估，并建议使用结合原始信号及其高频幅度直方图的特征空间来表示数据。
AI.result: 该方法可以以接近完美（near-perfect）的准确率识别各种颗粒材料，并且仅依赖于直接交互获得的力测量数据。提出的特征空间（原始信号和高频幅度直方图的组合）显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够仅依靠直接交互获得的力测量数据，以接近完美（near-perfect）的准确率识别各种颗粒材料。进一步的分析表明，结合力信号的时域动力学和频域谱的特征空间是高性能的关键，作者提出的结合原始信号和高频幅度直方图的特征空间显著优于基线方法。
AI.translation: 尽管能够识别颗粒材料为机器人烹饪或土方作业等应用带来了潜力，但颗粒材料识别仍然是一个具有挑战性的领域，现有方法大多依赖于在密闭容器中摇晃材料。这项工作提出了一个交互式材料识别框架，使机器人仅使用力-力矩测量即可识别各种颗粒材料。与先前的工作不同，所提出的方法使用与材料的直接交互。该方法通过使用包含11种颗粒材料的真实世界数据集的实验进行了评估，我们也使该数据集公开可用。结果表明，我们的方法可以以接近完美的准确率识别各种颗粒材料，同时仅依赖于从直接交互中获得的力测量数据。此外，我们全面的数据分析和实验表明，高性能特征空间必须结合与力信号时域动力学和频域谱相关的特征。我们通过提出原始信号及其高频幅度直方图的组合作为建议的特征空间表示来解决这个问题。我们证明了所提出的特征空间在很大程度上优于基线方法。代码和数据集可访问：https://irobotics.aalto.fi/identify_granular/。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种创新的、基于直接交互和纯力矩测量的颗粒材料识别框架，以克服现有方法的局限性。通过在包含11种材料的真实世界数据集上进行评估，该方法实现了接近完美的识别精度。研究还发现，高性能的特征空间需要结合力信号的时域动态和频域信息，并提出了一个结合原始信号和高频幅度直方图的有效特征表示。
AI.keywords: 颗粒材料识别, 力测量, 机器人交互, 时频特征, 机器人烹饪
AI.comments: 该工作的主要创新在于使用直接交互和纯力矩测量来进行颗粒材料识别，这与以往依赖密闭容器振动的方法形成鲜明对比。它提供了一个实用的、高精度的框架，并公开了数据集和代码，对机器人抓取和操作领域具有重要意义。局限性可能在于其对“直接交互”的依赖，这可能在某些实际场景中难以实现或不安全。

title: Energy-Based Model for Accurate Estimation of Shapley Values in Feature Attribution
summary:
Shapley value is a widely used tool in explainable artificial intelligence
(XAI), as it provides a principled way to attribute contributions of input
features to model outputs. However, estimation of Shapley value requires
capturing conditional dependencies among all feature combinations, which poses
significant challenges in complex data environments. In this article, EmSHAP
(Energy-based model for Shapley value estimation), an accurate Shapley value
estimation method, is proposed to estimate the expectation of Shapley
contribution function under the arbitrary subset of features given the rest. By
utilizing the ability of energy-based model (EBM) to model complex
distributions, EmSHAP provides an effective solution for estimating the
required conditional probabilities. To further improve estimation accuracy, a
GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit)-coupled partition function estimation method is
introduced. The GRU network captures long-term dependencies with a lightweight
parameterization and maps input features into a latent space to mitigate the
influence of feature ordering. Additionally, a dynamic masking mechanism is
incorporated to further enhance the robustness and accuracy by progressively
increasing the masking rate. Theoretical analysis on the error bound as well as
application to four case studies verified the higher accuracy and better
scalability of EmSHAP in contrast to competitive methods.

title: A Survey on Large Language Model-Based Game Agents
summary:
Game environments provide rich, controllable settings that stimulate many
aspects of real-world complexity. As such, game agents offer a valuable testbed
for exploring capabilities relevant to Artificial General Intelligence.
Recently, the emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) provides new
opportunities to endow these agents with generalizable reasoning, memory, and
adaptability in complex game environments. This survey offers an up-to-date
review of LLM-based game agents (LLMGAs) through a unified reference
architecture. At the single-agent level, we synthesize existing studies around
three core components: memory, reasoning, and perception-action interfaces,
which jointly characterize how language enables agents to perceive, think, and
act. At the multi-agent level, we outline how communication protocols and
organizational models support coordination, role differentiation, and
large-scale social behaviors. To contextualize these designs, we introduce a
challenge-centered taxonomy linking six major game genres to their dominant
agent requirements, from low-latency control in action games to open-ended goal
formation in sandbox worlds. A curated list of related papers is available at
https://github.com/git-disl/awesome-LLM-game-agent-papers

title: Faster Game Solving by Fixpoint Acceleration
summary:
We propose a method for solving parity games with acyclic (DAG)
sub-structures by computing nested fixpoints of a DAG attractor function that
lives over the non-DAG parts of the game, thereby restricting the domain of the
involved fixpoint operators. Intuitively, this corresponds to accelerating
fixpoint computation by inlining cycle-free parts during the solution of parity
games, leading to earlier convergence. We also present an economic
later-appearance-record construction that takes Emerson-Lei games to parity
games, and show that it preserves DAG sub-structures; it follows that the
proposed method can be used also for the accelerated solution of Emerson-Lei
games.

AI.title_translation: 通过不动点加速实现更快的博弈求解
AI.tldr: 针对有DAG子结构的奇偶对偶博弈，我们提出了一种通过计算嵌套不动点来加速求解的新方法，它通过内联无环部分加速不动点计算，并可扩展到Emerson-Lei博弈。
AI.motivation: 对具有不对称（acyclic，即DAG）子结构的奇偶对偶博弈（parity games）进行更快速的求解。
AI.method: 通过计算一个定义在博弈非DAG部分上的DAG吸引子函数的嵌套不动点来求解具有DAG子结构的奇偶对偶博弈，从而限制了不动点算子的域。此外，还提出了一种经济的后出现记录（later-appearance-record）构造方法，将Emerson-Lei博弈转化为奇偶对偶博弈，并证明了该构造保留了DAG子结构。
AI.result: 通过在求解过程中内联无环部分，加速了不动点计算，导致了更早的收敛。该方法可以推广到加速Emerson-Lei博弈的求解。
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种通过计算定义在博弈非DAG部分上的DAG吸引子函数的嵌套不动点来求解具有有环（DAG）子结构的奇偶对偶博弈的方法，从而限制了所涉及的不动点算子的域。直观上，这相当于在求解奇偶对偶博弈的过程中，通过内联无环部分来加速不动点计算，从而实现更早的收敛。我们还提出了一个经济的后出现记录构造，将Emerson-Lei博弈转化为奇偶对偶博弈，并证明了它保留了DAG子结构；由此可知，所提出的方法也可用于加速Emerson-Lei博弈的求解。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通过计算定义在博弈非DAG部分上的DAG吸引子函数的嵌套不动点来加速具有DAG子结构的奇偶对偶博弈求解的方法。该方法通过限制不动点算子的域，实现了不动点计算的加速和更早的收敛。此外，研究还表明该方法可应用于Emerson-Lei博弈的加速求解。
AI.keywords: 奇偶对偶博弈,不动点加速,DAG子结构,不动点计算,Emerson-Lei博弈
AI.comments: 该方法的主要创新点在于利用有向无环图（DAG）子结构来加速奇偶对偶博弈（parity games）的求解，通过在非DAG部分计算嵌套不动点来限制不动点算子的域，从而实现更快的收敛。其重要性在于为一类具有特定结构的博弈问题提供了更高效的求解算法。限制方面，该方法明确针对具有DAG子结构的博弈，对一般博弈的适用性未在摘要中说明。

title: Replicating Human Anatomy with Vision Controlled Jetting -- A Pneumatic Musculoskeletal Hand and Forearm
summary:
The functional replication and actuation of complex structures inspired by
nature is a longstanding goal for humanity. Creating such complex structures
combining soft and rigid features and actuating them with artificial muscles
would further our understanding of natural kinematic structures. We printed a
biomimetic hand in a single print process comprised of a rigid skeleton, soft
joint capsules, tendons, and printed touch sensors. We showed it's actuation
using electric motors. In this work, we expand on this work by adding a forearm
that is also closely modeled after the human anatomy and replacing the hand's
motors with 22 independently controlled pneumatic artificial muscles (PAMs).
Our thin, high-strain (up to 30.1%) PAMs match the performance of
state-of-the-art artificial muscles at a lower cost. The system showcases
human-like dexterity with independent finger movements, demonstrating
successful grasping of various objects, ranging from a small, lightweight coin
to a large can of 272g in weight. The performance evaluation, based on
fingertip and grasping forces along with finger joint range of motion,
highlights the system's potential.

title: Cut elimination for Cyclic Proofs: A Case Study in Temporal Logic
summary:
We consider modal logic extended with the well-known temporal operator
'eventually' and provide a cut-elimination procedure for a cyclic sequent
calculus that captures this fragment. The work showcases an adaptation of the
reductive cut-elimination method to cyclic calculi. Notably, the proposed
algorithm applies to a cyclic proof and directly outputs a cyclic cut-free
proof without appealing to intermediate machinery for regularising the end
proof.

AI.tldr: 研究人员为带有“将来时”算子的模态逻辑的循环证明提供了一种新的、直接的消减算法，该算法能直接生成无循环的证明。

AI.method: 提出了一种将还原性消减方法（reductive cut-elimination method）适配到循环演算（cyclic sequent calculus）中的算法。
AI.result: 提出了一个适用于循环证明的算法，可以直接输出一个无循环的消减证明（cyclic cut-free proof），而无需使用用于正则化最终证明的中间机制。

AI.translation: 我们考虑了扩展了著名的“将来时”（eventually）算子的模态逻辑，并为捕获该逻辑片段的循环序列演算提供了一种消减程序。这项工作展示了将还原性消减方法（reductive cut-elimination method）适配到循环演算中的过程。值得注意的是，所提出的算法适用于循环证明，并直接输出一个无循环的消减证明，而无需诉诸于用于正则化最终证明的中间机制。

title: Improving Uncertainty Estimation through Semantically Diverse Language Generation
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) can suffer from hallucinations when generating
text. These hallucinations impede various applications in society and industry
by making LLMs untrustworthy. Current LLMs generate text in an autoregressive
fashion by predicting and appending text tokens. When an LLM is uncertain about
the semantic meaning of the next tokens to generate, it is likely to start
hallucinating. Thus, it has been suggested that predictive uncertainty is one
of the main causes of hallucinations. We introduce Semantically Diverse
Language Generation (SDLG) to quantify predictive uncertainty in LLMs. SDLG
steers the LLM to generate semantically diverse yet likely alternatives for an
initially generated text. This approach provides a precise measure of aleatoric
semantic uncertainty, detecting whether the initial text is likely to be
hallucinated. Experiments on question-answering tasks demonstrate that SDLG
consistently outperforms existing methods while being the most computationally
efficient, setting a new standard for uncertainty estimation in LLMs.

AI.title_translation: 通过语义多样性语言生成改进不确定性估计
AI.tldr: SDLG通过生成多种语义不同的文本来精确衡量LLM预测的不确定性，这种不确定性是导致幻觉的原因。SDLG在问答任务中表现出色，且计算效率高，是更好的不确定性估计方法。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成文本时可能出现幻觉，这削弱了其在社会和工业应用中的可信度。预测不确定性被认为是导致幻觉的主要原因之一。
AI.method: 引入语义多样性语言生成（SDLG），通过引导大型语言模型为初始生成的文本生成语义多样但可能的替代方案来量化预测不确定性。
AI.result: 实验表明，SDLG在问答任务上持续优于现有方法，并且是计算效率最高的方法。
AI.conclusion: SDLG为大型语言模型的不确定性估计设定了新标准。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成文本时可能会出现幻觉。这些幻觉因使LLMs不可信而阻碍了它们在社会和工业中的各种应用。目前的LLMs通过预测和附加文本标记以自回归方式生成文本。当LLM对下一个要生成的标记的语义含义不确定时，它很可能会开始产生幻觉。因此，有人提出预测不确定性是导致幻觉的主要原因之一。我们引入了语义多样性语言生成（SDLG）来量化LLMs中的预测不确定性。SDLG引导LLM为最初生成的文本生成语义多样但可能的替代方案。这种方法提供了对随机语义不确定性的精确度量，检测初始文本是否可能产生幻觉。在问答任务上的实验表明，SDLG持续优于现有方法，同时也是计算效率最高的方法，为LLMs中的不确定性估计设定了新标准。
AI.summary: 本文提出了语义多样性语言生成（SDLG）方法，旨在通过生成语义多样且可能的替代文本来量化大型语言模型（LLMs）的预测不确定性，从而检测和缓解幻觉问题。实验证明SDLG在问答任务上性能优越且计算高效。
AI.keywords: 不确定性估计, 语言生成, 幻觉, 语义多样性, 大型语言模型
AI.comments: 该方法（SDLG）创新性地通过生成语义多样的替代文本来量化预测不确定性，这被认为是解决大型语言模型（LLMs）幻觉问题的关键。其优势在于能精确衡量随机语义不确定性，并且在实验中表现出优越的性能和最高的计算效率。

title: RASPNet: A Benchmark Dataset for Radar Adaptive Signal Processing Applications
summary:
We present a large-scale dataset called RASPNet for radar adaptive signal
processing (RASP) applications to support the development of data-driven models
within the adaptive radar community. RASPNet exceeds 16 TB in size and
comprises 100 realistic scenarios compiled over a variety of topographies and
land types across the contiguous United States. For each scenario, RASPNet
comprises 10,000 clutter realizations from an airborne radar setting, which can
be used to benchmark radar and complex-valued learning algorithms. RASPNet
intends to fill a prominent gap in the availability of a large-scale, realistic
dataset that standardizes the evaluation of RASP techniques and complex-valued
neural networks. We outline its construction, organization, and several
applications, including a transfer learning example to demonstrate how RASPNet
can be used for real-world adaptive radar scenarios.

title: Tracking solutions of time-varying variational inequalities
summary:
Tracking the solution of time-varying variational inequalities is an
important problem with applications in game theory, optimization, and machine
learning. Existing work considers time-varying games or time-varying
optimization problems. For strongly convex optimization problems or strongly
monotone games, these results provide tracking guarantees under the assumption
that the variation of the time-varying problem is restrained, that is, problems
with a sublinear solution path. In this work we extend existing results in two
ways: In our first result, we provide tracking bounds for (1) variational
inequalities with a sublinear solution path but not necessarily monotone
functions, and (2) for periodic time-varying variational inequalities that do
not necessarily have a sublinear solution path-length. Our second main
contribution is an extensive study of the convergence behavior and trajectory
of discrete dynamical systems of periodic time-varying VI. We show that these
systems can exhibit provably chaotic behavior or can converge to the solution.
Finally, we illustrate our theoretical results with experiments.

AI.title_translation: 时变变分不等式的解跟踪
AI.tldr: 本研究扩展了对时变变分不等式解的跟踪理论，首次为解路径不一定是次线性的周期性问题提供了跟踪保证，并分析了相关离散系统的复杂动力学行为（包括混沌）。
AI.motivation: 跟踪时变变分不等式的解是一个在博弈论、优化和机器学习中具有重要应用的问题，现有工作大多只考虑了具有次线性解路径的强凸优化或强单调博弈。
AI.method: 提供跟踪界限（针对非单调函数和非次线性路径的周期问题），并对周期性时变变分不等式的离散动力系统进行了收敛行为和轨迹的广泛研究。
AI.result: 在两个方面扩展了现有结果：(1) 为解路径为次线性但函数不一定是单调的变分不等式，以及(2) 为解路径不一定是次线性的周期性时变变分不等式提供了跟踪界限；第二个贡献是证明了周期性时变变分不等式的离散动力系统可能表现出混沌行为或收敛到解。
AI.conclusion: 摘要中未明确给出最终结论，但暗示了通过理论分析和实验验证了所提跟踪界限的有效性和离散系统的复杂行为。
AI.translation: 跟踪时变变分不等式的解是一个在博弈论、优化和机器学习中具有重要问题。现有工作考虑了时变博弈或时变优化问题。对于强凸优化问题或强单调博弈，这些结果在假设时变问题的变化受到约束（即具有次线性解路径的问题）下提供了跟踪保证。在这项工作中，我们在两个方面扩展了现有结果：在我们的第一个结果中，我们为（1）解路径为次线性但函数不一定是单调的变分不等式，以及（2）解路径不一定是次线性的周期性时变变分不等式提供了跟踪界限。我们的第二个主要贡献是对周期性时变变分不等式离散动力系统的收敛行为和轨迹进行了广泛研究。我们证明了这些系统可以表现出可证明的混沌行为或收敛到解。最后，我们用实验说明了我们的理论结果。
AI.summary: 本文针对时变变分不等式（VI）的解跟踪问题，扩展了现有研究。研究人员提供了跟踪界限，不仅适用于解路径为次线性的非单调VI，还适用于解路径不一定是次线性的周期性时变VI。此外，论文深入分析了周期性时变VI的离散动力系统，发现其行为可能表现为混沌或收敛。理论结果通过实验进行了验证。
AI.keywords: 时变变分不等式, 跟踪, 周期性, 动力系统, 混沌行为
AI.comments: 本论文的创新之处在于扩展了现有结果，首次为解路径非线性（即非次线性）的周期性时变变分不等式提供了跟踪界限，并深入研究了离散动力系统的收敛和轨迹，揭示了潜在的混沌行为。其重要性在于将变分不等式的跟踪理论扩展到更一般的时变问题设置。局限性在于摘要中未提及具体的数学模型或方法细节。

title: Feature compression is the root cause of adversarial fragility in neural network classifiers
summary:
In this paper, we uniquely study the adversarial robustness of deep neural
networks (NN) for classification tasks against that of optimal classifiers. We
look at the smallest magnitude of possible additive perturbations that can
change a classifier's output. We provide a matrix-theoretic explanation of the
adversarial fragility of deep neural networks for classification. In
particular, our theoretical results show that a neural network's adversarial
robustness can degrade as the input dimension $d$ increases. Analytically, we
show that neural networks' adversarial robustness can be only $1/\sqrt{d}$ of
the best possible adversarial robustness of optimal classifiers. Our theories
match remarkably well with numerical experiments of practically trained NN,
including NN for ImageNet images. The matrix-theoretic explanation is
consistent with an earlier information-theoretic feature-compression-based
explanation for the adversarial fragility of neural networks.

title: Link Prediction with Untrained Message Passing Layers
summary:
Message passing neural networks (MPNNs) operate on graphs by exchanging
information between neigbouring nodes. MPNNs have been successfully applied to
various node-, edge-, and graph-level tasks in areas like molecular science,
computer vision, natural language processing, and combinatorial optimization.
However, most MPNNs require training on large amounts of labeled data, which
can be costly and time-consuming. In this work, we explore the use of various
untrained message passing layers in graph neural networks, i.e. variants of
popular message passing architecture where we remove all trainable parameters
that are used to transform node features in the message passing step. Focusing
on link prediction, we find that untrained message passing layers can lead to
competitive and even superior performance compared to fully trained MPNNs,
especially in the presence of high-dimensional features. We provide a
theoretical analysis of untrained message passing by relating the inner
products of features implicitly produced by untrained message passing layers to
path-based topological node similarity measures. As such, untrained message
passing architectures can be viewed as a highly efficient and interpretable
approach to link prediction.

AI.title_translation: 使用未训练的消息传递层的链接预测
AI.tldr: 移除了训练参数的图网络层（未训练MPNN层）在链接预测任务上表现出色，甚至优于完全训练的模型，并且更高效、更具可解释性。
AI.motivation: 大多数消息传递神经网络（MPNN）需要大量有标签数据进行训练，这既昂贵又耗时。本研究旨在探索使用未训练消息传递层（移除了所有可训练参数）的可行性。
AI.method: 移除消息传递步骤中用于转换节点特征的所有可训练参数，构建未训练的消息传递层，并将其应用于链接预测任务。同时，对未训练消息传递进行理论分析，将其与基于路径的拓扑节点相似性度量联系起来。
AI.result: 研究发现，未训练的消息传递层在链接预测任务上可以获得与完全训练的MPNNs相竞争甚至更优的性能，尤其是在存在高维特征时。
AI.conclusion: 未训练的消息传递架构可以被视为一种高效且可解释的链接预测方法。
AI.translation: 消息传递神经网络（MPNN）通过交换相邻节点之间的信息在图上操作。MPNN已成功应用于分子科学、计算机视觉、自然语言处理和组合优化等领域的各种节点、边和图级别的任务。然而，大多数MPNNs需要在大量的有标签数据上进行训练，这可能既昂贵又耗时。在这项工作中，我们探索了在图神经网络中使用各种未训练的消息传递层，即移除了消息传递步骤中用于转换节点特征的所有可训练参数的流行消息传递架构的变体。在关注链接预测时，我们发现未训练的消息传递层可以带来与完全训练的MPNNs相竞争甚至更优的性能，尤其是在存在高维特征的情况下。我们通过将未训练消息传递层隐式产生的内积与基于路径的拓扑节点相似性度量相关联，对未训练消息传递进行了理论分析。因此，未训练的消息传递架构可以被视为一种高效且可解释的链接预测方法。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在图神经网络中使用不含任何可训练参数的“未训练消息传递层”来解决链接预测问题。研究发现，这些未训练层在性能上可以与完全训练的MPNNs相媲美甚至更优，尤其是在高维特征场景下。作者还提供了理论分析，将未训练消息传递产生的内积与其隐含的拓扑节点相似性度量联系起来，证明了这种方法的高效性和可解释性。
AI.keywords: 链接预测, 消息传递神经网络, 未训练层, 图神经网络, 拓扑相似性
AI.comments: 这项工作的主要创新在于探索并证明了在图神经网络中移除所有可训练参数的“未训练消息传递层”在特定任务（链接预测）上可以与完全训练的模型相媲美甚至超越它们，这极大地提高了效率和可解释性。其理论分析将未训练层隐式产生的内积与拓扑相似性度量联系起来，是重要贡献。

title: Analysis of Iterative Deblurring: No Explicit Noise
summary:
Iterative deblurring, notably the Richardson-Lucy algorithm with and without
regularization, is analyzed in the context of nuclear and high-energy physics
applications. In these applications, probability distributions may be
discretized into a few bins, measurement statistics can be high, and instrument
performance can be well understood. In such circumstances, it is essential to
understand the deblurring first without any explicit noise considerations. We
employ singular value decomposition for the blurring matrix in a low-count
pixel system. A strong blurring may yield a null space for the blurring matrix.
Yet, a nonnegativity constraint for images built into the deblurring may help
restore null-space content in a high-contrast image with zero or low intensity
for a sufficient number of pixels. For low-contrast images, control over
null-space content can be achieved through regularization. When regularization
is applied, the blurred image is, in practice, restored to one that is still
blurred but less than the starting image.

AI.title_translation: 迭代去模糊分析：无显式噪声
AI.tldr: 在没有明确噪声的情况下，分析了迭代去模糊（如R-L算法）在低计数像素系统中的表现。SVD揭示了强模糊下的零空间问题，非负约束和正则化可以帮助恢复零空间内容，但正则化后的结果仍比原始输入模糊。
AI.motivation: 在核和高能物理应用中，概率分布被离散化，测量统计数据高，仪器性能好理解，因此有必要首先在不明确考虑噪声的情况下理解去模糊过程。
AI.method: 采用奇异值分解（SVD）来分析低计数像素系统中模糊矩阵的性质。
AI.result: 强模糊可能导致模糊矩阵的零空间。对于高对比度图像，内置于去模糊中的非负约束可以帮助恢复零空间内容；对于低对比度图像，可以通过正则化来控制零空间内容。
AI.conclusion: 当应用正则化时，模糊图像实际上被恢复成一个比初始图像模糊程度更低但仍然是模糊的图像。
AI.translation: 在核和高能物理应用的背景下，分析了迭代去模糊，特别是带有和不带正则化的Richardson-Lucy算法。在这些应用中，概率分布可能被离散化为几个区间，测量统计数据可能很高，并且仪器性能可以被很好地理解。在这些情况下，必须首先在不明确考虑任何噪声的情况下理解去模糊过程。我们采用奇异值分解（SVD）来分析低计数像素系统中模糊矩阵的性质。强模糊可能导致模糊矩阵的零空间。然而，内置于去模糊过程中的图像非负约束可以帮助恢复高对比度图像中的零空间内容，前提是图像中存在足够多的像素具有零或低强度。对于低对比度图像，可以通过正则化来控制零空间内容。当应用正则化时，模糊图像在实践中被恢复成一个仍然模糊但比初始图像模糊程度更低的图像。
AI.summary: 本文分析了在核物理和高能物理应用中，不显式考虑噪声的迭代去模糊过程，特别是Richardson-Lucy算法。通过对模糊矩阵进行奇异值分解，研究了强模糊导致的零空间问题，并探讨了非负约束和正则化如何影响零空间内容的恢复，指出正则化处理后的图像会得到一定程度的恢复，但仍会保留一定的模糊性。
AI.keywords: 迭代去模糊, 瑞奇森-卢西算法, 奇异值分解, 零空间, 非负约束
AI.comments: 这项工作在核物理和高能物理背景下分析了迭代去模糊（特别是Richardson-Lucy算法），重点关注了在没有显式噪声模型的情况下，奇异值分解如何揭示强模糊下的零空间问题，以及非负约束和正则化对恢复零空间内容的影响。创新点在于其对特定领域（低计数像素系统）中迭代去模糊的深入理论分析。

title: Enhancing Psychometric Analysis with Interactive SIA Modules
summary:
ShinyItemAnalysis (SIA) is an R package and shiny application for an
interactive presentation of psychometric methods and analysis of multi-item
measurements in psychology, education, and social sciences in general. In this
article, we present a new feature introduced in the recent version of the
package, called "SIA modules", which allows researchers and practitioners to
offer new analytical methods for broader use via add-on extensions. SIA modules
are designed to integrate with and build upon the SIA interactive application,
enabling them to leverage the existing infrastructure for tasks such as data
uploading and processing. They can access and further use a range of outputs
from various analyses, including models and datasets. Because SIA modules come
in R packages (or extend the existing ones), they may come bundled with their
datasets, use object-oriented systems, or even compiled code. We illustrate the
concepts using sample modules from the newly introduced SIAmodules package and
other packages. After providing a general overview of building Shiny
applications, we describe how to develop the SIA add-on modules with the
support of the new SIAtools package. Finally, we discuss possibilities of
future development and emphasize the importance of freely available,
interactive psychometric software for dissemination of methodological
innovations.

title: Non-Borda elections under relaxed IIA conditions
summary:
Arrow's celebrated Impossibility Theorem asserts that an election rule, or
Social Welfare Function (SWF), between three or more candidates meeting a set
of strict criteria cannot exist. Maskin suggests that Arrow's conditions for
SWFs are too strict. In particular he weakens the "Independence of Irrelevant
Alternatives" condition (IIA), which states that if in two elections, each
voter's binary preference between candidates $c_i$ and $c_j$ is the same, then
the two results must agree on their preference between $c_i$ and $c_j$.
Instead, he proposes a modified IIA condition (MIIA). Under this condition, the
result between $c_i$ and $c_j$ can be affected not just by the order of $c_i$
and $c_j$ in each voter's ranking, but also the number of candidates between
them. More candidates between $c_i$ and $c_j$ communicates some information
about the strength of a voter's preference between the two candidates, and
Maskin argues that it should be admissible evidence in deciding on a final
ranking.
  We construct SWFs for three-party elections which meet the MIIA criterion
along with other sensibility criteria, but are far from being Borda elections
(where each voter assigns a score to each candidate linearly according to their
ranking). On the other hand, we give cases in which any SWF must be the Borda
rule.

AI.title_translation: 在放宽的IIA条件下非Borda选举
AI.tldr: 研究了在放松对“无关替代品独立性”的要求（使用MIIA）后，是否存在非Borda的选举规则。对于三方选举，我们找到了满足新条件的非Borda规则，但也确定了必须是Borda规则的特定场景。
AI.motivation: 阿罗的“不可能定理”断言满足一组严格标准的选举规则不存在，而Maskin认为阿罗的“无关替代品独立性”（IIA）条件过于严格，因此提出并研究了更宽松的“修正的IIA”（MIIA）条件。
AI.method: 通过构造满足修正的IIA（MIIA）标准的三方选举的社会福利函数（SWF），并确定必须是Borda规则的特定情况。
AI.result: 构造了满足MIIA标准的非Borda三方选举SWF，并给出了任何SWF都必须是Borda规则的情况。
AI.conclusion: 论文构建了满足MIIA和其他合理性标准的非Borda社会福利函数（SWF）用于三方选举，同时确定了在何种情况下，任何满足条件的SWF都必须是Borda规则。
AI.translation: 阿罗著名的“不可能定理”断言，在三名或更多候选人的选举规则，即社会福利函数（SWF），不可能满足一组严格的标准。Maskin建议阿罗对SWF的标准过于严格。特别是，他削弱了“无关替代品独立性”（IIA）条件，该条件指出，如果在两次选举中，每位选民在候选人$c_i$和$c_j$之间的二元偏好相同，那么两次选举在$c_i$和$c_j$之间的偏好结果必须一致。相反，他提出了一个修正的IIA条件（MIIA）。在该条件下，关于$c_i$和$c_j$的结果不仅可以受到每位选民排名中$c_i$和$c_j$顺序的影响，还可以受到它们之间候选人数量的影响。$c_i$和$c_j$之间更多的候选人传达了选民对这两个候选人偏好强度的信息，Maskin认为这应该被视为决定最终排名的可采纳证据。我们为三方选举构造了满足MIIA标准以及其他合理性标准的SWF，这些函数与Borda选举（其中每位选民根据其排名线性分配分数）相去甚远。另一方面，我们给出了在这些情况下任何SWF都必须是Borda规则的例子。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在放宽阿罗不可能定理中“无关替代品独立性”（IIA）条件至“修正的IIA”（MIIA）后，三方选举中社会福利函数（SWF）的存在性。论文成功构造了满足MIIA标准的非Borda规则，同时也指出了在某些情况下，任何满足条件的规则都必然是Borda规则。
AI.keywords: Arrow's Impossibility Theorem, IIA, MIIA, Social Welfare Function, Borda Rule
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于探索了在放宽“无关替代品独立性”（IIA）条件到“修正的IIA”（MIIA）后，非Borda选举规则的存在性。其重要性在于为阿罗不可能定理提供了一个可能的“出口”，尽管是在特定限制下（三方选举）。局限性在于研究仅限于三方选举。

title: Path-Consistency with Prefix Enhancement for Efficient Inference in LLMs
summary:
To enhance the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs),
self-consistency has become a popular approach, combining multiple samplings
with majority voting. However, current methods are computationally expensive
and time-consuming due to the need for numerous samplings. To address this,
this paper introduces path-consistency, which leverages the confidence of
earlier-generated answers to identify the most promising prefix and guide the
generation of subsequent branches. By dynamically guiding the generation of
subsequent branches based on this prefix, path-consistency mitigates both the
errors and redundancies from random or less useful sampling in
self-consistency. This approach reduces errors and redundancies from random
sampling, significantly accelerating inference by minimizing token consumption.
Our extensive empirical results demonstrate that path-consistency improves
inference latency by up to 40.5\%, while maintaining task accuracy across
various tasks, including mathematical reasoning, commonsense reasoning, and
symbolic reasoning.

title: Network Anomaly Traffic Detection via Multi-view Feature Fusion
comments:
in Chinese language, Accepted by Journal of Command and Control.
  https://www.jc2.org.cn/CN/10.20278/j.jc2.2096-0204.2024.0196
summary:
Traditional anomalous traffic detection methods are based on single-view
analysis, which has obvious limitations in dealing with complex attacks and
encrypted communications. In this regard, we propose a Multi-view Feature
Fusion (MuFF) method for network anomaly traffic detection. MuFF models the
temporal and interactive relationships of packets in network traffic based on
the temporal and interactive viewpoints respectively. It learns temporal and
interactive features. These features are then fused from different perspectives
for anomaly traffic detection. Extensive experiments on six real traffic
datasets show that MuFF has excellent performance in network anomalous traffic
detection, which makes up for the shortcomings of detection under a single
perspective.
