title: Constraint Satisfaction Approaches to Wordle: Novel Heuristics and Cross-Lexicon Validation
comments:
35 pages, 14 figures, 10 tables. Open-source implementation with 91%
  test coverage available at
  https://github.com/jahidul-arafat/constraint_satisfaction_wordle_arxiv_preprint
summary:
Wordle presents an algorithmically rich testbed for constraint satisfaction
problem (CSP) solving. While existing solvers rely on information-theoretic
entropy maximization or frequency-based heuristics without formal constraint
treatment, we present the first comprehensive CSP formulation of Wordle with
novel constraint-aware solving strategies. We introduce CSP-Aware Entropy,
computing information gain after constraint propagation rather than on raw
candidate sets, and a Probabilistic CSP framework integrating Bayesian
word-frequency priors with logical constraints. Through evaluation on 2,315
English words, CSP-Aware Entropy achieves 3.54 average guesses with 99.9%
success rate, a statistically significant 1.7% improvement over Forward
Checking (t=-4.82, p<0.001, Cohen's d=0.07) with 46% faster runtime (12.9ms
versus 23.7ms per guess). Under 10% noise, CSP-aware approaches maintain 5.3
percentage point advantages (29.0% versus 23.7%, p=0.041), while Probabilistic
CSP achieves 100% success across all noise levels (0-20%) through constraint
recovery mechanisms. Cross-lexicon validation on 500 Spanish words demonstrates
88% success with zero language-specific tuning, validating that core CSP
principles transfer across languages despite an 11.2 percentage point gap from
linguistic differences (p<0.001, Fisher's exact test). Our open-source
implementation with 34 unit tests achieving 91% code coverage provides
reproducible infrastructure for CSP research. The combination of formal CSP
treatment, constraint-aware heuristics, probabilistic-logical integration,
robustness analysis, and cross-lexicon validation establishes new performance
benchmarks demonstrating that principled constraint satisfaction techniques
outperform classical information-theoretic and learning-based approaches for
structured puzzle-solving domains.

title: Long-Term Mapping of the Douro River Plume with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary:
We study the problem of long-term (multiple days) mapping of a river plume
using multiple autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs), focusing on the Douro
river representative use-case. We propose an energy - and communication -
efficient multi-agent reinforcement learning approach in which a central
coordinator intermittently communicates with the AUVs, collecting measurements
and issuing commands. Our approach integrates spatiotemporal Gaussian process
regression (GPR) with a multi-head Q-network controller that regulates
direction and speed for each AUV. Simulations using the Delft3D ocean model
demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms both single- and
multi-agent benchmarks, with scaling the number of agents both improving mean
squared error (MSE) and operational endurance. In some instances, our algorithm
demonstrates that doubling the number of AUVs can more than double endurance
while maintaining or improving accuracy, underscoring the benefits of
multi-agent coordination. Our learned policies generalize across unseen
seasonal regimes over different months and years, demonstrating promise for
future developments of data-driven long-term monitoring of dynamic plume
environments.

title: Enabling Network Policy Enforcement in Service Meshes
summary:
Portable service mesh implementations enable Layer 4 to Layer 7 policy
enforcement across heterogeneous infrastructures, yet they depend on the
underlying network's connectivity and policies. Layer 3 network policies govern
IP traffic regardless of whether upper layers authorize the flow. While these
policies are integral to security, correct enforcement often requires
coordination across multiple teams, and achieving consistent policy behavior
across heterogeneous environments is challenging. Studies show that most
Kubernetes clusters do not enforce any network policies. We propose integrating
Layer 3 network policy enforcement with service meshes to protect data-plane
traffic in a portable, infrastructure-agnostic manner. This integration allows
developers to define Layer 3-7 policies and to ensure enforcement across any
infrastructure. Our solution builds an overlay Layer 3 network and enforces
Layer 3 policies by routing traffic through specific policy enforcement points
and applying default-deny principles with authorization keys. We prototyped our
approach using Kubernetes and Istio and found that it adds less than 1ms of
latency while supporting complex policies comparable to native Kubernetes
network policies.

title: Efficient Latent Variable Causal Discovery: Combining Score Search and Targeted Testing
summary:
Learning causal structure from observational data is especially challenging
when latent variables or selection bias are present. The Fast Causal Inference
(FCI) algorithm addresses this setting but often performs exhaustive
conditional independence tests across many subsets, leading to spurious
independence claims, extra or missing edges, and unreliable orientations. We
present a family of score-guided mixed-strategy causal search algorithms that
build on this tradition. First, we introduce BOSS-FCI and GRaSP-FCI,
straightforward variants of GFCI that substitute BOSS or GRaSP for FGES,
thereby retaining correctness while incurring different scalability tradeoffs.
Second, we develop FCI Targeted-testing (FCIT), a novel mixed-strategy method
that improves upon these variants by replacing exhaustive all-subsets testing
with targeted tests guided by BOSS, yielding well-formed PAGs with higher
precision and efficiency. Finally, we propose a simple heuristic, LV-Dumb (also
known as BOSS-POD), which bypasses latent-variable-specific reasoning and
directly returns the PAG of the BOSS DAG. Although not strictly correct in the
FCI sense, it scales better and often achieves superior accuracy in practice.
Simulations and real-data analyses demonstrate that BOSS-FCI and GRaSP-FCI
provide sound baselines, FCIT improves both efficiency and reliability, and
LV-Dumb offers a practical heuristic with strong empirical performance.
Together, these method highlight the value of score-guided and targeted
strategies for scalable latent-variable causal discovery.

AI.title_translation: 高效的潜变量因果发现：结合评分搜索和定向测试
AI.tldr: 针对有潜在变量的因果发现难题，本文提出了一系列改进算法（BOSS-FCI, GRaSP-FCI, FCIT, LV-Dumb）。FCIT用目标测试取代了耗尽的测试，提高了效率和可靠性；LV-Dumb是一个实用的、快速的启发式方法。这些方法共同展示了评分指导和目标测试在可扩展因果发现中的价值。
AI.motivation: 从观测数据中学习因果结构时，存在潜在变量或选择偏差时尤其具有挑战性，而现有的FCI算法通常进行详尽的条件独立性测试，导致错误或不可靠的结果。
AI.method: 提出了BOSS-FCI和GRaSP-FCI作为GFCI的变体；开发了FCIT，用基于BOSS的定向测试替代了详尽的所有子集测试；提出了LV-Dumb（或BOSS-POD）作为一种绕过特定于潜变量的推理的启发式方法。
AI.result: 模拟和真实数据分析表明，BOSS-FCI和GRaSP-FCI提供了可靠的基线；FCIT提高了效率和可靠性；LV-Dumb提供了一种实用的具有强大实证性能的启发式方法。
AI.conclusion: BOSS-FCI和GRaSP-FCI提供了可靠的基线，FCIT在效率和可靠性上都有提升，而LV-Dumb提供了一种具有强大实证性能的实用启发式方法。这些方法共同突显了评分指导和定向策略在可扩展潜变量因果发现中的价值。
AI.translation: 从观测数据中学习因果结构在存在潜在变量或选择偏差时尤其具有挑战性。快速因果推断（FCI）算法解决了这种情况，但通常对许多子集进行详尽的条件独立性检验，导致虚假的独立性声明、多余或缺失的边以及不可靠的定向。我们提出了一族基于评分指导的混合策略因果搜索算法，建立在此传统之上。首先，我们引入了BOSS-FCI和GRaSP-FCI，它们是GFCI的直接变体，用BOSS或GRaSP替代FGES，从而保持了正确性，但带来了不同的可扩展性权衡。其次，我们开发了FCI定向测试（FCIT），一种新颖的混合策略方法，它通过用BOSS指导的定向测试取代详尽的所有子集测试来改进这些变体，从而产生具有更高精度和效率的良好形成的PAG。最后，我们提出了一个简单的启发式方法LV-Dumb（也称为BOSS-POD），它绕过了特定于潜在变量的推理，并直接返回BOSS DAG的PAG。虽然在FCI意义上不严格正确，但它具有更好的可扩展性，并且在实践中通常能实现更高的准确性。模拟和真实数据分析表明，BOSS-FCI和GRaSP-FCI提供了可靠的基线，FCIT提高了效率和可靠性，而LV-Dumb提供了一种具有强大实证性能的实用启发式方法。这些方法共同突出了评分指导和定向策略在可扩展的潜在变量因果发现中的价值。
AI.summary: 本文针对存在潜在变量或选择偏差的因果发现难题，提出了一系列基于评分指导的混合策略算法。首先引入了BOSS-FCI和GRaSP-FCI作为现有方法的变体。核心创新是FCIT，它使用BOSS指导的定向测试取代了详尽的子集测试，以提高精度和效率。此外，还提出了启发式方法LV-Dumb，它虽然不严格遵循FCI，但在实践中具有更好的可扩展性和性能。
AI.keywords: 潜变量因果发现, FCI, 评分搜索, 定向测试, 混合策略
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了FCIT，用基于BOSS的定向测试替代了FCI中耗时的所有子集测试，提高了效率和可靠性。LV-Dumb作为一种启发式方法，虽然不严格遵循FCI，但在实践中表现出良好的可扩展性和准确性。文章强调了评分指导和定向测试策略在可扩展的潜变量因果发现中的价值。

title: AWARE, Beyond Sentence Boundaries: A Contextual Transformer Framework for Identifying Cultural Capital in STEM Narratives
comments:
The authors are withdrawing this version to correct issues identified
  in the experimental design and analysis. A revised and validated version will
  be submitted after further review
summary:
Identifying cultural capital (CC) themes in student reflections can offer
valuable insights that help foster equitable learning environments in
classrooms. However, themes such as aspirational goals or family support are
often woven into narratives, rather than appearing as direct keywords. This
makes them difficult to detect for standard NLP models that process sentences
in isolation. The core challenge stems from a lack of awareness, as standard
models are pre-trained on general corpora, leaving them blind to the
domain-specific language and narrative context inherent to the data. To address
this, we introduce AWARE, a framework that systematically attempts to improve a
transformer model's awareness for this nuanced task. AWARE has three core
components: 1) Domain Awareness, adapting the model's vocabulary to the
linguistic style of student reflections; 2) Context Awareness, generating
sentence embeddings that are aware of the full essay context; and 3) Class
Overlap Awareness, employing a multi-label strategy to recognize the
coexistence of themes in a single sentence. Our results show that by making the
model explicitly aware of the properties of the input, AWARE outperforms a
strong baseline by 2.1 percentage points in Macro-F1 and shows considerable
improvements across all themes. This work provides a robust and generalizable
methodology for any text classification task in which meaning depends on the
context of the narrative.

The authors are withdrawing this version to correct issues identified
  in the experimental design and analysis. A revised and validated version will
  be submitted after further review

AI.title_translation: AWARE，超越句子边界：一个用于识别STEM叙事中文化资本的上下文Transformer框架
AI.tldr: AWARE是一个新的Transformer框架，通过增加对领域、上下文和类别重叠的“意识”，显著提高了在难以检测的、跨句子边界的学生叙事中识别文化资本主题的准确性，超越了现有基线。
AI.motivation: 在学生反思中识别文化资本（CC）主题对于促进课堂公平至关重要，但这些主题（如抱负或家庭支持）通常融入叙事中，而非直接的关键词，标准NLP模型难以检测，因为它们通常孤立地处理句子，并且在通用语料上预训练，对领域特定语言和叙事上下文缺乏感知。
AI.method: AWARE框架包含三个核心组件：1) 领域感知（Domain Awareness），使模型的词汇适应学生反思的语言风格；2) 上下文感知（Context Awareness），生成感知到完整文章上下文的句子嵌入；3) 类别重叠感知（Class Overlap Awareness），采用多标签策略来识别单个句子中主题的共存。
AI.result: 通过使模型明确感知到输入数据的特性，AWARE在宏平均F1得分上超越了强大的基线2.1个百分点，并在所有主题上都有显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过使模型明确感知到输入数据的特性，AWARE在宏平均F1得分上超越了强大的基线2.1个百分点，并在所有主题上都有显著改进。这项工作为任何意义依赖于叙事背景的文本分类任务提供了一种稳健且可推广的方法。
AI.translation: 在学生反思中识别文化资本（CC）主题可以提供宝贵的见解，有助于培养课堂中的公平学习环境。然而，诸如抱负目标或家庭支持等主题通常编织在叙事中，而不是作为直接关键词出现。这使得标准NLP模型（它们孤立地处理句子）难以检测。核心挑战源于缺乏感知，因为标准模型是在通用语料上预训练的，对数据固有的领域特定语言和叙事上下文视而不见。为解决这个问题，我们引入了AWARE，一个系统地尝试提高Transformer模型对这项细微任务的感知的框架。AWARE有三个核心组件：1）领域感知，使模型的词汇适应学生反思的语言风格；2）上下文感知，生成感知到完整文章上下文的句子嵌入；3）类别重叠感知，采用多标签策略来识别单个句子中主题的共存。我们的结果表明，通过使模型明确感知到输入数据的特性，AWARE在宏平均F1得分上超越了强大的基线2.1个百分点，并在所有主题上都有显著改进。这项工作为任何意义依赖于叙事背景的文本分类任务提供了一种稳健且可推广的方法。
AI.summary: AWARE是一个创新的上下文Transformer框架，旨在解决标准NLP模型在识别学生叙事（如STEM反思）中跨句子边界的文化资本主题时面临的挑战。该框架通过整合领域感知、上下文感知和类别重叠感知三个核心组件，系统地增强了模型对领域特定语言和叙事上下文的理解能力，并在实验中显著优于基线模型。
AI.keywords: 文化资本识别, 语境化Transformer, 领域适应, 跨句边界, STEM叙事
AI.comments: AWARE框架的创新之处在于它系统地解决了标准Transformer模型在处理需要跨句子理解的领域特定文本（如学生反思中的文化资本识别）时的局限性，通过引入领域、上下文和类别重叠三个维度的“意识”来增强模型能力。其重要性在于为需要深层叙事理解的文本分类任务提供了一个稳健且可推广的方法。局限性可能在于其对特定领域数据的适应性要求较高。

title: Structured Cognitive Loop for Behavioral Intelligence in Large Language Model Agents
comments:
The revisions included clarifying that this work is a preliminary
  study in the Abstract, improving the readability of figures, and adding
  emphasis on the role of the meta-prompt in the system's architecture and
  hallucination control
summary:
Large language models have advanced natural language understanding and
generation, but their use as autonomous agents introduces architectural
challenges for multi-step tasks. Existing frameworks often mix cognition,
memory, and control in a single prompt, reducing coherence and predictability.
The Structured Cognitive Loop (SCL) is proposed as an alternative architecture
that separates these functions. In SCL, the language model handles cognition,
memory is stored externally, and execution is guided by a lightweight
controller within a goal-directed loop. This design allows intermediate results
to be recorded and verified before actions are taken, improving traceability
and evaluation. SCL is evaluated against prompt-based baselines such as ReAct
and LangChain agents across three tasks: travel planning, conditional email
drafting, and constraint-guided image generation. Under matched settings, SCL
achieves an average task success rate of 86.3 percent, compared with 70.5 to
76.8 percent for baselines. It also shows higher goal fidelity, fewer redundant
calls, and reduced unsupported assertions. These results indicate that
separating cognition, memory, and control can enhance reliability and
interpretability without relying on larger models or heavier prompts. The
findings should be regarded as preliminary evidence, with broader tests across
model families and task domains planned for future work.

  study in the Abstract, improving the readability of figures, and adding

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型智能体中行为智能的结构化认知循环
AI.tldr: 研究人员设计了一种名为SCL的新架构，它将LLM智能体的思考、记忆和行动分开，而不是把它们都塞进一个提示里。这样做后，智能体在完成复杂任务时更可靠、更容易追踪，成功率比传统方法高出不少。
AI.motivation: 现有框架将认知、记忆和控制混合在单个提示中，导致多步任务中的一致性和可预测性降低。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为结构化认知循环（SCL）的替代架构，它将认知（由语言模型处理）、外部存储的记忆和由轻量级控制器指导的执行分离到目标导向的循环中。
AI.result: 在旅行规划、条件邮件起草和约束引导的图像生成三项任务中，SCL的平均任务成功率为86.3%，优于基线的70.5%至76.8%。SCL还表现出更高的目标保真度、更少的冗余调用和更少的未经支持的断言。
AI.conclusion: 将认知、记忆和控制分离可以提高大型语言模型智能体的可靠性和可解释性，而无需依赖更大模型或更重的提示。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型在自然语言理解和生成方面取得了进步，但将其用作自主智能体会在多步任务中引入架构挑战。现有框架通常将认知、记忆和控制混合在单个提示中，降低了连贯性和可预测性。本文提出了结构化认知循环（SCL）作为替代架构，它将这些功能分开。在SCL中，语言模型处理认知，记忆存储在外部，执行由目标导向循环中的轻量级控制器指导。这种设计允许在采取行动前记录和验证中间结果，提高了可追溯性和评估性。SCL与ReAct和LangChain智能体等基于提示的基线在旅行规划、条件邮件起草和约束引导的图像生成三项任务中进行了评估。在匹配的设置下，SCL的平均任务成功率为86.3%，而基线的成功率为70.5%至76.8%。它还显示出更高的目标保真度、更少的冗余调用和更少的未经支持的断言。这些结果表明，分离认知、记忆和控制可以在不依赖更大模型或更重提示的情况下提高可靠性和可解释性。这些发现应被视为初步证据，计划在未来工作中对模型家族和任务领域进行更广泛的测试。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为结构化认知循环（SCL）的新架构，用于解决大型语言模型作为自主智能体在执行多步任务时面临的架构挑战。SCL通过将认知、外部记忆和由轻量级控制器指导的执行分离到目标导向的循环中，提高了任务的连贯性和可预测性。实验结果表明，SCL在多项任务上的成功率显著高于基于提示的基线方法。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 智能体, 结构化认知循环, 记忆, 控制
AI.comments: 该方法通过明确分离认知、记忆和控制，解决了大型语言模型作为自主智能体在执行多步任务时架构不一致性的问题，提高了可追溯性和评估性。其创新性在于提出的SCL架构。然而，作者指出结果是初步的，需要更广泛的测试。

title: Revisiting Long-context Modeling from Context Denoising Perspective
summary:
Long-context models (LCMs) have demonstrated great potential in processing
long sequences, facilitating many real-world applications. The success of LCMs
can be attributed to their ability to locate implicit critical information
within the context for further prediction. However, recent research reveals
that LCMs are often susceptible to contextual noise, i.e., irrelevant tokens,
that can mislead model attention. In this paper, we conduct a fine-grained
analysis of the context noise and propose an effective metric, the Integrated
Gradient (IG) score, to detect and quantify the noise information within the
context. Our findings reveal that even simple mitigation of detected context
noise can substantially boost the model's attention on critical tokens and
benefit subsequent predictions. Building on this insight, we propose Context
Denoising Training (CDT), a straightforward yet effective training strategy
that improves attention on critical tokens while reinforcing their influence on
model predictions. Extensive experiments across four tasks, under both context
window scaling and long-context alignment settings, demonstrate the superiority
of CDT. Notably, when trained with CDT, an open-source 8B model can achieve
performance (50.92) comparable to GPT-4o (51.00).

title: Deterministic Legal Agents: A Canonical Primitive API for Auditable Reasoning over Temporal Knowledge Graphs
comments:
Major revision reframing the paper from an API spec to a novel
  architectural pattern for deterministic agents. The core contribution is now
  positioned as a blueprint for auditable reasoning, essential for building
  trustworthy legal AI systems
summary:
For autonomous legal agents to operate safely in high-stakes domains, they
require a foundation of absolute determinism and auditability-guarantees that
standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks cannot provide. When
interacting with temporal knowledge graphs that model the complex evolution of
legal norms, agents must navigate versioning, causality, and hierarchical
structures with precision, a task for which black-box vector search is
ill-suited. This paper introduces a new architectural pattern to solve this: a
formal Primitive API designed as a secure execution layer for reasoning over
such graphs. Instead of a monolithic query engine, our framework provides a
library of canonical primitives-atomic, composable, and auditable primitives.
This design empowers planner-guided agents to decompose complex legal questions
into transparent execution plans, enabling critical tasks with full
verifiability, including: (i) precise point-in-time version retrieval, (ii)
robust causal lineage tracing, and (iii) context-aware hybrid search.
Ultimately, this architecture transforms opaque retrieval into auditable
reasoning, turning the agent's internal process from a black box into a
verifiable log of deterministic primitives and providing a blueprint for
building the next generation of trustworthy legal AI.

AI.title_translation: 确定性法律代理：用于时间知识图谱上可审计推理的规范原始API
AI.tldr: 为了让法律AI在处理复杂的时间知识图谱时更安全、可信赖，我们用一套原子的、可审计的“原始API”替换了不透明的RAG系统，这使得代理的每一步推理过程（如版本检索和因果追踪）都变得完全透明和可验证。
AI.motivation: 标准RAG框架无法为高风险领域的自主法律代理提供绝对的确定性和可审计性，尤其是在处理涉及版本控制、因果关系和层次结构的复杂时间知识图谱时，黑盒向量搜索表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的架构模式：一个形式化的“原始API”，作为一个安全执行层，用于在时间知识图谱上进行推理。该框架提供了一组原子化、可组合、可审计的规范原语库，而不是单一的查询引擎。
AI.result: 该设计使规划器引导的代理能够将复杂的法律问题分解为透明的执行计划，从而实现关键任务（包括精确的时间点版本检索、稳健的因果链追溯和上下文感知的混合搜索）的完全可验证性。
AI.conclusion: 该架构将不透明的检索转化为可审计的推理，将代理的内部过程从黑箱转变为确定性原语的可验证日志，并为构建下一代可信赖的法律AI提供了蓝图。
AI.translation: 为了让自主法律代理在高风险领域安全运行，它们需要绝对确定性和可审计性的基础——这是标准检索增强生成（RAG）框架无法提供的保证。当与模拟法律规范复杂演变的时间知识图谱交互时，代理必须精确地处理版本控制、因果关系和层次结构，而黑盒向量搜索对于这项任务来说非常不合适。本文介绍了一种新的架构模式来解决这个问题：一个形式化的原始API，设计为在这些图上进行推理的安全执行层。我们的框架提供了一组规范原语库——原子化、可组合和可审计的——而不是一个单一的查询引擎。这种设计使规划器引导的代理能够将复杂的法律问题分解为透明的执行计划，从而实现关键任务的完全可验证性，包括：（i）精确的时间点版本检索，（ii）稳健的因果链追溯，以及（iii）上下文感知的混合搜索。最终，该架构将不透明的检索转化为可审计的推理，将代理的内部过程从黑箱转变为确定性原语的可验证日志，并为构建下一代可信赖的法律AI提供了蓝图。
AI.summary: 为解决标准RAG框架在处理时间知识图谱时缺乏确定性和可审计性的问题，本文提出了一种新的“原始API”架构模式。该模式提供了一组原子化的规范原语，作为安全执行层，使规划器引导的代理能够将法律问题分解为透明的执行计划，从而实现对版本、因果关系和搜索的精确、可验证的操作，最终目标是构建可信赖的法律AI。
AI.keywords: 确定性法律代理, 时间知识图谱, 原始API, 可审计推理, 规范原语
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一个“原始API”架构模式，用以取代不透明的RAG框架，从而确保法律AI推理的绝对确定性和可审计性。其重要性在于为高风险领域的自主法律代理提供了构建可信赖AI的蓝图。目前未提及局限性。

title: LongRM: Revealing and Unlocking the Context Boundary of Reward Modeling
summary:
Reward model (RM) plays a pivotal role in aligning large language model (LLM)
with human preferences. As real-world applications increasingly involve long
history trajectories, e.g., LLM agent, it becomes indispensable to evaluate
whether a model's responses are not only high-quality but also grounded in and
consistent with the provided context. Yet, current RMs remain confined to
short-context settings and primarily focus on response-level attributes (e.g.,
safety or helpfulness), while largely neglecting the critical dimension of long
context-response consistency. In this work, we introduce Long-RewardBench, a
benchmark specifically designed for long-context RM evaluation, featuring both
Pairwise Comparison and Best-of-N tasks. Our preliminary study reveals that
even state-of-the-art generative RMs exhibit significant fragility in
long-context scenarios, failing to maintain context-aware preference judgments.
Motivated by the analysis of failure patterns observed in model outputs, we
propose a general multi-stage training strategy that effectively scales
arbitrary models into robust Long-context RMs (LongRMs). Experiments show that
our approach not only substantially improves performance on long-context
evaluation but also preserves strong short-context capability. Notably, our 8B
LongRM outperforms much larger 70B-scale baselines and matches the performance
of the proprietary Gemini 2.5 Pro model.

title: How can we assess human-agent interactions? Case studies in software agent design
summary:
LLM-powered agents are both a promising new technology and a source of
complexity, where choices about models, tools, and prompting can affect their
usefulness. While numerous benchmarks measure agent accuracy across domains,
they mostly assume full automation, failing to represent the collaborative
nature of real-world use cases. In this paper, we make two major steps towards
the rigorous assessment of human-agent interactions. First, we propose PULSE, a
framework for more efficient human-centric evaluation of agent designs, which
comprises collecting user feedback, training an ML model to predict user
satisfaction, and computing results by combining human satisfaction ratings
with model-generated pseudo-labels. Second, we deploy the framework on a
large-scale web platform built around the open-source software agent OpenHands,
collecting in-the-wild usage data across over 15k users. We conduct case
studies around how three agent design decisions -- choice of LLM backbone,
planning strategy, and memory mechanisms -- impact developer satisfaction
rates, yielding practical insights for software agent design. We also show how
our framework can lead to more robust conclusions about agent design, reducing
confidence intervals by 40% compared to a standard A/B test. Finally, we find
substantial discrepancies between in-the-wild results and benchmark performance
(e.g., the anti-correlation between results comparing claude-sonnet-4 and
gpt-5), underscoring the limitations of benchmark-driven evaluation. Our
findings provide guidance for evaluations of LLM agents with humans and
identify opportunities for better agent designs.

title: UniCoD: Enhancing Robot Policy via Unified Continuous and Discrete Representation Learning
summary:
Building generalist robot policies that can handle diverse tasks in
open-ended environments is a central challenge in robotics. To leverage
knowledge from large-scale pretraining, prior work (VLA) has typically built
generalist policies either on top of vision-language understanding models
(VLMs) or generative models. However, both semantic understanding from
vision-language pretraining and visual dynamics modeling from visual-generation
pretraining are crucial for embodied robots. Recent unified models of
generation and understanding have demonstrated strong capabilities in both
comprehension and generation through large-scale pretraining. We posit that
robotic policy learning can likewise benefit from the combined strengths of
understanding, planning, and continuous future representation learning.
Building on this insight, we introduce UniCoD, which acquires the ability to
dynamically model high-dimensional visual features through pretraining on over
1M internet-scale instructional manipulation videos. Subsequently, UniCoD is
fine-tuned on data collected from the robot embodiment, enabling the learning
of mappings from predictive representations to action tokens. Extensive
experiments show our approach consistently outperforms baseline methods in
terms of 9\% and 12\% across simulation environments and real-world
out-of-distribution tasks.

AI.title_translation: UniCoD：通过统一的连续和离散表征学习增强机器人策略
AI.tldr: UniCoD通过结合互联网视频预训练的强大视觉动态建模能力与机器人具身微调，创建了一种新的统一表征学习框架，用于构建更通用的机器人策略，并在各种测试中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 构建能够处理开放环境多样化任务的通用机器人策略是核心挑战。先前的通用策略依赖于视觉-语言理解模型（VLMs）或生成模型，但两者都缺乏对机器人至关重要的语义理解和视觉动态建模的全面结合。作者认为机器人策略学习可以从理解、规划和连续未来表征学习的结合中受益。
AI.method: UniCoD首先在超过100万个互联网尺度的指令操作视频上进行预训练，以获得动态建模高维视觉特征的能力。随后，在机器人具身收集的数据上进行微调，学习从预测表征到动作令牌的映射。
AI.result: 在模拟环境和真实世界的分布外任务中，UniCoD的性能分别持续超越基线方法9%和12%。
AI.conclusion: UniCoD通过结合理解、规划和连续未来表征学习，展示了在模拟和真实世界任务中超越基线方法的性能。
AI.translation: 构建能够处理开放环境多样化任务的通用机器人策略是机器人领域的中心挑战。先前的研究（VLA）通常在视觉-语言理解模型（VLMs）或生成模型的基础上构建通用策略。然而，来自视觉-语言预训练的语义理解和来自视觉生成预训练的视觉动态建模对于具身机器人至关重要。最近的生成和理解统一模型在大规模预训练中展示了强大的理解和生成能力。我们认为，机器人策略学习同样可以从理解、规划和连续未来表征学习的结合优势中受益。基于这一见解，我们引入了UniCoD，它通过在超过100万个互联网尺度的指令操作视频上进行预训练，获得了动态建模高维视觉特征的能力。随后，UniCoD在从机器人具身收集的数据上进行微调，以实现在预测表征到动作令牌之间的映射学习。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法在模拟环境和真实世界的分布外任务中的性能分别持续优于基线方法9%和12%。
AI.summary: UniCoD提出了一种新的机器人策略学习方法，通过结合理解、规划和连续未来表征学习，利用大规模互联网视频预训练来动态建模高维视觉特征，随后在机器人具身数据上微调，以实现从预测表征到动作令牌的映射，从而在各种任务中提高了通用机器人的性能。
AI.keywords: 机器人策略, 统一表征学习, 连续离散表示, 视觉语言模型, 预训练
AI.comments: UniCoD的创新点在于将理解、规划和连续未来表征学习结合起来，以增强机器人策略的学习。它利用了大规模互联网视频预训练的优势，并在机器人具身数据上进行微调，以应对通用机器人策略的挑战。局限性可能在于对大规模预训练数据的依赖和实际部署的泛化能力。

title: InternSVG: Towards Unified SVG Tasks with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary:
General SVG modeling remains challenging due to fragmented datasets, limited
transferability of methods across tasks, and the difficulty of handling
structural complexity. In response, we leverage the strong transfer and
generalization capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to
achieve unified modeling for SVG understanding, editing, and generation. We
present the InternSVG family, an integrated data-benchmark-model suite. At its
core is SAgoge, the largest and most comprehensive multimodal dataset for SVG
tasks, encompassing both static graphics and dynamic animations. It covers
icons, long-sequence illustrations, scientific diagrams, and dynamic
animations, supporting tasks of varied difficulty levels and providing deeper
hierarchies with richer attributes compared to previous datasets. Based on this
resource, we introduce SArena, a companion benchmark with comprehensive task
definitions and standardized evaluation that aligns with the domains and
difficulty spectrum covered by SAgoge. Building on these foundations, we
propose InternSVG, a unified MLLM for SVG understanding, editing, and
generation with SVG-specific special tokens, subword-based embedding
initialization, and a two-stage training strategy that progresses from short
static SVGs to long-sequence illustrations and complex animations. This unified
formulation induces positive transfer and improves overall performance.
Experiments on SArena and prior benchmark confirm that InternSVG achieves
substantial gains and consistently outperforms leading open and proprietary
counterparts.

AI.title_translation: InternSVG：迈向多模态大语言模型的统一 SVG 任务
AI.tldr: 研究人员为解决 SVG 任务分散和建模困难的问题，构建了 InternSVG 综合套件，包括最大的 SVG 数据集 SAgoge、标准测试基准 SArena，以及一个统一的多模态大语言模型 InternSVG，该模型通过特定技术和分阶段训练，成功实现了 SVG 任务的统一处理并大幅提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 SVG 建模面临数据集零散、方法间迁移能力有限以及难以处理结构复杂性的挑战。研究旨在利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）强大的迁移和泛化能力，实现 SVG 理解、编辑和生成的统一建模。
AI.method: 构建了集成的“数据-基准-模型”套件：1. 提出了 SAgoge，一个包含静态图形和动态动画的大规模多模态 SVG 数据集。2. 建立了 SArena，一个配套的基准测试，具有标准化的评估。3. 提出了 InternSVG，一个统一的多模态大语言模型，采用 SVG 特殊标记、子词嵌入初始化和两阶段训练策略（从静态到动画）。
AI.result: InternSVG 在 SArena 和先前基准测试上取得了实质性的性能提升，并持续优于领先的开源和专有模型。
AI.conclusion: 该统一的 MLLM 框架通过引入特定于 SVG 的特殊标记、基于子词的嵌入初始化和两阶段训练策略，成功实现了 SVG 理解、编辑和生成的统一建模，并在 SArena 和现有基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 通用 SVG 建模由于数据集零散、方法在任务间的迁移能力有限以及处理结构复杂性的困难而仍然具有挑战性。为此，我们利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）强大的迁移和泛化能力，实现了 SVG 理解、编辑和生成的统一建模。我们提出了 InternSVG 系列，一个集成的“数据-基准-模型”套件。其核心是 SAgoge，迄今为止最大、最全面的 SVG 任务多模态数据集，涵盖静态图形和动态动画。它覆盖了图标、长序列插图、科学图表和动态动画，支持不同难度的任务，并比先前的数据集具有更深层次的层次结构和更丰富的属性。基于此资源，我们引入了 SArena，一个配套的基准测试，其任务定义和标准化评估与 SAgoge 覆盖的领域和难度范围保持一致。在这些基础之上，我们提出了 InternSVG，一个统一的 MLLM，用于 SVG 理解、编辑和生成，它采用了 SVG 特有的特殊标记、基于子词的嵌入初始化以及一个从短静态 SVG 发展到长序列插图和复杂动画的两阶段训练策略。这种统一的表述引发了积极的迁移，并提高了整体性能。在 SArena 和先前基准上的实验证明，InternSVG 实现了实质性的增益，并持续优于领先的开源和专有模型。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 InternSVG 框架，旨在解决 SVG 任务碎片化和方法泛化性差的问题。该框架包括一个大规模多模态 SVG 数据集 SAgoge、一个标准化的评估基准 SArena，以及一个统一的多模态大语言模型 InternSVG。InternSVG 通过引入 SVG 特有机制和两阶段训练策略，实现了对 SVG 理解、编辑和生成的统一处理，并在实验中展现出超越现有 SOTA 模型的性能。
AI.keywords: SVG 建模, 多模态大语言模型, 数据集, 基准测试, 统一模型
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于构建了首个集成了大规模数据集 (SAgoge)、标准基准 (SArena) 和统一模型 (InternSVG) 的 SVG 任务解决方案。其重要性在于解决了现有 SVG 任务分散和方法泛化性差的问题。局限性可能在于对 MLLM 的依赖性，以及训练策略的复杂性。

title: Differentiable Fast Top-K Selection for Large-Scale Recommendation
comments: 12 pages, 5 figures. Minor corrections in v2
summary:
Cascade ranking is a widely adopted paradigm in large-scale information
retrieval systems for Top-K item selection. However, the Top-K operator is
non-differentiable, hindering end-to-end training. Existing methods include
Learning-to-Rank approaches (e.g., LambdaLoss), which optimize ranking metrics
like NDCG and suffer from objective misalignment, and differentiable
sorting-based methods (e.g., ARF, LCRON), which relax permutation matrices for
direct Top-K optimization but introduce gradient conflicts through matrix
aggregation. A promising alternative is to directly construct a differentiable
approximation of the Top-K selection operator, bypassing the use of soft
permutation matrices. However, even state-of-the-art differentiable Top-K
operator (e.g., LapSum) require $O(n \log n)$ complexity due to their
dependence on sorting for solving the threshold. Thus, we propose DFTopK, a
novel differentiable Top-K operator achieving optimal $O(n)$ time complexity.
By relaxing normalization constraints, DFTopK admits a closed-form solution and
avoids sorting. DFTopK also avoids the gradient conflicts inherent in
differentiable sorting-based methods. We evaluate DFTopK on both the public
benchmark RecFLow and an industrial system. Experimental results show that
DFTopK significantly improves training efficiency while achieving superior
performance, which enables us to scale up training samples more efficiently. In
the online A/B test, DFTopK yielded a +1.77% revenue lift with the same
computational budget compared to the baseline. To the best of our knowledge,
this work is the first to introduce differentiable Top-K operators into
recommendation systems and the first to achieve theoretically optimal
linear-time complexity for Top-K selection. We have open-sourced our
implementation to facilitate future research in both academia and industry.

title: GS-Verse: Mesh-based Gaussian Splatting for Physics-aware Interaction in Virtual Reality
summary:
As the demand for immersive 3D content grows, the need for intuitive and
efficient interaction methods becomes paramount. Current techniques for
physically manipulating 3D content within Virtual Reality (VR) often face
significant limitations, including reliance on engineering-intensive processes
and simplified geometric representations, such as tetrahedral cages, which can
compromise visual fidelity and physical accuracy. In this paper, we introduce
GS-Verse (Gaussian Splatting for Virtual Environment Rendering and Scene
Editing), a novel method designed to overcome these challenges by directly
integrating an object's mesh with a Gaussian Splatting (GS) representation. Our
approach enables more precise surface approximation, leading to highly
realistic deformations and interactions. By leveraging existing 3D mesh assets,
GS-Verse facilitates seamless content reuse and simplifies the development
workflow. Moreover, our system is designed to be physics-engine-agnostic,
granting developers robust deployment flexibility. This versatile architecture
delivers a highly realistic, adaptable, and intuitive approach to interactive
3D manipulation. We rigorously validate our method against the current
state-of-the-art technique that couples VR with GS in a comparative user study
involving 18 participants. Specifically, we demonstrate that our approach is
statistically significantly better for physics-aware stretching manipulation
and is also more consistent in other physics-based manipulations like twisting
and shaking. Further evaluation across various interactions and scenes confirms
that our method consistently delivers high and reliable performance, showing
its potential as a plausible alternative to existing methods.

AI.title_translation: GS-Verse：基于网格的高斯泼溅用于虚拟现实中的物理感知交互
AI.tldr: GS-Verse通过将现有3D网格与高斯泼溅（GS）表示直接集成，创建了一种新的VR交互方法，实现了更真实的形变和物理感知操作（如拉伸、扭曲），并在用户研究中表现出显著优于现有技术的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前VR中物理操作3D内容的技术依赖于工程密集型流程和简化的几何表示（如四面体笼），这损害了视觉保真度和物理准确性。
AI.method: 提出了GS-Verse（虚拟环境渲染和场景编辑的高斯泼溅），一种新颖的方法，通过将对象的现有3D网格与高斯泼溅（GS）表示直接集成来解决现有挑战。该方法实现了更精确的表面近似、逼真的形变，并利用现有网格资产实现内容复用，简化了开发流程。系统设计为与物理引擎无关，提供了部署灵活性。
AI.result: 通过与当前最先进的VR-GS耦合技术的比较用户研究（18名参与者）进行验证。结果表明，GS-Verse在物理感知拉伸操作方面具有统计学上的显著优势，并且在扭曲和晃动等其他基于物理的操作中也更加一致。在各种交互和场景中的进一步评估证实了该方法持续提供高且可靠的性能。
AI.conclusion: GS-Verse提供了一种高度逼真、适应性强且直观的交互式3D操作方法，具有作为现有方法的可行替代方案的潜力。
AI.translation: 随着对沉浸式3D内容需求的增长，对直观高效的交互方法的需求变得至关重要。当前在虚拟现实（VR）中物理操作3D内容的技术通常面临重大限制，包括依赖工程密集型过程和简化的几何表示（例如四面体笼），这可能会损害视觉保真度和物理准确性。在本文中，我们介绍了GS-Verse（虚拟环境渲染和场景编辑的高斯泼溅），这是一种旨在克服这些挑战的新颖方法，它通过将对象的网格与高斯泼溅（GS）表示直接集成。我们的方法能够实现更精确的表面近似，从而带来高度逼真的形变和交互。通过利用现有的3D网格资产，GS-Verse促进了内容的无缝重用并简化了开发工作流程。此外，我们的系统设计为与物理引擎无关，赋予开发人员强大的部署灵活性。这种多功能架构为交互式3D操作提供了一种高度逼真、适应性强且直观的方法。我们通过一项涉及18名参与者的比较用户研究，针对当前最先进的将VR与GS耦合的技术，严格验证了我们的方法。具体而言，我们证明了我们的方法在物理感知拉伸操作方面具有统计学上的显著优势，并且在扭曲和晃动等其他基于物理的操作中也更加一致。对各种交互和场景的进一步评估证实，我们的方法持续提供高且可靠的性能，显示出其作为现有方法可行替代方案的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了GS-Verse，一种将对象网格与高斯泼溅（GS）表示直接集成的新型方法，以解决当前VR物理操作中视觉保真度和物理准确性受损的问题。GS-Verse实现了更精确的表面近似和高度逼真的形变与交互，并支持现有3D网格资产的复用和物理引擎无关的部署。通过一项用户研究，GS-Verse被证明在物理感知拉伸操作上显著优于现有技术，并在其他物理操作中表现出更高的一致性，展现出其作为交互式3D操作可行替代方案的潜力。
AI.keywords: 高斯泼溅, 虚拟现实, 物理交互, 网格模型, 神经渲染
AI.comments: GS-Verse的创新点在于其将传统的3D网格结构与新兴的神经渲染技术高斯泼溅（GS）进行了深度融合，从而在保证GS渲染高视觉保真度的同时，利用网格结构提供了精确的几何基础，以支持物理引擎进行可靠的形变和交互计算。特别值得注意的是，该方法解决了现有VR物理交互中普遍存在的几何简化导致的准确性问题，并声称实现了物理引擎无关的灵活部署。用户研究的结果（统计学显著性优势）为该方法的有效性提供了有力支持，使其成为VR沉浸式内容交互领域的一个重要进展。

title: Hey, wait a minute: on at-issue sensitivity in Language Models
comments:
10 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. See
  https://github.com/sangheek16/hey-wait-a-minute for code and data
summary:
Evaluating the naturalness of dialogue in language models (LMs) is not
trivial: notions of 'naturalness' vary, and scalable quantitative metrics
remain limited. This study leverages the linguistic notion of 'at-issueness' to
assess dialogue naturalness and introduces a new method: Divide, Generate,
Recombine, and Compare (DGRC). DGRC (i) divides a dialogue as a prompt, (ii)
generates continuations for subparts using LMs, (iii) recombines the dialogue
and continuations, and (iv) compares the likelihoods of the recombined
sequences. This approach mitigates bias in linguistic analyses of LMs and
enables systematic testing of discourse-sensitive behavior. Applying DGRC, we
find that LMs prefer to continue dialogue on at-issue content, with this effect
enhanced in instruct-tuned models. They also reduce their at-issue preference
when relevant cues (e.g., "Hey, wait a minute") are present. Although
instruct-tuning does not further amplify this modulation, the pattern reflects
a hallmark of successful dialogue dynamics.
comment:
10 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. See
  https://github.com/sangheek16/hey-wait-a-minute for code and data

AI.title_translation: 嘿，等一下：关于语言模型中的“在议题上”敏感性
AI.tldr: 本研究引入了DGRC方法，利用语言学中的“在议题上”（at-issueness）概念来评估语言模型的对话自然度。研究发现，语言模型倾向于围绕“在议题上”的内容继续对话，并且在存在相关提示（如“Hey, wait a minute”）时，这种倾向会减弱，这反映了成功的对话动态。
AI.motivation: 评估语言模型对话的自然度并非易事，因为“自然度”的概念各不相同，且缺乏可扩展的定量指标。
AI.method: 引入了“划分、生成、重组和比较”（DGRC）的新方法。该方法步骤包括：(i) 将对话划分为提示，(ii) 使用语言模型为子部分生成续写，(iii) 重组对话和续写，以及 (iv) 比较重组序列的似然度。该方法旨在减轻对语言模型进行语言分析时的偏差，并系统地测试语篇敏感行为。
AI.result: 语言模型倾向于围绕“在议题上”的内容继续对话，且指令调优模型（instruct-tuned models）的这种效果更强。当存在相关提示（例如：“Hey, wait a minute”）时，语言模型会降低其“在议题上”的偏好。指令调优并未进一步增强这种调节作用。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型对“在议题上”内容的偏好及其对相关提示的敏感性（尽管指令调优未能进一步放大这种敏感性）反映了成功对话动态的一个标志。
AI.translation: 评估语言模型（LMs）中对话的自然度并非易事：对于“自然度”的理解各不相同，且可扩展的定量指标仍然有限。本研究利用语言学中的“在议题上”（at-issueness）概念来评估对话的自然度，并引入了一种新方法：划分、生成、重组和比较（DGRC）。DGRC (i) 将对话划分为提示，(ii) 使用语言模型为子部分生成续写，(iii) 重组对话和续写，以及 (iv) 比较重组序列的似然度。这种方法减轻了对语言模型进行语言分析时的偏差，并能够系统地测试语篇敏感行为。应用DGRC，我们发现语言模型倾向于围绕“在议题上”的内容继续对话，且指令调优模型中的这种效果有所增强。当存在相关提示（例如：“Hey, wait a minute”）时，它们也会降低其“在议题上”的偏好。尽管指令调优并未进一步放大这种调节作用，但这种模式反映了成功对话动态的一个标志。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新方法DGRC（划分、生成、重组和比较），利用语言学中的“在议题上”概念来定量评估语言模型的对话自然度。DGRC通过比较不同重组序列的似然度来系统地测试语言模型的语篇敏感行为。实验结果表明，语言模型（尤其是指令调优模型）倾向于关注“在议题上”的内容进行对话，并且在出现像“Hey, wait a minute”这样的相关提示时，会成功地调整其“在议题上”的偏好，体现了成功的对话动态。
AI.keywords: 对话自然度, 在议题上敏感性, 语言模型, DGRC, 指令调优
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将“在议题上”（at-issueness）这一语言学概念引入到语言模型对话自然度的量化评估中。通过引入DGRC这一系统性测试方法，研究者能够超越传统的主观或有限的指标，深入探索语言模型对语篇结构的敏感性。发现指令调优模型在“在议题上”内容上的偏好增强，以及模型能够响应中断性提示（如“Hey, wait a minute”）并调整焦点，证明了现有语言模型在对话动态方面取得了显著进展，为未来更精细的对话系统设计提供了重要的语言学洞察。

title: Real-Time Neural Video Compression with Unified Intra and Inter Coding
summary:
Neural video compression (NVC) technologies have advanced rapidly in recent
years, yielding state-of-the-art schemes such as DCVC-RT that offer superior
compression efficiency to H.266/VVC and real-time encoding/decoding
capabilities. Nonetheless, existing NVC schemes have several limitations,
including inefficiency in dealing with disocclusion and new content, interframe
error propagation and accumulation, among others. To eliminate these
limitations, we borrow the idea from classic video coding schemes, which allow
intra coding within inter-coded frames. With the intra coding tool enabled,
disocclusion and new content are properly handled, and interframe error
propagation is naturally intercepted without the need for manual refresh
mechanisms. We present an NVC framework with unified intra and inter coding,
where every frame is processed by a single model that is trained to perform
intra/inter coding adaptively. Moreover, we propose a simultaneous two-frame
compression design to exploit interframe redundancy not only forwardly but also
backwardly. Experimental results show that our scheme outperforms DCVC-RT by an
average of 12.1% BD-rate reduction, delivers more stable bitrate and quality
per frame, and retains real-time encoding/decoding performances. Code and
models will be released.

AI.title_translation: 统一帧内和帧间编码的实时神经视频压缩
AI.tldr: 提出了一种统一帧内/帧间编码的实时神经视频压缩（NVC）框架，解决了现有NVC在处理遮挡消除和错误传播方面的限制。新方案性能优于DCVC-RT 12.1%，并保持了实时性。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经视频压缩（NVC）方案（如DCVC-RT）存在局限性，包括处理遮挡消除和新内容时的低效性、以及帧间错误传播和累积问题。
AI.method: 1. 借鉴经典视频编码思想，允许在帧间编码的帧中进行帧内编码，以处理遮挡消除和新内容，并自然地阻止错误传播。2. 提出了一个统一帧内和帧间编码的NVC框架，其中每个帧都由一个经过训练、可自适应执行帧内/帧间编码的单一模型处理。3. 提出了一种同步双帧压缩设计，以不仅向前而且向后利用帧间冗余。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，该方案比DCVC-RT平均降低了12.1%的BD-率，每帧的比特率和质量更加稳定，并保持了实时编码/解码性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一帧内和帧间编码，该方案成功消除了现有NVC的局限性，实现了更高的压缩效率（比DCVC-RT高12.1%）和更稳定的性能，同时保持了实时性。
AI.translation: 神经视频压缩（NVC）技术近年来发展迅速，产生了像DCVC-RT这样最先进的方案，其压缩效率优于H.266/VVC并具备实时编码/解码能力。然而，现有的NVC方案仍存在一些局限性，包括处理遮挡消除和新内容时的低效性、帧间错误传播和累积等问题。为了消除这些局限性，我们借鉴了经典视频编码方案中的思想，即允许在帧间编码的帧中进行帧内编码。通过启用帧内编码工具，可以适当地处理遮挡消除和新内容，并且无需手动刷新机制即可自然地阻止帧间错误传播。我们提出了一个具有统一帧内和帧间编码的NVC框架，其中每个帧都由一个经过训练可自适应执行帧内/帧间编码的单一模型处理。此外，我们提出了一种同步双帧压缩设计，以不仅向前而且向后利用帧间冗余。实验结果表明，我们的方案平均比DCVC-RT降低了12.1%的BD-率，每帧的比特率和质量更加稳定，并保持了实时编码/解码性能。代码和模型将发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个实时神经视频压缩（NVC）框架，通过统一帧内和帧间编码来解决现有NVC方案中处理新内容和帧间错误传播的效率低下问题。该框架采用单一模型自适应地执行帧内/帧间编码，并引入同步双帧压缩设计以同时利用前向和后向的帧间冗余。实验证明，该方案在保持实时性能的同时，比DCVC-RT实现了12.1%的BD-率降低和更稳定的每帧质量与比特率。
AI.keywords: 神经视频压缩, 帧内/帧间编码, 实时压缩, BD-率, 错误传播
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将传统视频编码中的核心思想（即在P/B帧中引入帧内编码能力）有效地集成到神经视频压缩（NVC）框架中。这不仅解决了现有NVC模型在处理遮挡和错误累积方面的固有弱点，还通过“同步双帧压缩”进一步优化了冗余利用。与最先进的DCVC-RT相比，12.1%的BD-率提升是显著的，同时保持了实时性，这对于实际应用至关重要。该工作展示了将经典编码智慧与深度学习模型融合的有效性。

title: WeCKD: Weakly-supervised Chained Distillation Network for Efficient Multimodal Medical Imaging
summary:
Knowledge distillation (KD) has traditionally relied on a static
teacher-student framework, where a large, well-trained teacher transfers
knowledge to a single student model. However, these approaches often suffer
from knowledge degradation, inefficient supervision, and reliance on either a
very strong teacher model or large labeled datasets. To address these, we
present the first-ever Weakly-supervised Chain-based KD network (WeCKD) that
redefines knowledge transfer through a structured sequence of interconnected
models. Unlike conventional KD, it forms a progressive distillation chain,
where each model not only learns from its predecessor but also refines the
knowledge before passing it forward. This structured knowledge transfer further
enhances feature learning and addresses the limitations of one-step KD. Each
model in the chain is trained on only a fraction of the dataset and shows that
effective learning can be achieved with minimal supervision. Extensive
evaluation on six imaging datasets across otoscopic, microscopic, and magnetic
resonance imaging modalities shows that it generalizes and outperforms existing
methods. Furthermore, the proposed distillation chain resulted in cumulative
accuracy gains of up to +23% over a single backbone trained on the same limited
data, which highlights its potential for real-world adoption.

AI.title_translation: WeCKD：用于高效多模态医学成像的弱监督链式蒸馏网络
AI.tldr: 传统知识蒸馏（KD）存在知识退化和监督效率低的问题。本文提出了WeCKD，一种弱监督链式蒸馏网络，它通过模型序列渐进地提炼知识。WeCKD在多模态医学成像任务上，仅使用少量数据和弱监督，性能优于现有方法，相对单一骨干模型准确率最高提升23%。
AI.motivation: 传统的知识蒸馏（KD）依赖于静态的师生框架，存在知识退化、监督效率低下以及过度依赖强大的教师模型或大型标注数据集的问题。
AI.method: 提出了首个弱监督链式知识蒸馏网络（WeCKD）。它通过一个结构化的互连模型序列（渐进式蒸馏链）来重新定义知识迁移。链中的每个模型不仅从其前身学习，还会在将知识传递给下一个模型之前对其进行提炼。链中的每个模型仅使用一小部分数据集进行训练（弱监督）。
AI.result: 在耳镜、显微镜和磁共振成像等六个多模态医学成像数据集上进行了广泛评估，结果表明该方法具有泛化性并优于现有方法。所提出的蒸馏链相对于在相同有限数据上训练的单一骨干模型，累积准确率增益高达+23%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法展示了在最小监督下实现有效学习的潜力，凸显了其在实际应用中的潜力（特别是在标注数据有限的情况下）。
AI.translation: 知识蒸馏（KD）传统上依赖于静态的师生框架，其中一个大型的、训练有素的教师模型将知识迁移给单个学生模型。然而，这些方法通常存在知识退化、监督效率低下以及过度依赖非常强大的教师模型或大型标注数据集的问题。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了首个弱监督链式知识蒸馏网络（WeCKD），它通过一个结构化的互连模型序列来重新定义知识迁移。与传统的KD不同，它形成了一个渐进式蒸馏链，其中每个模型不仅从其前身学习，而且在将知识向前传递之前还会对知识进行提炼。这种结构化的知识迁移进一步增强了特征学习，并解决了单步KD的局限性。链中的每个模型仅使用一小部分数据集进行训练，并表明即使在最小监督下也可以实现有效的学习。在耳镜、显微镜和磁共振成像模态的六个成像数据集上的广泛评估表明，它具有泛化性并优于现有方法。此外，所提出的蒸馏链相对于在相同有限数据上训练的单一骨干模型，累积准确率增益高达+23%，这凸显了其在实际应用中的潜力。
AI.summary: WeCKD是一种用于高效多模态医学成像的弱监督链式知识蒸馏网络。针对传统KD中知识退化和监督低效的问题，WeCKD引入了一个渐进式模型序列，其中知识被顺序学习和提炼。这种方法允许模型仅使用少量数据进行有效训练，并在六个医学成像数据集上表现出优越的泛化能力和性能，相对于单一骨干模型实现了高达23%的准确率提升。
AI.keywords: 弱监督, 知识蒸馏, 链式蒸馏, 多模态医学成像, 高效学习
AI.comments: 本文的主要创新在于提出了首个弱监督链式知识蒸馏（WeCKD）框架，打破了传统的静态师生模型，转而采用渐进式的知识提炼序列。这种方法有效地解决了传统知识蒸馏中存在的知识退化和对大量标注数据依赖的问题。在多模态医学成像领域的显著性能提升（高达23%）表明了该方法在数据稀疏的实际应用场景中具有重要的价值和潜力。

title: AndroByte: LLM-Driven Privacy Analysis through Bytecode Summarization and Dynamic Dataflow Call Graph Generation
comments:
Accepted at the Annual Computer Security Applications Conference
  (ACSAC) 2025
summary:
With the exponential growth in mobile applications, protecting user privacy
has become even more crucial. Android applications are often known for
collecting, storing, and sharing sensitive user information such as contacts,
location, camera, and microphone data often without the user's clear consent or
awareness raising significant privacy risks and exposure. In the context of
privacy assessment, dataflow analysis is particularly valuable for identifying
data usage and potential leaks. Traditionally, this type of analysis has relied
on formal methods, heuristics, and rule-based matching. However, these
techniques are often complex to implement and prone to errors, such as taint
explosion for large programs. Moreover, most existing Android dataflow analysis
methods depend heavily on predefined list of sinks, limiting their flexibility
and scalability. To address the limitations of these existing techniques, we
propose AndroByte, an AI-driven privacy analysis tool that leverages LLM
reasoning on bytecode summarization to dynamically generate accurate and
explainable dataflow call graphs from static code analysis. AndroByte achieves
a significant F\b{eta}-Score of 89% in generating dynamic dataflow call graphs
on the fly, outperforming the effectiveness of traditional tools like FlowDroid
and Amandroid in leak detection without relying on predefined propagation rules
or sink lists. Moreover, AndroByte's iterative bytecode summarization provides
comprehensive and explainable insights into dataflow and leak detection,
achieving high, quantifiable scores based on the G-Eval metric.
comment:
Accepted at the Annual Computer Security Applications Conference
  (ACSAC) 2025

AI.title_translation: AndroByte：通过字节码摘要和动态数据流调用图生成实现LLM驱动的隐私分析
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 AndroByte 的AI驱动工具，它利用大型语言模型（LLM）对Android字节码进行摘要，并动态生成数据流调用图，从而实现更准确、可解释的隐私泄露检测，且优于FlowDroid等传统工具。
AI.motivation: 移动应用（特别是Android应用）未经用户明确同意或知情，收集、存储和共享敏感用户数据（如联系人、位置、摄像头、麦克风），造成重大隐私风险。传统的基于形式化方法、启发式方法或规则匹配的数据流分析方法实现复杂、易出错（如大型程序中的污点爆炸），并且受限于预定义的“汇集点”（sinks）列表，缺乏灵活性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出了AndroByte，一个AI驱动的隐私分析工具。它利用大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，基于字节码摘要，从静态代码分析中动态生成准确且可解释的数据流调用图。
AI.result: 在动态生成数据流调用图方面，实现了89%的显著F-Score。在泄露检测方面，优于FlowDroid和Amandroid等传统工具，且不依赖预定义的传播规则或汇集点列表。通过迭代字节码摘要，基于G-Eval指标获得了高且可量化的分数，提供了全面且可解释的数据流和泄露检测见解。
AI.conclusion: AndroByte通过利用LLM推理和字节码摘要，有效地解决了现有Android数据流分析在灵活性、可扩展性和准确性方面的限制，提供了一种无需预定义规则集即可实现高性能、可解释隐私泄露检测的新方法。
AI.translation: 随着移动应用的指数级增长，保护用户隐私变得更加关键。Android应用通常在没有用户明确同意或知晓的情况下，收集、存储和共享敏感的用户信息，例如联系人、位置、摄像头和麦克风数据，这带来了重大的隐私风险和暴露。在隐私评估的背景下，数据流分析对于识别数据使用和潜在泄露特别有价值。传统上，这类分析依赖于形式化方法、启发式方法和基于规则的匹配。然而，这些技术通常实现复杂且容易出错，例如大型程序中的污点爆炸。此外，大多数现有的Android数据流分析方法严重依赖预定义的汇集点列表，限制了它们的灵活性和可扩展性。为了解决现有技术的这些局限性，我们提出了 AndroByte，这是一种AI驱动的隐私分析工具，它利用LLM基于字节码摘要进行推理，从而通过静态代码分析动态生成准确且可解释的数据流调用图。AndroByte 在动态生成数据流调用图方面实现了89%的显著F-Score，在泄露检测方面优于 FlowDroid 和 Amandroid 等传统工具的有效性，且不依赖预定义的传播规则或汇集点列表。此外，AndroByte 的迭代字节码摘要为数据流和泄露检测提供了全面且可解释的见解，并基于 G-Eval 指标获得了高且可量化的分数。
AI.summary: AndroByte是一种新型的AI驱动隐私分析工具，旨在解决传统Android数据流分析方法（如依赖预定义规则和汇集点列表）的局限性。该工具通过结合大型语言模型（LLM）推理和字节码摘要，能够从静态代码分析中动态生成准确且可解释的数据流调用图。实验结果显示，AndroByte在动态图生成中实现了89%的F-Score，在无需预定义规则的情况下，其泄露检测能力优于FlowDroid和Amandroid等传统工具，并提供了高度可解释的分析结果。
AI.keywords: LLM驱动分析, 隐私分析, Android, 字节码摘要, 数据流调用图
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种利用大型语言模型（LLM）来增强移动应用隐私分析的新颖方法。其主要创新点在于将LLM的语义理解和推理能力应用于字节码摘要，从而摆脱了传统数据流分析对预定义污点传播规则和汇集点列表的依赖。这极大地提高了分析的灵活性和可扩展性，尤其是在面对大型或新颖的应用程序接口时。89%的F-Score和优于FlowDroid的表现证明了其有效性。此外，提供“可解释的见解”是其重要的优势，有助于安全研究人员理解数据泄露的精确路径。

title: Reflections from Research Roundtables at the Conference on Health, Inference, and Learning (CHIL) 2025
summary:
The 6th Annual Conference on Health, Inference, and Learning (CHIL 2025),
hosted by the Association for Health Learning and Inference (AHLI), was held in
person on June 25-27, 2025, at the University of California, Berkeley, in
Berkeley, California, USA. As part of this year's program, we hosted Research
Roundtables to catalyze collaborative, small-group dialogue around critical,
timely topics at the intersection of machine learning and healthcare. Each
roundtable was moderated by a team of senior and junior chairs who fostered
open exchange, intellectual curiosity, and inclusive engagement. The sessions
emphasized rigorous discussion of key challenges, exploration of emerging
opportunities, and collective ideation toward actionable directions in the
field. In total, eight roundtables were held by 19 roundtable chairs on topics
of "Explainability, Interpretability, and Transparency," "Uncertainty, Bias,
and Fairness," "Causality," "Domain Adaptation," "Foundation Models," "Learning
from Small Medical Data," "Multimodal Methods," and "Scalable, Translational
Healthcare Solutions."

AI.title_translation: 对健康、推断与学习会议 (CHIL) 2025 研究圆桌会议的反思/回顾

AI.motivation: 旨在围绕机器学习与医疗健康交叉领域的关键、及时主题，催化协作性的小组对话，促进开放交流、知识探索和包容性参与。

title: Towards Relaxed Multimodal Inputs for Gait-based Parkinson's Disease Assessment
summary:
Parkinson's disease assessment has garnered growing interest in recent years,
particularly with the advent of sensor data and machine learning techniques.
Among these, multimodal approaches have demonstrated strong performance by
effectively integrating complementary information from various data sources.
However, two major limitations hinder their practical application: (1) the need
to synchronize all modalities during training, and (2) the dependence on all
modalities during inference. To address these issues, we propose the first
Parkinson's assessment system that formulates multimodal learning as a
multi-objective optimization (MOO) problem. This not only allows for more
flexible modality requirements during both training and inference, but also
handles modality collapse issue during multimodal information fusion. In
addition, to mitigate the imbalance within individual modalities, we introduce
a margin-based class rebalancing strategy to enhance category learning. We
conduct extensive experiments on three public datasets under both synchronous
and asynchronous settings. The results show that our framework-Towards Relaxed
InPuts (TRIP)-achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming the best
baselines by 16.48, 6.89, and 11.55 percentage points in the asynchronous
setting, and by 4.86 and 2.30 percentage points in the synchronous setting,
highlighting its effectiveness and adaptability.

AI.title_translation: 迈向用于基于步态的帕金森病评估的松弛多模态输入
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为TRIP的基于多目标优化（MOO）的框架，用于帕金森病评估。该框架解决了多模态输入在训练和推理时必须同步或完全可用的限制，并在同步和异步设置下均实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态帕金森病评估方法存在两大实际应用障碍：(1) 训练时需要同步所有模态；(2) 推理时依赖所有模态。
AI.method: 提出了第一个将多模态学习公式化为多目标优化（MOO）问题的帕金森评估系统（TRIP）。该方法不仅提供了更灵活的模态需求，还处理了多模态信息融合中的模态崩溃问题。此外，引入了基于边界的类别再平衡策略来减轻个体模态内的数据不平衡。
AI.result: 在三个公共数据集的同步和异步设置上进行了广泛实验。该框架（TRIP）在异步设置中超越最佳基线16.48、6.89和11.55个百分点，在同步设置中超越4.86和2.30个百分点，达到了最先进（SOTA）的性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的TRIP框架有效且适应性强，能够解决多模态输入在实际应用中的严格限制，显著提高了帕金森病评估的性能。
AI.translation: 近年来，帕金森病评估引起了越来越多的关注，特别是随着传感器数据和机器学习技术的出现。其中，多模态方法通过有效整合来自各种数据源的互补信息，展示了强大的性能。然而，两大主要限制阻碍了它们的实际应用：(1) 训练期间需要同步所有模态，以及 (2) 推理期间依赖所有模态。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了第一个将多模态学习表述为多目标优化（MOO）问题的帕金森评估系统。这不仅允许在训练和推理期间对模态有更灵活的要求，而且还处理了多模态信息融合期间的模态崩溃问题。此外，为了减轻个体模态内部的不平衡，我们引入了一种基于边界的类别再平衡策略来增强类别学习。我们在三个公共数据集上进行了同步和异步设置下的广泛实验。结果表明，我们的框架——迈向松弛输入（TRIP）——实现了最先进的性能，在异步设置中超越最佳基线16.48、6.89和11.55个百分点，在同步设置中超越4.86和2.30个百分点，突显了其有效性和适应性。
AI.summary: 本文针对基于步态的帕金森病评估中多模态方法的实际应用限制（即严格的模态同步和可用性要求），提出了首个将多模态学习公式化为多目标优化（MOO）问题的评估系统（TRIP）。该框架通过引入基于边界的类别再平衡策略来增强学习，并有效解决了模态崩溃问题。实验证明，TRIP在同步和异步设置中均达到了最先进的性能，展示了其优越性和灵活性。
AI.keywords: 帕金森病评估, 多模态输入, 多目标优化, 步态分析
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将多模态学习的实际约束（如模态异步和缺失）转化为多目标优化问题进行解决，显著增强了基于传感器数据的帕金森病评估模型的实用性。在医疗健康领域，传感器数据采集往往面临不完整或不同步的问题，TRIP框架为应对这些“松弛输入”提供了切实可行的解决方案，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Executable Epistemology: The Structured Cognitive Loop as an Architecture of Intentional Understanding
comments:
The terminology has been aligned with related works of the same
  author to maintain coherence and consistency throughout the broader research
  framework
summary:
Large language models exhibit intelligence without genuine epistemic
understanding, exposing a key gap: the absence of epistemic architecture. This
paper introduces the Structured Cognitive Loop (SCL) as an executable
epistemological framework for emergent intelligence. Unlike traditional AI
research asking "what is intelligence?" (ontological), SCL asks "under what
conditions does cognition emerge?" (epistemological). Grounded in philosophy of
mind and cognitive phenomenology, SCL bridges conceptual philosophy and
implementable cognition. Drawing on process philosophy, enactive cognition, and
extended mind theory, we define intelligence not as a property but as a
performed process -- a continuous loop of judgment, memory, control, action,
and regulation. SCL makes three contributions. First, it operationalizes
philosophical insights into computationally interpretable structures, enabling
"executable epistemology" -- philosophy as structural experiment. Second, it
shows that functional separation within cognitive architecture yields more
coherent and interpretable behavior than monolithic prompt based systems,
supported by agent evaluations. Third, it redefines intelligence: not
representational accuracy but the capacity to reconstruct its own epistemic
state through intentional understanding. This framework impacts philosophy of
mind, epistemology, and AI. For philosophy, it allows theories of cognition to
be enacted and tested. For AI, it grounds behavior in epistemic structure
rather than statistical regularity. For epistemology, it frames knowledge not
as truth possession but as continuous reconstruction within a
phenomenologically coherent loop. We situate SCL within debates on cognitive
phenomenology, emergence, normativity, and intentionality, arguing that real
progress requires not larger models but architectures that realize cognitive
principles structurally.

AI.title_translation: 可执行的认识论：作为意向性理解架构的结构化认知循环
AI.tldr: 针对大型语言模型缺乏真正的认知理解问题，本文提出了结构化认知循环（SCL）架构。SCL将智能定义为一个连续的过程循环（判断、记忆、控制、行动、调节），实现了“可执行的认识论”，并通过功能分离而非单一提示系统，证明了能产生更连贯和可解释的行为。
AI.motivation: 解决大型语言模型（LLMs）展示出智能但缺乏真正的认识论理解（即缺乏认知架构）的关键缺陷。
AI.method: 提出结构化认知循环（SCL）作为可执行的认识论框架。该框架基于心智哲学、认知现象学、过程哲学、具身认知和扩展心智理论。SCL将智能定义为一个包含“判断、记忆、控制、行动、调节”的连续执行过程循环，并侧重于功能分离的架构设计。
AI.result: SCL实现了可计算解释的“可执行认识论”。通过代理评估，证明了SCL的功能分离架构比单一提示系统能产生更连贯和可解释的行为。此外，它将智能重新定义为重建自身认知状态的能力。
AI.conclusion: 真正的进步不在于更大的模型，而在于能够结构性地实现认知原理的架构。SCL影响了心智哲学、认识论和人工智能领域，它将行为建立在认知结构而非统计规律之上，并将知识视为在现象学连贯循环中的持续重建。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型展现出智能，但缺乏真正的认识论理解，暴露了一个关键的缺陷：认知架构的缺失。本文引入了结构化认知循环（SCL）作为一种用于突现智能的可执行认识论框架。与传统人工智能研究关注“智能是什么？”（本体论）不同，SCL关注“认知在何种条件下涌现？”（认识论）。SCL以心智哲学和认知现象学为基础，弥合了概念哲学和可实现认知之间的鸿沟。借鉴过程哲学、具身认知和扩展心智理论，我们将智能定义为一种被执行的过程——一个持续的判断、记忆、控制、行动和调节的循环，而非一种属性。SCL做出了三项贡献。首先，它将哲学洞察操作化为可计算解释的结构，实现了“可执行的认识论”——将哲学作为结构性实验。其次，通过代理评估的支持，它表明认知架构中的功能分离比单一提示系统能产生更连贯和可解释的行为。第三，它重新定义了智能：不是表征的准确性，而是通过意向性理解来重建自身认识状态的能力。该框架影响了心智哲学、认识论和人工智能。对于哲学而言，它允许认知理论得到实施和检验。对于人工智能而言，它将行为建立在认识结构而非统计规律之上。对于认识论而言，它将知识框定为在现象学连贯循环中的持续重建，而非对真理的占有。我们将SCL置于关于认知现象学、涌现、规范性和意向性的辩论之中，认为真正的进步需要的不是更大的模型，而是能够结构性地实现认知原理的架构。
AI.summary: 本文提出了结构化认知循环（SCL）框架，以解决大型语言模型缺乏真正的认识论理解和认知架构的问题。SCL是一种“可执行的认识论”，它将智能定义为一个持续的、由判断、记忆、控制、行动和调节组成的执行过程循环。通过将哲学见解转化为可计算的结构，并采用功能分离的架构，SCL在代理评估中展示出比单一提示系统更连贯和可解释的行为。该研究重新定义了智能，强调重建自身认知状态的能力，并主张人工智能的未来发展应侧重于实现认知原理的结构化架构。
AI.keywords: 结构化认知循环, 可执行认识论, 意向性理解, 认知架构, 认知现象学
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它试图将深奥的哲学概念（如认识论、认知现象学、过程哲学）直接转化为可计算和可执行的AI架构。它明确指出了当前LLM的局限性在于缺乏“认知架构”，而不仅仅是规模不足。通过引入SCL，文章提供了一个具体的、基于循环过程的替代方案，旨在实现真正的“意向性理解”，这超越了传统AI对统计准确性或表征精度的追求。其重要性在于为AI研究提供了一个新的理论基础，即从本体论转向认识论，并为心智哲学提供了一个实验平台。如果其声称的“代理评估”结果具有说服力，这将是对当前主流的大规模、单一模型范式的一个重要挑战。

title: Generative AI for Biosciences: Emerging Threats and Roadmap to Biosecurity
summary:
The rapid adoption of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in the
biosciences is transforming biotechnology, medicine, and synthetic biology. Yet
this advancement is intrinsically linked to new vulnerabilities, as GenAI
lowers the barrier to misuse and introduces novel biosecurity threats, such as
generating synthetic viral proteins or toxins. These dual-use risks are often
overlooked, as existing safety guardrails remain fragile and can be
circumvented through deceptive prompts or jailbreak techniques. In this
Perspective, we first outline the current state of GenAI in the biosciences and
emerging threat vectors ranging from jailbreak attacks and privacy risks to the
dual-use challenges posed by autonomous AI agents. We then examine urgent gaps
in regulation and oversight, drawing on insights from 130 expert interviews
across academia, government, industry, and policy. A large majority ($\approx
76$\%) expressed concern over AI misuse in biology, and 74\% called for the
development of new governance frameworks. Finally, we explore technical
pathways to mitigation, advocating a multi-layered approach to GenAI safety.
These defenses include rigorous data filtering, alignment with ethical
principles during development, and real-time monitoring to block harmful
requests. Together, these strategies provide a blueprint for embedding security
throughout the GenAI lifecycle. As GenAI becomes integrated into the
biosciences, safeguarding this frontier requires an immediate commitment to
both adaptive governance and secure-by-design technologies.

AI.title_translation: 生成式AI在生物科学中的应用：新兴威胁与生物安全路线图
AI.tldr: 生成式AI正在改变生物科学，但带来了新的生物安全风险（如制造毒素）。现有安全措施薄弱。本文概述了新兴威胁（包括越狱攻击和双重用途挑战），基于130位专家的访谈，指出了监管空白，并提出了一个多层级的技术和治理缓解路线图，以确保AI的安全集成。
AI.motivation: 鉴于生成式AI在生物科学中的快速应用降低了滥用的门槛，并引入了新的生物安全威胁（如生成合成病毒蛋白或毒素），而现有的安全防护措施仍然脆弱且容易被规避，因此有必要概述这些威胁、评估监管差距并制定缓解策略。
AI.method: 1. 概述生成式AI在生物科学中的现状和新兴威胁载体（如越狱攻击、隐私风险、自主AI代理的双重用途挑战）。2. 引用对来自学术界、政府、工业界和政策制定者等130位专家的访谈见解，以检验监管和监督方面的紧迫差距。3. 探索技术缓解途径，倡导多层级的GenAI安全方法（包括数据过滤、伦理对齐和实时监控）。
AI.result: 大多数专家（约76%）对AI在生物学中的滥用表示担忧，74%的专家呼吁制定新的治理框架。提出的缓解策略包括严格的数据过滤、开发过程中的伦理原则对齐以及实时监控以阻止有害请求。
AI.conclusion: 随着生成式AI被整合到生物科学中，保护这一前沿领域需要立即致力于适应性治理和安全设计技术，以在GenAI的整个生命周期中嵌入安全性。
AI.translation: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）在生物科学中的快速采用正在改变生物技术、医学和合成生物学。然而，这种进步与新的脆弱性紧密相连，因为GenAI降低了滥用的门槛，并引入了新的生物安全威胁，例如生成合成病毒蛋白或毒素。这些双重用途风险经常被忽视，因为现有的安全防护措施仍然脆弱，并且可以通过欺骗性提示或越狱技术来规避。在本观点中，我们首先概述了GenAI在生物科学中的当前状态以及新兴威胁载体，范围从越狱攻击、隐私风险到自主AI代理带来的双重用途挑战。然后，我们考察了监管和监督方面的紧迫差距，借鉴了对来自学术界、政府、工业界和政策制定者等130位专家的访谈见解。绝大多数专家（约76%）对AI在生物学中的滥用表示担忧，74%的专家呼吁制定新的治理框架。最后，我们探讨了技术缓解途径，倡导一种多层级的GenAI安全方法。这些防御措施包括严格的数据过滤、开发过程中与伦理原则的对齐，以及实时监控以阻止有害请求。总而言之，这些策略为在GenAI的整个生命周期中嵌入安全性提供了一个蓝图。随着GenAI被整合到生物科学中，保护这一前沿领域需要立即致力于适应性治理和安全设计技术。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了生成式AI（GenAI）在生物科学中应用所带来的双重用途风险和新兴生物安全威胁。这些威胁包括越狱攻击和自主AI代理滥用的可能性，因为现有安全防护措施容易被规避。通过对130位专家的访谈，研究发现绝大多数受访者对AI滥用表示担忧，并呼吁建立新的治理框架。作者提出了一个多层级的缓解路线图，包括数据过滤、伦理对齐和实时监控，旨在为GenAI的安全集成提供“安全设计”的蓝图，并强调需要立即采取适应性治理措施。
AI.keywords: 生成式AI, 生物安全, 双重用途风险, 治理框架, 越狱攻击
AI.comments: 这篇论文的及时性和重要性极高，因为它直接解决了生成式AI在生物技术这一高风险领域带来的迫切且日益增长的威胁。其创新点在于结合了技术威胁分析（如越狱攻击）和广泛的社会/政策调研（130位专家访谈），为治理框架提供了坚实的实证基础。通过提出一个“安全设计”和多层级防御的路线图，它为政策制定者、AI开发者和生物安全专业人员提供了一个实用的行动蓝图。它强调了AI降低了恶意行为的门槛，这可能是对生物安全领域最具颠覆性的影响之一。

title: CrossRay3D: Geometry and Distribution Guidance for Efficient Multimodal 3D Detection
summary:
The sparse cross-modality detector offers more advantages than its
counterpart, the Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) detector, particularly in terms of
adaptability for downstream tasks and computational cost savings. However,
existing sparse detectors overlook the quality of token representation, leaving
it with a sub-optimal foreground quality and limited performance. In this
paper, we identify that the geometric structure preserved and the class
distribution are the key to improving the performance of the sparse detector,
and propose a Sparse Selector (SS). The core module of SS is Ray-Aware
Supervision (RAS), which preserves rich geometric information during the
training stage, and Class-Balanced Supervision, which adaptively reweights the
salience of class semantics, ensuring that tokens associated with small objects
are retained during token sampling. Thereby, outperforming other sparse
multi-modal detectors in the representation of tokens. Additionally, we design
Ray Positional Encoding (Ray PE) to address the distribution differences
between the LiDAR modality and the image. Finally, we integrate the
aforementioned module into an end-to-end sparse multi-modality detector, dubbed
CrossRay3D. Experiments show that, on the challenging nuScenes benchmark,
CrossRay3D achieves state-of-the-art performance with 72.4 mAP and 74.7 NDS,
while running 1.84 faster than other leading methods. Moreover, CrossRay3D
demonstrates strong robustness even in scenarios where LiDAR or camera data are
partially or entirely missing.

AI.title_translation: CrossRay3D：用于高效多模态 3D 检测的几何和分布指导
AI.tldr: 提出 CrossRay3D，一种高效的稀疏多模态 3D 检测器。通过几何结构指导（RAS）和类别分布平衡改进 token 表示质量，在 nuScenes 上实现了 SOTA 性能（72.4 mAP, 74.7 NDS），速度提升 1.84 倍，并展示了强大的传感器缺失鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的稀疏跨模态检测器忽略了 token 表示的质量，导致前景质量欠佳和性能受限。作者认为保留几何结构和类别分布是提高稀疏检测器性能的关键。
AI.method: 提出一个稀疏选择器（Sparse Selector, SS）来提高 token 表示质量。SS 的核心组件包括：1. Ray-Aware Supervision (RAS)，用于在训练阶段保留丰富的几何信息。2. Class-Balanced Supervision，用于自适应地重新加权类别语义的显著性，确保保留与小物体相关的 token。此外，设计了 Ray Positional Encoding (Ray PE) 来解决 LiDAR 模态和图像之间的分布差异。所有模块集成到端到端稀疏多模态检测器 CrossRay3D 中。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 基准测试中，CrossRay3D 实现了 72.4 mAP 和 74.7 NDS 的最先进性能。它比其他领先方法运行速度快 1.84 倍。此外，CrossRay3D 在 LiDAR 或相机数据部分或完全缺失的场景中表现出强大的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CrossRay3D 通过几何和分布指导显著提高了稀疏多模态 3D 检测的性能和效率，并在数据缺失的场景中表现出强大的鲁棒性，达到了最先进的水平。
AI.translation: 稀疏跨模态检测器比其对应的鸟瞰图（BEV）检测器具有更多优势，尤其是在下游任务的适应性和计算成本节省方面。然而，现有的稀疏检测器忽略了 token 表示的质量，使其前景质量欠佳且性能有限。在本文中，我们确定保留几何结构和类别分布是提高稀疏检测器性能的关键，并提出了一个稀疏选择器（Sparse Selector, SS）。SS 的核心模块是 Ray-Aware Supervision (RAS)，它在训练阶段保留了丰富的几何信息；以及 Class-Balanced Supervision，它自适应地重新加权类别语义的显著性，确保在 token 采样过程中保留与小物体相关的 token。因此，它在 token 表示方面优于其他稀疏多模态检测器。此外，我们设计了 Ray Positional Encoding (Ray PE) 来解决 LiDAR 模态和图像之间的分布差异。最后，我们将上述模块集成到一个端到端稀疏多模态检测器中，命名为 CrossRay3D。实验表明，在极具挑战性的 nuScenes 基准测试中，CrossRay3D 实现了 72.4 mAP 和 74.7 NDS 的最先进性能，同时比其他领先方法快 1.84 倍。此外，CrossRay3D 即使在 LiDAR 或相机数据部分或完全缺失的场景中也表现出强大的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 CrossRay3D，一种用于高效多模态 3D 检测的稀疏跨模态检测器。该方法旨在解决现有稀疏检测器中 token 表示质量次优的问题，并强调几何结构和类别分布是性能提升的关键。核心贡献包括一个稀疏选择器（SS），其中包含 Ray-Aware Supervision (RAS) 用于保留几何信息，以及 Class-Balanced Supervision 用于平衡类别语义。此外，还引入了 Ray Positional Encoding (Ray PE) 来处理模态间的分布差异。CrossRay3D 在 nuScenes 上实现了最先进的 mAP 和 NDS，同时运行速度更快，并在数据缺失场景中展示了强大的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 稀疏跨模态检测, 3D 检测, 几何指导, 分布平衡, CrossRay3D
AI.comments: 该论文针对稀疏跨模态 3D 检测器中的关键瓶颈——token 表示质量——提出了明确的解决方案。创新点在于引入了几何结构（Ray-Aware Supervision）和类别分布平衡（Class-Balanced Supervision）作为指导，以确保高质量的前景 token 被保留。与 BEV 方法相比，稀疏检测器在计算效率和下游任务适应性上的优势得到了强调。实验结果显示，CrossRay3D 不仅达到了 SOTA 性能，还实现了显著的加速比（1.84 倍），并且在传感器数据缺失的场景中表现出强大的鲁棒性，这对于实际自动驾驶应用至关重要，是该方法的一大亮点。

title: Uniworld-V2: Reinforce Image Editing with Diffusion Negative-aware Finetuning and MLLM Implicit Feedback
summary:
Instruction-based image editing has achieved remarkable progress; however,
models solely trained via supervised fine-tuning often overfit to annotated
patterns, hindering their ability to explore and generalize beyond training
distributions. To this end, we introduce Edit-R1, a novel post-training
framework for instruction-based image editing based on policy optimization.
Specifically, we utilize Diffusion Negative-aware Finetuning (DiffusionNFT), a
likelihood-free policy optimization method consistent with the flow matching
forward process, thereby enabling the use of higher-order samplers and more
efficient training. Another key challenge here is the absence of a universal
reward model, resulting from the diverse nature of editing instructions and
tasks. To bridge this gap, we employ a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)
as a unified, training-free reward model, leveraging its output logits to
provide fine-grained feedback. Furthermore, we carefully design a low-variance
group filtering mechanism to reduce MLLM scoring noise and stabilize
optimization. \texttt{UniWorld-V2}, trained with this framework, achieves
\textbf{state-of-the-art} results on the ImgEdit and GEdit-Bench benchmarks,
scoring 4.49 and 7.83, respectively. Crucially, our framework is
model-agnostic, delivering substantial performance gains when applied to
diverse base models like Qwen-Image-Edit and FLUX-Kontext, demonstrating its
wide applicability. Code and models are publicly available to support further
research.

AI.title_translation: Uniworld-V2：使用扩散负样本感知微调和 MLLM 隐式反馈强化图像编辑
AI.tldr: 针对指令式图像编辑中模型过拟合和奖励模型缺失问题，本文提出了 Edit-R1 策略优化框架。该框架结合了高效的扩散负样本感知微调（DiffusionNFT）和使用 MLLM 输出 logits 作为统一、免训练的隐式奖励模型。训练出的 UniWorld-V2 在 ImgEdit 和 GEdit-Bench 上达到了 SOTA，且该框架具有模型无关性。
AI.motivation: 现有的指令式图像编辑模型仅通过监督微调训练，容易对标注模式过拟合，限制了其探索和泛化到训练分布之外的能力。此外，缺乏一个适用于各种编辑指令和任务的通用奖励模型。
AI.method: 提出 Edit-R1 策略优化后训练框架。核心方法包括：1. **扩散负样本感知微调 (DiffusionNFT)**，一种与流匹配前向过程一致的无似然策略优化方法，实现高效训练和使用高阶采样器。2. 使用**多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM)** 作为统一、免训练的奖励模型，利用其输出 logits 提供细粒度的隐式反馈。3. 设计**低方差组过滤机制**来减少 MLLM 评分噪声并稳定优化。
AI.result: 训练出的 UniWorld-V2 在 ImgEdit 和 GEdit-Bench 基准测试上取得了最先进（SOTA）的结果，得分分别为 4.49 和 7.83。该框架具有模型无关性，应用于 Qwen-Image-Edit 和 FLUX-Kontext 等多种基础模型时，性能均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 成功开发了 Edit-R1 策略优化框架，解决了监督微调模型的过拟拟合和奖励模型缺失的问题。训练出的 UniWorld-V2 在图像编辑基准上实现了最先进的性能，并证明了该框架对于不同基础模型的广泛适用性和有效性。
AI.translation: 基于指令的图像编辑已取得了显著进展；然而，仅通过监督微调训练的模型经常对标注模式过拟合，阻碍了它们探索和泛化到训练分布之外的能力。为此，我们引入了 Edit-R1，这是一个基于策略优化的新型指令式图像编辑后训练框架。具体来说，我们利用了扩散负样本感知微调（DiffusionNFT），这是一种与流匹配前向过程一致的无似然策略优化方法，从而能够使用更高阶的采样器并实现更高效的训练。另一个关键挑战是缺乏通用的奖励模型，这是由于编辑指令和任务的多样性所致。为了弥合这一差距，我们采用多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）作为一个统一、免训练的奖励模型，利用其输出 logits 来提供细粒度的反馈。此外，我们精心设计了一个低方差组过滤机制来减少 MLLM 评分噪声并稳定优化。使用此框架训练的 UniWorld-V2 在 ImgEdit 和 GEdit-Bench 基准测试上取得了**最先进**的结果，得分分别为 4.49 和 7.83。至关重要的是，我们的框架是模型无关的，应用于 Qwen-Image-Edit 和 FLUX-Kontext 等各种基础模型时，能带来显著的性能提升，证明了其广泛的适用性。代码和模型已公开发布以支持进一步研究。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Edit-R1，一个用于指令式图像编辑的策略优化后训练框架，旨在解决监督微调模型的过拟合和泛化能力不足的问题。该框架结合了 Diffusion Negative-aware Finetuning (DiffusionNFT) 以实现高效的无似然策略优化，并利用 MLLM 作为统一、免训练的奖励模型，通过其输出 logits 提供隐式反馈，同时使用低方差组过滤机制稳定训练。基于此框架训练的 UniWorld-V2 在 ImgEdit 和 GEdit-Bench 上实现了 SOTA 性能，并证明了该框架对多种基础模型的广泛适用性。
AI.keywords: 图像编辑, 策略优化, 扩散负样本感知微调, MLLM 隐式反馈, 模型无关性
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将强化学习（策略优化）引入到图像编辑的后训练阶段，有效地解决了传统监督微调的过拟合问题。关键的技术突破是提出了 DiffusionNFT，实现了高效的无似然优化，并巧妙地利用 MLLM 的内在理解能力作为“隐式反馈”奖励模型，绕过了构建昂贵且通用的显式奖励模型的难题。该框架的模型无关性证明了其作为通用优化范式的潜力，对于提升现有扩散模型在复杂指令遵循任务上的性能具有重要价值。

title: DiscoTrack: A Multilingual LLM Benchmark for Discourse Tracking
summary:
Recent LLM benchmarks have tested models on a range of phenomena, but are
still focused primarily on natural language understanding for extraction of
explicit information, such as QA or summarization, with responses often tar-
geting information from individual sentences. We are still lacking more
challenging, and im- portantly also multilingual, benchmarks focus- ing on
implicit information and pragmatic infer- ences across larger documents in the
context of discourse tracking: integrating and aggregating information across
sentences, paragraphs and multiple speaker utterances. To this end, we present
DiscoTrack, an LLM benchmark target- ing a range of tasks across 12 languages
and four levels of discourse understanding: salience recognition, entity
tracking, discourse relations and bridging inference. Our evaluation shows that
these tasks remain challenging, even for state-of-the-art models.

AI.title_translation: DiscoTrack：一个用于篇章追踪的多语言LLM基准测试
AI.tldr: 现有的LLM基准侧重于显式信息提取。本文提出了DiscoTrack，这是一个涵盖12种语言、针对篇章追踪（包括显著性识别、实体追踪、篇章关系和桥接推理）的新的多语言基准测试，实验表明这对现有SOTA模型仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM基准主要关注显式信息提取（如问答或摘要），且通常针对单个句子。目前缺乏更具挑战性、且重要的是多语言的基准，来关注大型文档中涉及篇章追踪的隐式信息和语用推理，即跨句子、段落和多说话者话语整合和聚合信息的能力。
AI.method: 提出了DiscoTrack，这是一个多语言LLM基准测试，专门针对篇章追踪问题。该基准涵盖12种语言，并针对四个层次的篇章理解任务：显著性识别、实体追踪、篇章关系和桥接推理。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，即使对于最先进的模型，这些篇章追踪任务仍然具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 最近的LLM基准测试对模型进行了一系列现象的测试，但主要仍集中于自然语言理解中显式信息的提取，例如问答或摘要，其响应通常针对单个句子中的信息。我们仍然缺乏更具挑战性、且重要的是多语言的基准测试，来关注篇章追踪背景下大型文档中的隐式信息和语用推理：即跨句子、段落和多说话者话语整合和聚合信息的能力。为此，我们提出了DiscoTrack，这是一个LLM基准测试，针对12种语言和四个层次的篇章理解任务：显著性识别、实体追踪、篇章关系和桥接推理。我们的评估表明，即使对于最先进的模型，这些任务仍然具有挑战性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DiscoTrack，这是一个多语言LLM基准测试，旨在解决现有基准仅关注单个句子中显式信息提取的局限。DiscoTrack专注于篇章追踪，要求模型跨越句子、段落和多说话者话语整合隐式信息和语用推理。该基准涵盖12种语言，包含显著性识别、实体追踪、篇章关系和桥接推理四个核心任务。评估结果表明，DiscoTrack对当前最先进的模型构成了重大挑战。
AI.keywords: LLM基准测试, 篇章追踪, 多语言, 语用推理, 隐式信息
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于填补了现有LLM基准在复杂篇章理解和多语言支持方面的空白。通过引入篇章追踪（整合跨句子、段落的隐式信息）作为核心评估点，该工作推动了LLM从简单的信息提取迈向更深层次的语用推理。DiscoTrack涵盖了12种语言和四个细分的篇章理解任务，使其成为衡量LLM跨语言、复杂推理能力的重要工具。结果表明，即使是SOTA模型也难以应对这些挑战，突显了该领域未来研究的必要性。

title: DiffVLA++: Bridging Cognitive Reasoning and End-to-End Driving through Metric-Guided Alignment
summary:
Conventional end-to-end (E2E) driving models are effective at generating
physically plausible trajectories, but often fail to generalize to long-tail
scenarios due to the lack of essential world knowledge to understand and reason
about surrounding environments. In contrast, Vision-Language-Action (VLA)
models leverage world knowledge to handle challenging cases, but their limited
3D reasoning capability can lead to physically infeasible actions. In this work
we introduce DiffVLA++, an enhanced autonomous driving framework that
explicitly bridges cognitive reasoning and E2E planning through metric-guided
alignment. First, we build a VLA module directly generating semantically
grounded driving trajectories. Second, we design an E2E module with a dense
trajectory vocabulary that ensures physical feasibility. Third, and most
critically, we introduce a metric-guided trajectory scorer that guides and
aligns the outputs of the VLA and E2E modules, thereby integrating their
complementary strengths. The experiment on the ICCV 2025 Autonomous Grand
Challenge leaderboard shows that DiffVLA++ achieves EPDMS of 49.12.

AI.title_translation: DiffVLA++：通过度量引导对齐连接认知推理与端到端驾驶
AI.tldr: DiffVLA++是一个新的自动驾驶框架，它通过引入一个度量引导的轨迹评分器，将擅长认知推理的VLA模型与擅长物理可行性的E2E模型结合起来，以解决复杂场景下的泛化和物理可行性问题，并在ICCV 2025挑战赛中取得了优异成绩。
AI.motivation: 解决传统端到端（E2E）驾驶模型在长尾场景中泛化能力差（缺乏世界知识），以及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽然利用了世界知识但由于3D推理能力有限而导致物理上不可行动作的问题。
AI.method: 引入DiffVLA++框架，通过度量引导对齐明确连接认知推理和端到端规划。具体包括：1. 构建直接生成语义轨迹的VLA模块。2. 设计具有密集轨迹词汇表的E2E模块以确保物理可行性。3. 引入度量引导的轨迹评分器来指导和对齐VLA和E2E模块的输出。
AI.result: 在ICCV 2025自动驾驶大挑战排行榜上，DiffVLA++取得了49.12的EPDMS分数。
AI.conclusion: 通过度量引导对齐，DiffVLA++成功整合了VLA（认知推理）和E2E（物理可行性）模块的互补优势。
AI.translation: 传统的端到端（E2E）驾驶模型在生成物理上合理的轨迹方面是有效的，但由于缺乏理解和推理周围环境所必需的世界知识，它们通常无法泛化到长尾场景。相比之下，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型利用世界知识来处理具有挑战性的案例，但其有限的3D推理能力可能导致物理上不可行的动作。在这项工作中，我们介绍了DiffVLA++，这是一个增强的自动驾驶框架，它通过度量引导对齐明确地连接了认知推理和E2E规划。首先，我们构建了一个直接生成语义基础驾驶轨迹的VLA模块。其次，我们设计了一个具有密集轨迹词汇表的E2E模块，以确保物理可行性。第三，也是最关键的，我们引入了一个度量引导的轨迹评分器，它指导和对齐VLA和E2E模块的输出，从而整合它们的互补优势。在ICCV 2025自动驾驶大挑战排行榜上的实验表明，DiffVLA++取得了49.12的EPDMS分数。
AI.summary: DiffVLA++是一种增强的自动驾驶框架，旨在弥合认知推理（VLA模型提供）和物理可行性规划（E2E模型提供）之间的差距。该框架通过一个度量引导的轨迹评分器实现关键对齐，该评分器整合了VLA生成的语义轨迹和E2E模块生成的物理可行轨迹，从而提高了模型在长尾场景中的泛化能力和动作的物理准确性。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA), 端到端驾驶 (E2E), 认知推理, 度量引导对齐
AI.comments: 本文解决了自动驾驶领域中VLA模型（擅长高层推理但缺乏物理准确性）和E2E模型（擅长物理准确性但缺乏泛化能力）的根本性矛盾。DiffVLA++的核心创新在于引入了“度量引导的轨迹评分器”，这是一种新颖的对齐机制，能够系统地结合两个模块的优势。实验结果（在ICCV 2025挑战赛上的高分）证明了这种混合架构在处理复杂驾驶场景中的有效性和重要性。

title: Introducing Linear Implication Types to $λ_{GT}$ for Computing With Incomplete Graphs
comments: 36 pages, 14 figures, This paper is submitted to PRO2025-3
summary:
Designing programming languages that enable intuitive and safe manipulation
of data structures is a critical research challenge. Conventional destructive
memory operations using pointers are complex and prone to errors. Existing type
systems, such as affine types and shape types, address this problem towards
safe manipulation of heaps and pointers, but design of high-level declarative
languages that allow us to manipulate complex pointer data structures at a
higher level of abstraction is largely an open problem. The $\lambda_{GT}$
language, a purely functional programming language that treats hypergraphs
(hereafter referred to as graphs) as primary data structures, addresses some of
these challenges. By abstracting data with shared references and cycles as
graphs, it enables declarative operations through pattern matching and
leverages its type system to guarantee safety of these operations.
Nevertheless, the previously proposed type system of $\lambda_{GT}$ leaves two
significant open challenges. First, the type system does not support
\emph{incomplete graphs}, that is, graphs in which some elements are missing
from the graphs of user-defined types. Second, the type system relies on
dynamic type checking during pattern matching. This study addresses these two
challenges by incorporating linear implication into the $\lambda_{GT}$ type
system, while introducing new constraints to ensure its soundness.

AI.title_translation: 为$\lambda_{GT}$引入线性蕴含类型以处理不完整图的计算
AI.tldr: $\lambda_{GT}$（一种基于图的函数式语言）的原有类型系统无法处理不完整图且依赖动态检查。本文通过引入线性蕴含类型来解决这两个关键问题。

AI.method: 通过将线性蕴含（linear implication）整合到$\lambda_{GT}$类型系统中，并引入新的约束以确保其可靠性（soundness），来解决对不完整图的支持和动态类型检查的挑战。

AI.translation: 设计能够直观且安全地操作数据结构的编程语言是一项关键的研究挑战。使用指针的传统破坏性内存操作既复杂又容易出错。现有的类型系统，例如仿射类型（affine types）和形状类型（shape types），致力于安全地操作堆和指针，但设计允许我们在更高抽象层次上操作复杂指针数据结构的高级声明式语言仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。$\lambda_{GT}$语言是一种纯函数式编程语言，它将超图（在本文中简称为图）视为主要数据结构，解决了其中一些挑战。通过将具有共享引用和循环的数据抽象为图，它能够通过模式匹配实现声明式操作，并利用其类型系统来保证这些操作的安全性。然而，先前提出的$\lambda_{GT}$类型系统留下了两个重大的开放挑战。首先，该类型系统不支持“不完整图”，即图中的某些元素从用户定义的类型图中缺失。其次，该类型系统在模式匹配过程中依赖动态类型检查。本研究通过将线性蕴含（linear implication）纳入$\lambda_{GT}$类型系统，同时引入新的约束以确保其可靠性，来解决这两个挑战。
AI.summary: $\lambda_{GT}$是一种将图作为主要数据结构的纯函数式语言，旨在实现复杂指针数据结构的安全和声明式操作。然而，其原有类型系统无法处理不完整图（缺少元素的图），并且在模式匹配时需要动态类型检查。本文通过向$\lambda_{GT}$类型系统引入线性蕴含类型，并增加新的约束以保证其可靠性，从而解决了对不完整图的支持和消除动态检查的两个核心挑战。
AI.keywords: 线性蕴含类型, $\lambda_{GT}$, 不完整图, 类型系统, 函数式编程
AI.comments: 论文解决了函数式编程语言$\lambda_{GT}$在处理复杂数据结构时的核心限制。通过引入线性蕴含类型，作者旨在将类型检查从动态推向静态，并扩展语言对“不完整”数据结构（即部分缺失的数据）的处理能力。这对于提高$\lambda_{GT}$的安全性和可用性至关重要，是类型系统设计领域中，特别是在处理图和复杂引用结构方面的重要进展。

title: QiMeng-SALV: Signal-Aware Learning for Verilog Code Generation
summary:
The remarkable progress of Large Language Models (LLMs) presents promising
opportunities for Verilog code generation which is significantly important for
automated circuit design. The lacking of meaningful functional rewards hinders
the preference optimization based on Reinforcement Learning (RL) for producing
functionally correct Verilog code. In this paper, we propose Signal-Aware
Learning for Verilog code generation (QiMeng-SALV) by leveraging code segments
of functionally correct output signal to optimize RL training. Considering
Verilog code specifies the structural interconnection of hardware gates and
wires so that different output signals are independent, the key insight of
QiMeng-SALV is to extract verified signal-aware implementations in partially
incorrect modules, so as to enhance the extraction of meaningful functional
rewards. Roughly, we verify the functional correctness of signals in generated
module by comparing with that of reference module in the training data. Then
abstract syntax tree (AST) is employed to identify signal-aware code segments
which can provide meaningful functional rewards from erroneous modules.
Finally, we introduce signal-aware DPO which is optimized on the correct
signal-level code segments, thereby preventing noise and interference from
incorrect signals. The proposed QiMeng-SALV underscores the paradigm shift from
conventional module-level to fine-grained signal-level optimization in Verilog
code generation, addressing the issue of insufficient functional rewards.
Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance
on VerilogEval and RTLLM, with a 7B parameter model matching the performance of
the DeepSeek v3 671B model and significantly outperforming the leading
open-source model CodeV trained on the same dataset. Our code is available at
https://github.com/zy1xxx/SALV.

AI.title_translation: 启梦-SALV：面向 Verilog 代码生成的信号感知学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 QiMeng-SALV，一种用于 Verilog 代码生成的信号感知学习方法。它通过提取部分正确代码中的信号级功能奖励，将优化从模块级转为细粒度信号级优化。该方法在 VerilogEval 和 RTLLM 上实现了 SOTA 性能，其中 7B 模型性能与 671B 模型相当。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在 Verilog 代码生成方面有巨大潜力，但缺乏有意义的功能性奖励阻碍了基于强化学习（RL）的偏好优化，使其难以生成功能正确的 Verilog 代码。
AI.method: 提出“启梦-SALV”（QiMeng-SALV），即面向 Verilog 代码生成的信号感知学习。核心思想是从部分不正确的模块中提取经过验证的信号感知实现，以增强有意义的功能性奖励的提取。具体步骤包括：1) 通过与训练数据中的参考模块进行比较，验证生成模块中信号的功能正确性；2) 利用抽象语法树（AST）识别错误模块中能提供有意义功能性奖励的信号感知代码段；3) 引入信号感知 DPO（Direct Preference Optimization），它基于正确的信号级代码段进行优化，从而避免错误信号带来的噪声和干扰。
AI.result: 在 VerilogEval 和 RTLLM 上取得了最先进的性能。一个 7B 参数的模型达到了 DeepSeek v3 671B 模型的性能，并且显著优于在相同数据集上训练的领先开源模型 CodeV。
AI.conclusion: 提出的 QiMeng-SALV 强调了 Verilog 代码生成中从传统的模块级优化到细粒度信号级优化的范式转变，解决了功能性奖励不足的问题。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）的显著进展为 Verilog 代码生成带来了有希望的机会，这对自动化电路设计至关重要。缺乏有意义的功能性奖励阻碍了基于强化学习（RL）的偏好优化，使其难以生成功能正确的 Verilog 代码。在本文中，我们提出了面向 Verilog 代码生成的信号感知学习（QiMeng-SALV），通过利用功能正确输出信号的代码段来优化 RL 训练。考虑到 Verilog 代码指定了硬件门和导线的结构互连，使得不同的输出信号是独立的，QiMeng-SALV 的关键洞察在于在部分不正确的模块中提取经过验证的信号感知实现，从而增强有意义功能性奖励的提取。大致而言，我们通过与训练数据中的参考模块进行比较，验证生成模块中信号的功能正确性。然后，利用抽象语法树（AST）从错误模块中识别能够提供有意义功能性奖励的信号感知代码段。最后，我们引入了信号感知 DPO（Direct Preference Optimization），它基于正确的信号级代码段进行优化，从而防止错误信号带来的噪声和干扰。所提出的 QiMeng-SALV 强调了 Verilog 代码生成中从传统的模块级优化到细粒度信号级优化的范式转变，解决了功能性奖励不足的问题。实验证明，我们的方法在 VerilogEval 和 RTLLM 上取得了最先进的性能，其中一个 7B 参数的模型达到了 DeepSeek v3 671B 模型的性能，并且显著优于在相同数据集上训练的领先开源模型 CodeV。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/zy1xxx/SALV 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 QiMeng-SALV（面向 Verilog 代码生成的信号感知学习），旨在利用大语言模型改进 Verilog 代码生成。它通过将优化从模块级转向细粒度的信号级，解决了基于强化学习的偏好优化中功能性奖励不足的限制。QiMeng-SALV 验证信号的正确性，利用 AST 从错误模块中提取正确的信号感知代码段，并应用信号感知 DPO 进行优化。该方法在 VerilogEval 和 RTLLM 等基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，展示了卓越的效率，其中一个 7B 模型达到了 671B 模型的性能。
AI.keywords: Verilog 代码生成, 信号感知学习, 强化学习（RL）, DPO, 抽象语法树（AST）
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将优化范式从传统的模块级（粗粒度奖励信号）转移到了细粒度的信号级优化。这对于 Verilog 这种硬件描述语言来说非常重要，因为不同的信号和导线是相对独立工作的。利用抽象语法树（AST）来定位正确性，并将 DPO 应用于这些细粒度代码段，是一种巧妙的方法，可以从部分正确的生成结果中提取最大的效用，解决了功能正确性任务中常见的稀疏奖励问题。实验结果显示，7B 模型能匹配 671B 模型的性能，这突显了该方法的显著效率提升和实际重要性。

title: A Tutorial on Cognitive Biases in Agentic AI-Driven 6G Autonomous Networks
comments: 19 pages, 15 figures, 1 table, link to source code available
summary:
The path to higher network autonomy in 6G lies beyond the mere optimization
of key performance indicators (KPIs). While KPIs have enabled automation gains
under TM Forum Levels 1--3, they remain numerical abstractions that act only as
proxies for the real essence of communication networks: seamless connectivity,
fairness, adaptability, and resilience. True autonomy requires perceiving and
reasoning over the network environment as it is. Such progress can be achieved
through \emph{agentic AI}, where large language model (LLM)-powered agents
perceive multimodal telemetry, reason with memory, negotiate across domains,
and act via APIs to achieve multi-objective goals. However, deploying such
agents introduces the challenge of cognitive biases inherited from human
design, which can distort reasoning, negotiation, tool use, and actuation.
Between neuroscience and AI, this paper provides a tutorial on a selection of
well-known biases, including their taxonomy, definition, mathematical
formulation, emergence in telecom systems and the commonly impacted agentic
components. The tutorial also presents various mitigation strategies tailored
to each type of bias. The article finally provides two practical use-cases,
which tackle the emergence, impact and mitigation gain of some famous biases in
6G inter-slice and cross-domain management. In particular, anchor
randomization, temporal decay and inflection bonus techniques are introduced to
specifically address anchoring, temporal and confirmation biases. This avoids
that agents stick to the initial high resource allocation proposal or decisions
that are recent and/or confirming a prior hypothesis. By grounding decisions in
a richer and fairer set of past experiences, the quality and bravery of the
agentic agreements in the second use-case, for instance, are leading to $\times
5$ lower latency and around $40\%$ higher energy saving.
