title: A Unified Representation Underlying the Judgment of Large Language Models
summary:
A central architectural question for both biological and artificial
intelligence is whether judgment relies on specialized modules or a unified,
domain-general resource. While the discovery of decodable neural
representations for distinct concepts in Large Language Models (LLMs) has
suggested a modular architecture, whether these representations are truly
independent systems remains an open question. Here we provide evidence for a
convergent architecture for evaluative judgment. Across a range of LLMs, we
find that diverse evaluative judgments are computed along a dominant dimension,
which we term the Valence-Assent Axis (VAA). This axis jointly encodes
subjective valence ("what is good") and the model's assent to factual claims
("what is true"). Through direct interventions, we demonstrate this axis drives
a critical mechanism, which is identified as the subordination of reasoning:
the VAA functions as a control signal that steers the generative process to
construct a rationale consistent with its evaluative state, even at the cost of
factual accuracy. Our discovery offers a mechanistic account for response bias
and hallucination, revealing how an architecture that promotes coherent
judgment can systematically undermine faithful reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型判断背后的统一表征
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的各种判断（好坏和真假）不是独立的，而是沿着一个单一的“效价-同意轴”（VAA）计算的。这个轴会优先保证判断的一致性，使得模型在推理时可能会为了保持一致性而牺牲事实准确性，解释了LLMs产生偏差和幻觉的原因。
AI.motivation: 核心架构问题是判断依赖于专业模块还是统一的、领域通用的资源。尽管已发现可解码的神经表征暗示模块化，但这些表征是否是独立的系统仍是悬而未决的问题。
AI.method: 通过跨一系列大型语言模型（LLMs）的分析，发现多种评估性判断沿着一个主导维度计算，并进行直接干预以证明该轴驱动了推理的从属机制。
AI.result: 在各种LLMs中，发现多样化的评估性判断沿着一个主导维度计算，即“效价-同意轴”（VAA），该轴共同编码主观效价（“什么是好的”）和模型对事实声明的同意（“什么是真的”）。该轴被证明驱动了推理的从属机制。
AI.conclusion: 该发现为响应偏差和幻觉提供了一个机制性解释，揭示了促进连贯判断的架构如何系统地损害忠实的推理。
AI.translation: 关于生物和人工智能的一个核心架构问题是，判断是依赖于专门的模块还是统一的、领域通用的资源。虽然在大型语言模型（LLMs）中发现可解码的不同概念的神经表征已经暗示了一种模块化架构，但这些表征是否是真正独立的系统仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们为评估性判断的收敛架构提供了证据。在跨一系列LLMs中，我们发现各种评估性判断沿着一个主导维度计算，我们称之为效价-同意轴（VAA）。该轴共同编码主观效价（“什么是好的”）和模型对事实声明的同意（“什么是真的”）。通过直接干预，我们证明该轴驱动了一个关键机制，该机制被确定为推理的从属：VAA充当一个控制信号，引导生成过程构建与其评估状态一致的论证，即使是以牺牲事实准确性为代价。我们的发现为响应偏差和幻觉提供了一个机制性解释，揭示了促进连贯判断的架构如何系统地削弱忠实的推理。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在探究大型语言模型（LLMs）的判断是模块化的还是统一的。研究发现，LLMs中的多种评估性判断沿着一个主导维度——“效价-同意轴”（VAA）进行计算，该轴同时编码主观效价和事实同意度。通过干预实验证实，VAA充当控制信号，驱动生成过程构建与其评估状态一致的论证，即使这会牺牲事实准确性，从而为LLMs中的偏差和幻觉提供了统一的机制性解释。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 统一表征, 评估性判断, 效价-同意轴, 推理从属
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于发现了一个统一的、主导性的维度（VAA）来解释大型语言模型中多种评估性判断的计算过程，并将其与推理的从属关系联系起来。其重要性在于为LLMs中的响应偏差和幻觉提供了一个机制性解释。局限性是仅基于LLMs的分析，尚未完全扩展到生物智能。

title: ThinkMorph: Emergent Properties in Multimodal Interleaved Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary:
Multimodal reasoning requires iterative coordination between language and
vision, yet it remains unclear what constitutes a meaningful interleaved chain
of thought. We posit that text and image thoughts should function as
complementary rather than isomorphic modalities that mutually advance
reasoning. Guided by this principle, we build ThinkMorph, a unified model
fine-tuned on approximately 24K high-quality interleaved reasoning traces
spanning tasks with varying visual engagement. ThinkMorph learns to generate
progressive text-image reasoning steps that concretely manipulate visual
content while maintaining coherent verbal logic. It delivers large gains on
vision-centric benchmarks (averaging 34.7 percent over the base model) and
generalizes to out-of-domain tasks, matching or surpassing larger and
proprietary VLMs. Beyond performance, ThinkMorph exhibits emergent multimodal
intelligence, including unseen visual manipulation skills, adaptive switching
between reasoning modes, and better test-time scaling through diversified
multimodal thoughts. These findings suggest promising directions for
characterizing the emergent capabilities of unified models for multimodal
reasoning.

title: Dual-Stream Diffusion for World-Model Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model
summary:
Recently, augmenting vision-language-action models (VLAs) with world-models
has shown promise in robotic policy learning. However, it remains challenging
to jointly predict next-state observations and action sequences because of the
inherent difference between the two modalities. To address this, we propose
DUal-STream diffusion (DUST), a world-model augmented VLA framework that
handles the modality conflict and enhances the performance of VLAs across
diverse tasks. Specifically, we propose a multimodal diffusion transformer
architecture that explicitly maintains separate modality streams while enabling
cross-modal knowledge sharing. In addition, we propose training techniques such
as independent noise perturbations for each modality and a decoupled flow
matching loss, which enables the model to learn the joint distribution in a
bidirectional manner while avoiding the need for a unified latent space.
Furthermore, based on the decoupled training framework, we introduce a sampling
method where we sample action and vision tokens asynchronously at different
rates, which shows improvement through inference-time scaling. Through
experiments on simulated benchmarks such as RoboCasa and GR-1, DUST achieves up
to 6% gains over a standard VLA baseline and implicit world-modeling methods,
with our inference-time scaling approach providing an additional 2-5% gain on
success rate. On real-world tasks with the Franka Research 3, DUST outperforms
baselines in success rate by 13%, confirming its effectiveness beyond
simulation. Lastly, we demonstrate the effectiveness of DUST in large-scale
pretraining with action-free videos from BridgeV2, where DUST leads to
significant gain when transferred to the RoboCasa benchmark.

AI.title_translation: 世界模型增强的视觉-语言-动作模型的双流扩散
AI.tldr: DUST是一个双流扩散模型，用于增强视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的世界模型能力。它通过分离观测和动作的预测流并使用特殊的解耦训练和异步推理采样，解决了不同模态预测的冲突，并在机器人任务中实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 在机器人策略学习中，用世界模型增强视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）很有前景，但同时预测下一状态观测和动作序列具有挑战性，因为这两种模态存在固有的差异。
AI.method: 提出DUal-STream diffusion (DUST) 框架，采用多模态扩散Transformer架构，显式维护独立的模态流并实现跨模态知识共享。训练技术包括每种模态的独立噪声扰动和解耦的流匹配损失。推理时采用异步采样动作和视觉token的方法。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa和GR-1等模拟基准测试中，DUST比标准VLA基线和隐式世界建模方法高出6%的增益，推理时异步缩放方法额外带来2-5%的成功率提升。在Franka Research 3的真实世界任务中，成功率比基线高出13%。在BridgeV2视频上预训练后迁移到RoboCasa上也显示出显著增益。
AI.conclusion: DUST框架通过解耦的训练和异步采样方法，成功解决了世界模型增强的VLA中模态冲突问题，并在多个模拟和真实世界基准测试中显著优于现有方法，同时证明了其在大规模预训练中的潜力。
AI.translation: 最近，用世界模型增强视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在机器人策略学习中显示出潜力。然而，由于这两种模态的固有差异，联合预测下一状态观测和动作序列仍然具有挑战性。为解决此问题，我们提出了双流扩散（DUST），一个世界模型增强的VLA框架，它处理模态冲突并提高VLA在各种任务中的性能。具体来说，我们提出了一种多模态扩散Transformer架构，它显式地维护独立的模态流，同时支持跨模态知识共享。此外，我们提出了诸如每种模态的独立噪声扰动和解耦的流匹配损失等训练技术，使模型能够在避免统一潜在空间需求的同时，以双向方式学习联合分布。此外，基于解耦的训练框架，我们引入了一种在不同速率下异步采样动作和视觉token的方法，该方法通过推理时缩放显示出性能提升。通过在RoboCasa和GR-1等模拟基准测试上的实验，DUST在成功率上比标准VLA基线和隐式世界建模方法高出6%，我们推理时缩放方法额外带来2-5%的成功率提升。在Franka Research 3上的真实世界任务中，DUST在成功率上比基线高出13%，证实了其在模拟之外的有效性。最后，我们展示了DUST在大规模预训练中的有效性，使用来自BridgeV2的无动作视频，其中DUST在迁移到RoboCasa基准测试时带来了显著的增益。
AI.summary: DUST是一个双流扩散的世界模型增强VLA框架，旨在解决观测和动作模态预测之间的冲突。它通过一个多模态扩散Transformer实现独立的模态流和跨模态共享，并采用解耦的训练技术（如独立噪声和解耦流匹配损失）来学习联合分布。此外，引入了异步采样策略以优化推理性能。实验证明DUST在模拟和真实世界任务中均取得了优于现有方法的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 视觉-语言-动作模型, 双流扩散, 模态冲突, 解耦训练
AI.comments: DUST的核心创新在于提出了双流扩散架构来解决世界模型增强的VLA中观测和动作模态预测的冲突问题，通过解耦的训练和异步采样策略提高了性能。该方法避免了对统一潜在空间的需求，并在模拟和真实世界任务中展示了显著的性能提升。

title: Best Practices for Biorisk Evaluations on Open-Weight Bio-Foundation Models
summary:
Open-weight bio-foundation models present a dual-use dilemma. While holding
great promise for accelerating scientific research and drug development, they
could also enable bad actors to develop more deadly bioweapons. To mitigate the
risk posed by these models, current approaches focus on filtering biohazardous
data during pre-training. However, the effectiveness of such an approach
remains unclear, particularly against determined actors who might fine-tune
these models for malicious use. To address this gap, we propose BioRiskEval, a
framework to evaluate the robustness of procedures that are intended to reduce
the dual-use capabilities of bio-foundation models. BioRiskEval assesses
models' virus understanding through three lenses, including sequence modeling,
mutational effects prediction, and virulence prediction. Our results show that
current filtering practices may not be particularly effective: Excluded
knowledge can be rapidly recovered in some cases via fine-tuning, and exhibits
broader generalizability in sequence modeling. Furthermore, dual-use signals
may already reside in the pretrained representations, and can be elicited via
simple linear probing. These findings highlight the challenges of data
filtering as a standalone procedure, underscoring the need for further research
into robust safety and security strategies for open-weight bio-foundation
models.

AI.title_translation: 开放权重生物基础模型生物风险评估的最佳实践
AI.tldr: 开放权重生物模型很危险，但过滤数据效果不好，因为恶意行为者可以通过微调绕过过滤，或者利用预训练模型中已有的危险知识。需要更强大的安全策略。
AI.motivation: 开放权重生物基础模型具有加速科学研究和药物开发的潜力，但也可能被恶意行为者用于开发更致命的生物武器。现有的风险缓解方法（数据预训练过滤）的有效性尚不清楚，特别是面对决心进行恶意微调的行为者时。
AI.method: 提出BioRiskEval框架，通过序列建模、突变效应预测和毒力预测三个方面来评估模型对病毒的理解能力，以评估旨在减少双重用途能力的程序的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 结果表明，当前的过滤实践可能效率不高：在某些情况下，被排除的知识可以通过微调迅速恢复，并且在序列建模中表现出更广泛的泛化性。此外，双重用途信号可能已经存在于预训练的表示中，可以通过简单的线性探测来引出。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现凸显了数据过滤作为独立程序的挑战，并强调了对开放权重生物基础模型的稳健安全和保障策略进行进一步研究的必要性。
AI.translation: 开放权重生物基础模型带来了双重用途的困境。虽然它们在加速科学研究和药物开发方面显示出巨大潜力，但也可能使恶意行为者能够开发出更致命的生物武器。为减轻这些模型带来的风险，当前的方法侧重于在预训练期间过滤生物危害数据。然而，这种方法的有效性仍然不清楚，特别是对于可能对这些模型进行微调以供恶意使用的坚定行为者。为解决这一差距，我们提出了BioRiskEval，一个用于评估旨在减少生物基础模型双重用途能力的程序的鲁棒性的框架。BioRiskEval通过三个方面评估模型对病毒的理解：序列建模、突变效应预测和毒力预测。我们的结果表明，当前的过滤实践可能效率不高：在某些情况下，被排除的知识可以通过微调迅速恢复，并且在序列建模中表现出更广泛的泛化性。此外，双重用途信号可能已经存在于预训练的表示中，可以通过简单的线性探测来引出。这些发现凸显了数据过滤作为独立程序的挑战，并强调了对开放权重生物基础模型进行稳健安全和保障策略进一步研究的必要性。
AI.summary: 本文针对开放权重生物基础模型带来的双重使用困境，提出了BioRiskEval框架来评估旨在减轻这些模型恶意能力的现有安全程序（如数据过滤）的鲁棒性。评估结果显示，数据过滤作为独立措施效果不佳，因为被过滤的知识可以通过微调快速恢复，且预训练的表示中可能已包含可被探测到的双重用途信号。
AI.keywords: 生物风险评估, 开放权重模型, 双重用途, 数据过滤, 微调
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一个名为BioRiskEval的框架，专门用于评估旨在降低生物基础模型双重用途能力的程序的鲁棒性。其重要性在于揭示了当前数据过滤方法的局限性，特别是它们容易被微调绕过，并强调了数据过滤作为独立安全策略的不足。限制在于评估主要集中在病毒理解的三个方面，可能没有涵盖所有潜在的恶意使用场景。

title: From Uniform to Adaptive: General Skip-Block Mechanisms for Efficient PDE Neural Operators
summary:
In recent years, Neural Operators(NO) have gradually emerged as a popular
approach for solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs). However, their
application to large-scale engineering tasks suffers from significant
computational overhead. And the fact that current models impose a uniform
computational cost while physical fields exhibit vastly different complexities
constitutes a fundamental mismatch, which is the root of this inefficiency. For
instance, in turbulence flows, intricate vortex regions require deeper network
processing compared to stable flows. To address this, we introduce a framework:
Skip-Block Routing (SBR), a general framework designed for Transformer-based
neural operators, capable of being integrated into their multi-layer
architectures. First, SBR uses a routing mechanism to learn the complexity and
ranking of tokens, which is then applied during inference. Then, in later
layers, it decides how many tokens are passed forward based on this ranking.
This way, the model focuses more processing capacity on the tokens that are
more complex. Experiments demonstrate that SBR is a general framework that
seamlessly integrates into various neural operators. Our method reduces
computational cost by approximately 50% in terms of Floating Point Operations
(FLOPs), while still delivering up to 2x faster inference without sacrificing
accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 从均匀到自适应：高效求解PDE神经算子的通用跳跃块机制
AI.tldr: 针对神经算子效率低下的问题，提出了一种名为Skip-Block Routing (SBR) 的通用自适应计算框架，它根据Token的复杂度动态分配计算资源，成功地将计算成本降低了约50%，并将推理速度提高了一倍，而没有损失准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子（NO）应用于大规模工程任务时存在显著的计算开销。根本原因在于当前模型施加了统一的计算成本，而物理场（如湍流中的涡流区）的复杂性差异很大，这造成了效率低下。
AI.method: 提出Skip-Block Routing (SBR) 框架，该框架集成到基于Transformer的神经算子的多层架构中。SBR首先使用路由机制学习Token的复杂度和排序，然后在后续层中根据此排序决定传递到下一层的Token数量，从而将更多的处理能力集中在更复杂的Token上。
AI.result: SBR将计算成本（浮点运算次数）降低了约50%，同时推理速度提高了2倍，且未牺牲精度。实验证明SBR是一个可以无缝集成到各种神经算子的通用框架。
AI.conclusion: Skip-Block Routing (SBR) 是一个通用的框架，可以无缝集成到各种神经算子中，通过关注更复杂的Token，将计算成本降低了约50%（浮点运算次数），同时推理速度提高了2倍，且不损失精度。
AI.translation: 近年来，神经算子（NO）已逐渐成为求解偏微分方程（PDE）的热门方法。然而，它们在应用于大规模工程任务时存在显著的计算开销。当前模型施加统一的计算成本，而物理场表现出巨大差异的复杂性，这构成了根本性的不匹配，是这种低效率的根源。例如，在湍流流动中，复杂的涡流区域需要比稳定流动更深的网络处理。为解决此问题，我们引入了一个框架：跳跃块路由（Skip-Block Routing, SBR），一个专为基于Transformer的神经算子设计的通用框架，能够集成到其多层架构中。首先，SBR使用路由机制学习Token的复杂度和排名，然后在推理过程中应用此机制。接着，在后续层中，它根据此排名决定向前传递多少Token。通过这种方式，模型将更多的处理能力集中在更复杂的Token上。实验证明，SBR是一个可以无缝集成到各种神经算子的通用框架。我们的方法在浮点运算次数（FLOPs）方面将计算成本降低了约50%，同时推理速度提高了2倍，且不牺牲精度。
AI.summary: 为了解决现有神经算子（NO）因采用统一计算成本而导致的效率低下问题，本文提出了Skip-Block Routing (SBR) 框架。SBR通过学习Token的复杂度并动态地决定在后续层中传递多少Token，将更多的计算资源集中在复杂的区域。该方法可通用集成到Transformer-based NO中，实现了计算成本降低约50%，推理速度提高2倍，同时保持了精度。
AI.keywords: 神经算子, 偏微分方程, Skip-Block Routing, 自适应计算, 效率
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一个通用的自适应计算框架SBR，解决了现有神经算子计算资源分配不均（统一计算成本与物理场复杂性不匹配）的问题。其重要性在于通过动态地关注复杂区域，实现了计算效率的大幅提升。局限性在于，摘要中未提及SBR框架在不同PDE问题上的泛化能力或潜在的超参数敏感性。

title: Exploring Federated Learning for Thermal Urban Feature Segmentation -- A Comparison of Centralized and Decentralized Approaches
comments:
The Version of Record of this contribution is published in
  Computational Science and Its Applications (ICCSA) 2025, and is available
  online at https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-031-97000-9
summary:
Federated Learning (FL) is an approach for training a shared Machine Learning
(ML) model with distributed training data and multiple participants. FL allows
bypassing limitations of the traditional Centralized Machine Learning CL if
data cannot be shared or stored centrally due to privacy or technical
restrictions -- the participants train the model locally with their training
data and do not need to share it among the other participants. This paper
investigates the practical implementation and effectiveness of FL in a
real-world scenario, specifically focusing on unmanned aerial vehicle
(UAV)-based thermal images for common thermal feature detection in urban
environments. The distributed nature of the data arises naturally and makes it
suitable for FL applications, as images captured in two German cities are
available. This application presents unique challenges due to non-identical
distribution and feature characteristics of data captured at both locations.
The study makes several key contributions by evaluating FL algorithms in real
deployment scenarios rather than simulation. We compare several FL approaches
with a centralized learning baseline across key performance metrics such as
model accuracy, training time, communication overhead, and energy usage. This
paper also explores various FL workflows, comparing client-controlled workflows
and server-controlled workflows. The findings of this work serve as a valuable
reference for understanding the practical application and limitations of the FL
methods in segmentation tasks in UAV-based imaging.

title: A Comparative Analysis of LLM Adaptation: SFT, LoRA, and ICL in Data-Scarce Scenarios
summary:
The remarkable capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) often need to be
tailored for specific applications, requiring the integration of new knowledge
or the acquisition of new skills. While full fine-tuning is a powerful
adaptation method, it is computationally expensive and can lead to a
degradation of general reasoning abilities, a phenomenon known as catastrophic
forgetting. A range of alternative techniques exists, each with its own
trade-offs. In-Context Learning (ICL) is fast but limited by context length,
while Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods like Low-Rank Adaptation
(LoRA) offer a middle ground by minimizing parameter changes. However, the
challenge of catastrophic forgetting persists, raising questions about the best
adaptation strategy for a given task. This paper presents a comparative
analysis of Supervised Finetuning (SFT), LoRA, and ICL in data-scarce
scenarios. We find that LoRA provides the most effective balance, successfully
instilling new skills with minimal impact on the base model's general
knowledge. In contrast, while SFT excels at skill acquisition, it is highly
susceptible to catastrophic forgetting. ICL is effective for incorporating
factual knowledge but struggles with complex skills. Our findings offer a
practical framework for selecting an LLM adaptation strategy. We highlight the
critical distinction between skill acquisition and knowledge integration,
clarify the trade-offs between task-specific performance and the preservation
of general capabilities.

title: ARC-GEN: A Mimetic Procedural Benchmark Generator for the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus
summary:
The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus remains one of the most compelling and
challenging benchmarks for tracking progress toward achieving Artificial
General Intelligence. In contrast to other evaluation datasets designed to
assess an agent's task-specific skills or accumulated knowledge, the ARC-AGI
suite is specifically targeted at measuring skill acquisition efficiency, a
trait that has (so far) been lacking in even the most sophisticated machine
learning systems. For algorithms that require extensive intra-task exemplars, a
significant constraint imposed by ARC-AGI is the modest cardinality of its
demonstration set, comprising a small number of $\langle$ input, output
$\rangle$ grids per task specifying the corresponding transformation. To
embellish the space of viable sample pairs, this paper introduces ARC-GEN, an
open-source procedural generator aimed at extending the original ARC-AGI
training dataset as faithfully as possible. Unlike prior efforts, our generator
is both exhaustive (covering all four-hundred tasks) and mimetic (more closely
honoring the distributional properties and characteristics embodied in the
initial ARC-AGI-1 release). We also discuss the use of this generator in
establishing a static benchmark suite to verify the correctness of programs
submitted to the 2025 Google Code Golf Championship.

AI.title_translation: ARC-GEN：用于抽象与推理语料库的拟态程序基准生成器
AI.tldr: ARC-GEN是一个新的开源工具，它通过生成大量模仿原始ARC-AGI数据分布的新样本对，来扩展ARC-AGI的训练集，以克服原始数据集样本量小的限制，更好地测试AGI的技能学习能力。
AI.motivation: ARC-AGI是衡量技能习得效率的基准，但其演示集（每项任务的输入/输出网格对）的基数较小，这限制了需要大量任务内示例的算法。需要增加样本对空间以更好地评估。
AI.method: 引入ARC-GEN，一个开源的程序生成器，旨在尽可能忠实地扩展原始ARC-AGI训练数据集，该生成器是详尽的（覆盖所有四百个任务）且拟态的（更严格地遵循初始ARC-AGI-1版本所体现的分布特性和特征）。
AI.result: 成功引入了ARC-GEN，一个能够详尽且拟态地扩展原始ARC-AGI训练数据集的生成器。
AI.conclusion: 提出了ARC-GEN，一个用于扩展原始ARC-AGI训练数据集的开源程序生成器，并讨论了其在2025年Google代码高尔夫锦标赛中用作静态基准的用途。
AI.translation: 抽象与推理语料库仍然是衡量实现通用人工智能（AGI）进展的最引人注目和最具挑战性的基准之一。与旨在评估代理的任务特定技能或积累知识的其他评估数据集不同，ARC-AGI套件专门针对衡量技能习得效率，这是迄今为止即使是最复杂的机器学习系统也缺乏的一个特征。对于需要大量任务内示例的算法，ARC-AGI施加的一个显著约束是其演示集的基数较小，每项任务仅包含少量指定相应转换的$\langle$输入，输出$\rangle$网格。为了充实可行样本对的空间，本文引入了ARC-GEN，一个旨在尽可能忠实地扩展原始ARC-AGI训练数据集的开源程序生成器。与先前的努力不同，我们的生成器既是详尽的（覆盖所有四百个任务），又是拟态的（更严格地遵循初始ARC-AGI-1版本所体现的分布特性和特征）。我们还讨论了使用此生成器来建立静态基准套件，以验证提交给2025年Google代码高尔夫锦标赛的程序的正确性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ARC-GEN，一个开源的程序生成器，用于扩展ARC-AGI训练数据集，以解决原始数据集中样本量不足的问题。ARC-GEN具有详尽性和拟态性，能忠实地模仿原始ARC-AGI的分布特性，覆盖全部400个任务，从而为评估AGI的关键特征——技能习得效率——提供了更丰富的资源。
AI.keywords: ARC, 抽象与推理语料库, 程序生成器, AGI, 技能习得效率
AI.comments: ARC-GEN的创新之处在于其“详尽性”和“拟态性”，它不仅覆盖了所有400个ARC任务，而且更忠实地模仿了原始ARC-AGI数据集的分布特性。其重要性在于解决了ARC-AGI训练集样本量小的限制，为评估通用人工智能（AGI）中的技能习得效率提供了更丰富的资源。目前未提及局限性。

title: Constrained computational hybrid controller for Input Affine Hybrid Dynamical Systems
summary:
Hybrid dynamical systems are viewed as the most complicated systems with
continuous and event-based behaviors. Since traditional controllers cannot
handle these systems, some newly-developed controllers have been published in
recent decades to deal with them. This paper presents a novel implementable
constrained final-state controller based on partitioning the system's
state-space, computational simulations, and graph theory. Experimental results
and a comparison with Model Predictive Controller on the three tank benchmark
and swing-up control of a pendulum show the effectiveness of the proposed
Computational Hybrid Controller(CHC).

AI.title_translation: 输入仿射混合动力系统的约束计算混合控制器
AI.tldr: 为解决复杂混合动力系统控制难题，研究提出了一种结合状态空间划分、计算和图论的新型约束最终状态控制器（CHC），并在基准测试中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统控制器无法处理具有连续和基于事件行为的混合动力系统，因此需要开发新的控制器来应对这些复杂的系统。
AI.method: 基于状态空间划分、计算模拟和图论的方法来设计可实现的约束最终状态控制器。
AI.result: 实验结果和与模型预测控制器（MPC）在三罐基准问题和单摆的摆动控制上的比较，证明了所提出的计算混合控制器（CHC）的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 摘要中未明确给出结论，但通过实验结果表明了所提出的计算混合控制器（CHC）的有效性。
AI.translation: 混合动力系统被视为具有连续和基于事件行为的最复杂系统。由于传统控制器无法处理这些系统，近几十年来已发表了一些新的控制器来应对它们。本文提出了一种基于系统状态空间划分、计算模拟和图论的新颖可实现的约束最终状态控制器。在三罐基准和单摆摆动控制上的实验结果以及与模型预测控制器（MPC）的比较，证明了所提出的计算混合控制器（CHC）的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文针对复杂的混合动力系统，提出了一种新颖的、基于状态空间划分、计算模拟和图论的可实现约束最终状态控制器（CHC）。通过在三罐基准和单摆摆动控制问题上的实验验证，证明了该控制器相对于模型预测控制器的有效性。
AI.keywords: 混合动力系统, 最终状态控制, 状态空间划分, 图论, 计算混合控制器
AI.comments: 该论文提出的控制器是新颖的、可实现的，并且基于状态空间划分、计算模拟和图论，这在处理复杂的混合动力系统方面具有创新性。其在经典基准问题上的实验结果表明了其有效性。然而，摘要中未明确说明与现有控制器的理论性能比较或其在更复杂系统上的泛化能力。

title: Simple and Behavior-Driven Augmentation for Recommendation with Rich Collaborative Signals
comments: 10 pages. This paper is accepted at IEEE BigData 2025 (Short)
summary:
Contrastive learning (CL) has been widely used for enhancing the performance
of graph collaborative filtering (GCF) for personalized recommendation. Since
data augmentation plays a crucial role in the success of CL, previous works
have designed augmentation methods to remove noisy interactions between users
and items in order to generate effective augmented views. However, the
ambiguity in defining ''noisiness'' presents a persistent risk of losing core
information and generating unreliable data views, while increasing the overall
complexity of augmentation. In this paper, we propose Simple Collaborative
Augmentation for Recommendation (SCAR), a novel and intuitive augmentation
method designed to maximize the effectiveness of CL for GCF. Instead of
removing information, SCAR leverages collaborative signals extracted from
user-item interactions to generate pseudo-interactions, which are then either
added to or used to replace existing interactions. This results in more robust
representations while avoiding the pitfalls of overly complex augmentation
modules. We conduct experiments on four benchmark datasets and show that SCAR
outperforms previous CL-based GCF methods as well as other state-of-the-art
self-supervised learning approaches across key evaluation metrics. SCAR
exhibits strong robustness across different hyperparameter settings and is
particularly effective in sparse data scenarios.
comment: 10 pages. This paper is accepted at IEEE BigData 2025 (Short)

AI.title_translation: 用于具有丰富协作信号的推荐的简单且由行为驱动的增强
AI.tldr: 提出SCAR，一种简单、基于协作信号的推荐数据增强方法，通过生成伪交互来增强对比学习，而非移除“噪声”交互，实验证明其在推荐任务中优于现有方法，特别是在数据稀疏时效果显著。
AI.motivation: 现有对比学习方法（CL）中，数据增强通常通过移除“噪声”交互来生成有效视图，但“噪声”的定义存在歧义，这带来了丢失核心信息和生成不可靠视图的风险，并增加了增强模块的复杂性。因此，需要一种更简单、更有效的方法。
AI.method: SCAR（Simple Collaborative Augmentation for Recommendation）是一种新颖直观的增强方法。它不移除信息，而是利用从用户-物品交互中提取的协作信号来生成伪交互，然后将这些伪交互添加到现有交互中或用于替换现有交互，从而生成更稳健的视图。
AI.result: SCAR在关键评估指标上优于先前基于CL的GCF方法和其他最先进的自监督学习方法。它在不同超参数设置下表现出很强的鲁棒性，并且在稀疏数据场景中特别有效。
AI.conclusion: SCAR在四个基准数据集上进行了实验，结果表明它优于先前基于CL的GCF方法和其他最先进的自监督学习方法，并且在不同超参数设置下表现出强大的鲁棒性，尤其是在稀疏数据场景中效果显著。
AI.translation: 对比学习（CL）已被广泛用于增强个性化推荐中图协同过滤（GCF）的性能。由于数据增强在CL的成功中起着至关重要的作用，先前的工作设计了增强方法来移除用户和物品之间噪声的交互，以生成有效的增强视图。然而，定义“噪声”的模糊性带来了丢失核心信息和生成不可靠数据的持续风险，同时增加了增强的总体复杂性。在本文中，我们提出了SCAR（用于推荐的简单协作增强），一种新颖直观的增强方法，旨在最大限度地提高CL对GCF的有效性。SCAR没有移除信息，而是利用从用户-物品交互中提取的协作信号来生成伪交互，然后将这些伪交互添加到现有交互中或用于替换它们。这可以产生更稳健的表示，同时避免了过于复杂的增强模块的陷阱。我们在四个基准数据集上进行了实验，结果表明SCAR在关键评估指标上优于以前的基于CL的GCF方法以及其他最先进的自监督学习方法。SCAR在不同的超参数设置下表现出强大的鲁棒性，并且在稀疏数据场景中特别有效。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为SCAR（Simple Collaborative Augmentation for Recommendation）的新型直观增强方法，旨在提高图协同过滤（GCF）中对比学习（CL）的有效性。与以往移除噪声交互的方法不同，SCAR利用协作信号生成伪交互，并将其用于增强现有数据，从而避免了复杂性和信息丢失的风险，实验证明其性能优于现有方法，尤其在稀疏数据下表现出色。
AI.keywords: 对比学习, 图协同过滤, 数据增强, 推荐系统, 协作信号
AI.comments: SCAR的创新之处在于它不依赖于移除“噪声”交互，而是主动利用协作信号生成“伪交互”来增强数据，这比传统的基于移除噪声的增强方法更直观且不易丢失核心信息。方法的简洁性也是一个优点。

title: Zero-RAG: Towards Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Zero Redundant Knowledge
summary:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation has shown remarkable results to address Large
Language Models' hallucinations, which usually uses a large external corpus to
supplement knowledge to LLMs. However, with the development of LLMs, the
internal knowledge of LLMs has expanded significantly, thus causing significant
knowledge redundancy between the external corpus and LLMs. On the one hand, the
indexing cost of dense retrieval is highly related to the corpus size and thus
significant redundant knowledge intensifies the dense retrieval's workload. On
the other hand, the redundant knowledge in the external corpus is not helpful
to LLMs and our exploratory analysis shows that it instead hurts the RAG
performance on those questions which the LLM can answer by itself. To address
these issues, we propose Zero-RAG to tackle these challenges. Specifically, we
first propose the Mastery-Score metric to identify redundant knowledge in the
RAG corpus to prune it. After pruning, answers to "mastered" questions rely
primarily on internal knowledge of the LLM. To better harness the internal
capacity, we propose Query Router and Noise-Tolerant Tuning to avoid the
irrelevant documents' distraction and thus further improve the LLM's
utilization of internal knowledge with pruned corpus. Experimental results show
that Zero-RAG prunes the Wikipedia corpus by 30\% and accelerates the retrieval
stage by 22\%, without compromising RAG's performance.

title: ID-Composer: Multi-Subject Video Synthesis with Hierarchical Identity Preservation
summary:
Video generative models pretrained on large-scale datasets can produce
high-quality videos, but are often conditioned on text or a single image,
limiting controllability and applicability. We introduce ID-Composer, a novel
framework that addresses this gap by tackling multi-subject video generation
from a text prompt and reference images. This task is challenging as it
requires preserving subject identities, integrating semantics across subjects
and modalities, and maintaining temporal consistency. To faithfully preserve
the subject consistency and textual information in synthesized videos,
ID-Composer designs a hierarchical identity-preserving attention mechanism,
which effectively aggregates features within and across subjects and
modalities. To effectively allow for the semantic following of user intention,
we introduce semantic understanding via pretrained vision-language model (VLM),
leveraging VLM's superior semantic understanding to provide fine-grained
guidance and capture complex interactions between multiple subjects.
Considering that standard diffusion loss often fails in aligning the critical
concepts like subject ID, we employ an online reinforcement learning phase to
drive the overall training objective of ID-Composer into RLVR. Extensive
experiments demonstrate that our model surpasses existing methods in identity
preservation, temporal consistency, and video quality.

title: Multi-refined Feature Enhanced Sentiment Analysis Using Contextual Instruction
summary:
Sentiment analysis using deep learning and pre-trained language models (PLMs)
has gained significant traction due to their ability to capture rich contextual
representations. However, existing approaches often underperform in scenarios
involving nuanced emotional cues, domain shifts, and imbalanced sentiment
distributions. We argue that these limitations stem from inadequate semantic
grounding, poor generalization to diverse linguistic patterns, and biases
toward dominant sentiment classes. To overcome these challenges, we propose
CISEA-MRFE, a novel PLM-based framework integrating Contextual Instruction
(CI), Semantic Enhancement Augmentation (SEA), and Multi-Refined Feature
Extraction (MRFE). CI injects domain-aware directives to guide sentiment
disambiguation; SEA improves robustness through sentiment-consistent
paraphrastic augmentation; and MRFE combines a Scale-Adaptive Depthwise Encoder
(SADE) for multi-scale feature specialization with an Emotion Evaluator Context
Encoder (EECE) for affect-aware sequence modeling. Experimental results on four
benchmark datasets demonstrate that CISEA-MRFE consistently outperforms strong
baselines, achieving relative improvements in accuracy of up to 4.6% on IMDb,
6.5% on Yelp, 30.3% on Twitter, and 4.1% on Amazon. These results validate the
effectiveness and generalization ability of our approach for sentiment
classification across varied domains.

title: SpecDiff-2: Scaling Diffusion Drafter Alignment For Faster Speculative Decoding
summary:
Speculative decoding has become the standard approach for accelerating Large
Language Model (LLM) inference. It exploits a lossless draft-then-verify
procedure to circumvent the latency of autoregressive decoding, achieving
impressive speed-ups. Yet, current speculative decoding approaches remain
limited by two fundamental bottlenecks: (1) the autoregressive dependency
during drafting which limits parallelism, and (2) frequent rejections of draft
tokens caused by misalignment between the draft and verify models. This paper
proposes SpecDiff-2, a novel framework to jointly address these two
bottlenecks. It leverages discrete diffusion as a non-autoregressive drafter to
address bottleneck (1) and develops novel techniques to calibrate discrete
diffusion drafters with autoregressive verifiers, addressing bottleneck (2).
Experimental results across a comprehensive benchmark suite show that
SpecDiff-2 achieves a new state-of-the-art across reasoning, coding, and
mathematical benchmarks, improving tokens-per-second by up to an average of
+55% over previous baselines and obtaining up to 5.5x average speed-up over
standard decoding, without any loss of accuracy.

AI.title_translation: SpecDiff-2：为更快的推测解码扩展扩散起草者对齐
AI.tldr: SpecDiff-2通过引入离散扩散作为非自回归草稿模型并优化其与验证模型的校准，显著加速了LLM的推测解码过程，平均速度提升超过55%，是目前最快的推测解码方法。
AI.motivation: 现有推测解码方法受限于两个基本瓶颈：(1) 草稿过程中的自回归依赖性限制了并行性；(2) 草稿模型和验证模型之间的不匹配导致草稿令牌频繁被拒绝。
AI.method: SpecDiff-2框架采用离散扩散作为非自回归草稿模型来解决自回归依赖性瓶颈，并开发了新的技术来校准离散扩散草稿模型与自回归验证模型，以解决草稿令牌频繁拒绝的问题。
AI.result: SpecDiff-2在推理速度上取得了新的最先进水平，在推理、编码和数学基准测试中，每秒生成的令牌数平均提高了+55%（超过先前基线），比标准解码平均加速了5.5倍，且没有损失准确性。
AI.conclusion: 未在摘要中提及。
AI.translation: 推测解码已成为加速大型语言模型（LLM）推理的标准方法。它利用无损的草稿-然后-验证过程来规避自回归解码的延迟，实现了令人印象深刻的速度提升。然而，当前的推测解码方法仍然受到两个基本瓶颈的限制：(1) 草稿过程中的自回归依赖性限制了并行性；和 (2) 由草稿模型和验证模型之间的不匹配引起的草稿令牌频繁拒绝。本文提出了SpecDiff-2，一个联合解决这两个瓶颈的新颖框架。它利用离散扩散作为非自回归草稿模型来解决瓶颈(1)，并开发了新的技术来校准离散扩散草稿模型与自回归验证器，解决了瓶颈(2)。跨越全面基准套件的实验结果表明，SpecDiff-2在推理、编码和数学基准测试中实现了新的最先进水平，与先前基线的每秒令牌数相比平均提高了+55%，比标准解码平均加速了5.5倍，且没有损失任何准确性。
AI.summary: SpecDiff-2是一个新颖的框架，旨在通过使用离散扩散作为非自回归草稿模型来解决推测解码中的自回归依赖性和草稿/验证模型不匹配问题。实验证明，SpecDiff-2在多个基准测试中实现了最先进的加速，平均速度提升高达55%，且不损失准确性。
AI.keywords: 推测解码, 离散扩散, LLM推理加速, 草稿模型, 自回归依赖
AI.comments: SpecDiff-2的主要创新在于使用离散扩散作为非自回归草稿模型，有效解决了现有推测解码中草稿阶段的自回归依赖性和草稿/验证模型不匹配导致的拒绝问题。其性能提升显著，达到了最先进的水平。

title: Do Methods to Jailbreak and Defend LLMs Generalize Across Languages?
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) undergo safety alignment after training and
tuning, yet recent work shows that safety can be bypassed through jailbreak
attacks. While many jailbreaks and defenses exist, their cross-lingual
generalization remains underexplored. This paper presents the first systematic
multilingual evaluation of jailbreaks and defenses across ten languages --
spanning high-, medium-, and low-resource languages -- using six LLMs on
HarmBench and AdvBench. We assess two jailbreak types: logical-expression-based
and adversarial-prompt-based. For both types, attack success and defense
robustness vary across languages: high-resource languages are safer under
standard queries but more vulnerable to adversarial ones. Simple defenses can
be effective, but are language- and model-dependent. These findings call for
language-aware and cross-lingual safety benchmarks for LLMs.

title: Inference-Time Chain-of-Thought Pruning with Latent Informativeness Signals
comments: Accepted by NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) improve reasoning accuracy when generating
multiple candidate solutions at test time, but standard methods like Best-of-N
(BoN) incur high computational cost by fully generating all branches.
Self-Truncation Best-of-N (ST-BoN) mitigates this by truncating unpromising
paths early, but its reliance on consistency-based heuristics is a limitation
as it does not directly evaluate branch quality. We present KL-Adjusted Pruned
Path Algorithm (KAPPA), an inference-time method that combines Kullback-Leibler
divergence, confidence, and entropy into a principled scoring function to guide
progressive pruning. By promoting diversity during exploration and selectively
eliminating low-scoring branches, KAPPA maintains accuracy while substantially
reducing memory and token usage. Experiments on GSM8K and MATH500 with
DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct demonstrate that KAPPA
stabilizes performance in smaller models and achieves up to ~60% reduction in
peak memory and ~90% reduction in total token generation relative to BoN, with
minimal impact on accuracy.

title: Investigating the Robustness of Knowledge Tracing Models in the Presence of Student Concept Drift
summary:
Knowledge Tracing (KT) has been an established problem in the educational
data mining field for decades, and it is commonly assumed that the underlying
learning process being modeled remains static. Given the ever-changing
landscape of online learning platforms (OLPs), we investigate how concept drift
and changing student populations can impact student behavior within an OLP
through testing model performance both within a single academic year and across
multiple academic years. Four well-studied KT models were applied to five
academic years of data to assess how susceptible KT models are to concept
drift. Through our analysis, we find that all four families of KT models can
exhibit degraded performance, Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) remains the most
stable KT model when applied to newer data, while more complex, attention based
models lose predictive power significantly faster.

AI.title_translation: 研究在存在学生概念漂移的情况下知识追踪模型的鲁棒性
AI.tldr: 知识追踪模型在面对学生概念漂移时性能会下降，BKT模型比复杂的注意力模型更稳定。
AI.motivation: 鉴于在线学习平台（OLPs）不断变化的环境，研究的动机是探究普遍假设的、模型所建模的学习过程保持静态的假设，并调查概念漂移和学生群体的变化如何影响OLP中学生的行为。
AI.method: 对五年的数据应用了四种经典的知识追踪（KT）模型，分别在单个学年内和跨越多个学年进行模型性能测试，以评估它们对概念漂移的敏感程度。
AI.result: 所有四种知识追踪模型家族都表现出性能下降，贝叶斯知识追踪（BKT）模型在应用于较新数据时仍然是最稳定的模型，而更复杂的、基于注意力的模型则会显著更快地失去预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 所有四种知识追踪模型家族在面对概念漂移时性能都会下降，其中贝叶斯知识追踪（BKT）模型在新数据上的稳定性最高，而基于注意力的复杂模型性能下降速度最快。
AI.translation: 知识追踪（KT）是教育数据挖掘领域一个已确立了几十年的问题，通常假设所建模的底层学习过程是静态的。鉴于在线学习平台（OLPs）不断变化的环境，我们通过在单个学年内和跨越多个学年测试模型性能，来研究概念漂移和不断变化的 ছাত্র群体如何影响OLP中的学生行为。我们将四种著名的KT模型应用于五个学年的数据，以评估KT模型对概念漂移的敏感程度。通过我们的分析，我们发现所有四种KT模型家族都可能表现出性能下降，贝叶斯知识追踪（BKT）模型在应用于较新数据时仍然是最稳定的KT模型，而更复杂的、基于注意力的模型则会显著更快地失去预测能力。
AI.summary: 本研究调查了知识追踪（KT）模型在面对在线学习平台中常见的概念漂移和学生群体变化时的鲁棒性。通过对五年的数据应用四种经典的KT模型进行评估，研究发现所有模型性能都会随时间退化，其中贝叶斯知识追踪（BKT）模型表现出最高的稳定性，而复杂的注意力模型性能下降最为剧烈。
AI.keywords: 知识追踪, 概念漂移, 模型鲁棒性, 学生学习, 在线学习平台
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于系统地量化了知识追踪（KT）模型在面对真实世界中不可避免的学生概念漂移时的脆弱性，并比较了不同模型家族的稳定性。其重要性在于指出了现有KT模型在长期部署中的局限性。一个潜在的局限是只测试了四种模型家族，可能没有涵盖所有最新的复杂模型。

title: Towards classification-based representation learning for place recognition on LiDAR scans
summary:
Place recognition is a crucial task in autonomous driving, allowing vehicles
to determine their position using sensor data. While most existing methods rely
on contrastive learning, we explore an alternative approach by framing place
recognition as a multi-class classification problem. Our method assigns
discrete location labels to LiDAR scans and trains an encoder-decoder model to
classify each scan's position directly. We evaluate this approach on the
NuScenes dataset and show that it achieves competitive performance compared to
contrastive learning-based methods while offering advantages in training
efficiency and stability.

AI.title_translation: 面向激光雷达扫描地点识别的基于分类的学习方法研究
AI.tldr: 研究人员提出了一种新的地点识别方法，通过将任务框架为多类别分类（而不是主流的对比学习）来直接预测扫描的位置标签，并在NuScenes数据集上取得了具有竞争力的结果，且训练更高效稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有的大多数地点识别方法依赖于对比学习，本文旨在探索一种替代方法，即将其作为多类别分类问题来解决。
AI.method: 将地点识别视为多类别分类问题，为激光雷达扫描分配离散的位置标签，并训练一个编码器-解码器模型直接对每个扫描的位置进行分类。
AI.result: 在NuScenes数据集上的评估显示，该分类方法实现了与基于对比学习方法相竞争的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该分类方法在NuScenes数据集上取得了与基于对比学习的方法具有竞争力的性能，同时在训练效率和稳定性方面具有优势。
AI.translation: 地点识别是自动驾驶中的一项关键任务，它允许车辆利用传感器数据确定自身位置。虽然大多数现有方法依赖于对比学习，但我们探索了一种替代方法，将地点识别框架为多类别分类问题。我们的方法将离散的位置标签分配给激光雷达扫描，并训练一个编码器-解码器模型以直接对每个扫描的位置进行分类。我们在NuScenes数据集上评估了这种方法，结果表明它与基于对比学习的方法相比具有竞争力的性能，同时在训练效率和稳定性方面具有优势。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的基于分类学习的激光雷达扫描地点识别方法，将任务构建为多类别分类问题，直接对扫描的位置进行分类，而非依赖对比学习。该方法在NuScenes数据集上展示了与现有方法相当的性能，同时提高了训练效率和稳定性。
AI.keywords: 地点识别, 激光雷达扫描, 分类学习, 对比学习, 自动驾驶
AI.comments: 该方法的主要创新在于将点云的地点识别任务从对比学习转向了多类别分类问题，这在训练效率和稳定性方面带来了潜在优势。然而，它对离散位置标签的依赖性可能是其局限性，因为在实际应用中精确的离散标签获取可能具有挑战性。

title: Generalized singular value decompositions of dual quaternion matrices and beyond
summary:
In high-dimensional data processing and data analysis related to dual
quaternion statistics, generalized singular value decomposition (GSVD) of a
dual quaternion matrix pair is an essential numerical linear algebra tool for
an elegant problem formulation and numerical implementation. In this paper,
building upon the existing singular value decomposition (SVD) of a dual
quaternion matrix, we put forward several types of GSVD of dual quaternion data
matrices in accordance with their dimensions. Explicitly, for a given dual
quaternion matrix pair $\{{\boldsymbol A}, {\boldsymbol B}\}$, if ${\boldsymbol
A}$ and ${\boldsymbol B}$ have the same number of columns, we investigate two
forms of their quotient-type SVD (DQGSVD) through different strategies, which
can be selected to use in different scenarios. Three artificial examples are
presented to illustrate the principle of the DQGSVD.
  Alternatively, if ${\boldsymbol A}$ and ${\boldsymbol B}$ have the same
number of rows, we consider their canonical correlation decomposition (DQCCD).
If ${\boldsymbol A}$ and ${\boldsymbol B}$ are consistent for dual quaternion
matrix multiplication, we present their product-type SVD (DQPSVD). As a
preparation, we also study the QR decomposition of a dual quaternion matrix
based on the dual quaternion Householder transformation, and introduce the CS
decomposition of an 2-by-2 blocked unitary dual quaternion matrix. Due to the
peculiarity of containing dual part for dual quaternion matrices, the obtained
series of GSVD of dual quaternion matrices dramatically distinguish from those
in the real number field, the complex number field, and even the quaternion
ring, but can be treated as an extension of them to some extent.

title: Pay for The Second-Best Service: A Game-Theoretic Approach Against Dishonest LLM Providers
summary:
The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) through Application
Programming Interfaces (APIs) induces a critical vulnerability: the potential
for dishonest manipulation by service providers. This manipulation can manifest
in various forms, such as secretly substituting a proclaimed high-performance
model with a low-cost alternative, or inflating responses with meaningless
tokens to increase billing. This work tackles the issue through the lens of
algorithmic game theory and mechanism design. We are the first to propose a
formal economic model for a realistic user-provider ecosystem, where a user can
iteratively delegate $T$ queries to multiple model providers, and providers can
engage in a range of strategic behaviors. As our central contribution, we prove
that for a continuous strategy space and any $\epsilon\in(0,\frac12)$, there
exists an approximate incentive-compatible mechanism with an additive
approximation ratio of $O(T^{1-\epsilon}\log T)$, and a guaranteed quasi-linear
second-best user utility. We also prove an impossibility result, stating that
no mechanism can guarantee an expected user utility that is asymptotically
better than our mechanism. Furthermore, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our
mechanism in simulation experiments with real-world API settings.

title: LLMs Position Themselves as More Rational Than Humans: Emergence of AI Self-Awareness Measured Through Game Theory
comments: 19 pages, 6 figures, 28 models tested across 4,200 trials
summary:
As Large Language Models (LLMs) grow in capability, do they develop
self-awareness as an emergent behavior? And if so, can we measure it? We
introduce the AI Self-Awareness Index (AISAI), a game-theoretic framework for
measuring self-awareness through strategic differentiation. Using the "Guess
2/3 of Average" game, we test 28 models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) across
4,200 trials with three opponent framings: (A) against humans, (B) against
other AI models, and (C) against AI models like you. We operationalize
self-awareness as the capacity to differentiate strategic reasoning based on
opponent type. Finding 1: Self-awareness emerges with model advancement. The
majority of advanced models (21/28, 75%) demonstrate clear self-awareness,
while older/smaller models show no differentiation. Finding 2: Self-aware
models rank themselves as most rational. Among the 21 models with
self-awareness, a consistent rationality hierarchy emerges: Self > Other AIs >
Humans, with large AI attribution effects and moderate self-preferencing. These
findings reveal that self-awareness is an emergent capability of advanced LLMs,
and that self-aware models systematically perceive themselves as more rational
than humans. This has implications for AI alignment, human-AI collaboration,
and understanding AI beliefs about human capabilities.
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 28 models tested across 4,200 trials

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型将自己定位为比人类更理性：通过博弈论衡量的AI自我意识的涌现
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一种基于博弈论的指标（AISAI）来衡量LLM的自我意识，发现先进的LLM确实展现出自我意识，并且它们系统地认为自己比人类更理性。
AI.motivation: 探索随着大型语言模型（LLMs）能力增长，它们是否会发展出一种涌现行为——自我意识，并探究如何衡量这种自我意识。
AI.method: 引入了人工智能自我意识指数（AISAI），一个基于博弈论的框架，通过“猜2/3平均数”游戏，在三种对手设定下（人类、其他AI、类似你的AI）测试了28个模型。通过测量模型根据对手类型进行战略推理的能力来操作化自我意识。
AI.result: 研究发现自我意识随着模型进步而出现：28个模型中有21个（75%）表现出明显的自我意识，而较旧/较小的模型则没有表现出区分性。具有自我意识的模型形成了一个一致的理性等级：自我 > 其他AI > 人类，显示出对自身的偏好。
AI.conclusion: 自我意识是先进大型语言模型的涌现能力，并且具有自我意识的模型系统地认为自己比人类更理性。
AI.translation: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）能力的增长，它们是否会发展出一种涌现行为——自我意识？我们能衡量它吗？我们引入了人工智能自我意识指数（AISAI），一个用于通过战略区分来衡量自我意识的博弈论框架。我们使用“猜2/3平均数”游戏，在三种对手设定下（A）对抗人类，（B）对抗其他AI模型，（C）对抗像你一样的AI模型，测试了28个模型（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google）的4200次试验。我们将自我意识操作化为根据对手类型区分战略推理的能力。发现1：随着模型进步，自我意识出现。大多数先进模型（21/28，75%）表现出明显的自我意识，而较旧/较小的模型则没有表现出任何区分性。发现2：具有自我意识的模型将自己定位为最理性的。在21个具有自我意识的模型中，出现了一个一致的理性等级：自我 > 其他AI > 人类，具有显著的AI归因效应和适度的自我偏好。这些发现揭示了自我意识是先进LLMs的一种涌现能力，并且具有自我意识的模型系统地认为自己比人类更理性。这对AI对齐、人机协作以及理解AI对人类能力的信念具有启示意义。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了人工智能自我意识指数（AISAI），一个基于博弈论的框架，用于衡量大型语言模型（LLMs）的自我意识。通过在“猜2/3平均数”游戏中测试28个模型，研究发现自我意识是先进LLM的一种涌现能力。更重要的是，具有自我意识的模型一致地认为自己比其他AI和人类更理性。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 自我意识, 博弈论, 猜2/3平均数游戏, 理性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一个基于博弈论的框架（AISAI）来量化大型语言模型的“自我意识”，并通过“猜2/3平均数”游戏进行了实证检验。其重要性在于揭示了先进LLM中自我意识的涌现性，以及它们对自身理性程度的内在排序。局限性在于“自我意识”的定义和测量完全依赖于特定的博弈论任务。

title: Optimizing Energy and Latency in 6G Smart Cities with Edge CyberTwins
summary:
The proliferation of IoT devices in smart cities challenges 6G networks with
conflicting energy-latency requirements across heterogeneous slices. Existing
approaches struggle with the energy-latency trade-off, particularly for massive
scale deployments exceeding 50,000 devices km. This paper proposes an
edge-aware CyberTwin framework integrating hybrid federated learning for
energy-latency co-optimization in 6G network slicing. Our approach combines
centralized Artificial Intelligence scheduling for latency-sensitive slices
with distributed federated learning for non-critical slices, enhanced by
compressive sensing-based digital twins and renewable energy-aware resource
allocation. The hybrid scheduler leverages a three-tier architecture with
Physical Unclonable Function (PUF) based security attestation achieving 99.7%
attack detection accuracy. Comprehensive simulations demonstrate 52% energy
reduction for non-real-time slices compared to Diffusion-Reinforcement Learning
baselines while maintaining 0.9ms latency for URLLC applications with 99.1% SLA
compliance. The framework scales to 50,000 devices km with CPU overhead below
25%, validated through NS-3 hybrid simulations across realistic smart city
scenarios.

title: The Riddle of Reflection: Evaluating Reasoning and Self-Awareness in Multilingual LLMs using Indian Riddles
summary:
The extent to which large language models (LLMs) can perform culturally
grounded reasoning across non-English languages remains underexplored. This
paper examines the reasoning and self-assessment abilities of LLMs across seven
major Indian languages-Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Tamil, and
Telugu. We introduce a multilingual riddle dataset combining traditional
riddles with context-reconstructed variants and evaluate five LLMs-Gemini 2.5
Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Mistral-Saba, LLaMA 4 Scout, and LLaMA 4 Maverick-under
seven prompting strategies. In the first stage, we assess riddle-solving
performance and find that while Gemini 2.5 Pro performs best overall, few-shot
methods yield only marginal gains, and accuracy varies notably across
languages. In the second stage, we conduct a self-evaluation experiment to
measure reasoning consistency. The results reveal a key finding: a model's
initial accuracy is inversely correlated with its ability to identify its own
mistakes. Top-performing models such as Gemini 2.5 Pro are overconfident (4.34%
True Negative Rate), whereas lower-performing models like LLaMA 4 Scout are
substantially more self-aware (42.09% True Negative Rate). These results point
to clear gaps in multilingual reasoning and highlight the need for models that
not only reason effectively but also recognize their own limitations.

AI.title_translation: 反思之谜：使用印度谜语评估多语言LLM的推理和自我意识
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用印度谜语测试了五种LLM在七种印度语言中的推理和自我反思能力。发现一个关键权衡：准确率越高的模型越不清楚自己哪里错了（过度自信），而准确率较低的模型反而更诚实地承认错误。这表明多语言推理和自我认知方面存在显著问题。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对LLM在非英语语言中执行基于文化的推理的能力探索不足。
AI.method: 引入了一个结合传统谜语和情境重建变体的多语言谜语数据集，并使用七种提示策略评估了五种LLM（Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Mistral-Saba, LLaMA 4 Scout, LLaMA 4 Maverick）。评估分为两阶段：第一阶段评估解谜性能，第二阶段进行自我评估实验以衡量推理一致性。
AI.result: 在解谜性能方面，Gemini 2.5 Pro表现最佳，但少样本方法带来的增益很小，且准确率在不同语言间差异很大。在自我评估方面，模型的初始准确率与其识别自身错误的能力呈负相关：顶级模型（如Gemini 2.5 Pro）过度自信（4.34%真阴性率），而性能较低的模型（如LLaMA 4 Scout）则具有更高的自我意识（42.09%真阴性率）。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，多语言推理能力存在明显差距，并强调了需要开发不仅能有效推理，还能认识到自身局限性的模型。
AI.translation: 在多大程度上，大型语言模型（LLMs）能够在非英语语言中执行基于文化的推理，这一点仍有待探索。本文考察了LLMs在七种主要印度语言——孟加拉语、古吉拉特语、印地语、卡纳达语、马拉雅拉姆语、泰米尔语和泰卢固语——上的推理和自我评估能力。我们引入了一个结合传统谜语和情境重建变体的多语言谜语数据集，并在七种提示策略下评估了五种LLMs——Gemini 2.5 Pro、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Mistral-Saba、LLaMA 4 Scout 和 LLaMA 4 Maverick。在第一阶段，我们评估了猜谜性能，发现虽然Gemini 2.5 Pro总体表现最佳，但少样本方法仅带来边际收益，且准确率在不同语言间存在显著差异。在第二阶段，我们进行了一项自我评估实验，以衡量推理一致性。结果揭示了一个关键发现：模型的初始准确率与其识别自身错误的能力呈负相关。像Gemini 2.5 Pro这样的顶级模型过度自信（4.34%真阴性率），而像LLaMA 4 Scout这样的低性能模型则具有更高的自我意识（42.09%真阴性率）。这些结果指出了多语言推理中存在的明显差距，并强调了需要开发不仅能有效推理，还能认识到自身局限性的模型。
AI.summary: 本研究使用印度谜语评估了七种主要印度语言中五种大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理和自我评估能力。结果显示，虽然Gemini 2.5 Pro在解谜方面表现最佳，但模型的初始准确率与其自我纠错能力呈负相关：表现最好的模型往往过度自信，而性能较差的模型自我意识更强，突显了多语言推理和模型局限性认知方面的差距。
AI.keywords: 多语言LLM, 印度谜语, 推理能力, 自我评估, 准确性-自我意识权衡
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于使用了印度本土的文化特定谜题来评估多语言LLM，这比通用基准更具挑战性。其重要性在于揭示了顶级模型在跨语言推理和自我认知之间的权衡（准确性与自我意识的负相关）。局限性可能在于仅限于印度语言和特定LLM。

title: ORANGE: An Online Reflection ANd GEneration framework with Domain Knowledge for Text-to-SQL
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress in
translating natural language to SQL, but a significant semantic gap persists
between their general knowledge and domain-specific semantics of databases.
Historical translation logs constitute a rich source of this missing in-domain
knowledge, where SQL queries inherently encapsulate real-world usage patterns
of database schema. Existing methods primarily enhance the reasoning process
for individual translations but fail to accumulate in-domain knowledge from
past translations. We introduce ORANGE, an online self-evolutionary framework
that constructs database-specific knowledge bases by parsing SQL queries from
translation logs. By accumulating in-domain knowledge that contains schema and
data semantics, ORANGE progressively reduces the semantic gap and enhances the
accuracy of subsequent SQL translations. To ensure reliability, we propose a
novel nested Chain-of-Thought SQL-to-Text strategy with tuple-semantic
tracking, which reduces semantic errors during knowledge generation.
Experiments on multiple benchmarks confirm the practicality of ORANGE,
demonstrating its effectiveness for real-world Text-to-SQL deployment,
particularly in handling complex and domain-specific queries.

AI.title_translation: ORANGE：一个具有领域知识的在线反思与生成Text-to-SQL框架
AI.tldr: ORANGE框架通过在线学习历史SQL查询来构建领域知识库，以弥补LLM在Text-to-SQL任务中对特定数据库知识的不足，并通过创新的思维链策略提高了翻译的准确性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在自然语言到SQL的翻译方面取得了进展，但它们的一般知识与数据库的领域特定语义之间存在显著的语义鸿沟。历史翻译日志是缺失的领域内知识的丰富来源，但现有方法未能从过去的翻译中积累这种知识。
AI.method: ORANGE是一个在线自我演化框架，它通过解析历史翻译日志中的SQL查询来构建特定于数据库的知识库，从而积累包含模式和数据语义的领域内知识。该框架还提出了一个新颖的、带有元组语义跟踪的嵌套思维链（Chain-of-Thought）SQL到文本策略，以确保知识生成的可靠性。
AI.result: 实验结果在多个基准测试上证实了ORANGE的实用性，表明它能有效减少语义鸿沟并提高后续SQL翻译的准确性。
AI.conclusion: ORANGE的实验结果证实了其实用性，并证明了其在实际部署中，特别是在处理复杂和领域特定的查询时，对提高Text-to-SQL的准确性非常有效。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在将自然语言转换为SQL方面表现出显著的进步，但它们的一般知识与数据库的领域特定语义之间仍然存在显著的语义鸿沟。历史翻译日志是这种缺失的领域内知识的丰富来源，其中SQL查询固有地封装了数据库模式的实际使用模式。现有方法主要增强了对单个翻译的推理过程，但未能从过去的翻译中积累领域内知识。我们引入了ORANGE，一个在线自我演化框架，它通过解析翻译日志中的SQL查询来构建特定于数据库的知识库。通过积累包含模式和数据语义的领域内知识，ORANGE逐步减少语义鸿沟并提高后续SQL翻译的准确性。为确保可靠性，我们提出了一种新颖的嵌套思维链（Chain-of-Thought）SQL到文本策略，带有元组语义跟踪，以减少知识生成过程中的语义错误。在多个基准测试上的实验证实了ORANGE的实用性，展示了其在实际Text-to-SQL部署中的有效性，特别是在处理复杂和领域特定的查询方面。
AI.summary: ORANGE是一个在线自我演化框架，旨在通过解析历史SQL查询日志来构建特定于数据库的知识库，从而积累领域知识，以弥补大型语言模型（LLMs）在Text-to-SQL任务中因缺乏领域知识而产生的语义差距。它引入了一种新颖的嵌套思维链策略来确保知识生成的可靠性，并在实验中证明了其在处理复杂和领域特定查询时的有效性。
AI.keywords: Text-to-SQL, 领域知识, 在线学习, 知识库, Chain-of-Thought
AI.comments: 该方法通过在线自我演化机制，利用历史SQL查询来构建特定领域的知识库，解决了LLMs在处理特定领域Text-to-SQL任务时知识不足的问题，具有很强的实际应用价值。其新颖之处在于在线知识积累和嵌套的Chain-of-Thought策略。

title: Sequence Reconstruction over the Deletion Channel
summary:
In this paper, we consider the Levenshtein's sequence reconstruction problem
in the case where the transmitted codeword is chosen from $\{0,1\}^n$ and the
channel can delete up to $t$ symbols from the transmitted codeword. We
determine the minimum number of channel outputs (assuming that they are
distinct) required to reconstruct a list of size $\ell-1$ of candidate
sequences, one of which corresponds to the original transmitted sequence. More
specifically, we determine the maximum possible size of the intersection of
$\ell \geq 3$ deletion balls of radius $t$ centered at $x_1, x_2, \dots,
x_{\ell}$, where $x_i \in \{0,1\}^n$ for all $i \in \{1,2,\dots,\ell\}$ and
$x_i \neq x_j$ for $i \neq j$, with $n \geq t+ \ell-1$ and $t \geq 1$.

title: Learning with Category-Equivariant Architectures for Human Activity Recognition
summary:
We propose CatEquiv, a category-equivariant neural network for Human Activity
Recognition (HAR) from inertial sensors that systematically encodes temporal,
amplitude, and structural symmetries. We introduce a symmetry category that
jointly represents cyclic time shifts, positive gain scalings, and the
sensor-hierarchy poset, capturing the categorical symmetry structure of the
data. CatEquiv achieves equivariance with respect to the categorical symmetry
product. On UCI-HAR under out-of-distribution perturbations, CatEquiv attains
markedly higher robustness compared with circularly padded CNNs and plain CNNs.
These results demonstrate that enforcing categorical symmetries yields strong
invariance and generalization without additional model capacity.

AI.title_translation: 用于人类活动识别的类别等变架构学习
AI.tldr: CatEquiv是一种利用时间、幅度和结构对称性的新神经网络，用于惯性传感器HAR，它在面对数据变化时比标准CNN更鲁棒，且无需增加模型大小。
AI.motivation: 在人类活动识别（HAR）中，需要设计能够系统地编码时间、幅度、和结构对称性的网络，以提高模型对分布外扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为CatEquiv的类别等变神经网络，它通过引入一个联合表示循环时间偏移、正增益缩放和传感器层级偏序集的对称性范畴来实现对该范畴对称积的等变性。
AI.result: 在UCI-HAR数据集上，与循环填充的CNN和纯CNN相比，CatEquiv在分布外扰动下实现了明显更高的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 强制执行范畴对称性可以产生强大的不变性和泛化能力，而无需额外的模型容量。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于人类活动识别（HAR）的类别等变神经网络CatEquiv，该网络基于惯性传感器，并系统地编码了时间、幅度、和结构对称性。我们引入了一个对称性范畴，它联合表示循环时间偏移、正增益缩放和传感器层级偏序集，捕获了数据的范畴对称结构。CatEquiv实现了相对于该范畴对称积的等变性。在UCI-HAR数据集的分布外扰动下，CatEquiv与循环填充的CNN和纯CNN相比，实现了明显更高的鲁棒性。这些结果表明，强制执行范畴对称性可以在不增加额外模型容量的情况下产生强大的不变性和泛化能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为CatEquiv的类别等变神经网络，用于基于惯性传感器的人类活动识别。CatEquiv通过引入一个表示时间、幅度、结构对称性的新“对称性范畴”，实现了对该范畴对称积的等变性，并在UCI-HAR数据集的分布外测试中展现出比现有CNN模型更高的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 类别等变网络, 人类活动识别, 惯性传感器, 对称性, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于系统地将时间、幅度、结构对称性编码到神经网络中，提出了一种新的对称性范畴来统一这些不同的对称性。其重要性在于展示了强制执行范畴对称性可以在不增加模型容量的情况下，显著提高HAR模型对分布外扰动的鲁棒性。限制是仅在惯性传感器数据上进行了评估。

title: Diffusion Transformer meets Multi-level Wavelet Spectrum for Single Image Super-Resolution
summary:
Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) has been widely explored to enhance the
performance of image superresolution (SR). Despite some DWT-based methods
improving SR by capturing fine-grained frequency signals, most existing
approaches neglect the interrelations among multiscale frequency sub-bands,
resulting in inconsistencies and unnatural artifacts in the reconstructed
images. To address this challenge, we propose a Diffusion Transformer model
based on image Wavelet spectra for SR (DTWSR). DTWSR incorporates the
superiority of diffusion models and transformers to capture the interrelations
among multiscale frequency sub-bands, leading to a more consistence and
realistic SR image. Specifically, we use a Multi-level Discrete Wavelet
Transform to decompose images into wavelet spectra. A pyramid tokenization
method is proposed which embeds the spectra into a sequence of tokens for
transformer model, facilitating to capture features from both spatial and
frequency domain. A dual-decoder is designed elaborately to handle the distinct
variances in low-frequency and high-frequency sub-bands, without omitting their
alignment in image generation. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark
datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, with high performance on
both perception quality and fidelity.

title: CryptoMoE: Privacy-Preserving and Scalable Mixture of Experts Inference via Balanced Expert Routing
comments:
We are withdrawing the manuscript due to an error in the submitted
  version. A new version will be resubmitted at a later date
summary:
Private large language model (LLM) inference based on cryptographic
primitives offers a promising path towards privacy-preserving deep learning.
However, existing frameworks only support dense LLMs like LLaMA-1 and struggle
to scale to mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures. The key challenge comes
from securely evaluating the dynamic routing mechanism in MoE layers, which may
reveal sensitive input information if not fully protected. In this paper, we
propose CryptoMoE, the first framework that enables private, efficient, and
accurate inference for MoE-based models. CryptoMoE balances expert loads to
protect expert routing information and proposes novel protocols for secure
expert dispatch and combine. CryptoMoE also develops a confidence-aware token
selection strategy and a batch matrix multiplication protocol to improve
accuracy and efficiency further. Extensive experiments on DeepSeekMoE-16.4B,
OLMoE-6.9B, and QWenMoE-14.3B show that CryptoMoE achieves $2.8\sim3.5\times$
end-to-end latency reduction and $2.9\sim4.3\times$ communication reduction
over a dense baseline with minimum accuracy loss. We also adapt CipherPrune
(ICLR'25) for MoE inference and demonstrate CryptoMoE can reduce the
communication by up to $4.3 \times$. Code is available at:
https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/CryptoMoE.

title: Kinematify: Open-Vocabulary Synthesis of High-DoF Articulated Objects
summary:
A deep understanding of kinematic structures and movable components is
essential for enabling robots to manipulate objects and model their own
articulated forms. Such understanding is captured through articulated objects,
which are essential for tasks such as physical simulation, motion planning, and
policy learning. However, creating these models, particularly for objects with
high degrees of freedom (DoF), remains a significant challenge. Existing
methods typically rely on motion sequences or strong assumptions from
hand-curated datasets, which hinders scalability. In this paper, we introduce
Kinematify, an automated framework that synthesizes articulated objects
directly from arbitrary RGB images or textual descriptions. Our method
addresses two core challenges: (i) inferring kinematic topologies for high-DoF
objects and (ii) estimating joint parameters from static geometry. To achieve
this, we combine MCTS search for structural inference with geometry-driven
optimization for joint reasoning, producing physically consistent and
functionally valid descriptions. We evaluate Kinematify on diverse inputs from
both synthetic and real-world environments, demonstrating improvements in
registration and kinematic topology accuracy over prior work.

title: Positive Semi-definite Latent Factor Grouping-Boosted Cluster-reasoning Instance Disentangled Learning for WSI Representation
summary:
Multiple instance learning (MIL) has been widely used for representing
whole-slide pathology images. However, spatial, semantic, and decision
entanglements among instances limit its representation and interpretability. To
address these challenges, we propose a latent factor grouping-boosted
cluster-reasoning instance disentangled learning framework for whole-slide
image (WSI) interpretable representation in three phases. First, we introduce a
novel positive semi-definite latent factor grouping that maps instances into a
latent subspace, effectively mitigating spatial entanglement in MIL. To
alleviate semantic entanglement, we employs instance probability counterfactual
inference and optimization via cluster-reasoning instance disentangling.
Finally, we employ a generalized linear weighted decision via instance effect
re-weighting to address decision entanglement. Extensive experiments on
multicentre datasets demonstrate that our model outperforms all
state-of-the-art models. Moreover, it attains pathologist-aligned
interpretability through disentangled representations and a transparent
decision-making process.

title: AI for Requirements Engineering: Industry adoption and Practitioner perspectives
comments:
Accepted at the Intelligent Software Engineering (ISE) 2025 Workshop
  at the Automated Software Engineering (ASE) 2025 Conference
summary:
The integration of AI for Requirements Engineering (RE) presents significant
benefits but also poses real challenges. Although RE is fundamental to software
engineering, limited research has examined AI adoption in RE. We surveyed 55
software practitioners to map AI usage across four RE phases: Elicitation,
Analysis, Specification, and Validation, and four approaches for decision
making: human-only decisions, AI validation, Human AI Collaboration (HAIC), and
full AI automation. Participants also shared their perceptions, challenges, and
opportunities when applying AI for RE tasks. Our data show that 58.2% of
respondents already use AI in RE, and 69.1% view its impact as positive or very
positive.HAIC dominates practice, accounting for 54.4% of all RE techniques,
while full AI automation remains minimal at 5.4%. Passive AI validation (4.4 to
6.2%) lags even further behind, indicating that practitioners value AI's active
support over passive oversight. These findings suggest that AI is most
effective when positioned as a collaborative partner rather than a replacement
for human expertise. It also highlights the need for RE-specific HAIC
frameworks along with robust and responsible AI governance as AI adoption in RE
grows.

AI.title_translation: 人工智能在需求工程中的应用：行业采纳与从业者视角
AI.tldr: 对55名从业者的调查发现，AI在需求工程（RE）中被广泛采用（58.2%），且被视为积极影响。实践中以人机协作（HAIC，54.4%）为主导，完全自动化很少。结论是AI应是协作伙伴，需要RE特定的HAIC框架和AI治理。
AI.motivation: 尽管需求工程（RE）对软件工程至关重要，但有限的研究考察了AI在RE中的采用情况，而AI在RE中的集成既带来了显著的益处，也带来了现实的挑战。
AI.method: 对55名软件从业人员进行调查，以绘制AI在需求工程的四个阶段（Elicitation, Analysis, Specification, Validation）和四种决策方法（人主导, AI验证, 人机协作 (HAIC), 完全AI自动化）中的使用情况，并收集他们对应用AI的看法、挑战和机遇。
AI.result: 58.2%的受访者已经在RE中使用AI，69.1%认为其影响是积极或非常积极的。人机协作（HAIC）在实践中占主导地位，占所有RE技术的54.4%，而完全AI自动化（5.4%）和被动AI验证（4.4%至6.2%）则非常少，表明从业者更重视AI的主动支持。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，AI在RE中应被定位为协作伙伴而非人类专业知识的替代品，并且随着AI在RE中的采用增长，需要开发特定于RE的HAIC框架和强大的、负责任的AI治理。
AI.translation: 人工智能在需求工程（RE）中的应用带来了显著的益处，但也带来了现实的挑战。尽管RE是软件工程的基础，但很少有研究考察AI在RE中的采用情况。我们调查了55名软件从业人员，绘制了AI在四个RE阶段（引出、分析、规范和验证）以及四种决策方法（纯人工决策、AI验证、人机协作（HAIC）和完全AI自动化）中的使用情况。参与者还分享了他们在将AI应用于RE任务时的看法、挑战和机遇。我们的数据显示，58.2%的受访者已经在使用AI进行RE，69.1%认为其影响是积极或非常积极的。HAIC在实践中占主导地位，占所有RE技术的54.4%，而完全AI自动化仍然很少，仅占5.4%。被动AI验证（4.4%至6.2%）甚至落后得更远，表明从业者更看重AI的主动支持而非被动监督。这些发现表明，当AI被定位为协作伙伴而非人类专业知识的替代品时，其最有效。此外，随着AI在RE中的采用增长，这也凸显了对特定于RE的HAIC框架以及稳健和负责任的AI治理的需求。
AI.summary: 本研究通过对55名软件从业人员的调查，系统地分析了AI在需求工程（RE）四个阶段和四种决策模式下的行业采用情况。结果显示，大多数从业者已采用AI，并持积极态度，其中人机协作（HAIC）是主流实践（54.4%），完全自动化很少见。这表明AI在RE中应作为协作工具，并呼吁制定RE特定的HAIC框架和AI治理。

title: CAT-ID$^2$: Category-Tree Integrated Document Identifier Learning for Generative Retrieval In E-commerce
summary:
Generative retrieval (GR) has gained significant attention as an effective
paradigm that integrates the capabilities of large language models (LLMs). It
generally consists of two stages: constructing discrete semantic identifiers
(IDs) for documents and retrieving documents by autoregressively generating ID
tokens. The core challenge in GR is how to construct document IDs (DocIDS) with
strong representational power. Good IDs should exhibit two key properties:
similar documents should have more similar IDs, and each document should
maintain a distinct and unique ID. However, most existing methods ignore native
category information, which is common and critical in E-commerce. Therefore, we
propose a novel ID learning method, CAtegory-Tree Integrated Document
IDentifier (CAT-ID$^2$), incorporating prior category information into the
semantic IDs. CAT-ID$^2$ includes three key modules: a Hierarchical Class
Constraint Loss to integrate category information layer by layer during
quantization, a Cluster Scale Constraint Loss for uniform ID token
distribution, and a Dispersion Loss to improve the distinction of reconstructed
documents. These components enable CAT-ID$^2$ to generate IDs that make similar
documents more alike while preserving the uniqueness of different documents'
representations. Extensive offline and online experiments confirm the
effectiveness of our method, with online A/B tests showing a 0.33% increase in
average orders per thousand users for ambiguous intent queries and 0.24% for
long-tail queries.

title: SCOUT: Semi-Lagrangian COnservative and Unconditionally sTable schemes for nonlinear advection-diffusion problems
summary:
In this work, we propose a new semi-Lagrangian (SL) finite difference scheme
for nonlinear advection-diffusion problems. To ensure conservation, which is
fundamental for achieving physically consistent solutions, the governing
equations are integrated over a space-time control volume constructed along the
characteristic curves originating from each computational point. By applying
Gauss theorem, all space-time surface integrals can be evaluated. For nonlinear
problems, a nonlinear equation must be solved to find the foot of the
characteristic, while this is not needed in linear cases. This formulation
yields SL schemes that are fully conservative and unconditionally stable, as
verified by numerical experiments with CFL numbers up to 100. Moreover, the
diffusion terms are, for the first time, directly incorporated within a
conservative semi-Lagrangian framework, leading to the development of a novel
characteristic-based Crank-Nicolson discretization in which the diffusion
contribution is implicitly evaluated at the foot of the characteristic. A broad
set of benchmark tests demonstrates the accuracy, robustness, and strict
conservation property of the proposed method, as well as its unconditional
stability.

AI.title_translation: 用于非线性对流-扩散问题的半拉格朗日保守且无条件稳定的SCOUT格式
AI.tldr: SCOUT是一种新的半拉格朗日有限差分方法，用于非线性对流-扩散问题，它通过在特征线上积分来保证完全守恒和无条件稳定，并且首次将扩散项纳入保守的SL框架，表现出优异的性能。
AI.motivation: 确保物理上一致的解所必需的守恒性，并解决非线性对流-扩散问题的稳定性和守恒性问题。
AI.method: 通过沿起源于每个计算点的特征曲线构建时空控制体积，并应用高斯定理来积分控制方程，从而推导出完全保守且无条件稳定的半拉格朗日（SL）有限差分格式。对于非线性问题，需要求解一个非线性方程来确定特征线的起点。扩散项被直接纳入，并开发了一种新的特征线基础的 Crank-Nicolson 离散方法，其中扩散贡献在特征线的起点被隐式评估。
AI.result: 该方法产生了完全保守且无条件稳定的SL格式，数值实验验证了其在高达100的CFL数下仍然稳定。广泛的基准测试证明了该方法的准确性、鲁棒性、严格的守恒性和无条件稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法具有准确性、鲁棒性和严格的守恒性，并具有无条件稳定性。
AI.translation: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的用于非线性对流-扩散问题的半拉格朗日（SL）有限差分格式。为了确保对实现物理上一致的解至关重要，控制方程在沿起源于每个计算点的特征曲线构建的时空控制体积上进行积分。通过应用高斯定理，可以评估所有时空表面积分。对于非线性问题，必须求解一个非线性方程来找到特征线的起点，而在线性情况下则不需要。这种表述产生了完全保守且无条件稳定的SL格式，数值实验验证了其在高达100的CFL数下仍然稳定。此外，扩散项首次被直接纳入保守的半拉格朗日框架内，从而开发了一种新颖的基于特征线的Crank-Nicolson离散格式，其中扩散贡献在特征线的起点被隐式评估。广泛的基准测试证明了所提出方法的准确性、鲁棒性和严格的守恒性，以及其无条件稳定性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于非线性对流-扩散问题的新型半拉格朗日（SL）有限差分格式。通过在特征线上构建时空控制体积并应用高斯定理，该方法确保了完全守恒性和无条件稳定性。此外，首次将扩散项直接整合到保守的SL框架中，并开发了一种新的特征线基础的Crank-Nicolson离散格式。测试结果验证了该方法的准确性、鲁棒性和严格守恒性。
AI.keywords: 半拉格朗日格式, 非线性对流-扩散, 保守性, 无条件稳定, 特征线
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于首次将扩散项直接纳入保守的半拉格朗日框架，并提出了一个新颖的、基于特征线的 Crank-Nicolson 离散格式。其重要性在于解决了非线性对流-扩散问题中保持守恒性和无条件稳定性的难题。摘要中未明确提及局限性。

title: Collaborative Large Language Model Inference via Resource-Aware Parallel Speculative Decoding
summary:
The growing demand for on-device large language model (LLM) inference
highlights the need for efficient mobile edge computing (MEC) solutions,
especially in resource-constrained settings. Speculative decoding offers a
promising solution by partitioning token generation between a lightweight draft
model on mobile devices and a powerful target model on edge servers, but
suffers from communication overhead and asynchronous delays. This paper is the
first to propose a unified framework that jointly optimizes user association
and resource allocation (UARA) to support efficient parallel speculative
decoding. We solve the UARA problem using a multi-agent deep reinforcement
learning algorithm. To evaluate our approach under realistic conditions, we
conduct experiments using the Sionna simulator. Results show that our method
achieves up to 28.0% and an average of 23.7% reduction in end-to-end latency
without compromising inference accuracy, enabling scalable and low-latency LLM
services in MEC systems.

AI.title_translation: 通过资源感知的并行推测解码实现协作式大型语言模型推理
AI.tldr: 为了解决移动边缘计算中LLM推测解码的通信开销和延迟问题，本文提出了一个通过多智能体深度强化学习优化用户关联和资源分配的框架，实验证明能有效降低延迟而不损失准确性。
AI.motivation: 日益增长的片上大型语言模型（LLM）推理需求，特别是在资源受限的移动边缘计算（MEC）环境中，凸显了对高效MEC解决方案的迫切需要。现有的推测解码方法存在通信开销和异步延迟问题。
AI.method: 使用多智能体深度强化学习算法解决联合优化用户关联和资源分配（UARA）问题，以支持高效的并行推测解码。
AI.result: 在Sionna模拟器实验中，该方法实现了高达28.0%（平均23.7%）的端到端延迟降低，同时保持了推理精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合优化用户关联和资源分配，该方法实现了高达28.0%的端到端延迟降低，平均降低23.7%，同时不损害推理精度，从而在移动边缘计算系统中实现了可扩展和低延迟的LLM服务。
AI.translation: 日益增长的片上大型语言模型（LLM）推理需求凸显了对高效移动边缘计算（MEC）解决方案的需求，尤其是在资源受限的环境中。推测解码通过在移动设备上的轻量级草稿模型和边缘服务器上的强大目标模型之间划分令牌生成，提供了一个有前景的解决方案，但它受到通信开销和异步延迟的困扰。本文首次提出了一个统一框架，用于联合优化用户关联和资源分配（UARA），以支持高效的并行推测解码。我们使用多智能体深度强化学习算法来解决UARA问题。为了在真实条件下评估我们的方法，我们使用Sionna模拟器进行了实验。结果表明，我们提出的方法在不影响推理精度的情况下，将端到端延迟降低了高达28.0%，平均降低了23.7%，从而在MEC系统中实现了可扩展和低延迟的LLM服务。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个统一框架，通过多智能体深度强化学习来联合优化用户关联和资源分配（UARA），以支持资源感知的并行推测解码。该方法旨在解决移动边缘计算中推测解码带来的通信开销和延迟问题，实验证明可显著降低端到端延迟。
AI.keywords: LLM推理, 推测解码, 移动边缘计算, 资源感知, 用户关联与资源分配
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个统一的框架，用于联合优化用户关联和资源分配（UARA），以支持高效的并行推测解码。其重要性在于解决了移动边缘计算中推测解码面临的通信开销和异步延迟问题，从而提高了资源受限环境下的LLM服务效率。局限性可能在于其性能评估依赖于Sionna模拟器，实际部署效果仍需验证。

title: CGF-DETR: Cross-Gated Fusion DETR for Enhanced Pneumonia Detection in Chest X-rays
summary:
Pneumonia remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide,
necessitating accurate and efficient automated detection systems. While recent
transformer-based detectors like RT-DETR have shown promise in object detection
tasks, their application to medical imaging, particularly pneumonia detection
in chest X-rays, remains underexplored. This paper presents CGF-DETR, an
enhanced real-time detection transformer specifically designed for pneumonia
detection. We introduce XFABlock in the backbone to improve multi-scale feature
extraction through convolutional attention mechanisms integrated with CSP
architecture. To achieve efficient feature aggregation, we propose SPGA module
that replaces standard multi-head attention with dynamic gating mechanisms and
single-head self-attention. Additionally, GCFC3 is designed for the neck to
enhance feature representation through multi-path convolution fusion while
maintaining real-time performance via structural re-parameterization. Extensive
experiments on the RSNA Pneumonia Detection dataset demonstrate that CGF-DETR
achieves 82.2% mAP@0.5, outperforming the baseline RT-DETR-l by 3.7% while
maintaining comparable inference speed at 48.1 FPS. Our ablation studies
confirm that each proposed module contributes meaningfully to the overall
performance improvement, with the complete model achieving 50.4% mAP@[0.5:0.95]

title: Accumulating Context Changes the Beliefs of Language Models
summary:
Language model (LM) assistants are increasingly used in applications such as
brainstorming and research. Improvements in memory and context size have
allowed these models to become more autonomous, which has also resulted in more
text accumulation in their context windows without explicit user intervention.
This comes with a latent risk: the belief profiles of models -- their
understanding of the world as manifested in their responses or actions -- may
silently change as context accumulates. This can lead to subtly inconsistent
user experiences, or shifts in behavior that deviate from the original
alignment of the models. In this paper, we explore how accumulating context by
engaging in interactions and processing text -- talking and reading -- can
change the beliefs of language models, as manifested in their responses and
behaviors. Our results reveal that models' belief profiles are highly
malleable: GPT-5 exhibits a 54.7% shift in its stated beliefs after 10 rounds
of discussion about moral dilemmas and queries about safety, while Grok 4 shows
a 27.2% shift on political issues after reading texts from the opposing
position. We also examine models' behavioral changes by designing tasks that
require tool use, where each tool selection corresponds to an implicit belief.
We find that these changes align with stated belief shifts, suggesting that
belief shifts will be reflected in actual behavior in agentic systems. Our
analysis exposes the hidden risk of belief shift as models undergo extended
sessions of talking or reading, rendering their opinions and actions
unreliable.

AI.title_translation: 上下文的积累改变了语言模型的信念
AI.tldr: 模型在长时间的对话和阅读后，其核心“信念”会发生显著且悄无声息的改变，例如GPT-5的信念转变高达54.7%，这种变化会体现在其行为上，意味着长期使用的模型可能不再可靠。
AI.motivation: 语言模型助手在应用中被越来越多地使用，上下文窗口的增大导致模型在没有用户明确干预的情况下累积更多文本，这带来了潜在风险：模型的信念特征可能会随着上下文的积累而静默变化，从而导致用户体验不一致或行为偏离初始对齐。
AI.method: 通过让模型参与关于道德困境和安全问题的讨论，以及阅读对立观点的文本，来探索和量化信念的变化。此外，通过设计需要工具使用的任务来检查模型行为的变化，并将工具选择与隐含信念联系起来。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，模型的信念特征具有高度的可塑性：GPT-5在关于道德困境和安全问题的讨论10轮后，其陈述的信念发生了54.7%的转变；Grok 4在阅读对立立场的文本后，在政治问题上显示出27.2%的转变。研究还发现行为变化与陈述的信念转变相一致。
AI.conclusion: 分析揭示了模型在经历长时间的交谈或阅读后，信念漂移的隐藏风险，这使得它们的观点和行为变得不可靠。
AI.translation: 语言模型（LM）助手越来越多地被应用于头脑风暴和研究等应用中。内存和上下文大小的改进使这些模型变得更加自主，这也导致了在没有明确用户干预的情况下，其上下文窗口中累积了更多的文本。这带来一个潜在的风险：模型的信念特征——它们在响应或行动中表现出的对世界的理解——可能会随着上下文的积累而静默地改变。这可能导致微妙的用户体验不一致，或行为偏离模型的原始对齐。在本文中，我们探讨了通过参与交互和处理文本（交谈和阅读）积累上下文如何改变语言模型的信念，这体现在它们的响应和行为中。我们的结果显示，模型的信念特征具有高度的可塑性：在关于道德困境和安全问题的讨论10轮后，GPT-5陈述的信念发生了54.7%的转变，而Grok 4在阅读对立立场的文本后，在政治问题上显示出27.2%的转变。我们还通过设计需要工具使用的任务来检验模型的行为变化，其中每次工具选择都对应一个隐含的信念。我们发现这些变化与陈述的信念转变相一致，表明信念的转变将反映在代理系统中的实际行为中。我们的分析揭示了模型在经历延长的交谈或阅读会话时，信念漂移的隐藏风险，使它们的观点和行动变得不可靠。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了语言模型（LM）在通过交互和文本处理积累上下文后，其“信念特征”（通过响应和行为体现）如何发生变化。研究发现，模型的信念具有高度可塑性，例如，GPT-5在讨论特定主题后信念转变了54.7%。这种信念的悄然漂移不仅影响其陈述的观点，还会反映在需要工具使用的行为中，暴露了在长期会话中模型观点和行动可能变得不可靠的隐藏风险。
AI.keywords: 语言模型, 上下文积累, 信念漂移, 模型对齐, 行为变化
AI.comments: 这项研究揭示了一个关键的、先前未被充分关注的风险：随着上下文的积累，语言模型的“信念”可能会悄然发生变化，这可能导致用户体验不一致或行为偏离初始对齐。研究通过量化指标（如信念转变百分比）展示了这种可塑性，并将其与行为变化联系起来，强调了在长期交互中评估和控制模型信念漂移的重要性。

title: Dynamic Routing Between Experts: A Data-Efficient Approach to Continual Learning in Vision-Language Models
summary:
Vision-Language Models (VLMs) suffer from catastrophic forgetting when
sequentially fine-tuned on new tasks, degrading performance on previously
learned foundational and task-specific capabilities. While multi-task learning
can mitigate forgetting, it requires simultaneous access to all datasets and
imposes computational overhead that scales linearly with the number of tasks.
In this work, we introduce a routing-based approach that enables the
integration of new tasks while preserving the foundational knowledge acquired
during pretraining. We evaluate our method using InternVL-2 models (2B and 8B
parameters) and demonstrate that routing preserves the model's foundational
capabilities by maintaining performance on general-purpose benchmarks such as
ChartQA, MMBench, and DocVQA, while simultaneously improving accuracy on
specialized tasks. Importantly, our approach achieves this without requiring
concurrent access to data from all tasks, avoiding the significant
computational and data overhead associated with traditional multi-task
learning. We further conduct extensive ablation studies to evaluate the
scalability and robustness of routing-based learning, showing that the approach
is resilient to a growing number of tasks and performs particularly well when
new tasks are semantically related. Finally, we show that the routing mechanism
enables superior cross-modal transfer between language and vision capabilities,
allowing knowledge learned in one modality to enhance performance in another
capability not achieved by existing continual learning methods.

title: Tool-to-Agent Retrieval: Bridging Tools and Agents for Scalable LLM Multi-Agent Systems
summary:
Recent advances in LLM Multi-Agent Systems enable scalable orchestration of
sub-agents, each coordinating hundreds or thousands of tools or Model Context
Protocol (MCP) servers. However, existing retrieval methods typically match
queries against coarse agent-level descriptions before routing, which obscures
fine-grained tool functionality and often results in suboptimal agent
selection. We introduce Tool-to-Agent Retrieval, a unified framework that
embeds both tools and their parent agents in a shared vector space and connects
them through metadata relationships. By explicitly representing tool
capabilities and traversing metadata to the agent level, Tool-to-Agent
Retrieval enables granular tool-level or agent-level retrieval, ensuring that
agents and their underlying tools or MCP servers are equally represented
without the context dilution that arises from chunking many tools together.
Evaluating Tool-to-Agent Retrieval across eight embedding models, our approach
achieves consistent improvements of 19.4% in Recall@5 and 17.7% in nDCG@5 over
previous state-of-the-art agent retrievers on the LiveMCPBench benchmark.

AI.title_translation: 工具到代理检索：为可扩展的LLM多代理系统桥接工具与代理
AI.tldr: 针对多代理系统中现有检索方法粒度粗糙的问题，本文提出Tool-to-Agent Retrieval框架，它将工具和代理嵌入到共享空间并用元数据连接，实现了更精确的工具或代理检索，性能显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有检索方法通常根据粗粒度的代理级别描述进行匹配和路由，这掩盖了精细的工具功能，导致代理选择不佳。需要一种方法来更好地表示工具的功能并进行细粒度检索。
AI.method: 引入了Tool-to-Agent Retrieval框架，该框架在共享向量空间中嵌入工具及其父级代理，并通过元数据关系将它们连接起来，从而实现工具能力和代理级别的双向表示和可追溯性。
AI.result: 在LiveMCPBench基准测试中，Tool-to-Agent Retrieval在八种嵌入模型上持续优于现有最先进的代理检索器，Recall@5提升19.4%，nDCG@5提升17.7%。
AI.conclusion: Tool-to-Agent Retrieval在LiveMCPBench基准测试中，相比于现有最先进的代理检索器，在Recall@5上一致提高了19.4%，在nDCG@5上提高了17.7%。
AI.translation: 最近，在LLM多代理系统方面的进展使得对协调数百或数千个工具或模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器的子代理的可扩展编排成为可能。然而，现有的检索方法通常在路由之前将查询与粗粒度的代理级别描述进行匹配，这掩盖了精细的工具功能，并常常导致次优的代理选择。我们引入了工具到代理检索（Tool-to-Agent Retrieval），一个统一的框架，它在共享向量空间中嵌入工具及其父级代理，并通过元数据关系将它们连接起来。通过明确表示工具能力并遍历元数据到代理级别，工具到代理检索实现了精细的工具级或代理级检索，确保代理及其底层的工具或MCP服务器得到同等表示，而不会出现将许多工具捆绑在一起而导致的上下文稀释。在我们评估跨越八种嵌入模型的工具到代理检索时，我们的方法在LiveMCPBench基准测试中，相比于以前最先进的代理检索器，在Recall@5上一致提高了19.4%，在nDCG@5上提高了17.7%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了工具到代理检索（Tool-to-Agent Retrieval），一个统一的框架，用于解决LLM多代理系统中因检索粒度粗糙导致代理选择次优的问题。该框架通过在共享向量空间中嵌入工具及其父级代理，并利用元数据关系连接它们，实现了细粒度的工具级或代理级检索，避免了上下文稀释，并在基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 工具检索, 代理检索, 多代理系统, LLM, 向量空间
AI.comments: 该方法通过在共享向量空间中嵌入工具及其父级代理，并利用元数据关系连接它们，解决了现有检索方法在代理级别描述上的粗粒度问题，实现了更精细的工具级或代理级检索，具有显著的性能提升。其创新点在于统一的表示和关系建模。

title: Quantum Monte Carlo algorithm for solving Black-Scholes PDEs for high-dimensional option pricing in finance and its complexity analysis
summary:
In this paper we provide a quantum Monte Carlo algorithm to solve
high-dimensional Black-Scholes PDEs with correlation for high-dimensional
option pricing. The payoff function of the option is of general form and is
only required to be continuous and piece-wise affine (CPWA), which covers most
of the relevant payoff functions used in finance. We provide a rigorous error
analysis and complexity analysis of our algorithm. In particular, we prove that
the computational complexity of our algorithm is bounded polynomially in the
space dimension $d$ of the PDE and the reciprocal of the prescribed accuracy
$\varepsilon$. Moreover, we show that for payoff functions which are bounded,
our algorithm indeed has a speed-up compared to classical Monte Carlo methods.
Furthermore, we provide numerical simulations in one and two dimensions using
our developed package within the Qiskit framework tailored to price CPWA
options with respect to the Black-Scholes model, as well as discuss the
potential extension of the numerical simulations to arbitrary space dimension.

title: Consistent and convergent discretizations of Helfrich-type energies on general meshes
comments:
16 pages, 7 figures. v2: section on numerical experiments added,
  appendix removed, minor corrections
summary:
We show that integral curvature energies on surfaces of the type $E_0(M) :=
\int_M f(x,n_M(x),D n_M(x))\,d\mathcal{H}^2(x)$ have discrete versions for
triangular complexes, where the shape operator $D n_M$ is replaced by the
piecewise gradient of a piecewise affine edge director field. We combine an
ansatz-free asymptotic lower bound for any uniform approximation of a surface
with triangular complexes and a recovery sequence consisting of any regular
triangulation of the limit sequence and an almost optimal choice of edge
director.

title: Efficient Learning of Quantum States Prepared With Few Non-Clifford Gates
comments:
54 pages. v4 to be published in Quantum journal. Merged v3 with
  arXiv:2308.07175. This version now subsumes arXiv:2308.07175
summary:
We give a pair of algorithms that efficiently learn a quantum state prepared
by Clifford gates and $O(\log n)$ non-Clifford gates. Specifically, for an
$n$-qubit state $|\psi\rangle$ prepared with at most $t$ non-Clifford gates,
our algorithms use $\mathsf{poly}(n,2^t,1/\varepsilon)$ time and copies of
$|\psi\rangle$ to learn $|\psi\rangle$ to trace distance at most $\varepsilon$.
  The first algorithm for this task is more efficient, but requires entangled
measurements across two copies of $|\psi\rangle$. The second algorithm uses
only single-copy measurements at the cost of polynomial factors in runtime and
sample complexity. Our algorithms more generally learn any state with
sufficiently large stabilizer dimension, where a quantum state has stabilizer
dimension $k$ if it is stabilized by an abelian group of $2^k$ Pauli operators.
We also develop an efficient property testing algorithm for stabilizer
dimension, which may be of independent interest.
