title: Desynchronization Index: a New Connectivity Approach for Exploring Epileptogenic Networks
comments:
This work is submitted to IEEE Journal of Translational Engineering
  in Health and Medicine
summary:
Objective: This work presents a new computational framework to assist
neurophysiologists in Stereoelectroencephalography (SEEG) analysis, with the
goal of improving the definition of the Epileptogenic Zone (EZ) in patients
with drug-resistant epilepsy. Methods and procedures: We consider the Phase
Transfer Entropy (PTE) to estimate the effective connectivity between SEEG
channels, and design a novel algorithm, named the Desynchronization Index (DI),
that identifies the EZ as the group of channels showing independent behavior
with respect to the rest of the network during the seconds preceding the
seizure propagation. Results: We test the proposed DI algorithm against the
Epileptogenicity Index (EI) on a clinical dataset of 20 patients, considering
the channels that were thermocoagulated at the end of SEEG monitoring as the
detection target. Our results indicate that DI overcomes EI in terms of area
under the ROC curve (AUC=0.85 vs. AUC=0.83), while combining the two algorithms
as a unique tool leads to the best performance (AUC=0.87). Conclusion: The DI
algorithm underscores connectivity dynamics that can hardly be identified with
a pure visual analysis, increasing the accuracy in the EZ definition compared
to traditional methods. Clinical impact: The integration of connectivity- and
energy-based features can lead to the definition of a new biomarker of
epileptogenic channels, reducing the burden required by the SEEG review in the
case of extensive implants and improving the understanding of the dynamics
behind the generation of seizures.

title: A Block-Sparse Bayesian Learning Algorithm with Dictionary Parameter Estimation for Multi-Sensor Data Fusion
comments: Re-upload to fix minor mistake in the "Identical Sensors" paragraph
summary:
We propose an sparse Bayesian learning (SBL)-based method that leverages
group sparsity and multiple parameterized dictionaries to detect the relevant
dictionary entries and estimate their continuous parameters by combining data
from multiple independent sensors. In a MIMO multi-radar setup, we demonstrate
its effectiveness in jointly detecting and localizing multiple objects, while
also emphasizing its broader applicability to various signal processing tasks.
A key benefit of the proposed SBL-based method is its ability to resolve
correlated dictionary entries-such as closely spaced objects-resulting in
uncorrelated estimates that improve subsequent estimation stages.
  Through numerical simulations, we show that our method outperforms the
newtonized orthogonal matching pursuit (NOMP) algorithm when two objects cross
paths using a single radar. Furthermore, we illustrate how fusing measurements
from multiple independent radars leads to enhanced detection and localization
performance.

AI.method: 提出了一种基于稀疏贝叶斯学习（SBL）的方法，该方法利用组稀疏性和多个参数化字典来检测相关的字典项并估计其连续参数，将来自多个独立传感器的数据结合起来。

AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种基于稀疏贝叶斯学习（SBL）的方法，该方法利用组稀疏性和多个参数化字典，通过结合来自多个独立传感器的数据来检测相关的字典项并估计其连续参数。在MIMO多雷达设置中，我们证明了其在联合检测和定位多个目标方面的有效性，同时也强调了其在各种信号处理任务中的广泛适用性。所提出的基于SBL的方法的一个关键优点是它能够分辨相关的字典项——例如紧密间隔的目标——从而产生不相关的估计，以改进后续的估计阶段。通过数值模拟，我们证明了当使用单个雷达时，我们的方法在两个目标交叉路径时优于牛顿化正交匹配追踪（NOMP）算法。此外，我们还说明了如何融合来自多个独立雷达的测量结果可以提高检测和定位性能。

title: Invited Paper: BitMedViT: Ternary-Quantized Vision Transformer for Medical AI Assistants on the Edge
comments:
Accepted at 2025 IEEE/ACM International Conf. on Computer-Aided
  Design (ICCAD) Oct. 26-30 2025, Munich, DE
summary:
Vision Transformers (ViTs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in
interpreting complex medical imaging data. However, their significant
computational and memory demands pose challenges for deployment in real-time,
resource-constrained mobile and wearable devices used in clinical environments.
We introduce, BiTMedViT, a new class of Edge ViTs serving as medical AI
assistants that perform structured analysis of medical images directly on the
edge. BiTMedViT utilizes ternary- quantized linear layers tailored for medical
imaging and com- bines a training procedure with multi-query attention,
preserving stability under ternary weights with low-precision activations.
Furthermore, BiTMedViT employs task-aware distillation from a high-capacity
teacher to recover accuracy lost due to extreme quantization. Lastly, we also
present a pipeline that maps the ternarized ViTs to a custom CUDA kernel for
efficient memory bandwidth utilization and latency reduction on the Jetson Orin
Nano. Finally, BiTMedViT achieves 86% diagnostic accuracy (89% SOTA) on
MedMNIST across 12 datasets, while reducing model size by 43x, memory traffic
by 39x, and enabling 16.8 ms inference at an energy efficiency up to 41x that
of SOTA models at 183.62 GOPs/J on the Orin Nano. Our results demonstrate a
practical and scientifically grounded route for extreme-precision medical
imaging ViTs deployable on the edge, narrowing the gap between algorithmic
advances and deployable clinical tools.

title: Stacked Flexible Intelligent Metasurface Design for Multi-User Wireless Communications
comments:
We found a minor error in one of the early equations and it
  propagates to the later ones. Now, we are in the process of fixing this error
  and upload an updated paper
summary:
Stacked intelligent metasurfaces (SIMs) have recently emerged as an effective
solution for next-generation wireless networks. A SIM comprises multiple
metasurface layers that enable signal processing directly in the wave domain.
Moreover, recent advances in flexible metamaterials have highlighted the
potential of flexible intelligent metasurfaces (FIMs), which can be physically
morphed to enhance communication performance. In this paper, we propose a
stacked flexible intelligent metasurface (SFIM)-based communication system for
the first time, where each metasurface layer is deformable to improve the
system's performance. We first present the system model, including the transmit
and receive signal models as well as the channel model, and then formulate an
optimization problem to maximize the system sum rate under constraints on the
transmit power budget, morphing distance, and the unit-modulus condition of the
meta-atom responses. To solve this problem, we develop an alternating
optimization framework based on the gradient projection method. Simulation
results demonstrate that the proposed SFIM-based system achieves significant
performance gains compared to its rigid SIM counterpart.

title: Nonasymptotic Convergence Rates for Plug-and-Play Methods With MMSE Denoisers
summary:
It is known that the minimum-mean-squared-error (MMSE) denoiser under
Gaussian noise can be written as a proximal operator, which suffices for
asymptotic convergence of plug-and-play (PnP) methods but does not reveal the
structure of the induced regularizer or give convergence rates. We show that
the MMSE denoiser corresponds to a regularizer that can be written explicitly
as an upper Moreau envelope of the negative log-marginal density, which in turn
implies that the regularizer is 1-weakly convex. Using this property, we derive
(to the best of our knowledge) the first sublinear convergence guarantee for
PnP proximal gradient descent with an MMSE denoiser. We validate the theory
with a one-dimensional synthetic study that recovers the implicit regularizer.
We also validate the theory with imaging experiments (deblurring and computed
tomography), which exhibit the predicted sublinear behavior.

title: A new stochastic diffusion process to model and predict electricity production from natural gas sources in the United States
summary:
This paper introduces a new stochastic diffusion process to model the
electricity production from natural gas sources (as a percentage of total
electricity production) in the United States. The method employs trend function
analysis to generate fits and forecasts with both conditional and unconditional
estimated trend functions. Parameters are estimated using the maximum
likelihood (ML) method, based on discrete sampling paths of the variable
"electricity production from natural gas sources in the United States" with
annual data from 1990 to 2021. The results show that the proposed model
effectively fits the data and provides dependable medium-term forecasts for
2022-2023.

AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种新的随机扩散过程来专门对美国的天然气发电量进行建模和预测。其重要性在于为能源预测提供了一个新的数学工具，但其局限性可能在于仅使用了年度数据，且对中短期预测的有效性进行了验证，长期预测能力未知。

title: Enhancing Phenotype Discovery in Electronic Health Records through Prior Knowledge-Guided Unsupervised Learning
comments:
Submitted to JAMIA; preprint is the author's original version. Github
  repo: https://github.com/mm4963/prior-guided-EHR-phenotyping/tree/main
summary:
Objectives: Unsupervised learning with electronic health record (EHR) data
has shown promise for phenotype discovery, but approaches typically disregard
existing clinical information, limiting interpretability. We operationalize a
Bayesian latent class framework for phenotyping that incorporates
domain-specific knowledge to improve clinical meaningfulness of EHR-derived
phenotypes and illustrate its utility by identifying an asthma sub-phenotype
informed by features of Type 2 (T2) inflammation.
  Materials and methods: We illustrate a framework for incorporating clinical
knowledge into a Bayesian latent class model via informative priors to guide
unsupervised clustering toward clinically relevant subgroups. This approach
models missingness, accounting for potential missing-not-at-random patterns,
and provides patient-level probabilities for phenotype assignment with
uncertainty. Using reusable and flexible code, we applied the model to a large
asthma EHR cohort, specifying informative priors for T2 inflammation-related
features and weakly informative priors for other clinical variables, allowing
the data to inform posterior distributions.
  Results and Conclusion: Using encounter data from January 2017 to February
2024 for 44,642 adult asthma patients, we found a bimodal posterior
distribution of phenotype assignment, indicating clear class separation. The T2
inflammation-informed class (38.7%) was characterized by elevated eosinophil
levels and allergy markers, plus high healthcare utilization and medication
use, despite weakly informative priors on the latter variables. These patterns
suggest an "uncontrolled T2-high" sub-phenotype. This demonstrates how our
Bayesian latent class modeling approach supports hypothesis generation and
cohort identification in EHR-based studies of heterogeneous diseases without
well-established phenotype definitions.

AI.title_translation: 通过先验知识引导的无监督学习增强电子健康记录中的表型发现
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一种结合临床知识（通过贝叶斯信息先验）的无监督学习模型，用于分析EHR数据以发现更具临床意义的疾病表型。在哮喘研究中，该模型成功分离出一个与T2炎症相关的亚表型，表明这种知识引导的方法优于忽略临床背景的传统方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的使用EHR数据的无监督学习方法在表型发现方面显示出潜力，但通常忽略现有的临床信息，从而限制了所发现表型的可解释性。
AI.method: 采用了一种操作化的贝叶斯潜在类别框架，通过信息先验来整合临床知识，以指导无监督聚类到临床相关的亚组。该方法对缺失情况进行建模，并提供带不确定性的患者级别表型分配概率。
AI.result: 在44,642名成人哮喘患者的就诊数据上，模型显示出表型分配的双峰后验分布，表明存在清晰的类别分离。其中，受T2炎症信息先验影响的类别（占38.7%）表现出嗜酸性粒细胞水平和过敏标志物升高，以及高医疗利用率和药物使用，这表明存在一个“未受控的T2高”亚表型。
AI.conclusion: 该贝叶斯潜在类别建模方法支持了对EHR中异质性疾病的假设生成和队列识别，特别是对于那些没有明确表型定义的疾病。
AI.translation: 目标：使用电子健康记录（EHR）数据的无监督学习在表型发现方面显示出潜力，但方法通常忽略现有的临床信息，限制了解释性。我们操作化了一个贝叶斯潜在类别框架，该框架纳入了领域特定知识，以提高EHR衍生表型的临床有意义性，并通过识别受II型（T2）炎症特征影响的哮喘亚表型来说明其效用。材料和方法：我们说明了一种通过信息先验将临床知识纳入贝叶斯潜在类别模型以指导无监督聚类到临床相关亚组的框架。该方法对缺失情况进行建模，考虑了潜在的随机缺失模式，并提供带不确定性的患者级别表型分配概率。使用可重用和灵活的代码，我们将该模型应用于大型哮喘EHR队列，为T2炎症相关特征指定信息先验，为其他临床变量指定弱信息先验，使数据能够告知后验分布。结果和结论：使用2017年1月至2024年2月的就诊数据，涉及44,642名成人哮喘患者，我们发现表型分配的双峰后验分布，表明清晰的类别分离。受T2炎症信息先验影响的类别（38.7%）的特点是嗜酸性粒细胞水平和过敏标志物升高，以及高医疗利用率和药物使用，尽管对后者的变量设置了弱信息先验。这些模式提示存在一个“未受控的T2高”亚表型。这证明了我们的贝叶斯潜在类别建模方法如何在没有明确表型定义的EHR研究中支持异质性疾病的假设生成和队列识别。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种操作化的贝叶斯潜在类别框架，通过引入领域知识（作为信息先验）来增强电子健康记录（EHR）数据的无监督学习表型发现，以提高临床有意义性。通过将该方法应用于哮喘队列，并以II型（T2）炎症特征为指导，研究成功识别出一个具有特定生物标志物和高医疗利用率的“未受控T2高”亚表型，证明了该方法在发现复杂疾病异质性方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 无监督学习, 表型发现, 电子健康记录, 贝叶斯潜在类别模型, T2炎症
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将领域知识通过信息先验引入到贝叶斯潜在类别框架中，以指导无监督聚类，从而提高了发现的表型（亚表型）的临床意义和可解释性。其重要性在于为处理具有异质性且缺乏明确表型定义的复杂疾病（如哮喘）的EHR数据提供了一种新的、可解释的分析范式。局限性可能在于过度依赖先验知识的设置，尽管作者试图通过弱信息先验来平衡这一点。

title: Wavelet Based Cross Correlations with Applications
summary:
Wavelet Transforms are a widely used technique for decomposing a signal into
coefficient vectors that correspond to distinct frequency/scale bands while
retaining time localization. This property enables an adaptive analysis of
signals at different scales, capturing both temporal and spectral patterns. By
examining how correlations between two signals vary across these scales, we
obtain a more nuanced understanding of their relationship than what is possible
from a single global correlation measure. In this work, we expand on the theory
of wavelet-based correlations already used in the literature and elaborate on
wavelet correlograms, partial wavelet correlations, and additive wavelet
correlations using the Pearson and Kendall definitions. We use both Orthogonal
and Non-decimated discrete Wavelet Transforms, and assess the robustness of
these correlations under different wavelet bases. Simulation studies are
conducted to illustrate these methods, and we conclude with applications to
real-world datasets.

AI.title_translation: 基于小波的交叉相关及其应用
AI.tldr: 该工作深入研究并扩展了小波基上的交叉相关理论，引入了多种细化的相关度量（如小波相关图），使用了不同类型的小波变换来分析信号在不同频率尺度上的关系，并在仿真和实际数据上进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 通过检查两个信号在不同尺度上的相关性变化，可以比单一的全局相关性度量获得对它们之间关系的更细致的理解。
AI.method: 扩展了文献中已使用的小波相关理论，详细阐述了使用Pearson和Kendall定义的小波相关图、偏小波相关和加性小波相关。使用了正交和非抽样离散小波变换，并评估了不同小波基下的相关性鲁棒性。
AI.result: 通过仿真研究说明了这些方法，并将其应用于真实世界数据集。
AI.conclusion: 研究以在真实世界数据集上的应用作为结束。
AI.translation: 小波变换是一种广泛使用的技术，用于将信号分解成对应于不同频率/尺度带的系数向量，同时保持时间局部性。这种特性使得能够在不同尺度上对信号进行自适应分析，捕捉时间和频谱模式。通过检查两个信号在这些尺度上相关性如何变化，我们可以比仅使用单一全局相关度量获得对它们之间关系的更细致的理解。在这项工作中，我们扩展了文献中已使用的小波相关理论，并使用Pearson和Kendall定义详细阐述了小波相关图、偏小波相关和加性小波相关。我们同时使用了正交和非抽样离散小波变换，并评估了这些相关性在不同小波基下的鲁棒性。进行了仿真研究以说明这些方法，最后以在真实世界数据集上的应用作结。
AI.summary: 本文扩展了小波相关理论，详细阐述了基于Pearson和Kendall定义的多种小波相关方法（如小波相关图、偏小波相关和加性小波相关），同时利用正交和非抽样小波变换并评估了不同小波基的鲁棒性，旨在通过跨尺度分析获得对信号关系的更精细理解。
AI.keywords: 小波变换, 交叉相关, 小波相关图, 离散小波变换, 信号分析
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于扩展和详细阐述了基于小波的相关性理论，特别是小波相关图、偏小波相关和加性小波相关，并同时使用了正交和非抽样小波变换，评估了不同小波基下的鲁棒性。重要性在于提供了比单一全局相关性更细致的信号关系分析方法。

title: A generic network theoretic based model to classify SDG indicators
summary:
To achieve the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, coordinated
action across their interlinked indicators is required. Although most of the
research on the interlinkages of the SDGs is done at the goal level, policies
are usually made and implemented at the level of indicators (or targets). Our
study examines the existing literature on SDG interlinkages and indicator (or
target) prioritization, highlighting important drawbacks of current
methodologies. To address these limitations, we propose a generic network-based
model that can quantify the importance of the SDG indicators and help
policymakers in identifying indicators for maximum synergistic impact. Our
model applies to any country, offering a tool for national policymakers. We
illustrate the application of this model using data from India, identifying
important indicators that are crucial for accelerating progress in the SDGs.
While our main contribution lies in developing this network-theoretic
methodology, we also provide supporting empirical evidence from existing
literature for selected key observations.

AI.title_translation: 一个基于通用网络理论的模型，用于分类可持续发展目标（SDG）指标

AI.translation: 为了实现联合国可持续发展目标，需要对其相互关联的指标进行协调行动。尽管大多数关于可持续发展目标关联性的研究是在目标层面进行的，但政策通常在指标（或目标）层面制定和实施。我们的研究考察了有关可持续发展目标关联性和指标（或目标）优先排序的现有文献，突出了当前方法的局限性。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了一个通用的基于网络的模型，可以量化可持续发展指标的重要性，并帮助政策制定者识别出能产生最大协同影响的指标。我们的模型适用于任何国家，为国家政策制定者提供了一个工具。我们使用印度的数据来说明该模型的应用，确定了对加速实现可持续发展目标至关重要的指标。虽然我们的主要贡献在于开发了这种网络理论方法，但我们也为选定的关键观察结果提供了来自现有文献的支持性实证证据。

title: Identification of Separable OTUs for Multinomial Classification in Compositional Data Analysis
summary:
High-throughput sequencing has transformed microbiome research, but it also
produces inherently compositional data that challenge standard statistical and
machine learning methods. In this work, we propose a multinomial classification
framework for compositional microbiome data based on penalized log-ratio
regression and pairwise separability screening. The method quantifies the
discriminative ability of each OTU through the area under the receiver
operating characteristic curve ($AUC$) for all pairwise log-ratios and
aggregates these values into a global separability index $S_k$, yielding
interpretable rankings of taxa together with confidence intervals. We
illustrate the approach by reanalyzing the Baxter colorectal adenoma dataset
and comparing our results with Greenacre's ordination-based analysis using
Correspondence Analysis and Canonical Correspondence Analysis. Our models
consistently recover a core subset of taxa previously identified as
discriminant, thereby corroborating Greenacre's main findings, while also
revealing additional OTUs that become important once demographic covariates are
taken into account. In particular, adjustment for age, gender, and diabetes
medication improves the precision of the separation index and highlights new,
potentially relevant taxa, suggesting that part of the original signal may have
been influenced by confounding. Overall, the integration of log-ratio modeling,
covariate adjustment, and uncertainty estimation provides a robust and
interpretable framework for OTU selection in compositional microbiome data. The
proposed method complements existing ordination-based approaches by adding a
probabilistic and inferential perspective, strengthening the identification of
biologically meaningful microbial signatures.

title: Extended Kalman Filtering on Stiefel Manifolds
summary:
A generalisation of the extended Kalman filter for Stiefel manifold-valued
measurements is presented. We provide simulations on the 2-sphere and the space
of orthogonal 4-by-2 matrices which show significant improvement of the
Extended Kalman Filter compared to only relying on raw measurements.

title: Bayesian spatio-temporal weighted regression for integrating missing and misaligned environmental data
summary:
Estimating environmental exposures from multi-source data is central to
public health research and policy. Integrating data from satellite products and
ground monitors are increasingly used to produce exposure surfaces. However,
spatio-temporal misalignment often induced from missing data introduces
substantial uncertainty and reduces predictive accuracy. We propose a Bayesian
weighted predictor regression framework that models spatio-temporal
relationships when predictors are observed on irregular supports or have
substantial missing data, and are not concurrent with the outcome. The key
feature of our model is a spatio-temporal kernel that aggregates the predictor
over local space-time neighborhoods, built directly into the likelihood,
eliminating any separate gap-filling or forced data alignment stage. We
introduce a numerical approximation using a Voronoi-based spatial quadrature
combined with irregular temporal increments for estimation under data
missingness and misalignment. We showed that misspecification of the spatial
and temporal lags induced bias in the mean and parameter estimates, indicating
the need for principled parameter selection. Simulation studies confirmed these
theoretical findings, where careful tuning was critical to control bias and
achieve accurate prediction, while the proposed quadrature performed well under
severe missingness. As an illustrative application, we estimated fine
particulate matter (PM$_{2.5}$) in northern California using satellite-derived
aerosol optical depth (AOD) and wildfire smoke plume indicators. Relative to a
traditional collocated linear model, our approach improved out-of-sample
predictive performance (over 50\% increase in R$^2$), reduced uncertainty, and
yielded robust temporal predictions and spatial surface estimation. Our
framework is extensible to additional spatio-temporally varying covariates and
other kernel families.

title: Cluster Size Matters: A Comparative Study of Notip and pARI for Post Hoc Inference in fMRI
summary:
All Resolutions Inference (ARI) is a post hoc inference method for functional
Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) data analysis that provides valid lower
bounds on the proportion of truly active voxels within any, possibly
data-driven, cluster. As such, it addresses the paradox of spatial specificity
encountered with more classical cluster-extent thresholding methods. It allows
the cluster-forming threshold to be increased in order to locate the signal
with greater spatial precision without overfitting, also known as the
drill-down approach. Notip and pARI are two recent permutation-based extensions
of ARI designed to increase statistical power by accounting for the strong
dependence structure typical of fMRI data. A recent comparison between these
papers based on large voxel clusters concluded that pARI outperforms Notip. We
revisit this conclusion by conducting a systematic comparison of the two. Our
reanalysis of the same fMRI data sets from the Neurovault database demonstrates
the existence of complementary performance regimes: while pARI indeed achieves
higher sensitivity for large clusters, Notip provides more informative and
robust results for smaller clusters. In particular, while Notip supports
informative ``drill-down'' exploration into subregions of activation, pARI
often yields non-informative bounds in such cases, and can even underperform
the baseline ARI method.

AI.title_translation: 簇大小很重要：Notip和pARI在fMRI后验推断中的比较研究
AI.tldr: 比较fMRI后验推断方法Notip和pARI，发现pARI擅长大簇，但Notip在小簇上表现更好，支持更精细的信号定位。
AI.motivation: 先前研究基于大簇的比较得出pARI优于Notip的结论，本研究旨在重新审视并系统比较这两种方法，以确定其性能的真实情况。
AI.method: 系统地比较了Notip和pARI两种基于置换的ARI扩展方法，使用Neurovault数据库中的fMRI数据集进行重新分析。
AI.result: pARI在高激活簇上实现了更高的敏感性，而Notip在较小簇上表现出更具信息量和鲁棒性的结果，pARI在小簇上可能导致无信息量的界限，甚至表现不如基线ARI方法。
AI.conclusion: pARI在高激活簇上具有更高的敏感性，但Notip在较小的簇上提供了更具信息量和鲁棒性的结果，支持有信息量的“钻探”探索。
AI.translation: 所有分辨率推断（ARI）是一种用于功能磁共振成像（fMRI）数据分析的后验推断方法，它为任何可能的、数据驱动的激活簇内真正活跃体素的比例提供了有效的下界。因此，它解决了经典簇范围阈值方法遇到的空间特异性悖论。它允许增加簇形成阈值，以更高的空间精度定位信号，而不会过度拟合，也称为“钻探”方法。Notip和pARI是ARI的两种最新基于置换的扩展，旨在通过解释fMRI数据中典型的强依赖结构来提高统计功效。最近一项基于大型体素簇对这两篇论文的比较得出结论，pARI优于Notip。我们通过系统比较重新审视了这一结论。我们对Neurovault数据库中相同fMRI数据集的重新分析表明存在互补的性能状态：虽然pARI确实在大型簇中实现了更高的敏感性，但Notip在较小的簇中提供了更具信息量和更稳健的结果。特别是，虽然Notip支持对激活子区域进行信息量的“钻探”探索，但pARI在这种情况下通常会产生无信息量的界限，甚至可能表现不如基线ARI方法。
AI.summary: 本文对fMRI数据后验推断方法Notip和pARI进行了系统比较。研究发现，先前认为pARI优于Notip的结论仅在处理大簇时成立。对于较小的激活簇，Notip提供了更具信息量和鲁棒性的统计推断，支持精细的“钻探”分析，而pARI在小簇上可能表现不佳。
AI.keywords: fMRI, 后验推断, ARI, Notip, pARI
AI.comments: 该研究通过系统比较Notip和pARI两种ARI扩展方法，揭示了它们在不同聚类大小下的性能差异，挑战了先前认为pARI优于Notip的结论。其创新点在于明确区分了两种方法在处理大小聚类时的互补性能，为fMRI后验推断的选择提供了更精细的指导。限制在于分析基于Neurovault数据库中的fMRI数据集，结果的普适性可能受限于这些数据。

title: On the Convergence of the Extended Kalman Filter on Stiefel Manifolds when Observing a Constant Particle with Measurement Errors
summary:
In this paper we first introduce the setting of filtering on Stiefel
manifolds. Then, assuming the underlying system process is constant, the
convergence of the extended Kalman filter with Stiefel manifold-valued
observations is proved. This corresponds to the case where one has measurement
errors that needs to be filtered. Finally, some simulations are presented for a
selected few Stiefel manifolds and the speed of convergence is studied.

AI.title_translation: 关于在观测具有测量误差的常数粒子时扩展卡尔曼滤波器在斯蒂费尔流形上的收敛性研究
AI.tldr: 在观测值有噪声（测量误差）且系统状态不变的情况下，证明了扩展卡尔曼滤波器在斯蒂费尔流形上的收敛性，并通过仿真验证了收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 研究在斯蒂费尔流形上进行滤波的设置，并证明在存在测量误差的情况下，扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）的收敛性，对应于需要对存在测量误差的观测数据进行滤波的实际情况。
AI.method: 首先引入了斯蒂费尔流形上的滤波设置，然后理论证明了在系统过程恒定和观测值存在测量误差的假设下，扩展卡尔曼滤波器的收敛性，最后通过仿真研究了收敛速度。
AI.result: 证明了扩展卡尔曼滤波器在斯蒂费尔流形上观测具有测量误差的常数粒子时的收敛性，并对不同斯蒂费尔流形上的收敛速度进行了仿真研究。
AI.conclusion: 证明了在系统过程为常数且观测值具有测量误差的情况下，扩展卡尔曼滤波器在斯蒂费尔流形上的收敛性，并通过仿真研究了收敛速度。
AI.translation: 本文首先介绍了在斯蒂费尔流形上进行滤波的设置。然后，在假设底层系统过程为常数的情况下，证明了具有斯蒂费尔流形值观测的扩展卡尔曼滤波器的收敛性。这对应于需要对存在测量误差的观测数据进行滤波的情况。最后，对选定的几个斯蒂费尔流形进行了一些仿真，并研究了收敛速度。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在斯蒂费尔流形上进行滤波的问题，并证明了当底层系统过程保持恒定时，具有斯蒂费尔流形值观测的扩展卡尔曼滤波器的收敛性，该场景对应于存在测量误差的观测情况。最后，通过仿真分析了在特定斯蒂费尔流形上的收敛速度。
AI.keywords: 扩展卡尔曼滤波器, 斯蒂费尔流形, 收敛性, 测量误差, 粒子滤波
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于证明了扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）在观测值具有测量误差、且系统过程为常数的情况下，在斯蒂费尔流形（Stiefel Manifolds）上的收敛性。这对于处理流形上具有噪声的观测数据具有重要的理论和实际意义。方法学上，作者主要通过理论证明和数值模拟相结合的方式来验证结论。局限性在于，研究仅限于系统过程为常数的情况。

title: Random time-shift approximation enables hierarchical Bayesian inference of mechanistic within-host viral dynamics models on large datasets
summary:
Mechanistic mathematical models of within-host viral dynamics are tools for
understanding how a virus' biology and its interaction with the immune system
shape the infectivity of a host. The biology of the process is encoded by the
structure and parameters of the model that can be inferred statistically by
fitting to viral load data. The main drawback of mechanistic models is that
this inference is computationally expensive because the model must be
repeatedly solved. This limits the size of the datasets that can be considered
or the complexity of the models fitted. In this paper we develop a much cheaper
inference method for this class of models by implementing a novel approximation
of the model dynamics that uses a combination of random and deterministic
processes. This approximation also properly accounts for process noise early in
the infection when cell and virion numbers are small, which is important for
the viral dynamics but often overlooked. Our method runs on a consumer laptop
and is fast enough to facilitate a full hierarchical Bayesian treatment of the
problem with sharing of information to allow for individual level parameter
differences. We apply our method to simulated datasets and a reanalysis of
COVID-19 monitoring data in an National Basketball Association cohort of 163
individuals.

title: The Curious Problem of the Normal Inverse Mean: Robustness and Shrinkage
summary:
In astronomical observations, the estimation of distances from parallaxes is
a challenging task due to the inherent measurement errors and the non-linear
relationship between the parallax and the distance. This study leverages ideas
from robust Bayesian inference to tackle these challenges, investigating a
broad class of prior densities for estimating distances with a reduced bias and
variance. Through theoretical analysis, simulation experiments, and the
application to data from the Gaia Data Release 1 (GDR1), we demonstrate that
heavy-tailed priors provide more reliable distance estimates, particularly in
the presence of large fractional parallax errors. Theoretical results highlight
the "curse of a single observation," where the likelihood dominates the
posterior, limiting the impact of the prior. Nevertheless, heavy-tailed priors
can delay the explosion of posterior risk, offering a more robust framework for
distance estimation. The findings suggest that reciprocal invariant priors,
with polynomial decay in their tails, such as the Half-Cauchy and Product
Half-Cauchy, are particularly well-suited for this task, providing a balance
between bias reduction and variance control.

AI.title_translation: 正态逆均值的奇特问题：稳健性与收缩
AI.tldr: 研究发现，对于有大误差的天文视差测距问题，使用重尾贝叶斯先验（如半柯西）比传统方法更稳健，能更好地控制估计的偏差和方差，尽管“单一观测的诅咒”限制了先验的作用。
AI.motivation: 在天文观测中，由于固有的测量误差和视差与距离之间的非线性关系，从视差估计距离是一项具有挑战性的任务。研究旨在通过稳健的贝叶斯推断来解决这些挑战，以获得具有更低偏差和方差的可靠距离估计。
AI.method: 理论分析、模拟实验以及应用于盖亚数据发布1（GDR1）数据。研究侧重于探索一类广泛的先验密度，并利用稳健贝叶斯推断的思想。
AI.result: 重尾先验能提供更可靠的距离估计，尤其是在存在大的分数视差误差时。理论结果表明“单一观测的诅咒”现象，即似然函数支配后验，限制了先验的影响，但重尾先验可以延迟后验风险的爆发。
AI.conclusion: 重尾先验，特别是具有多项式尾部衰减的倒数不变先验（如半柯西和乘积半柯西），能有效平衡偏差减少和方差控制，为视差距离估计提供了一个更稳健的框架。
AI.translation: 在天文观测中，由于固有的测量误差以及视差与距离之间的非线性关系，距离估计是一个具有挑战性的任务。本研究利用稳健贝叶斯推断的思想来应对这些挑战，研究了一类广泛的先验密度，用于以更低的偏差和方差估计距离。通过理论分析、模拟实验以及应用于盖亚数据发布1（GDR1）的数据，我们证明了重尾先验在存在大的分数视差误差的情况下能提供更可靠的距离估计。理论结果突出了“单一观测的诅咒”，即似然函数主导后验，限制了先验的影响。尽管如此，重尾先验可以延迟后验风险的爆发，为距离估计提供了一个更稳健的框架。研究结果表明，具有多项式尾部衰减的倒数不变先验，如半柯西和乘积半柯西，特别适合这项任务，在减少偏差和控制方差之间取得了平衡。
AI.summary: 本研究采用稳健贝叶斯推断方法，探索了一类先验密度，以解决天文观测中视差测距的挑战。通过理论、模拟和Gaia GDR1数据的应用，研究发现重尾先验（特别是具有多项式尾部衰减的倒数不变先验）能提供更可靠的距离估计，有效平衡了偏差和方差。
AI.keywords: 距离估计, 视差, 稳健贝叶斯推断, 重尾先验, Gaia GDR1
AI.comments: 该研究将稳健贝叶斯推断的思想应用于天文距离估计，解决了传统方法中存在的偏差和方差问题。其创新点在于证明了重尾先验在处理大的视差误差时具有更高的可靠性，并通过理论分析揭示了“单一观测的诅咒”现象。然而，其局限性在于理论上表明在某些情况下似然函数会主导后验，限制了先验的影响。该研究对天文学中的距离估计问题具有重要指导意义。

title: A tutorial on conducting sample size and power calculations for detecting treatment effect heterogeneity in cluster randomized trials with linear mixed models
comments:
v2: revision under review, 36 pages (main 22, supplemental 14), ; v1:
  28 pages, 4 tables, 5 figures
summary:
Cluster-randomized trials (CRTs) are a well-established class of designs for
evaluating community-based interventions. An essential task in planning these
trials is determining the number of clusters and cluster sizes needed to
achieve sufficient statistical power for detecting a clinically relevant effect
size. While methods for evaluating the average treatment effect (ATE) for the
entire study population are well-established, sample size methods for testing
heterogeneity of treatment effects (HTEs), i.e., treatment-covariate
interaction or difference in subpopulation-specific treatment effects, in CRTs
have only recently been developed. For pre-specified analyses of HTEs in CRTs,
effect-modifying covariates should, ideally, be accompanied by sample size or
power calculations to ensure the trial has adequate power for the planned
analyses. Power analysis for testing HTEs is more complex than for ATEs due to
the additional design parameters that must be specified. Power and sample size
formulas for testing HTEs via linear mixed effects (LME) models have been
separately derived for different cluster-randomized designs, including single
and multi-period parallel designs, crossover designs, and stepped-wedge
designs, and for continuous and binary outcomes. This tutorial provides a
consolidated reference guide for these methods and enhances their accessibility
through an online R Shiny calculator. We further discuss key considerations for
conducting sample size and power calculations to test pre-specified HTE
hypotheses in CRTs, highlighting the importance of specifying advanced
estimates of intracluster correlation coefficients for both outcomes and
covariates, and their implications for power. The sample size methodology and
calculator functionality are demonstrated through a real CRT example.

title: Asset-liability management with Epstein-Zin utility$\quad$ under stochastic interest rate and unknown market price of risk
summary:
This paper considers a stochastic control problem with Epstein-Zin recursive
utility under partial information (unknown market price of risk), in which an
investor is constrained to a liability at the end of the investment period.
Introducing liabilities is the main novelty of the model and appears for the
first time in the literature of recursive utilities. Such constraint leads to a
fully coupled forward-backward stochastic differential equation (FBSDE), which
well-posedness has not been addressed in the literature. We derive an explicit
solution to the FBSDE, contrasting with the existence and uniqueness results
with no explicit expression of the solutions typically found in most related
literature. Moreover, under minimal additional assumptions, we obtain the
Malliavin differentiability of the solution of the FBSDE. We solve the problem
completely and find the expression of the controls and the value function.
Finally, we determine the utility loss that investors suffer from ignoring the
fact that they can learn about the market price of risk.

AI.title_translation: 随机利率和未知市场风险价格下带有Epstein-Zin效用的资产负债管理
AI.tldr: 在考虑随机利率和未知风险价格的情况下，首次将负债约束纳入Epstein-Zin递归效用模型中，导出了复杂的前向-后向随机微分方程（FBSDE）的显式解析解，并确定了最优策略和效用损失。
AI.motivation: 考虑在部分信息（未知的市场风险价格）下，且投资者在投资期末受到负债约束的Epstein-Zin递归效用下的随机控制问题。引入负债是模型的主要新颖之处。
AI.method: 构建带有负债约束的随机控制问题，推导并求解了导致的全耦合前向-后向随机微分方程（FBSDE），并应用Malliavin微积分来证明解的可微性。
AI.result: 推导出了FBSDE的显式解，这与大多数相关文献中通常找到的没有显式表达式的存在性和唯一性结果形成对比。此外，在最少附加假设下，获得了FBSDE解的Malliavin可微性。
AI.conclusion: 论文完整地求解了问题，得到了控制和价值函数的表达式，并确定了投资者因忽略市场风险价格信息而遭受的效用损失。
AI.translation: 本文考虑了一个在部分信息（未知的市场风险价格）下，且投资者在投资期末受到负债约束的Epstein-Zin递归效用下的随机控制问题。引入负债是模型的主要新颖之处，并且首次出现在递归效用文献中。这种约束导致了一个全耦合的前向-后向随机微分方程（FBSDE），其适定性尚未在文献中得到解决。我们推导了FBSDE的显式解，这与大多数相关文献中通常找到的没有显式表达式的存在性和唯一性结果形成对比。此外，在最少附加假设下，我们获得了FBSDE解的Malliavin可微性。我们完整地求解了该问题，并找到了控制和价值函数的表达式。最后，我们确定了投资者因忽略可以学习市场风险价格这一事实而遭受的效用损失。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在随机利率和未知市场风险价格（部分信息）下，带有最终期限负债约束的Epstein-Zin递归效用随机控制问题。主要创新是首次引入了负债约束，这导致了一个全耦合的FBSDE。论文导出了该FBSDE的显式解，证明了其Malliavin可微性，并完全求解了资产负债管理问题，确定了最优控制和价值函数，以及忽略风险价格信息造成的效用损失。
AI.keywords: 资产负债管理, Epstein-Zin 效用, 随机利率, 风险价格, FBSDE
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于首次在递归效用文献中引入了负债约束，并导出了相应的全耦合前向-后向随机微分方程（FBSDE）的显式解，这与大多数文献中仅有存在性和唯一性结果但无显式解的情况形成对比。其重要性在于为带有负债约束和不确定风险价格的Epstein-Zin效用下的资产负债管理提供了完整的解析解。限制方面，研究是基于随机控制和FBSDE框架，实际应用可能依赖于模型参数的准确估计。

title: Generative modelling of financial time series with structured noise and MMD-based signature learning
summary:
Generating synthetic financial time series data that accurately reflects
real-world market dynamics holds tremendous potential for various applications,
including portfolio optimization, risk management, and large scale machine
learning. We present an approach that {uses structured noise} for training
generative models for financial time series. The expressive power of the
signature transform {has been shown to be able} to capture the complex
dependencies and temporal structures inherent in financial data {when used to
train generative models in the form of a signature kernel }. We employ a moving
average model to model the variance of the noise input, enhancing the model's
ability to reproduce stylized facts such as volatility clustering. Through
empirical experiments on S\&P 500 index data, we demonstrate that our model
effectively captures key characteristics of financial time series and
outperforms comparable {approaches}. In addition, we explore the application of
the synthetic data generated to train a reinforcement learning agent for
portfolio management, achieving promising results. Finally, we propose a method
to add robustness to the generative model by tweaking the noise input so that
the generated sequences can be adjusted to different market environments with
minimal data.

AI.title_translation: 具有结构化噪声和基于MMD的签名学习的金融时间序列的生成建模
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一种使用结构化噪声和签名学习来生成逼真金融时间序列的新生成模型，该模型能捕获波动性聚类等特征，并在投资组合管理中取得了良好效果，还具备适应不同市场环境的鲁棒性调整能力。
AI.motivation: 生成准确反映现实市场动态的合成金融时间序列数据，可用于投资组合优化、风险管理和大规模机器学习等多种应用。
AI.method: 使用结构化噪声训练生成模型，并利用签名变换（以签名核的形式）来捕获复杂依赖关系和时间结构。采用移动平均模型来模拟噪声输入的方差，以重现波动性聚类等风格化事实。最后，提出了一种通过调整噪声输入来增强模型鲁棒性的方法。
AI.result: 实证实验表明，该模型有效地捕捉了金融时间序列的关键特征，并优于可比较的方法。在利用合成数据训练投资组合管理中的强化学习智能体时也取得了可喜的结果。
AI.conclusion: 该模型有效地捕捉了金融时间序列的关键特征并优于现有方法。此外，生成的合成数据在训练投资组合管理中的强化学习智能体方面取得了可喜的结果。最后，提出了一种通过调整噪声输入来增强模型鲁棒性的方法，使其能够以最小的数据调整适应不同的市场环境。
AI.translation: 生成准确反映现实市场动态的合成金融时间序列数据，在投资组合优化、风险管理和大规模机器学习等各种应用中具有巨大潜力。我们提出了一种使用结构化噪声来训练金融时间序列生成模型的方法。签名变换（以签名核的形式）在用于训练生成模型时，已被证明能够捕获金融数据中固有的复杂依赖关系和时间结构。我们采用移动平均模型来模拟噪声输入的方差，增强了模型重现波动性聚类等风格化事实的能力。通过对S\&P 500指数数据的实证实验，我们证明了我们的模型有效地捕捉了金融时间序列的关键特征，并优于可比较的方法。此外，我们探索了将生成的合成数据应用于训练强化学习智能体以进行投资组合管理，取得了可喜的结果。最后，我们提出了一种通过调整噪声输入来增强生成模型鲁棒性的方法，使得生成的序列能够以最小的数据调整适应不同的市场环境。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种利用结构化噪声和基于MMD的签名学习来生成金融时间序列的新方法。通过使用移动平均模型处理噪声方差，该模型能够更好地重现波动性聚类等市场特征。实验证明了该模型在S\&P 500数据上的有效性，并且生成的合成数据可用于训练投资组合管理的强化学习智能体，同时还提出了一种通过调整噪声输入来增强模型鲁棒性的方法。
AI.keywords: 金融时间序列, 生成模型, 结构化噪声, 签名学习, 投资组合管理
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于结合了结构化噪声和基于MMD的签名学习来生成金融时间序列，特别关注了通过移动平均模型处理噪声方差以重现波动性聚类等特征。其重要性在于为金融应用（如投资组合优化和风险管理）提供了更逼真的合成数据。局限性可能在于模型对特定金融指数（S\&P 500）的有效性尚未在更广泛的市场中得到验证。

title: First order Martingale model risk and semi-static hedging
summary:
We investigate model risk distributionally robust sensitivities for
functionals on the Wasserstein space when the underlying model is constrained
to the martingale class and/or is subject to constraints on the first marginal
law. Our results extend the findings of Bartl, Drapeau, Obloj \& Wiesel
\cite{bartl2021sensitivity} and Bartl \& Wiesel \cite{bartlsensitivityadapted}
by introducing the minimization of the distributionally robust problem with
respect to semi-static hedging strategies. We provide explicit
characterizations of the model risk (first order) optimal semi-static hedging
strategies. The distributional robustness is analyzed both in terms of the
adapted Wasserstein metric and the more relevant standard Wasserstein metric.

AI.title_translation: 一阶鞅模型风险与半静态对冲
AI.tldr: 研究了受鞅约束或边际定律约束的模型下，一阶模型风险的分布鲁棒敏感性，并明确给出了最优的半静态对冲策略。
AI.motivation: 扩展了Bartl等人关于敏感性的现有研究结果，特别是通过引入对半静态对冲策略的最小化，来解决底层模型受限于鞅类或一阶边际定律时的模型风险问题。
AI.method: 通过对函数在沃尔斯泰因空间上的分布鲁棒敏感性进行研究，并引入对半静态对冲策略的最小化，来分析模型风险。具体使用了适应的沃尔斯泰因度量和标准的沃尔斯泰因度量。
AI.result: 提供了模型风险（一阶）最优半静态对冲策略的明确刻画。
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 我们研究了当底层模型受限于鞅类和/或其一阶边际定律受到约束时，沃尔斯泰因空间上泛函的分布鲁棒敏感性。我们的结果通过引入对半静态对冲策略的分布鲁棒问题的最小化，扩展了Bartl、Drapeau、Obloj和Wiesel \cite{bartl2021sensitivity}以及Bartl和Wiesel \cite{bartlsensitivityadapted}的研究发现。我们提供了模型风险（一阶）最优半静态对冲策略的明确刻画。分布鲁棒性是根据适应的沃尔斯泰因度量和更相关的标准沃尔斯泰因度量两个方面进行分析的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了当底层模型受限于鞅类或一阶边际定律时，沃尔斯泰因空间上泛函的分布鲁棒敏感性。研究将分布鲁棒问题的最小化扩展至包含半静态对冲策略，并明确刻画了一阶最优的半静态对冲策略。分析中同时考虑了适应的沃尔斯泰因度量和标准的沃尔斯泰因度量。
AI.keywords: 模型风险, 分布鲁棒性, 鞅, 半静态对冲, 沃尔斯泰因空间
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将分布鲁棒优化问题与半静态对冲策略相结合，并明确刻画了一阶最优的半静态对冲策略。其重要性在于扩展了现有的敏感性分析结果，使其适用于受限于鞅类或一阶边际定律的模型。论文的局限性在于仅关注一阶模型风险，可能未涵盖更复杂的模型不确定性。

title: Differential Beliefs in Financial Markets Under Information Constraints: A Modeling Perspective
summary:
We apply the theory of McKean-Vlasov-type SDEs to study several problems
related to market efficiency in the context of partial information and
partially observable financial markets: (i) convergence of reduced-information
market price processes to the true price process under an increasing
information flow; (ii) a specific mechanism of shrinking biases under
increasing information flows; (iii) optimal aggregation of expert opinions by a
trader seeking a positive alpha. All these problems are studied by means of
(conditional) McKean-Vlasov-type SDEs, Wasserstein barycenters, KL divergence
and relevant tools from convex optimization, optimal control and nonlinear
filtering. We supply the theoretical results in (i)-(iii) with concrete
simulations demonstrating how the proposed models can be applied in practice to
model financial markets under information constraints and the arbitrage-seeking
behavior of traders with differential beliefs.
